jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: "We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time." AI Platform Engineer As an AI Platform Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the foundational components of an enterprise AI platform, enabling secure, scalable, and responsible development and deployment of advanced AI and agentic solutions. You will work across the full AI platform stack, from data ingestion and vector databases to retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, agent platforms, and developer\-facing APIs, enabling teams to rapidly deliver innovative AI\-powered business capabilities. You will collaborate with security, FinOps, platform engineering, data engineering, and application teams to deliver enterprise\-grade AI capabilities that are secure, observable, and cost efficient. Your work will span cloud\-native AI services, agentic architectures, orchestration frameworks, and responsible AI guardrails. You will play a critical role in designing and implementing solutions based on Model Context Protocol (MCP), enterprise AI Gateway patterns, and modern agent platforms including Amazon Bedrock and AWS AgentCore. You will help establish the enterprise standards for model access, agent execution, governance, observability, and cost optimization while enabling a multi\-model AI ecosystem through AI Gateway technologies such as Kong AI Gateway and similar enterprise platforms. You can build and maintain AI platform services: * Design, build, and operate enterprise AI platform capabilities supporting Generative AI, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic workloads. * Develop scalable data ingestion pipelines, knowledge ingestion workflows, and AI data services. * Integrate vector databases, embeddings, knowledge graphs, and enterprise knowledge repositories with appropriate governance controls. * Design and implement retrieval frameworks supporting enterprise search, semantic search, and RAG patterns. * Build and operate AI services using Amazon Bedrock, including foundation model integrations, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, and inference capabilities. * Design and support agentic architectures utilizing AWS AgentCore and other enterprise agent platforms. * Implement model serving infrastructure for real\-time and batch inference workloads. * Enable secure agentic workflows through Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool orchestration frameworks, and agent\-to\-agent communication patterns. * Design and implement AI Gateway capabilities using technologies such as Kong AI Gateway to provide centralized authentication, routing, governance, observability, rate limiting, and policy enforcement for AI workloads. * Develop APIs, SDKs, reusable platform services, and self\-service capabilities that accelerate AI adoption across engineering teams. You ensure observability and responsible AI: * Monitor model performance, application behavior, agent execution, and service reliability. * Implement logging, tracing, alerting, rollback, and operational recovery mechanisms. * Monitor AI usage patterns, token consumption, latency, throughput, and AI Gateway telemetry. * Implement observability solutions that provide visibility into prompts, responses, model behavior, agent interactions, and platform health. * Apply explainability, fairness, governance, and compliance guardrails consistent with Responsible AI principles. * Support model evaluation, benchmarking, experimentation, and lifecycle management processes. You have experience embedding security and compliance: * Design and implement secure AI platform architectures using cloud\-native security controls. * Integrate encryption, IAM, secrets management, and audit logging capabilities. * Implement secure access patterns through AI Gateway platforms including authorization, policy enforcement, prompt security controls, and data protection measures. * Support compliance with regulatory and internal governance frameworks, including privacy, security, and Responsible AI requirements. * Partner with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, and Data Governance teams to ensure safe and compliant use of enterprise data and AI services. * Enable governance for models, agents, prompts, tools, and enterprise knowledge sources. You drive operational excellence: * Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices to ensure reliability, scalability, and operational maturity. * Apply FinOps principles to optimize AI platform utilization, model consumption, and cloud spending. * Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC). * Establish operational standards, platform runbooks, SLA/SLO metrics, and support procedures. * Drive continuous improvements in platform security, performance, resiliency, and developer experience. You collaborate and enable teams: * Partner with software engineers, platform engineers, architects, and product teams to deliver enterprise AI solutions. * Consult with application teams on AI platform integration patterns and best practices. * Create reference architectures, reusable patterns, and implementation guidance. * Develop documentation, runbooks, architectural diagrams, and operational standards. * Mentor team members and help promote adoption of enterprise AI platform capabilities. Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of experience designing, building, and operating distributed platform technologies or cloud\-native systems. * 3\+ years of experience building, operating, or supporting AI/ML platforms and services. * Hands\-on experience with Amazon Bedrock and enterprise foundation model platforms. * Experience designing and implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures using vector databases, embeddings, and enterprise knowledge sources. * Experience building or operating agentic AI systems utilizing AWS AgentCore or comparable agent frameworks. * Experience designing and implementing solutions based on Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience implementing AI Gateway solutions (e.g., Kong AI Gateway or equivalent) for AI governance, traffic management, observability, and security. * Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks, agent\-to\-agent communication patterns, and multi\-agent architectures. * Strong understanding of LLM operations including prompt engineering, model evaluation, guardrails, governance, and token optimization. * Proficiency in Python and/or other languages commonly used for AI and platform engineering. * Experience with AWS cloud services, containerization, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices. * Understanding of observability, monitoring, and operational support for AI and agent\-based systems. * Experience implementing security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls in AI environments. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries. * AWS certifications related to AI, Machine Learning, Cloud Architecture, or Platform Engineering. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Bedrock Guardrails, Agents for Bedrock, and AWS AgentCore services. * Experience with Kong AI Gateway or comparable API and AI Gateway technologies. * Experience implementing MCP servers, tool catalogs, and secure tool execution frameworks. * Experience with enterprise multi\-model strategies spanning Anthropic Claude, Amazon Nova, OpenAI, Google Gemini, and other foundation models. * Familiarity with AI\-specific observability and monitoring platforms. * Experience implementing Responsible AI frameworks, guardrails, explainability, and model governance processes. * Experience with FinOps practices and cost optimization for Generative AI workloads. * Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, and platform engineering practices. * Experience building enterprise self\-service AI platforms and developer enablement capabilities. **Kaleidoscope, an Infosys Company, is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, spouse of protected veteran, or disability.**

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** ==================== The Electrical Engineer applies electrical engineering principles to improve the safety, quality, repeatability, and efficiency of Genie Reconditioning’s heavy\-equipment reconditioning operations. This is a production\-facing manufacturing engineering role, not a product\-design or product\-documentation position. The engineer develops electrical assembly and verification methods and provides advanced technical problem solving for wiring, controls, sensors, and electrical production processes. **Essential Job Functions** =========================== * Provide daily production\-floor engineering support across disassembly, preparation/paint, and assembly operations for Genie mobile elevating work platforms. * Apply engineering analysis and independent technical judgment to diagnose recurring production problems, determine root causes, and implement verified corrective actions. * Develop, validate, document, and improve production processes, standard work, workstation layouts, and assembly methods. * Analyze cycle times, constraints, ergonomics, first\-pass quality, safety, downtime, and rework; implement measurable improvements in throughput and cost. * Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, EHS, and Product Engineering to resolve manufacturing constraints and ensure process readiness. * Specify, evaluate, and support procurement, installation, commissioning, and validation of production tooling and equipment within approved authority. * Lead assigned manufacturing engineering technicians and project teams by setting daily priorities, delegating technical assignments, providing hands\-on coaching and training, monitoring execution, and addressing performance or quality concerns through the Engineering Manager. * Support lean manufacturing, 5S, structured problem solving, and waste\-reduction initiatives. * Participate in open\-book management by tracking relevant engineering metrics (including on\-time delivery, first\-pass acceptance, diagnostic hours per unit, and configuration accuracy), explaining performance drivers, and connecting improvements to operating and financial results. * Maintain engineering process records, electrical BOMs, controller software and configuration records, validation results, technical drawings, and change documentation; escalate product\-design changes to authorized product engineering personnel. * Engineer safe, repeatable processes for electrical teardown, component recovery, harness and panel installation, routing, connector assembly, termination, and verification in reconditioned boom lifts. * Analyze electrical schematics, power distribution, sensors, switches, controllers, control circuits, and machine electrical interfaces to identify manufacturing\-related and intermittent faults and corrective actions. * Develop or improve production test procedures, electrical diagnostic methods, test fixtures, and acceptance criteria; document test results and corrective actions. * Support troubleshooting of electrical and electrohydraulic interfaces in collaboration with mechanical engineering, maintenance, and quality. * Specify electrical test equipment and production tooling; evaluate wiring integrity, grounding, circuit protection, and applicable safety controls within approved engineering standards. **Technical Direction and Authority** ===================================== Exercises independent professional judgment in manufacturing methods, process engineering, technical analysis, and recommendations within approved company standards. May serve as technical team lead for assigned technicians and cross\-functional improvement initiatives, including work planning, task delegation, coaching, and feedback. Formal personnel decisions, including hiring, discipline, termination, and performance ratings, remain with authorized management unless expressly delegated. **Minimum Qualifications** ========================== * Bachelor’s degree (four\-year) in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline with substantial electrical systems coursework. * Three or more years of manufacturing, industrial equipment, or production engineering experience with demonstrated hands\-on problem solving. * Demonstrated ability to independently analyze technical problems, develop engineering solutions, and validate results. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions, and manufacturing documentation. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated ability to lead and develop people, and ability to coordinate technical work effectively on the production floor. * Electrical circuit analysis, electrical schematics, wiring harnesses, sensors, control systems, and electrical measurement techniques. * Proficiency with multimeters, diagnostic tools, electrical test procedures, and electrical safety practices. * Ability to evaluate electrical/electrohydraulic interfaces and distinguish production\-process issues from design\-authority decisions. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience with heavy industrial equipment, aerial work platforms, or equipment reconditioning, including Genie S\-65, S\-85, or S\-125\. * Experience with lean manufacturing, 5S, root cause analysis, process validation, and continuous improvement. * Experience with Infor CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine), production data systems, or comparable ERP/MRP tools. * Experience leading, coaching, mentoring, or coordinating manufacturing engineering technicians or cross\-functional production teams. **Work Environment and Physical Requirements** ============================================== Work occurs in engineering/office areas and on an active industrial production floor with noise, dust, fumes, moving equipment, and variable temperatures. Essential activities include regularly walking and standing to inspect processes; observing machinery and workstations; reading drawings and screens; communicating with employees; and using computers, measuring instruments, and tools. Occasional bending, reaching, and handling of components may be required. Use approved lifting equipment or assistance for heavy items. Required PPE and established machine\-guarding, lockout/tagout, and electrical safety procedures apply when relevant to assigned work. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable qualified individuals to perform essential functions. Production needs may require additional hours. **General Conditions** ====================== Comply with applicable safety, environmental, and quality requirements and company policies. Perform other related duties as assigned, consistent with business needs. Employment offers are contingent on satisfactory completion of applicable background screening and pre\-employment drug screening, conducted in accordance with law and company policy. Genie Reconditioning, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This description identifies principal duties and is not an employment contract; duties may evolve with business needs. Monday through Friday. Extended hours, including evenings and weekends, may be required to meet business needs. 40 hours per week; full\-time, salaried exempt.

For over a decade, we've believed voice builds the strongest business relationships. jobs.title: Field Application Engineer - Data Center Power
jobs.description: About Arete Arete Intelligent Power is building the intelligent power architecture from grid\-to\-chip. As industrial loads push the market toward 800 VDC, the path from the medium\-voltage grid to the point of consumption is being rebuilt — and the hard problem is no longer only conversion, but control. We design conversion, storage, and intelligent power management as a single architecture. Formed in 2025 and headquartered in Fremont, California, Arete serves AI computing, electrified transportation, microgrids, and heavy industry. This role is focused on AI data centers. The Role This is a customer\-facing engineering role. You will spend most of your time in front of other people's engineers — data center architects, OEM hardware teams, and the specifiers who write a basis of design. Your job is to find out what a customer actually needs, often before they can state it themselves, and to translate that into solutions our engineering team can build. You will partner directly with the Commercial Lead. They own the executive relationships, pricing, and the business case. You own technical discovery, architecture validation, and the engineering close. This is a strong fit for a systems architect, power electronics engineer, or site deployment lead who wants to move into a visible commercial role. It is not a design seat. You will not own a schematic. What You Will Do Discovery. Sit with a customer who knows they need 96% efficiency but cannot say what topology, what redundancy, or what safety framework that implies. Ask the questions that surface the real requirement — load profile, input feed, form factor, thermal envelope, what they are replacing, and when. Architecture validation. Develop conceptual designs and integration guidance for HVDC Power Racks, high\-efficiency power shelves, and in\-rack DC\-DC conversion. Assess fit, derating, thermal envelope, and integration risk at the assembly and sub\-assembly level. Technical close. Lead technical responses to RFPs and RFQs. Evaluate hardware specifications against customer requirements and carry the technical argument to a decision. Translation, in both directions. Explain conversion efficiency, intelligent power routing, and topology tradeoffs to people who will not follow the math — including executives and financial buyers. Then carry what you learn in the field back to engineering as a requirement they can build against. Standards engagement. Represent Arete in OCP working groups and at OCP Global Summit. Guide customers on ORv3 and OCP HPR form\-factor fit, and maintain our published conformance position as the open specifications move. Safety and certification support. Field customer and AHJ questions on NEC 645, UL 62368, DC arc\-flash and IEEE 1584 analysis, and DC protection at 800 VDC. Coordinate with internal teams and third\-party engineers on PE\-stamp scope. Global engineering interface. Work daily with our Taiwan\-based R\&D organization — translating customer requirements into engineering\-ready requests, and bringing specification answers back to the field without loss of fidelity. Voice of customer. Give the product and engineering teams direct field feedback that shapes future HVDC architecture and power conversion hardware. Hands\-on support. Assist hardware engineering teams and system integrators through bench testing and prototype validation, to ensure seamless component integration. What You Need Education. BSEE or a closely related technical discipline, with a focus on power electronics. Experience. At least five years in technical applications, pre\-sales engineering, field applications, or power engineering. Experience with server\-level power supplies or power conversion hardware is what we are looking for; adjacent high\-power conversion experience — traction, industrial drives, utility\-scale inverters, energy storage — is credited where the physics and the customer work transfer. A customer\-facing track record. You have sat across from a customer's engineer and walked them through a design tradeoff they did not want to hear. We will ask you for specific examples, by company and by situation. Domain depth. Working proficiency in AC and DC power topologies, with emphasis on HVDC architecture and high\-density DC\-DC and AC\-DC conversion. Physical engineering literacy. You can read a single\-line diagram, evaluate site thermal loads, reason about available grid capacity, and work to HVDC specifications. This role lives in physical constraints, not in a configuration file. Standards familiarity. Working knowledge of Open Compute Project rack and power specifications (ORv3, OCP HPR), and of the safety and certification framework governing data center power — NEC 645, UL 62368, IEEE 1584\. Direct OCP working\-group participation is a plus, not a requirement; we expect to build that presence with you. Component knowledge. Analytical understanding of power electronics components and their performance characteristics in high\-heat, high\-load environments. Professional Skills Customer\-facing judgment. Exceptional communication, with a record of guiding hardware engineers and executive stakeholders through complex technical evaluations. Collaborative execution. Demonstrated success working across account executives, OEM hardware developers, and internal product managers. International fluency. Comfortable across time zones and cultures, including regular early\-morning coordination with engineering teams in Taiwan, and periodic international travel. Mandarin is a strong plus. Employment Basics Type: Full\-time, exempt Location: Fremont, California. Onsite, with flexibility around the early\-morning engineering cadence. Travel: Approximately 20%, domestic and international. Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus paid time off. Work authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Arete is not sponsoring employment visas for this position at this time. Essential Functions and Work Environment Travel: Regular travel of approximately 20%, domestic and international, including air travel. Site access: Access to customer data center and laboratory environments, including areas containing energized electrical equipment, subject to site safety and personal protective equipment requirements. Hands\-on work: Bench work with rack\-level hardware, including occasional lifting and positioning of equipment up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation. Schedule: Regular early\-morning video conferences to coordinate with engineering teams in Asia. Workstation: Prolonged periods working at a computer. Reasonable accommodation. Applicants who require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process may contact hr@arete\-power.com. Equal opportunity. Arete Intelligent Power is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, reproductive health decisionmaking, marital status, age (40 and over), national origin, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Name one power conversion product you personally debugged in the field. What failed, and how did you find it? * Name a customer you personally walked through a design decision. What did they want, what did you recommend, and did they take it? * This role requires regular early\-morning video calls with our engineering team in Taiwan, and approximately 20% travel. Are you able to work that schedule? Experience: * power electronics or power conversion: 5 years (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Fremont, CA 94538 (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **About Bidfinite** Bidfinite is a fantasy auction game for car people. We also publish a shitty YouTube show that reviews, predicts and ridicules the collector\-car auction world. Fact, none of your friends are subscribed. **About the role** Still reading? We're hiring a contract developer, or a fractional full\-stack dev to join us as a trusted partner, to take Bidfinite from test mode through two launches: a public free\-play launch, then a launch with paid contests. The work is across three build phases. You choose how you're paid, from all cash to a mix of cash and equity that vests when each launch ships. We have had a POC running, tested it with car clubs and friends, but it was done on a tactical foundation. It was uglier than a 1 gen Honda Ridgeline, but it helped us improve game play. **What you'll build** You'll work directly with the founders to turn a working test\-mode game into a product ready for thousands of players hungry to put their useful and useless car knowledge to the test. Working from a Figma board and our working POC, you'll own features end to end, from design notes through shipped code, and help us make practical calls on architecture and tooling. **What we're looking for** * You've shipped at least one web app or game with real users and live, time\-sensitive data. * You've built secure sites with cash payments, ledgers, etc. * You're a beast in modern full\-stack web development: a front\-end framework, an API layer, and a relational database. Note: We have a solid front\-end dev, so if you're a car enthusiast with back\-end chops, reach out anyway. * You've built features that depend on outside data sources, such as scraped or third\-party listing data, and kept them reliable. * You've built real\-time or near\-real\-time features: countdowns, live updates, scoring, and leaderboards. * You work well in a small team: you scope, estimate, and flag risks early. * You can deal with two lifelong friends who sling slander and sarcasm, but it (probably) won't be aimed at you. Flexible on cash v. equity, but this is a boot\-strapped endeavor. Final hours, equity, and IP terms will be set out in a written agreement. **How to apply** You made it this far? Then you should email paul@bidfinite.com with the subject "Bidfinite contract developer" and include: * Links to one or two apps or games you shipped, and what you built on each * The pay option you'd lean toward, or questions about the options * Your availability and start date * 3 cars you hate, 3 cars you’ll buy when we all strike it rich We'll reply within 24 hours. Shortlisted applicants will have a quick call with the founders and, ideally, an IRL meetup. We do not discriminate on race or sex, but we’re douchey about car preferences. jobs.title: HPC Data Center Ops Engineer
jobs.description: **About San Francisco Compute** =============================== San Francisco Compute exists to give ambitious teams large scale supercomputers without taking on a catastrophic balance sheet risk. Most GPU clouds force you to sign long term contracts with no way out. If you underbuy, you miss the window. If you overbuy, you’ll blow up with no way out. It’s a desperate gamble that San Francisco Compute does not force you to play. Originally, SFC was an AI lab that bought too big of a GPU cluster and was forced to sublease it or go under. Today, we build data centers and supercomputers, then lease those machines on contracts that let our customers sublease. More than anyone else in the industry, we deeply felt the pain and fear of being forced to bet the farm with your neocloud vendor. To enable subleasing, we invented the first compute market and became the first to offer physical settlement. That means we operate GPU clusters like a neocloud and derisk our customers like a market. Customers buying GPU clusters don’t want to work through a network of brokers. They want to transact with the folks that have the keys to the cluster and can own the SLA. To keep the industry safe from unnecessary risk, SFC needs to scale fast. To do that, we serve financially motivated parties as a technical partner to build, operate, \& lease supercomputers on their behalf. Basically, we help folks who want an economic return build GPU clusters on their balance sheet, but operated in full by us. That lets us retain the technical control needed to run a cloud while scaling fast like a market. SFC’s ability to offer subleasing can significantly increase the levered returns for cluster owners. Our hybrid model outperforms brokered contracts or other “compute markets,” which have to go through a network of counterparties to solve problems. It also lets us design custom solutions for our customers, like clusters deployed in regions next to your dataset or physical eval set or a large CPU fleet deployed colocated with your GPU cluster. Our team includes senior \& technical leadership from places like Lambda, Crusoe, Digital Ocean, AWS, and Hut8\. Our CTO is the cofounder and former CEO of Voltage Park. In prior roles, our team has deployed 8GW of datacenter capacity \& hundreds of thousands of GPUs. We’ve been described as having “the highest talent density in the space.” If you are an honorable, gritty person with eyes wide open \& good epistemics, who wants to see AI go right, we’d love to work with you. There has never been a more critical moment in history and it is up to us to shape it on behalf of those who come after us. **About The Role** ------------------ Please note \- This role is based in our San Francisco office. Our clusters don’t run themselves. Someone has to pull the failed tray, chase the bad optic that’s flapping a link at 3am, and make sure the spare was already on the shelf before anyone needed it. That’s this role, and it’s as hands\-on as it gets. From racking and commissioning systems to replacing failed components, managing fiber, transceivers, liquid cooling, and maintaining accurate asset records. You’ll also manage procurement, including BOMs, vendor quotes, lead times, spares, warranties, and RMAs. Around 80% of the role focuses on data center operations and procurement, with 20% supporting office IT. Regular visits to local facilities and occasional travel to remote sites are required. You’ll work with cutting\-edge infrastructure, including HGX/DGX\-class GPU systems, InfiniBand and 400G\+ networks, high\-density power, and liquid cooling. As part of a small team, you’ll also help establish standards, develop runbooks, and mentor future team members. **About You** ------------- * You are based in the San Francisco Bay Area, and you have 5\+ years in data center operations, infrastructure support, or systems administration, with real hands\-on hardware and cabling responsibility * You know fiber — high\-density trunks and breakouts, end\-face inspection and cleaning, transceiver swaps — and you can tell a dirty connector from a dying optic * You’ve replaced server FRUs and racked, cabled, and commissioned equipment, and you work safely in and around energized racks * You’ve bought hardware, not just installed it: BOMs, vendor quotes, POs, receiving, warranty, and RMAs are familiar territory * You keep inventory and asset records that would survive an audit, across more than one site * You’re comfortable with TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, out\-of\-band management (IPMI, iDRAC, iLO, Redfish), and the Linux command line * You’re open to occasional travel to remote sites and to after\-hours maintenance windows when the work requires it **Some Nice To Haves** ---------------------- * Experience in HPC, GPU, or other high\-density compute environments, including HGX\- or DGX\-class platforms and rack\-scale designs * Experience with InfiniBand or high\-rate Ethernet at 400G and above * Experience with liquid cooling — CDUs, manifolds, and direct\-to\-chip cold plates * Colocation experience and familiarity with the tenant/operator relationship * NetBox or similar DCIM, and procurement or ERP systems * Scripting for automation and inventory reconciliation (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) * Enterprise wireless (Meraki, Ubiquiti, Aruba, Mist), MDM (Jamf, Intune, Kandji), and identity providers (Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID) * Certifications such as CompTIA Server\+, Cisco CCNA, or NVIDIA credentials **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- This job is physical. With or without reasonable accommodation, you’ll need to lift and position equipment up to 50 lbs unassisted (heavier chassis by team lift), work at elevation and in confined spaces behind racks, stand and walk for extended periods, handle fine motor work with optics and liquid\-cooling quick\-disconnects, work in sustained cold\-aisle temperatures and elevated noise (hearing protection provided), read small\-format labels and status indicators, and wear required PPE. **Benefits** ============ **Generous equity grant** ------------------------- Team members are offered a competitive salary along with equity in the company **Retirement matching** ----------------------- We match 401(k) plans up to 4% **Medical, dental \& vision** ----------------------------- We offer highly competitive medical, dental, vision insurance for employees and dependents. **Time off** ------------ We offer unlimited paid time off as well as 10\+ observed holidays **Parental leave** ------------------ We offer biological, adoptive, and foster parents paid time off to spend quality time with family **Daily lunch** --------------- We cover lunch daily for employees **Unlimited office book budget** -------------------------------- You can buy as many books for the office as you want The San Francisco Compute Company is committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. We make employment decisions based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, belief, national origin, social or ethical origin, age, physical, mental, or sensory disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, HIV status, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status including pregnancy, or any other status protected by law. We welcome the opportunity to consider qualified applicants with prior arrest or conviction records. Our commitment to diversity includes hiring talented individuals regardless of their criminal history, in accordance with local, state, and federal laws, including San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance and California’s ban\-the\-box laws.

jobs.title: Integration Engineer
jobs.description: Exthymic is an early\-stage deep\-tech startup on a mission to prevent millions of cancer deaths by making curative cell therapies widely accessible. Our platform enables the manufacturing of patient\-specific treatments at the point of care. Led by experienced industry pioneers, we blend hardware, software, and biochemical engineering to disrupt the status quo and democratize life\-saving therapies. Join us to solve complex challenges and drive global healthcare innovation. ### **About You** You are a hands\-on engineer who builds and tests hardware. You can assemble an instrument from drawings, write and run its test plan, and document both well enough for someone else to repeat the work. Our instrument combines fluidics, optics, thermal control, motion, electronics, software, and cell biology. You work across all of them with the engineers and scientists who design each subsystem, and you can make progress when drawings are incomplete and priorities shift. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Assemble and integrate instruments \- Build prototype instruments, subassemblies, and test rigs, including mechanical assembly, fluidic plumbing, cable harnesses, and sensor and actuator hookup. Bring up new builds with the design engineers, document deviations and fixes, and report assembly issues back to design. * Plan tests \- Work with design engineers and scientists to turn requirements into test plans and protocols with clear acceptance criteria, sample sizes, and measurement methods. Plan test campaigns for subsystems and the integrated instrument around upcoming design decisions. * Execute tests \- Run bench and integration tests on prototypes, subsystems, and full instruments, covering flow and volume accuracy, pressure, leak integrity, and thermal, optical, motion, and electrical performance. Support cell\-based runs with our scientists, and build and maintain the fixtures and test harnesses the tests need. * Document and analyze results \- Write test reports that support design verification, and maintain traceability from requirements to test results. Characterize failures, file reproducible issue reports, and support root cause investigation and retest. * Keep instruments running \- Maintain our prototype instruments and test equipment, including preventive maintenance, calibration, cleaning, spare parts, and a record of each unit's hardware and software revision. Diagnose and repair faults, and help automate data capture and instrument health checks. * Improve assembly instructions and SOPs \- Follow our assembly instructions and SOPs as you build and test, and report what is unclear, wrong, or missing. Work with their authors on revisions. * Mentor teammates \- Train and mentor junior engineers and technicians on assembly, test execution, and documentation. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, biomedical, or mechatronics engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 3 or more years of experience in instrument assembly, integration, test, or manufacturing engineering, preferably on electromechanical or laboratory instruments. * Hands\-on build skills: mechanical assembly from drawings, wiring and cable harnessing, fluidic tubing and fittings, and safe use of hand and power tools. * Troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, fluidic, and software faults using multimeters, oscilloscopes, pressure and flow sensors, and data acquisition systems. * Experience writing and executing test protocols and documenting builds and tests so others can reproduce them. * Ability to read CAD models (Onshape or similar) and electrical schematics. * Experience analyzing test data and drawing conclusions from it. * Willingness to work with biological systems and learn aseptic technique. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience integrating and testing fluidic, optical, thermal, or motion control systems. * Experience maintaining and calibrating lab or production equipment, or supporting equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ). * Test automation or data acquisition scripting (Python, LabVIEW, or similar). * Experience with embedded controllers, sensors, and motor drivers. * Exposure to design controls, ISO 13485, or GMP documentation practices. * Mammalian cell culture or biology lab experience. * Early\-stage startup experience. **Benefits** Competitive salary and benefits package, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and 401k match. **Salary Range:** $90,000 \- $110,000, commensurate with experience **Benefits:** We offer our employees comprehensive benefits, including medical, vision, and dental coverage, as well as retirement savings plans. Optional benefits include accident and term life offerings. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** Exthymic Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 and over), disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, reproductive health decision\-making, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We comply with all applicable equal employment opportunity laws and will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and employment process. **Agencies:** We work directly with candidates and do not accept unsolicited resumes or referrals from recruitment agencies, search firms, or staffing companies. Any resumes submitted by an agency without a signed agreement in place will be considered the property of Exthymic and no fee will be owed. If you are interested in partnering with us on a future search, please contact our HR team directly.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** ==================== The Mechanical Engineer applies mechanical engineering principles to improve the safety, quality, repeatability, and efficiency of Genie Reconditioning’s heavy\-equipment reconditioning operations so the factory meets required mix and rate with fewer total labor and rework hours per unit. This is a production\-facing manufacturing engineering role, not a product\-design or product\-documentation position. The engineer develops manufacturing methods and provides advanced technical problem solving for mechanical, hydraulic, structural, and assembly processes. **Essential Job Functions** =========================== * Provide daily production\-floor engineering support across disassembly, preparation/paint, and assembly operations for Genie mobile elevating work platforms. * Apply engineering analysis and independent technical judgment to diagnose recurring production problems, determine root causes, and implement verified corrective actions. * Develop, validate, document, deploy, and improve production processes, ERP routings, standard work, workstation layouts, factory flow, common infrastructure, and assembly methods. * Conduct time studies and labor analysis; analyze cycle times, bottleneck constraints, ergonomics, first\-pass quality, safety, downtime, and rework; implement measurable improvements in throughput, cost, and total labor and rework hours per unit, verified at the whole\-unit level. * Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, EHS, and Product Engineering to resolve manufacturing constraints and ensure process readiness. * Specify, evaluate, and support procurement, installation, commissioning, and validation of production tooling and equipment within approved authority. * Direct two manufacturing engineering technicians and project teams by setting daily priorities, delegating technical assignments, providing hands\-on coaching and training, monitoring execution, and addressing performance or quality concerns through the Engineering Manager. * Own labor control and the continuous improvement program (CIP); support lean manufacturing, 5S, structured problem solving, and waste\-reduction initiatives, and ensure savings are sustained. * Participate in open\-book management by tracking key engineering metrics (total labor per unit, rework hours per unit, bottleneck capacity, and sustained savings), explaining performance drivers, and connecting improvements to operating and financial results. * Maintain engineering process records, validation results, technical drawings, and change documentation; escalate product\-design changes to authorized product engineering personnel. * Engineer mechanical assembly, disassembly, alignment, fit\-up, fastening, and torque\-control processes for boom lifts and related equipment. * Analyze hydraulic and mechanical systems, components, interfaces, and failure modes; develop safe and repeatable production troubleshooting and verification methods. * Design or specify fixtures, jigs, lifting/positioning aids, tooling, and ergonomic improvements using engineering calculations and appropriate CAD tools. * Evaluate structural and mechanical assembly tolerances, material handling methods, fastening integrity, and process capability; coordinate any product\-design deviations through authorized channels. * Develop mechanical process trials, tooling acceptance criteria, equipment specifications, and documented validation plans. **Technical Direction and Authority** ===================================== Exercises independent professional judgment in manufacturing methods, process engineering, technical analysis, and recommendations within approved company standards. May serve as technical team lead for assigned technicians and cross\-functional improvement initiatives, including work planning, task delegation, coaching, and feedback. Formal personnel decisions, including hiring, discipline, termination, and performance ratings, remain with authorized management unless expressly delegated. **Minimum Qualifications** ========================== * Bachelor’s degree (four\-year) in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering with substantial mechanical coursework, or a closely related engineering discipline. * Three or more years of manufacturing, industrial equipment, or production engineering experience with demonstrated hands\-on problem solving. * Demonstrated ability to independently analyze technical problems, develop engineering solutions, and validate results. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions, and manufacturing documentation. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated ability to lead and develop people, ability to coordinate technical work effectively on the production floor, and a practical, collaborative approach with a sense of urgency and a willingness to listen to production associates. * Mechanical design and manufacturing principles; hydraulics, pneumatics, mechanical power transmission, fasteners, tolerances, and structural assemblies. * Ability to interpret mechanical drawings, GD\&T, specifications, and assembly requirements. * CAD proficiency (e.g., SolidWorks or equivalent) and engineering\-based tooling/fixture evaluation. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience with heavy industrial equipment, aerial work platforms, or equipment reconditioning, including Genie S\-65, S\-85, or S\-125\. * Experience with lean manufacturing, 5S, root cause analysis, process validation, and continuous improvement. * Experience with Infor CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine), production data systems, or comparable ERP/MRP tools. * Experience leading, coaching, mentoring, or coordinating manufacturing engineering technicians or cross\-functional production teams. **Work Environment and Physical Requirements** ============================================== Work occurs in engineering/office areas and on an active industrial production floor with noise, dust, fumes, moving equipment, and variable temperatures. Essential activities include regularly walking and standing to inspect processes; observing machinery and workstations; reading drawings and screens; communicating with employees; and using computers, measuring instruments, and tools. Occasional bending, reaching, and handling of components may be required. Use approved lifting equipment or assistance for heavy items. Required PPE and established machine\-guarding, lockout/tagout, and electrical safety procedures apply when relevant to assigned work. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable qualified individuals to perform essential functions. Production needs may require additional hours. **General Conditions** ====================== Comply with applicable safety, environmental, and quality requirements and company policies. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Biological Engineering, ML, or Lab System
jobs.description: **Member of Technical Staff \- Biological Engineering, ML, or Lab System** **About the role** Acelegen combines biology, AI, and laboratory automation to accelerate scientific discovery and drug development. Our platform connects protein evolution in living human cells, RNA sequence\-to\-function mapping, and AI\-assisted laboratory workflows. We are seeking hands\-on scientists and engineers to develop this platform and advance our discovery programs. You will own a defined technical problem from initial design through implementation, validation, and iteration. Depending on your background, your work will focus on one of the following areas. Candidates should **bring depth in at least one of the following areas** and be comfortable collaborating across disciplines. **1\. Member of Technical Staff — Protein \& RNA Engineering** Develop experimental systems that measure and improve how proteins and RNA function in human cells. Responsibilities: * Design and execute protein evolution or RNA screening campaigns, defining functional objectives, experimental controls, and criteria for selecting promising variants. * Develop and optimize cellular assays that measure outcomes such as protein expression, binding, signaling, or cell fitness. * Generate and interpret sequencing, flow cytometry, or reporter assay data to connect sequence changes with biological function. * Investigate variability and failed experiments, improve reproducibility, and document protocols that other researchers can reliably execute. * Collaborate with computational scientists to select designs for testing and turn experimental results into datasets for model development.Relevant qualifications: * Hands\-on experience in molecular biology and mammalian cell culture, with demonstrated ability to develop and troubleshoot assays. * Experience in at least one relevant area: protein engineering, directed evolution, CRISPR technologies, RNA biology, or pooled functional screening. * Familiarity with quantitative experimental analysis. Experience with primary human cells, sequencing library preparation, or high\-throughput assays is a plus. **2\. Member of Technical Staff — Machine Learning \& Model Training** Train and improve protein and RNA models using Acelegen’s experimental data. You will own model development from training data preparation and objective design through large\-scale training, evaluation, and experimental validation. Responsibilities: * Develop training pipelines for pretraining, continued pretraining, and fine\-tuning biological sequence models. * Design training objectives that connect protein and RNA sequences to experimentally measured function, including the effects of interacting mutations and cellular context. * Build training datasets from experimental screens, with rigorous filtering, normalization, versioning, and train–validation–test splits. * Run systematic experiments across model architectures, training objectives, data mixtures, and hyperparameters; use ablations to identify what drives improvements. * Optimize training efficiency and stability through distributed training, mixed precision, memory optimization, profiling, and reliable checkpointing. * Evaluate models on unseen sequences and experimental conditions, and work with scientists to validate model\-generated designs and incorporate new measurements into subsequent training rounds.Relevant qualifications: * Strong Python skills and hands\-on experience implementing and training deep learning models in PyTorch, JAX, or a comparable framework. * Practical understanding of transformer architectures, optimization methods, loss functions, and training dynamics, including diagnosing unstable training and overfitting. * Experience building reproducible training pipelines and running GPU\-based experiments, with systematic experiment tracking and model evaluation. * Demonstrated ownership of a substantial model training project, from dataset preparation through evaluation, in research or production. * Experience with distributed training, biological foundation models, sequence generation, or learning from experimental feedback is a plus. **3\. Member of Technical Staff — AI Laboratory Systems \& Automation** Build software and integrations that connect experimental planning, laboratory execution, and structured feedback. Responsibilities: * Develop tools that translate experimental plans into traceable workflows and capture their execution. * Build pipelines that connect protocols, video, timestamps, annotations, and assay results. * Integrate AI assistants with laboratory software and instruments to support researchers during experiments. * Develop evaluations for recognizing laboratory actions, detecting procedural errors, and assessing whether recorded evidence supports an experimental conclusion. * Debug systems in the laboratory and improve their reliability, usability, and recovery from failures.Relevant qualifications: * Strong software engineering skills, including Python, APIs, data pipelines, testing, and debugging. * Experience building systems used in real workflows, with attention to logging, traceability, and failure handling. * Experience in at least one relevant area: laboratory automation, instrument integration, AI agents, computer vision, or multimodal systems. Familiarity with wet\-lab workflows is a plus. **Requirements** * A Master's degree in a relevant scientific or engineering field, or equivalent practical experience. * Evidence of completing substantial hands\-on work, such as a validated assay, research project, model, or deployed system. * Ability to define milestones, investigate unexpected results, and communicate technical decisions clearly. * Careful documentation and a collaborative approach to working across biology and engineering. * Availability to work on\-site five days per week. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Stock Option Plan

effective change leader: you earn trust with technical peers, influence how teams work, and turn new tools and practices into durable habits * You are eager to invent new ways of working with LLMs and action * You operate with a tech\-lead mentality regardless of title or years of experience **Requirements** ---------------- * Strong generalist engineering ability across the full stack: Linux, environments, including NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, NCCL, and InfiniBand/RDMA * Experience supporting CI for large open\-source projects with 100\+ contributors * Experience building observable, stress testing, resilient CI/CD, and systematic reduction of flaky tests **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * Highly competitive salary and equity * Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents * Strong 401(k) match * Meals and snacks on us \+ discretionary productivity budget *Strong preference for in\-person in Palo Alto or Brooklyn.* **About Inco** ============== Inco AI (inco.ai) builds the agent\-native inference platform for tomorrow's token economics. Through hardware\-model co\-design, it turns any GPU fleet into efficient token production, trains inference\-aware models on each customer's real traffic, and deploys portably across heterogeneous compute. We've raised $20M\+ and are already building for customers: bare\-metal neoclouds and alternative hardware providers looking to differentiate their compute as inference infrastructure, and agentic software companies for whom inference cost is the line between viable and broken margins. We're the team behind industry\-defined techniques such as AWQ, DFlash, and TensorRT\-LLM, with combined decades in AI efficiency leadership and prior successful exits. Our researchers and engineers work where frontier research meets production. We operate on five principles: * **Operate at the frontier.** The field moves every day, and so do we. We reinvent ourselves constantly and push the frontier forward with our research. We keep process light and decisions fast, so a good idea reaches production in days, not quarters. Legacy doesn’t slow us down. * **Mission over individuals.** We are obsessed with our customers and humble in pursuit of the goal. We share credit, name mistakes early, and change our minds when the evidence says so. The question is always what moves the mission forward, never who was right. * **Amplify with agents.** Code is free now; architecture and process aren’t. We hand agents everything they can own, from code to operations, and spend our own time on design, judgment, and the problems only people can solve. * **Protect the maker’s time.** Focus is our scarcest resource. We keep meetings few and protect long, uninterrupted stretches of work. jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **About Citadel Aviation** Citadel Aviation has grown from a startup vision into a global leader in V/VVIP aircraft completions, maintenance, modifications, and luxury interiors. Located in Lake Charles, Dallas, and serving customers onsite where they're at, our teams deliver work on some of the most sophisticated narrow and wide body aircraft in the world. We have significantly expanded project volume since 2019, and that growth was built by people who take pride in doing the work right. Whatever your role, Citadel is a place to bring what you know and build what comes next. **Purpose** =========== The Software Developer builds and maintains the applications and integrations that serve Citadel's internal teams and external customers, with modern AI\-assisted development as a core part of how the work gets done. The role builds AI\-enabled features, automation, and decision\-support capabilities into Citadel's applications where they advance business outcomes, stays current as AI tools and workflows advance, manages assigned development work, and is accountable for the quality, reliability, and ongoing support of the applications it builds and maintains. This position reports to the Manager \- Software Development and partners with IT leadership and peers across IT and the broader business to ensure exceptional service to Citadel's internal and external customers, embodying Citadel's ethos of trust, respect, and collaboration. **Responsibilities** ==================== **Application Development \& AI\-Assisted Delivery** * Design, build, test, and ship business applications, integrations, and automation that serve Citadel's internal teams and external customers. * Use AI\-assisted development tools as a core part of the daily workflow; apply current best practices for prompting, task decomposition, context management, and output review, and bring proven advances into the team's practice as the field evolves. * Apply rigorous review discipline to AI\-generated code, including correctness validation, security review against known vulnerability patterns, test\-coverage verification, and adherence to Citadel's coding standards; maintain clear judgment about when AI tools can take the work and when human design, review, or rewrite is required. * Build AI\-enabled features and agent\-assisted workflows into Citadel's applications where they advance business outcomes, applying current patterns for prompting, context, tool use, evaluation, and safety controls. * Monitor and manage the cost of AI usage across development workflows and AI\-enabled features; share workflow learnings, prompts, and reusable patterns with the development team. **Business Partnership \& Portfolio Support** * Work directly with assigned business departments to understand workflows, identify opportunities, and build tools that improve how the business operates; partner with stakeholders from concept through prototyping, rollout, adoption, and ongoing support. * Maintain and modernize the existing application portfolio; pay down technical debt, address security and compliance findings, and keep applications current with platform and dependency updates. * Integrate applications with Citadel's core platforms, including ERP, finance, identity, and other operational systems, through APIs and data flows. * Build reporting and analytics deliverables for business consumers using Power BI, Crystal Reports, and the data flows that feed them. **Technical Craft \& Operations** * Develop in Citadel's primary stack (.NET, C\#, web technologies, SQL Server) with the supporting toolchain (Visual Studio, Git, IDE integrations, and AI assistants); design and maintain database schemas, queries, stored procedures, and reporting data flows. * Apply secure development practices, including input validation, secrets management, authentication and authorization controls, dependency management, and peer code review. * Perform in line with established sprint commitments, quality targets, and team KPIs; participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and peer code review. * Take ownership of incidents and issues in applications built or maintained by this role; participate in on\-call coverage as scheduled, diagnose and fix issues, communicate root cause and resolution, and maintain runbooks and technical documentation. * Identify and propose improvements in architecture, integration patterns, reusable components, deployment, and technical debt, and lead approved initiatives through delivery. **Requirements** ================ **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline (equivalent professional experience considered in lieu of degree). * 3\+ years of professional software development experience. * Hands\-on experience with .NET, C\#, and modern web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a current frontend framework). * Hands\-on experience with SQL Server, including writing queries and s gging, and test creation), with a demonstrated practice of validating, reviewing, and refining AI\-generated code before it reaches production; working familiarity with at least one mainstream tool such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or comparable. * Experience supporting applications in production, including diagnosing issues, addressing user\-reported bugs, and managing release coordination. * Demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical business stakeholders. * Demonstrated experience writing secure, maintainable, and well\-documented code. **Preferred** * Experience in aviation, aerospace, manufacturing, MRO, or other regulated operational environments. * Experience building AI\-enabled features into business applications, including large language model integration, retrieval patterns, prompt engineering, or agentic workflows. * Experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Devin, or comparable) and judgment about when to delegate work to agents. * Experience integrating with or supporting ERP and other operational business platforms (Microsoft Dynamics GP, Corridor Aviation, or comparable). * Experience with reporting platforms such as Power BI or Crystal Reports. * Experience with Python or Node.js as a complement to the .NET stack. * Familiarity with CI/CD build and release pipelines, and agile methodologies. **Working Conditions** ====================== * This position is considered OFFICE WORK, performed almost exclusively indoors during the day and occasionally at night. * Occasional exposure to airborne dust in the workplace; work surface is stable (flat). * Considered LIGHT work with frequent lifting up to 20 lbs; occasional climbing, stooping, kneeling, squatting, and reaching, with repetitive movements of arms and hands and seated work with back supported. * After\-hours and on\-call work is required for critical systems support and incident response. * Occasional travel to other Citadel sites for stakeholder embedding, project work, or collaboration; typically infrequent and primarily local or regional, with overnight travel only as project demands require. * May require flexible shifts, overtime, weekends, or holidays based on business demand. **Knowledge, Skills, and Other Attributes** =========================================== * Strong technical proficiency in .NET, C\#, SQL Server, and modern web development. * Working knowledge of API design and system\-integration patterns. * Strong fluency with AI\-assisted development tools and judgment about when to apply them, when human design and review is required, and how to verify outputs against common failure modes (security vulnerabilities, paper tests, over\-engineered solutions, architectural drift). * Ability to design clean, maintainable, and secure application architecture appropriate to the scope of the work. * Strong troubleshooting and debugging discipline, with a bias toward identifying and resolving root cause. * Project\-management and prioritization skills across simultaneous tasks and stakeholders. * Strong written and verbal communication with both technical peers and business stakeholders, including the ability to translate technical concepts for senior leadership audiences. * Customer\-service mindset, treating business stakeholders as partners in shipping the right thing. * Self\-motivated, adaptable, and willing to engage across the full lifecycle from idea through production support. **Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ *Citadel Aviation, LLC. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Cobalt Assembly** *Build, ship, and operate software with confidence.* **Headquarters:** San Francisco, California **Industry:** Cloud infrastructure and developer tools Cobalt Assembly develops a cloud platform that helps engineering teams build, deploy, monitor, and operate production software. Its customers include technology companies and large digital businesses that need reliable infrastructure without forcing every development team to manage complex cloud systems independently. The company is recognized for technically demanding work, a high engineering bar, and products designed primarily for professional software developers. **Software Engineer — Developer Platform** **Location:** San Francisco, California **Work arrangement:** Hybrid — four office days, with Friday available for remote work **Employment:** Full\-time, salaried and exempt **Schedule:** Monday through Friday **Hours:** Approximately 40–45 hours per week **Base salary:** $180,000–$220,000, depending on experience, skills, and interview level **Annual cash bonus:** Not offered for this position **Equity:** Initial grant valued at approximately $160,000–$320,000 over four years **Estimated annualized compensation:** $220,000–$300,000 at the initial grant\-date equity value **Reports to:** Engineering Manager, Developer Platform **On\-call:** Approximately one week every ten weeks The role Cobalt Assembly is hiring a Software Engineer to build the tools and services that other engineering teams use to develop, test, deploy, and monitor production applications. You will work on internal APIs, deployment workflows, developer tooling, and shared cloud infrastructure. This is a mid\-level individual\-contributor position with ownership of meaningful projects, but it does not include direct reports. What you’ll do * Build services and APIs that support application deployment, configuration, and production operations. * Improve developer workflows from local development through testing and release. * Design reliable systems for service discovery, permissions, deployment history, and configuration management. * Work with product engineers to identify recurring development problems and turn them into reusable platform capabilities. * Improve platform observability, automated testing, documentation, and operational readiness. * Investigate production incidents and implement changes that prevent similar failures. * Review code and technical proposals from engineers across the company. * Participate in architecture discussions and document important technical decisions. * Join the platform on\-call rotation after completing onboarding and readiness training. What we’re looking for * At least three years of professional software engineering experience. * Production experience with Go, Java, Python, TypeScript, or another modern programming language. * Experience building backend services, APIs, or internal developer tools. * Working knowledge of relational databases and distributed\-system fundamentals. * Understanding of testing, code review, version control, and continuous delivery. * Ability to diagnose problems using logs, metrics, traces, and production data. * Clear written and verbal communication. * Experience owning a project from initial design through production release. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline is helpful but not required. Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, CI/CD systems, or developer\-platform engineering is helpful but not required. Technology The platform primarily uses Go, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS. Candidates do not need experience with the entire stack and will receive time to learn unfamiliar components. Compensation and equity The base salary is determined by relevant experience, technical scope, interview performance, and internal leveling. This position does not include an annual cash bonus. Instead, employees receive an equity grant that normally vests over four years, subject to the company’s equity plan and continued employment. The stated equity value is calculated at the time of the grant. Its future value may increase or decrease and is not guaranteed. Equity should not be treated as cash salary. Benefits * **Health and wellbeing:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees; dependent coverage subsidy; mental\-health support; life and disability insurance. * **Retirement and financial:** 401(k) with a 4% company match, pre\-tax commuter benefits, and access to financial\-planning resources. * **Time away and family:** 20 days of annual PTO, company holidays, paid sick leave, and 16 weeks of paid parental leave. * **Professional development:** $3,000 annual learning budget, conference support, technical mentorship, and dedicated engineering\-learning days. * **Office and work support:** Company laptop and home\-office equipment, lunch on office days, commuter reimbursement, and relocation assistance when approved. Eligibility and complete plan terms are provided in the official benefits documentation. Schedule and on\-call expectations Most collaboration takes place between 10:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. Pacific Time. Engineers may arrange the remainder of their schedule with their manager. After onboarding, the engineer joins an on\-call rotation approximately once every ten weeks. On\-call engineers respond to urgent platform incidents outside regular hours. When substantial overnight work is required, the following workday’s schedule is adjusted. What success looks like Within the first 90 days, you will understand the platform architecture, deliver a production contribution, and complete on\-call readiness training. Within six months, you should independently lead a platform improvement used by multiple engineering teams and demonstrate sound judgment during design reviews and production incidents. Success is measured through reliability, adoption, developer experience, and long\-term system quality—not the number of code changes submitted. Culture Cobalt Assembly combines high technical standards with a practical approach to engineering. Employees are expected to challenge unclear requirements, explain tradeoffs, and take responsibility for the systems they operate. The team prefers simple, well\-understood solutions over unnecessary novelty. Code reviews are direct but respectful, and engineers are expected to share knowledge rather than protect individual areas of ownership. Hiring process * A 30\-minute introductory call with a member of the Engineering Recruiting team. * A 60\-minute collaborative coding interview in a shared development environment. * A technical interview covering backend fundamentals, debugging, and production reliability. * A system\-design conversation based on a realistic developer\-platform problem. * A final conversation with the Engineering Manager and two prospective teammates. * Final reference and employment\-verification checks, followed by a conditional written offer. Pay: $180,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94114

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Software Engineer** Location: Remote Level: Mid\-level (3\+ years) **Company Summary** NourishedRx is the first operating system for Food is Health, providing a comprehensive platform that enables partners—including non\-profits, counties, and states—to operationalize and scale their own clinically integrated nutrition programs. Founded in 2019, we are a high\-growth digital health company built on the conviction that diet\-related disease – the single largest influenceable category of healthcare spending – is best solved by treating diet as a root cause rather than a downstream symptom. We provide the interoperable infrastructure that turns nutrition from a fragmented, manual effort into scalable healthcare infrastructure. By serving as the underlying operating system, we empower health plans and government entities to design, launch, and measure clinically integrated nutrition programs with a focus on outcomes\-based reimbursement to drive meaningful health improvements. Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through food. **The Role** NourishedRx is seeking a Software Engineer who already works the way modern engineering teams now work: with AI coding agents doing much of the typing, and the engineer doing the thinking. You will build across our TypeScript platform — member, clinician, and partner experiences, the services behind them, and the integrations and data that make outcomes\-based reimbursement possible. Here, being a software engineer means owning the problem, not just the code. You decide what should be built and how, write the plan and the guardrails, direct tools like Claude Code and Cursor to do the implementation, and then prove the result is correct before it ships. In healthcare, “the agent wrote it” is never an excuse: you are accountable for every line that reaches production, and for the members and clinicians who depend on it. You will work closely with Product, Clinical, and Operations, including on our new ACCESS product for Medicare beneficiaries, and help shape how our team builds with agents as the tools keep changing. **Responsibilities** Building with Agents * Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) as your primary way of building: plan the change, direct the agent, and steer it when it goes wrong. * Write the clear specs, acceptance criteria, and constraints that let agents produce correct work the first time — and recognize when a task is faster or safer to do by hand. * Review agent\-written code as carefully as a teammate’s: check the logic, edge cases, security, and whether it fits the codebase, not just whether it runs. * Keep our codebase easy for both people and agents to work in: clear structure, good project instructions and context files, and tests that tell an agent when it is wrong. * Share what works. Help evolve the team’s practices, prompts, and tooling as agentic tools improve. Product \& Platform Engineering * Own features end to end across our TypeScript/Node services and React web apps, from understanding the need through release and follow\-up. * Build and maintain integrations with health plans, partners, and clinical data sources, and the data pipelines behind outcomes and performance reporting. * Contribute to ACCESS, our AI\-enabled offering for Medicare beneficiaries, including the agentic guide that helps members reach clinical goals. * Work directly with Product, Clinical, and Operations to turn real workflows into simple, reliable software — including human\-in\-the\-loop steps where judgment matters. * Ship small changes often, watch how they behave in production, and fix what you find. **Quality, Safety \& Reliability** * Verify before you ship: automated tests, running the real app, and checking results against what was asked — not just trusting a green build or an agent’s summary. * Protect member data.
