jobs.title: Software Engineer — Core Platform
jobs.description: **Rutherford Exchange** *Trusted infrastructure for modern financial markets.* **Headquarters:** New York, New York **Industry:** Financial technology and institutional software Rutherford Exchange develops transaction, portfolio, and financial\-data infrastructure used by investment firms, banks, and corporate finance teams. Its platform processes sensitive financial activity where reliability, security, and accurate reporting are essential. The company is known for strong engineering standards, long\-term client relationships, and a product culture that values sound technical decisions over unnecessary complexity. **Software Engineer — Core Platform** **Location:** New York, New York **Work arrangement:** Hybrid — three office days and two remote days per week **Employment:** Full\-time, salaried and exempt **Schedule:** Monday through Friday **Hours:** Approximately 40–45 hours per week **Base salary:** $175,000–$215,000, depending on experience, skills, and interview level **Annual cash bonus:** 15% target; actual payout may range from 0% to 25% **Target cash compensation:** Approximately $201,000–$247,000 **Equity:** Initial grant with an estimated annualized value of $30,000–$60,000 **Reports to:** Engineering Manager, Core Platform **On\-call:** Approximately one week every eight weeks The role Rutherford Exchange is looking for a Software Engineer to build and improve the services that power its financial platform. You will work on APIs, transaction workflows, data processing, and internal platform capabilities used by multiple product teams. This is a mid\-level individual\-contributor position with meaningful ownership, but it does not require previous fintech experience or people\-management responsibilities. What you’ll do * Design, build, test, and maintain production services used across the Rutherford platform. * Develop reliable APIs and asynchronous workflows for financial and operational data. * Improve system performance, observability, security, and failure recovery. * Work with product managers and designers to turn business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. * Review code and design proposals while providing practical, constructive feedback. * Investigate production issues and implement fixes that address underlying causes. * Improve automated testing, deployment processes, and developer tooling. * Participate in architecture discussions and document important technical decisions. * Join a rotating on\-call schedule after completing onboarding and production\-readiness training. What we’re looking for * At least three years of professional software engineering experience. * Production experience with Java, Go, Python, or another modern server\-side language. * Experience designing APIs and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. * Understanding of testing, version control, code review, and continuous delivery. * Ability to investigate problems across application, database, and infrastructure layers. * Clear written communication and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs. * Experience delivering projects with product and engineering partners. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field is helpful but not required. Experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kafka, Kubernetes, payments, or financial products is helpful but not required. Candidates are not expected to have every preferred skill. Technology The primary platform uses Java, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, and AWS. Engineers are not required to know the entire stack before joining, but should be comfortable learning unfamiliar technologies. Compensation The base salary is determined by the candidate’s relevant experience, demonstrated technical skills, interview performance, and internal compensation level. The annual cash bonus has a 15% target and is based on company performance and individual contribution. It is not guaranteed. New employees may receive a prorated bonus for their first year. The equity grant follows a four\-year vesting schedule. Its future value is not guaranteed and should not be treated as cash salary. Benefits * **Health and wellbeing:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer\-funded health savings account contribution; mental\-health support; life and disability insurance. * **Retirement and financial:** 401(k) with a 5% company match, annual cash bonus eligibility, commuter benefits, and financial\-planning resources. * **Time away and family:** Flexible PTO with a recommended minimum of 20 days, company holidays, paid sick leave, and 16 weeks of parental leave. * **Professional development:** $2,500 annual learning budget, conference support, technical mentorship, and internal engineering workshops. * **Work support:** Company laptop and home\-office equipment, subsidized meals on office days, and reimbursement for approved on\-call transportation. Eligibility and detailed plan terms are provided in the official benefits documentation. Schedule and on\-call expectations Most engineering work takes place during regular Eastern Time business hours. Teams schedule core collaboration between 10:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. After onboarding, the engineer joins an on\-call rotation approximately once every eight weeks. On\-call engineers handle urgent production alerts outside normal hours. Routine issues remain within the next business day, and managers adjust schedules when significant overnight work occurs. What success looks like Within the first 90 days, you will understand the platform’s main services, contribute production code, and complete on\-call readiness training. Within six months, you should independently deliver a meaningful platform improvement, participate confidently in design reviews, and resolve production issues with appropriate support. Strong performance means producing reliable software, making sensible technical tradeoffs, communicating early when risks appear, and improving the systems around you—not simply writing more code. Culture Engineering at Rutherford Exchange is collaborative, direct, and low\-ego. Technical proposals are expected to withstand thoughtful review, regardless of who presents them. The company values careful execution, but does not treat constant overtime as a sign of commitment. Engineers are encouraged to challenge unnecessary complexity, document decisions, and leave systems easier to understand than they found them. Hiring process * A 30\-minute introductory call with a member of the Engineering Recruiting team. * A 60\-minute technical conversation with two engineers, including collaborative coding in a shared editor. * A system\-design interview based on a realistic platform scenario. * A conversation with the Engineering Manager and a cross\-functional product partner. * Final reference and employment\-verification checks, followed by a conditional written offer. No take\-home assignment is required. Candidates receive the interview format and preparation guidance in advance. Pay: $175,000\.00 \- $215,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10040

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Applied ML
jobs.description: ### **About Circuit** Circuit is the AI execution layer for the physical economy. Industrial and manufacturing enterprises run on expertise: the hard\-won knowledge of how complex products are engineered, configured, sold, and supported. That expertise is scarce, slow to transfer, and walking out the door as a generation of experts retires. It lives in PDFs, spreadsheets, and the heads of a few people, and the hardest technical decisions wait on whoever happens to know. Circuit puts expert judgment in everyone's hands. We capture how the best people make critical technical decisions and turn it into agents that do the judgment\-heavy work, so anyone, regardless of skill level, can make the right call, from quote to install and support, with the accuracy these environments demand. Circuit is built by operators. Our leadership team has built and scaled real industrial companies, and we are already live in production with category\-leading manufacturers. We are not bolting AI onto an old playbook. We are building the layer that runs the last mile of how the physical economy executes. ### **The Role** As a Staff Engineer, Applied ML at Circuit, you’ll join Product Engineering and build the machine learning capabilities that power our product. You’ll work closely with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), Product Engineers, and directly with design customers to understand real\-world challenges and turn them into robust, scalable solutions. A core part of your role is recognizing where a customer need points to a broader product capability, then building it to work across customers and use cases. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on solving current product and customer problems. You’ll use advances in ML where they help, exercise judgment about what is ready to ship, and own solutions end to end, with attention to accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost. Success means delivering capabilities that make Circuit’s product more useful, reliable, and broadly applicable. You’ll draw primarily on LLMs, alongside traditional NNs and statistical models, choosing and combining approaches based on the problem. Your work will span understanding customer use cases and how users interact with the product, data and process modeling, understanding what exists today and how to build on it, evaluation, production implementation, and, where it pays off, model training and fine\-tuning. Most importantly, you’ll work end to end with our design customers, building solutions for them. Beyond individual features, you’ll help build shared capabilities such as Circuit’s evaluation framework, improving how we measure quality and catch regressions across the product. As priorities evolve, you’ll apply your engineering judgment wherever it can make the greatest impact. Product Engineering builds the core platform and works directly with customers and design partners. Our FDE teams own solutions architecture and technical demonstrations. You’ll work alongside them on what gets built, and partner with Core ML engineers when a customer problem calls for deeper work on our document models or the agent loop. Your teammates range from full\-stack engineers to applied ML researchers. **This position is based in Austin, TX, onsite 3 days/week.** ### **What Is in Production Today** Our core product includes a long\-running agent loop written in Go. Frontier model APIs drive the loop, while specialized tools handle retrieval, extraction, and agent execution. These tools let us solve industrial problems that general\-purpose agent harnesses struggle with. We use a combination of open\-source and internally fine\-tuned models, particularly vision\-language models (VLMs), hosted on KServe. Our customer data includes technical documents, high\-resolution blueprints, raster images, vector geometry, CAD, and structured data. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Work directly with FDEs and design\-customers end to end, to build solutions on top of Circuit that solve their challenges * Generalize and package our solutions and methods, and empower FDEs to efficiently deploy them across customers. * Improve our underlying models, harnesses, eval methodologies and more to power our solutions and help solve customer challenges. * Debug production systems including edge cases and failure modes in ML pipelines and retrieval systems. * Build and maintain evaluation systems, including datasets, scoring approaches, and repeatable testing to detect regressions. ### **Examples of Work You Could Own** * **Build a solution with a design customer.** Work with an FDE and a design customer to turn a judgment\-heavy workflow, from quoting a configured product to troubleshooting in the field, into an agent that gets it right. * **Model the customer’s data.** Turn a customer’s spreadsheets, PDFs, and product rules into a data and process model the agent can reason over. * **Generalize it.** Package a solution built for one customer so FDEs can deploy it for the next custome ne customer needs into something every customer can use. Ideally, you have deep expertise and strong technical opinions in at least one of these areas: * Retrieval systems, including embeddings and ranking * Model training and fine\-tuning for production, across LLMs, deep learning, or traditional ML * Evaluation design and dataset curation from messy, real\-world customer data * Debugging production ML systems with AI observability tools You do not need to be an expert in every area. Strong software engineering fundamentals, good judgment with customers, and the ability to turn one customer’s solution into a product capability matter more than familiarity with our exact stack. Beyond that, we look for: * Strong software engineering background, with a track record of owning and shipping production systems end to end. * Deep experience with data structures and data modeling across relational and graph databases, with strong, well\-reasoned opinions on schema design, normalization, and indexing strategy. * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs, RAG systems, and agent harnesses, with a solid grounding in how these systems work, fail, and need to be evaluated. * Experience working directly with customers or field teams, turning what you learn into what gets built. * A track record of taking a solution built for one customer and generalizing it so others can deploy it. * Built and maintained features across a multi\-service architecture, with strong proficiency in languages like Python and Go. * Daily, fluent use of AI coding tools. You write effective prompts, iterate when output is wrong, and reliably tell working code from code that only looks right. * Bonus: Vision and multimodal models, especially on technical documents (PDFs, CAD) with text, vector geometry, and raster content. * Bonus: Construction, civil engineering, or other industrial domains. * Bonus: Open\-source models (Qwen, DeepSeek, or similar), and serving them with vLLM, KServe, or similar. * Bonus: Hands\-on PyTorch (or similar) for training and fine\-tuning models. ### **Human Skills** * Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering working systems in production. * Strong product judgment, with an understanding of how system behavior impacts user experience and trust. * Rigorous reviewer of agent instructions, skills, and documentation, ensuring they’re clear, unambiguous, and reliable for agents to act on. * Curiosity about how systems behave in practice and how customers use them. * Bias toward shipping. You take ambiguous problems and drive them to working solutions without needing the path fully defined for you. * Judgment about what is ready to ship, and the willingness to push back to keep the work grounded in customer outcomes. * Clear communicator. You explain ML tradeoffs to FDEs and customers in plain terms, and share progress early. * Critical evaluation of AI output. You spot hallucinated APIs, incorrect logic, and subtle bugs before they reach production. * Systems thinking, including attention to correctness and failure modes. * Low ego, with a focus on team outcomes. ### **What We Offer** * High\-caliber team of seasoned manufacturing and AI leaders * Help create a category\-defining platform transforming how manufacturers sell, support, and innovate * Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and employer\-paid benefits * Flexible PTO and access to the latest AI tools * A values\-driven culture that rewards ownership, curiosity and velocity ### **Who Should Apply** If you like working directly with customers, turning a judgment\-heavy workflow into an agent that gets it right, and then making that solution work for the next customer without starting over, we want to talk. ### **Equal\-Opportunity Employer** We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

With a portfolio of 130\+ properties across 17 states and millions of rentable square feet, we specialize in fully automated facilities that redefine the storage experience. We use advanced technology, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making to streamline operations, make storage more convenient for customers, and maximize returns for investors. **Position Summary** -------------------- Over the past year, 10 Federal has shifted from buying third\-party software to building platforms in\-house. That creates the need for someone to own the IT operations and infrastructure layer underneath that work. This is a broad, hands\-on role in a company of under 100 people with an outsized technology footprint. You will own end\-user IT, corporate network infrastructure, identity and security administration, and Azure platform operations end to end, working closely with the engineering team building our in\-house platforms. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **End\-User IT \& Device Management** * Own the company's day\-to\-day IT experience, including onboarding/offboarding, laptop provisioning, and device lifecycle * Manage devices in Microsoft Intune, including compliance policies, app deployment, and patching * Provide front\-line support and build automation and self\-service tools to reduce recurring tickets ### **Network \& Physical Infrastructure** * Own the Raleigh office network: SonicWall firewalls, HP Aruba switching, wireless, VPN, and remote access * Serve as escalation point for site\-level connectivity supporting gates, cameras, kiosks, and other on\-site technology ### **Identity, Security \& Compliance** * Own identity and access management across Microsoft, including Entra ID, conditional access, and MFA * Design and maintain a security group and permissions model that reflects our actual org structure * Administer SharePoint site architecture and permissions; use Microsoft Purview for data governance and retention * Own the joiner\-mover\-leaver process end to end * Serve as tactical counterpart to our third\-party cybersecurity partner: tune configurations, administer tooling, and execute remediation ### **Azure Platform Operations** * Set and enforce standards for resource groups, naming, tagging, and role\-based access * Define repeatable provisioning for development, staging, and production environments, and own the deployment path to production * Set the model for managed identities, service accounts, secrets, and platform security * Monitor Azure cost, optimize spend, and automate infrastructure wherever possible ### **Backup, Disaster Recovery \& Incident Response** * Own the backup strategy and the technology disaster recovery plan, including documented procedures and periodic testing * Contribute technology input to the company\-wide business continuity plan * Triage and resolve technology incidents and escalate per the incident response plan ### **AI \& Automation** * Find recurring tickets, manual provisioning steps, or compliance reviews that can be automated or handled by an AI agent * Evaluate and adopt AI tooling to improve IT operations **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required** * 3\+ years of professional IT experience (5 preferred) with hands\-on system ownership, not only ticket\-queue work * Strong knowledge of Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft 365, and SharePoint administration * Practical Azure experience: resource management, RBAC, and cost management * Comfort with networking fundamentals and physical network hardware * Experience turning unstructured environments into structured systems and processes * No degree or certification required; candidates are evaluated on demonstrated ability ### **Preferred** * Microsoft Purview or other compliance tooling * Infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform, or similar) * Scripting in PowerShell or Python * Experience in a small or fast\-moving organization **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Success is defined through a 90\-day plan set with the hiring manager **Physical Requirements \& Work Environment** --------------------------------------------- * Standard office environment with extended computer use; no travel * Occasional work in network closets; occasionally lifting IT equipment up to 25 lbs. * Occasional on\-call availability for critical system issues **Benefits** ------------ * Several no\-cost premium health insurance options, plus a Health Savings Account * Dental, vision, life, and short\- and long\-term disability coverage * 401(k) with up to a 3% employer match and immediate vesting (eligible after 90 days) * 10 paid holidays and paid time off that grows with tenure * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Employee Recognition Program * Employee discounts on auto, home, and pet insurance, travel, electronics, and entertainment **Our Core Values** ------------------- Everything we do at 10 Federal is rooted in five core values. We look for team members who live them every day: * Master Your Craft — Take pride in your work, your process, and your performance. Own your results. * Commit to the Climb — Show up, keep growing, and pursue continuous improvement. * Lead the Way — Set the standard for customer experience and quality, regardless of title. * Be the Solution — Approach challenges with resourcefulness and a can\-do attitude. * All In All Together — Support your team, your customers, and your community as one unified force. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- 10 Federal Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Appl****y here:** https://10fed\-careers.vercel.app/ **About 10 Federal Storage** ---------------------------- 10 Federal Storage is a commercial real estate and self\-storage company and the nation's leading high\-tech self\-storage operator. With a portfolio of 130\+ properties across 17 states and millions of rentable square feet, we specialize in fully automated facilities that redefine the storage experience. We use advanced technology, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making to streamline operations, make storage more convenient for customers, and maximize returns for investors. **Position Summary** -------------------- The Systems Software Engineer builds the technology that runs 10 Federal. This is a hands\-on engineering seat, not a people\-manager role: you design, build, and own production systems across the company and report directly to the Chief AI Officer. Title at offer (Senior, Staff, Principal, or Director) is set to the candidate based on proven work. Most self\-storage operators bolt together third\-party tools that don't talk to each other. 10 Federal builds in\-house instead, and every system is modular: a self\-contained piece with a clean interface that can be swapped, extended, or reused without breaking what's connected to it. At the center is the Unified Data Platform (UDP), the company's single source of truth, which every system feeds and every new product is built on. The role spans Technology, Construction, Marketing, Operations, Accounting, and any team with a process worth automating, plus outward\-facing products such as the website, web app, APIs, and DaVinci Solutions, our sister company's lock and access\-control platform. Every system you build should move 10 Federal toward its North Star: higher operational efficiency and a better customer experience at the same time. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Architecture \& Engineering Standards** * Define the architecture for every system before code is written, with specs that document the design and the reasoning * Design modular services with clean interfaces that can be replaced or reused without a rewrite * Instrument everything with full logging and debugging from the start * Connect systems to MCP servers so they can be queried through an AI front end * Own each system full stack, from data layer to interface, and ship it deployed, documented, and tested ### **Cross\-Functional Delivery** * Gather requirements with department leaders and solve the real problem, not just the first version of it * Evaluate requests by time cost, dollar cost, scaling impact, and difficulty to build * Take work from spec to proof of concept to a full breakdown for leadership (steps, timeline, cost, and ownership) to production * Build tools people can operate without an engineer standing next to them * Use AI tools across code, documentation, research, and communication, and review, test, and own everything they produce **What You'll Actually Build** ------------------------------ This isn't theoretical. Here's what's already on the table: * The Unified Data Platform: build and extend the pipelines, connections, and architecture that keep it the one place where everything in the company connects, instead of letting it become another silo * Real\-time voice AI: build and extend our own voice AI, running on live speech\-to\-speech models and trained on 10 Federal's own data, instead of leaning on an expensive, generic voice vendor * Chat and SMS: fix or fully replace the customer\-facing experience running across 130\+ properties. Right now it's a generic tool with none of our actual business logic in it * System connections: keep connecting the systems that run this company (the FMS, the camera network, BI and reporting, and marketing) into the UDP instead of leaving them as disconnected logins * Platforms for every part of the company: build systems for Operations, Accounting, Marketing, Investing, Construction, and any other part of the business that can be made faster or smarter. Each platform should own its domain, fit into one cohesive orchestration, and feed the UDP * DaVinci Solutions: optimize, re\-implement, integrate, and extend the lock and access\-control platform for a software and SaaS business serving the broader self\-storage industry The UDP is the operating system of this company. The platforms around it are modular parts of one coordinated machine. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required** * A strong technical foundation in software, hardware, computer science, computer engineering, or an adjacent field (no degree required) * Full\-stack range: comfortable owning a service end to end, from backend and data layer to interface * Architecture thinking: you can draw a clean boundary around what a system owns and defend it * Modular design as default practice, with real work you can point to that was built that way * Debugging and observability instincts: you instrument what you build so it tells you why it broke * Self\-directed execution: you can take an ambiguous business problem, write the spec, and ship a working system * Proof over credentials: a portfolio, GitHub history, or systems you can walk through in depth ### **Preferred** * Microsoft ecosystem and Azure experience * C\# and .NET experience (relevant to DaVinci Solutions) * Experience building AI\-powered systems such as agentic workflows, RAG, and MCP integrations * Hands\-on experience with AI development tools such as Grok, Cursor, Claude, Codex, or Windsurf * Experience shipping public\-facing products, not just internal tools ### **Current Stack** The stack changes when something better can be proven. Today it includes: * Backend: Python and Go * Front end: TypeScript and React * Real\-time voice AI: LiveKit with xAI Grok * SMS: Twilio * Data: Postgres and Redis * Hosting and identity: Microsoft and Azure * Reporting: Power BI, Fabric, and internally built dashboards * AI integration: MCP servers connected to business systems * DaVinci Solutions: C\# and .NET **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Ship production systems that are deployed, documented, tested, and modular enough to reuse * Complete the first 90 days, a mutual evaluation period, in the office, shipping, and building reusable work * Replace or substantially cut the cost of third\-party vendors with in\-house systems * Move 10 Federal up and to the right on its North Star: better operational efficiency and customer experience **Physical Requirements \& Work Environment** --------------------------------------------- * Work in office at Raleigh, NC headquarters five days a week; this role is not remote or hybrid * Standard office environment with extended periods of sitting and computer use * Relocation assistance can be negotiated if needed **Benefits** ------------ * Base salary and title set to the candidate based on proven work * Compensation reviewed quarterly, with increases based on demonstrated impact rather than tenure * A written share of the savings when you fully replace or substantially cut the cost of a third\-party vendor, paid as a raise or bonus at leadership's discretion * Eligibility for equity grants under 10 Federal's equity incentive plan once performance is proven (no equity in the starting offer; awards reviewed annually at leadership's discretion) * Several no\-cost premium health insurance options, plus a Health Savings Account with up to $1,200 in annual employer contributions * Dental, vision, life, and short\- and long\-term disability coverage * 401(k) with up to a 3% employer match and immediate vesting (eligible after 90 days) * 10 paid holidays and paid time off that grows with tenure * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Employee Recognition Program * Employee discounts on auto, home, and pet insurance, travel, electronics, and entertainment **Our Core Values** ------------------- Everything we do at 10 Federal is rooted in five core values. We look for team members who live them every day: * Master Your Craft — Take pride in your work, your process, and your performance. Own your results. * Commit to the Climb — Show up, keep growing, and pursue continuous improvement. * Lead the Way — Set the standard for customer experience and quality, regardless of title. * Be the Solution — Approach challenges with resourcefulness and a can\-do attitude. * All In All Together — Support your team, your customers, and your community as one unified force. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- 10 Federal Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. **Apply here:** https://10fed\-careers.vercel.app/

* Support and consult with engineering and product teams around application security vulnerabilities. * Assist teams in reproducing, triaging, and addressing application security vulnerabilities identified through Pen Testing, SAST, DAST, or Dependency scans * Take initiative and drive changes in our bug bounty program which position us as an industry leading security program * Lead in jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life\-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries. **Position Overview** The Principal Data Engineer (IC) is a senior individual contributor and the accountable technical leader for assigned cross\-domain initiatives and enterprise data engineering capabilities. The role owns integrated technical direction and technical outcomes for work spanning multiple data domains, defines and stewards enterprise engineering standards and reference architectures, and drives convergence where duplicated or inconsistent solutions create enterprise cost, risk, or operational burden. The role advises on scope, sequencing, capacity, dependencies, and technical debt, but does not independently commit domain resources or business delivery dates. This position has no people\-management responsibility. Enterprise Data operates a domain\-aligned model built on Databricks and Unity Catalog. Working with Domain Leaders, Staff Engineers, Platform Engineering, and partner organizations, the role converts ambiguous enterprise needs into executable architecture and carries the most complex or highest\-risk work through validation and production. The role remains hands\-on through prototyping, reference implementations, critical\-path development, design and code review, and production problem solving. **Essential Duties** Include, but are not limited to, the following: **Cross\-domain technical leadership and delivery** * Own the technical outcome of assigned cross\-domain initiatives from initial ambiguity through production and lifecycle support. * Convert enterprise needs into integrated architecture and executable technical plans, decomposing complex work into deliverable increments across domains. * Coordinate technical execution across domain Staff Engineers and partner teams, identifying dependencies and architectural risks, and escalating decisions requiring business or delivery authority. * Remain hands\-on through prototypes, reference implementations, critical\-path development, technical validation, and production problem solving. **Enterprise architecture and standards** * Define, steward, and evolve enterprise data engineering standards, patterns, and reference architectures, and drive convergence where inconsistent or duplicative implementations create enterprise cost, risk, or operational burden. * Lead architecture for assigned enterprise capabilities, including semantic and metrics layers, canonical data models, batch, API, event\-driven, and streaming patterns, and governed data products supporting analytics, machine learning, and AI. * Establish enterprise data\-contract standards covering schemas, service expectations, compatibility, breaking\-change policy, and producer\-consumer responsibilities, and partner with Platform Engineering to convert recurring cross\-domain needs into shared capabilities. **Technical leadership and mentorship** * Lead enterprise design and code reviews for high\-complexity or cross\-domain work, and coach and mentor Staff and Senior Engineers across domains without formal people authority. * Communicate architecture and technical tradeoffs clearly to engineering, business, and executive stakeholders, and build reusable guidance that increases engineering consistency across Enterprise Data. **Operational excellence, security, and efficiency** * Evaluate architecture tradeoffs across reliability, scalability, performance, security, privacy, operability, adoption, and technical cost, and drive cost\-efficient use of compute, storage, streaming, and orchestration. * Serve as the enterprise technical escalation for incidents involving multiple domains or shared architecture patterns, and lead root\-cause analysis and preventive changes for recurring enterprise issues. * Design and review architectures handling protected health information to meet applicable security, privacy, lineage, audit, Quality Management System, HIPAA, CLIA, and regulatory requirements. * Provide technical direction and due diligence for vendor and external\-partner solutions, and advance responsible engineering practices including approved AI\-assisted development capabilities. * Ability to work nights and/or weekends, as needed. * Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork. * Support and comply with the company's Quality Management System policies and procedures. * Maintain regular and reliable attendance. * Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or Engineering; or High School Diploma/General Education Degree and 12 years of relevant experience as outlined in the essential duties in lieu of Bachelor's Degree. * Expert\-level experience with software development design and development and with relevant domain specific skills (see below). * Spark on Databricks or comparable platforms; Python, Scala, SQL, and Snowflake experience. * ETL and ELT data pipelines, including batch and event\-driven patterns. * Designing and implementing data modeling solutions using relational, dimensional, and/or NoSQL databases. * Database architecture testing methodology, including execution of test plans, debugging, and testing scripts and tools. * Open data file and table formats (Parquet, Avro, Delta Lake); cloud infrastructure and delivery services (AWS, S3, SQS, and GitLab CI/CD). * REST API development; familiarity with BI concepts and Tableau performance considerations. * Agile development tools; including, but not limited to, JIRA, Confluence repository. * Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across multiple teams and communicate complex technical decisions to senior engineering, business, and executive stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to perform the essential duties of the position with or without accommodation. **Preferred Qualifications** * Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog at enterprise scale. * Kafka, change data capture, and production event\-streaming architectures. * Semantic or metrics layer design, canonical data models, and governed data products. * Cloud data architecture in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. * Life sciences, diagnostics, or clinical laboratory environments involving protected health information, HIPAA, CLIA, FDA, or Quality Management System requirements. * Technical assessment and architecture direction for vendor and external\-partner platforms. *We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, creed, disability, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, and any other status protected by applicable local, state, or federal law. Applicable portions of the Company’s affirmative action program are available to any applicant or employee for inspection upon request.* The base pay for this position is $129,300\.00 – $258,700\.00\. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: Accessium Group is seeking a Network Engineer to join our growing technical team. This position is responsible for supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and assisting with the implementation of network infrastructure across multiple client environments. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of networking fundamentals, hands\-on experience with network equipment, and the ability to independently resolve routine technical issues. This individual should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced, multi\-client environment, collaborating with other engineers, and continuing to develop their technical expertise. This position offers opportunities to gain experience with a variety of networking technologies, participate in infrastructure projects, and grow professionally with support from senior engineering resources. This position may require up to 25% travel to client locations for network installations, maintenance, troubleshooting, and project implementations. ***Key Responsibilities*** **1\. Network Support \& Troubleshooting** * Troubleshoot network connectivity, performance, and configuration issues across client environments. * Support TCP/IP networking, DNS, DHCP, subnetting, VLANs, and routing fundamentals. * Diagnose common Layer 2 and Layer 3 network issues. * Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, switch ports, trunking, and basic routing. * Investigate network latency, packet loss, and intermittent connectivity issues. * Assist with troubleshooting WAN connectivity and ISP\-related issues. * Utilize network diagnostic tools, including ping, traceroute, and packet analysis tools. * Escalate complex issues to senior engineers when appropriate, providing documented troubleshooting findings. **2\. Firewall \& Network Security** * Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot firewall policies and access rules. * Support NAT, VPN connectivity, and basic network security configurations. * Troubleshoot site\-to\-site and remote\-access VPN connections. * Assist with firewall firmware updates, backups, and configuration changes. * Review firewall logs to investigate connectivity and security\-related issues. * Follow established network security practices and change management procedures. * Experience with Fortinet or similar firewall platforms is preferred. **3\. Switching \& Wireless Infrastructure** * Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot managed network switches. * Support VLAN configurations, uplinks, and switch port assignments. * Troubleshoot common switching issues, including connectivity problems and configuration mismatches. * Configure and troubleshoot wireless networks, SSIDs, and wireless VLAN assignments. * Assist with diagnosing wireless coverage, interference, and connectivity issues. * Support wireless access points and related infrastructure. * Experience with Ruckus, Cisco, Aruba, or similar networking platforms is preferred. **4\. Network Monitoring \& Documentation** * Monitor network infrastructure using platforms such as Auvik or similar tools. * Investigate network alerts and identify potential connectivity or performance issues. * Perform routine network maintenance and health checks. * Maintain accurate network diagrams, equipment inventories, and configuration documentation. * Document troubleshooting steps, technical findings, and issue resolutions. * Maintain client documentation in IT Glue or equivalent platforms. * Identify recurring issues and communicate recommendations for improvement. **5\. Network Implementation \& Projects** * Assist with the deployment and configuration of switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and other network equipment. * Independently complete routine network installations and configuration changes within established procedures. * Participate in firewall replacements, network upgrades, and infrastructure migrations. * Assist with ISP installations, circuit activations, and network cutovers. * Follow established implementation plans, change management procedures, and rollback processes. * Perform post\-implementation testing to verify connectivity and functionality. * Collaborate with senior engineers and project teams on more complex implementations. **6\. Client Support \& MSP Responsibilities** * Support multiple client environments with varying network configurations and technologies. * Manage assigned service tickets and provide timely updates on troubleshooting progress. * Prioritize work based on urgency, business impact, and established service expectations. * Communicate professionally with clients, vendors, and internal technical teams. * Balance daily support responsibilities with scheduled maintenance and project assignments. * Maintain accurate time entries, ticket notes, and technical documentation. * Take ownership of assigned issues and follow through to resolution or appropriate escalation. **Required Qualifications** * Approximately 2–4 years of hands\-on experience in network support, administration, or engineering, or equivalent demonstrated technical competency. * Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, subnetting, and networking fundamentals. * Experience configuring and troubleshooting managed switches, VLANs, and basic routing. * Working knowledge of firewalls, NAT, access control rules, and VPN connectivity. * Experience troubleshooting network connectivity and performance issues. * Familiarity with wireless networking and access point configurations. * Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve routine network issues. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills. * Ability to manage multiple assignments and work effectively within a team. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Willingness to learn new technologies and develop additional technical expertise. * Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% as needed to support client environments and project requirements. **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience working for a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or supporting multiple client environments. * Experience with Fortinet firewalls. * Familiarity with Ruckus, Cisco, Aruba, or similar networking equipment. * Experience with network monitoring tools such as Auvik. * Experience using IT Glue or similar documentation platforms. * Familiarity with OSPF, BGP, and other dynamic routing protocols. * Experience assisting with network migrations, firewall replacements, or infrastructure upgrades. * Network certifications such as CompTIA Network\+, CCNA, or Fortinet certifications. * Familiarity with healthcare IT environments and HIPAA security considerations. * Exposure to PACS, DICOM, or medical imaging network environments. **The successful candidate will demonstrate:** * **Technical Competency:** Apply networking fundamentals to troubleshoot and resolve common infrastructure issues. * **Independence:** Manage routine technical responsibilities without constant supervision while recognizing when additional expertise is needed. * **Accountability:** Take ownership of assigned tasks, communicate progress, and follow through on commitments. * **Collaboration:** Work effectively with senior engineers, support teams, and project personnel. * **Problem Solving:** Use a structured troubleshooting approach and demonstrate initiative when researching unfamiliar issues. * **Documentation:** Maintain accurate technical records, ticket notes, and configuration information. * **Professional Growth:** Demonstrate a willingness to expand technical knowledge and take on increasingly complex Own the full lifecycle from scoping through production. **Bridge product and engineering.** Bring customer insights back to the core product team. Identify patterns across customer needs that should become platform features. Help shape the roadmap based on what you're seeing in the field. **Technical problem\-solving under pressure.** Debug production issues in real time. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS is seeking a Sr. Technical Business Development Manager to own the go\-to\-market strategy that gives a fast\-growing forward deployed engineering (FDE) organization durable access to the engineers it needs to grow. Forward deployed engineers pair deep production software experience with direct customer engagement: they work alongside customers to solve complex technical problems, build production solutions, and turn emerging technology into scalable outcomes. The market for this talent is specialized and competitive, and winning in it requires a deliberate strategy, real investment, and subject matter fluency in the work itself. You will own that strategy end to end. You will build a fact\-based view of the talent market, define where AWS should compete and invest, and develop the business cases, investment proposals, and executive narratives that fund and direct that work. You will structure and manage a portfolio of external relationships, with technical communities, professional networks, industry groups, and conference organizations, as channels that give AWS credible access to experienced engineers. You will carry measurable goals for qualified pipeline, orchestrate delivery across engineering, marketing, communications, events, finance, legal, and Talent Acquisition without direct authority, and use market and conversion data to decide where to expand, redirect, or exit. You own the strategy and the business outcome; partner teams run execution and operations, and Talent Acquisition owns candidate outreach, assessment, and hiring at the downstream hand\-off. This role requires technical fluency in forward deployed engineering and the AI and cloud landscape, strong business judgment, and the ability to create clarity in an ambiguous environment where strategy, plan, and stakeholders are not predefined. You will advise senior leaders, negotiate and structure external engagements, and align teams you do not own. Travel: 30 to 50%. Key job responsibilities Own the go\-to\-market strategy for building durable access to forward deployed engineering talent. Translate the organization's growth plans and engineering needs into where AWS competes, which segments to prioritize, and how to allocate investment. Build a fact\-based view of the talent market: concentration, candidate motivations, competitive dynamics, geography, and emerging sources of qualified engineers. Develop the external value proposition for FDE opportunities at AWS, grounded in technical credibility with experienced engineering audiences. Build business cases, investment proposals, and operating plans for new pipeline initiatives, and carry the goals and performance measures that judge their return. Structure and manage a portfolio of external relationships (technical communities, professional networks, industry groups, conference organizations) as channels for reaching relevant engineers. Negotiate the terms and model of AWS participation. Orchestrate delivery across engineering, marketing, communications, events, finance, legal, operations, and Talent Acquisition, owning the business outcome while partner teams run execution. Establish the mechanisms that connect external engagement to the recruiting process: shared goals, pipeline attribution, feedback loops, and operating rhythms with partner teams. Measure market reach, audience quality, qualified pipeline, program efficiency, and conversion. Recommend where AWS should expand, redirect, replicate, or discontinue investment. Identify repeatable, scalable approaches that extend across technical disciplines, markets, and business teams while holding AWS's quality bar. Advise senior leaders on market position, pipeline strategy, investment requirements, and risks to the growth plan. Represent AWS credibly with technical leaders, engineering communities, and executive audiences. A day in the life Your work centers on how AWS builds sustained access to the specialized talent forward deployed engineering depends on. You will work with FDE leaders to understand growth plans, technical priorities, and future capability needs, then translate those into a market strategy, an investment thesis, and a portfolio of initiatives. Much of the role is strategic and deal\-oriented: you might decide AWS should compete in a specific engineering community, build the business case for a flagship initiative around an emerging discipline, and negotiate the terms of AWS's participation with an external organization. You will define the audience and business outcome, secure investment, align contributors across the org, and set the goals and quality bar, while partner teams handle delivery and logistics. You will track portfolio performance and shifts in the AI and engineering talent market, use pipeline and conversion insight to see which markets and initiatives produce the strongest return, and advise senior leaders on opportunities, investment choices, and risks. Success is whether your strategy creates a scalable, durable source of qualified forward deployed engineering talent. About the team You will support a growing AWS engineering organization that builds and deploys production solutions for complex customer challenges. Its forward deployed engineers combine deep technical expertise with close customer collaboration, working across disciplines to turn ambitious ideas and emerging technology into real\-world outcomes in a space shaped by rapid advances in AI, cloud, and modern software development. Its growth depends on attracting engineers who can pair technical delivery with customer engagement and business ownership, and this role owns the market strategy and investment that make that access possible. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience * 5\+ years of Go\-To\-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience * 5\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning), GenAI (Generative AI), Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience * 5\+ years of in program management, workforce strategy development, or metrics\-driven decision making experience * Bachelor's degree * Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Master's degree in business, data science, public administration, finance, engineering, human resources, or related field, or PMP certificate * Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations * Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements * Experience designing, implementing, and scaling workforce development programs across large\-scale operations, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions * Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross\-functional teams * Experience using analytical tools for workforce metrics and reporting Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Search Ranking and Exploration
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon's Search team creates ML algorithms that connect customers around the world with products that delight them. We harness machine learning at Amazon's scale to make the customer experience easier and smoother. Our impact is large. For example, if your innovations save even 1 minute per customer per year, then for every 100 million customers, you save approximately 190 years of human effort. Key job responsibilities As an Applied Scientist on the Search L1 Ranking team, you will build search ranking models that work for thousands of product types, billions of queries, and hundreds of millions of customers spread around the world. You will find the next set of big improvements to ranking, leverage large datasets to understand the complexities of customer behavior, and build ML models that work at Amazon scale. Amazon's Search ranking relies on efficient early stage ranking followed by power final stage ranking models. this role focuses on efficient models for early stage ranking phase, and techniques to personalize these models and optimize them automatically. A day in the life Our primary focus is improving search ranking systems. On a day\-to\-day this means building ML models, analyzing data from your recent A/B tests, and collaborating with partner teams on joint goals. We leverage agentic workflows to improve our scientific velocity, and partner closely with SDEs to bring our ideas to production. You will shape the future of search ranking by presenting proposals to Amazon's business and tech leaders. About the team We are a team consisting of ML scientists and software engineers. jobs.title: Fire Protection Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Do you want to apply your fire protection expertise to data center infrastructure that operates at a global scale? Are you excited about expanding your knowledge of building systems while contributing insights from your previous experience? In this role, you will influence all aspects of fire protection design, construction, operations, and maintenance for our data centers. This includes fire suppression, fire detection, fire alarm, and mass notification systems, as well as fire\-resistant construction and life safety. You will work with internal and external teams to define, design, detail, and document the fire protection features our facilities require, using both prescriptive and performance\-based design approaches. You will contribute your expertise to the continual improvement of our fire protection design standards, ensuring our buildings protect people and keep our customers' data safe and uninterrupted over the life of each facility. Key job responsibilities * Design and oversee fire water service infrastructure, including water supply analysis, coordination with utilities and fire officials, and establishing site\-level requirements for fire protection systems. * Review concept designs and construction documents from third\-party vendors to verify compliance with established design standards, local codes, National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) standards, International Code Council (ICC) requirements, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) expectations. * Prepare prescriptive and performance\-based designs for building fire suppression, alarm, and detection systems, and coordinate fire protection system space requirements, supporting utilities, and equipment locations. * Collaborate with construction, commissioning, operations, and risk management teams to resolve requests for information, value engineering queries, and technical questions throughout the project lifecycle. * Drive improvement of fire protection design standards and standard configuration templates across the organization, simplifying and strengthening systems with each iteration. A day in the life You will start your day reviewing active project designs, checking that fire protection elements meet our standards and local code requirements. You may join a cross\-functional call with architects, mechanical engineers, and construction managers to align on system layouts for a new build, then shift to evaluating a vendor's submittal package for a fire alarm system. In the afternoon, you might prepare a performance\-based design analysis or meet with local fire officials to secure approval of fire protection features. Throughout, you will mentor teammates and share lessons learned to improve quality across the team. About the team Our Data Center Design Engineering team includes architects, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, fire protection, and controls engineers working together to design the next generation of data centers at Amazon. We are committed to delivering world\-class uptime for our customers and we build facilities that emphasize security, safety, and efficiency while meeting growing demand. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to directly impact our business and contribute to continuous advancements in how we design and build infrastructure at scale.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities * Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel * Experience in commissioning * 5\+ years of data center engineering or operations, or 2\+ years of construction or project management experience * 5\+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience * Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field * Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA * Licensed Fire Protection Engineer **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience with building codes and regulations for your region * Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production * Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents * Experience in engineering, designing, or constructing data centers Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Sponsored Products and Brands
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) helps millions of advertisers reach shoppers across Amazon's stores worldwide. Behind every ad we show are machine learning models that predict click\-through rate (CTR) and conversion rate (CVR). These predictions decide which ads are relevant, how they rank, and how advertisers get value. Our team builds and runs the ML infrastructure behind those models, end to end: * Offline feature engineering: a multi\-tenant platform used by several ML teams. It runs thousands of daily feature jobs over petabyte\-scale data and produces the features that train models in every marketplace we serve. * Model training: the standard system that retrains CTR and CVR models every day. How fresh these models are directly affects advertiser results and Amazon's revenue. * Online feature store and feature retrieval: low\-latency, high\-throughput services that provide features when a model makes a prediction. These predictions feed the scores used in real\-time ad ranking. * Next\-generation research platform: a platform that uses AI agents to help scientists explore, test and launch new model ideas faster. As an SDE II, you'll design, build and run distributed systems that work at very large scale, both in offline batch processing and online serving. You'll work closely with applied scientists and engineers to make models fresher, help scientists try ideas faster, and keep the systems that support ads ranking reliable. Key job responsibilities * Design and develop ML infrastructure for advanced recommendation models, from training through real\-time inference, that delivers highly relevant ads to shoppers worldwide * Improve the scalability, automation and efficiency of large\-scale training and real\-time inference systems * Work closely with applied scientists to optimize the performance of ML models and infrastructure, and take models from experimentation into production * Deliver ML solutions end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment and operations * Collaborate with engineers and scientists across the team to build systems that serve ads across all Amazon platforms and surfaces * Participate in design and code reviews and mentor peers A day in the life You might start the day checking the health of the overnight feature and training pipelines. Then you'd work with scientists on how to support a new model architecture, and spend the afternoon building a performance improvement for the online feature store. You'll ship often, see your work affect ads served around the world, and influence how ML infrastructure grows across the organization. About the team The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re\-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re\-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. We're the team behind the full ML lifecycle for Sponsored Products recommendation models, from raw data to features, training and real\-time serving. We value ownership, getting things done, and close collaboration with science partners. We invest in mentorship and in tools that make engineers and scientists more productive, including AI\-assisted development.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 3\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of building large\-scale machine\-learning infrastructure for online recommendation, ads ranking, personalization or search experience * 1\+ years of machine learning, statistical modeling, data mining, and analytics techniques experience * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 1\+ years of mathematics optimization such as linear programming and nonlinear optimization experience * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Regional Environmental Engineer - Compliance, TX, AWS Environmental Team
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join a diverse, dynamic, and enthusiastic team of environmental professionals who play a leading role in environmental permitting and compliance at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where we have a history of leading the world in innovative technologies and services. The work of our Regional Environmental Engineers is critical to enabling AWS's growth in the US and around the world. The AWS Environmental team is an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS’s global operations, including physical data centers, as well as other AWS facilities, customer\-facing enterprises and products. The team has responsibility for architecting and implementing AWS’s global environmental programs. This includes defining and implementing risk management and compliance systems and driving their continuous improvement; setting and refining global policies and procedures; overseeing the development of standards, tools, auditing and metrics, and employee training; ensuring effective engagement by environmental teams on global initiatives, including those that are part of Amazon’s ambitious sustainability goals; providing specialist expertise; and engaging with all AWS business units to provide scalable and effective compliance strategies that support current and future business objectives while ensuring compliance with environmental regulations. As a Regional Environmental Engineer (REE), you will be responsible for environmental compliance at operating AWS data centers in Texas. You will develop standards and policies to support regulatory compliance, complete environmental performance analysis, establish and monitor metrics, and guide the teams in implementation of Amazon environmental standards. You will provide guidance and build effective relationships with internal and external partners, including government entities, contractors, consultants, design, construction, operations and other key stakeholders. This position is based in either near LBB or Austin, Texas and will require travel throughout the state and the US. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Why AWS? AWS is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. jobs.title: Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Do you dream of working in a role where your talent with building HVAC and plumbing design and next\-generation data center design can be merged? Do you want to expand your current knowledge of building systems while providing input from your previous experience? Have you ever wondered what it is like to be able to influence construction on a global scale? YES! Then keep reading…. In this role you will influence all aspects of Mechanical design, construction, operations, and maintenance for our global fleet of data centers. This includes fire suppression, fire detection, fire alarm, and mass notification systems, as well as fire\-resistant construction and life safety. You will work with internal and external teams to define, design, detail, and document the various Mechanical features that our facilities require, using both prescriptive and performance\-based design approaches. As an Owner, you will strive to ensure the Mechanical features of our buildings protect our people and keep our customer’s data safe and uninterrupted over the life of the building. We expect you to contribute your expertise to the continual improvement of our Mechanical design standards. Primary responsibilities will be to perform and oversee project\-related work, such as water supply analysis and design for fire water service to buildings, including coordination with utilities and fire officials to establish basic site infrastructure requirements. The ability to coordinate Mechanical system space requirements, supporting utilities, and equipment locations, and to provide detailed construction specifications for all Mechanical\-related trades will be expected. You will typically be responsible for the preparation of detailed designs for HVAC, plumbing, and hydronic systems. You will review all design disciplines to ensure they meet the code requirements described in our design standards. In some cases, you will oversee and review this work and in other cases you will perform the work yourself. As the team’s subject matter expert, you will ensure that contractors have the information they need to build our data centers the way we expect them to, and that our operations teams are well equipped to operate and maintain them as needed to meet our goals. As part of this role you will work with internal and external stakeholders, including design, construction, commissioning, operations, vendors, and other service providers, as well as local building and fire officials. You will be part of a global team, and you will be an integral part of our work to change the world through technology. Key job responsibilities * Driving improvement of design standards and project approaches across the organization. * Work with internal and external design teams to review designs in progress to ensure they meet established design standards, local code requirements, and any other requirements of the Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs). * Be responsible for providing high quality Mechanical engineering advice on a wide variety of projects globally while working with local engineering teams to achieve alignment of designs and design objectives. * Coordinating with construction, commissioning, and risk management teams to answer requests for information and value engineering queries. * Be responsible for construction documents, code compliance, design and installation standards, water supply evaluation and assessment, testing, inspections, and submittal review. * This position will require up to 25% travel. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skill  career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical Engineering * Cumulative 10\+ years of experience in design engineering or the construction industry, related to all aspects of Mechanical, including hydronics, air side duct design, and plumbing design * Experience applying local codes, International Code Council (ICC) requirements, and other Mechanical industry standards, procedures, and methodologies. * Experience with processes of design review, specification, development of design standards, and submittal review. * Ability to read and understand construction documents for all trades (design drawings, control diagrams, specifications, etc.). * United States Citizenship Required **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience authoring white papers, technical documentation, and training materials * Experience directly related to construction of data centers, critical medical, industrial, construction, oil and gas, or large\-scale mechanical and power systems. * Experience in the development processes for codes and standards * Experience with performance\-based alternatives to prescriptive Mechanical design. * Professional Engineering license, NCEES Record * Experience directly related to the design or construction of data centers or critical infrastructure or large\-scale mechanical and electrical plants Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
