jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Support Technology
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Anthropic's products are growing fast in reach and complexity. Every new model, product, and channel brings problems no one predicted. We want to catch each issue as early as possible, get customers unblocked fast, and fix the root cause. The best experience is one where a customer never has to ask for help. We are building a Support Technology engineering team to solve what stands between a customer and Claude, whether they want to use it but can't or are unhappy with their experience. That covers individual users, businesses, and customers who reach Claude through partners. Our goal is a better product experience for everyone who uses Claude. We make it easy for customers to get help and talk to us, through Claude itself and via human specialists with the tools to solve their problems. We also determine why they needed help and fix the cause in the product. Billing is a good example. When a charge is confusing, a payment fails, or a plan doesn't unlock, a customer should be able to reach us and get it resolved in one conversation. Then we want to learn why it happened and change the product, whether that's the subscription flow, the payment error, or the invoice, so the next customer never has to ask. As one of the team's early engineers, you will set the technical direction and build the core systems behind this work. We expect Claude to handle more of each case over time, from diagnosing an issue to resolving it to flagging the product fix behind it. Success means customers run into fewer problems, get them truly solved when they do, and are happy with the help they receive, whether it comes from Claude or a person. This is a hands\-on role with high leverage. You will write a lot of code and lead across teams, since many fixes belong to other product teams. You will partner with our Product Manager, the Product Support team, and product engineering teams such as Billing Platform. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Improve the product experience at the root: Build agents that spot where customers keep getting stuck and find the root cause, then ship the fix or drive it with the owning team until customers stop running into the problem * Make our support agents reliable first responders: Build the tools, APIs, and safe, audited workflows our Claude\-powered support agents use for common fixes, with evals, guardrails, and clean handoffs to people, and measure whether customers' problems actually get solved * Build the platform foundations: Create a reliable support platform that scales with our growth, including the experience and tools for customers and specialists, and the data that shows what customers are running into and whether our changes help * Support enterprise and partner channels: Extend support to business customers, admins, and partner\-sold customers, including cases that start outside our own products * Raise the bar and build with Claude: Set standards for reliability, observability, testing, and rollouts, mentor engineers, and use Claude heavily in your own work **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Deep backend and distributed systems skills, including APIs, data models, event\-driven systems, and third\-party integrations * Experience building production software, including technical lead roles on multi\-team projects * Experience building systems where correctness, access control, and auditability matter * A clear vision for how capable models like Claude can improve customer support, and motivation to build it * Judgment about when to ship a simple fix and when to invest in a platform * Track record of leading without formal authority and getting other teams to own and ship fixes **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * 8\+ years building backend or platform systems in production, including 3\+ years leading large\-scale, complex projects or teams as an engineer or tech lead * Experience building and improving customer\-facing products with measurable impact * Experience with billing, payments, or subscription systems * Experience shipping LLM\-based or agentic systems in production * Experience building with helpdesk or contact center platforms such as Intercom, Zendesk, or Salesforce Service Cloud * Experience building internal tools or platforms for operations teams such as support, risk, finance, or trust and safety * Experience building data pipelines for support or operations analytics * Full\-stack experience, including web UIs for internal tools or customer\-facing flows * Experience with enterprise features such as SSO, admin con  degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description: Burro is the leading robotics company in the world by number of robots working outdoors in the field with real customers. Our mission is to free people from tedious work and solve the critical labor shortages faced by farmers and others that work outdoors. To accomplish our mission, we need a world\-class, diverse team where everyone feels comfortable sharing their ideas. With this in mind, we strive to create a work environment where every employee can be themselves and express their perspective – this enables us to deliver the most creative and innovative solutions to problems our customers face. Headquartered in Philadelphia with an office in central California, and backed by top Agtech and autonomy investors, including S2G, Catalyst, Translink, Cibus, FPrime, Toyota Ventures, FFVC, Xplorer, and Radicle, Burro was created to solve the labor shortages facing farmers using robotics. Burros can be described as Disney's Wall\-E for agriculture and work outdoors, in a 1\.0 format. They function, today, as computer vision based autonomous ground vehicles for carrying, towing, and scouting, and are designed to lay the base for the fully autonomous future of work outdoors. We have a growing triple digit fleet deployed in paid commercial use within vineyards, nurseries, berries, and beyond, and demand for our product is accelerating, so we are growing our team. Reporting to the Director of Software Platform \& Integration, we are seeking a highly motivated **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test** with experience in robotics and autonomous systems to join our team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the quality and reliability of our robotics software, working closely with our User Acceptance Testing, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to ensure seamless development, testing, simulation, and deployment workflows, and helping to design, build, and deploy cutting\-edge agricultural and industrial autonomous robots. We are looking for a teammate who shares our enthusiasm for working with collaborative robots made to handle the tedious and physically demanding parts of agricultural work, has a passion for delivering a high\-quality end\-to\-end user experience, and maintains a collaborative attitude that supports and uplifts everyone they work with. ### **Responsibilities:** * Extend and maintain simulation\-based testing frameworks with Isaac and Gazebo, creating scenarios for our virtual fleet in industrial and agricultural environments. * Create and maintain ROS\-based testing frameworks for C\+\+ and Python robotics software applications, including functional, regression, integration, performance, acceptance, and stress testing on amd64 robotic platforms in both simulated and real\-world environments. * Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts to validate software functionality and performance across robotic systems, including embedded software, and cloud\-based services. * Drive the integration of QA processes into continuous integration, deployment, and testing (CI/CD/CT) pipelines, ensuring consistency and reliability. * Build and maintain internal tools and dashboards to monitor the health and performance of testing systems, collaborating with the Platform team on shared monitoring infrastructure to provide critical insights. * Identify, document, and track software defects and bugs, working closely with development teams for efficient resolution. * Support field testing and validation of autonomous systems in agricultural and industrial settings. * Collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and other cross\-functional teams to understand product requirements and specifications, to define and validate user acceptance criteria, and to provide timely feedback. * Advocate for overall product quality and promote best practices across the engineering organization. * Conduct periodic on\-site physical testing of robots (a few days per month), involving physical activity and requiring year\-round presence at both the Philadelphia office and the outdoor Phoenixville test farm. Serve as backup for the User Acceptance Technician as needed. ### **Requirements:** Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 3\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or test engineering, preferably in robotics, embedded systems, or autonomous systems. * Strong experience designing and implementing software testing methodologies, including unit, integration, system, and acceptance testing. * Exceptional problem\-solving skills and a keen attention to detail. * Experience with robotic simulation tools such as NVIDIA Isaac or Gazebo. * Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within a dynamic team environment. * Familiarity with ROS (Robot Operating System) or similar robotics middleware. * Proficiency in Python, Typescript/Javascript, C\+\+, and shell scripting for test automation. * Proficiency with Linux\-based development environments. * Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., Git). * Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI. Desired Qualifications * Experience robustly testing robotic software systems in simulation and data\-replay settings that may not be deterministic. * Experience working with 3D assets as used in simulation software. * Knowledge of computer vision and machine learning testing practices. * Familiarity with safety standards and compliance testing for autonomous systems. * Experience testing hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) systems. * A background in agricultural technology, industrial automation, or outdoor robotics. ### **Perks:** * Competitive salary and benefits package (medical/dental/vision) * Early\-Stage Equity * 401K Plan * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave RECRUITERS: We are not accepting agency resumes for this position. enabling scalable and composable agent solutions. * Build and optimize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines so agent behavior is grounded in trusted, approved, and governed knowledge sources. * Engineer prompts, tool\-use patterns, planning strategies, and reasoning approaches to deliver consistent, explainable, and reliable agent outcomes. * Integrate agentic AI and automation solutions with the Fund’s systems and platforms, including core applications, APIs, digital channels, and data services. * Work with Technology, Data, and Digital teams, including architects, engineers, delivery squads, Data Engineering, and Data Services, to align solutions with enterprise architecture, security, data quality, lineage, and governance standards. * Lead solution design activities and provide technical direction for AI, automation, and software engineering solutions, ensuring alignment with enter llaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across the full service lifecycle, including requirements discovery, solution design, implementation, deployment, operational support, continuous improvement, and service management. **Desired:** * Experience applying design thinking principles and/or working within recognized architecture frameworks. * Experience with Azure services, cloud concepts, and cloud\-native solution design within a Microsoft ecosystem. * Exposure to regulated environments, such as financial services, superannuation, or insurance, and familiarity with AI governance, risk, ethical, privacy, and compliance frameworks. * Experience working within Agile, Lean, startup, or DevOps delivery models. * Working knowledge of DevOps and MLOps concepts, including CI/CD, monitoring, and model, agent, or automation lifecycle management. * Knowledge of ITIL and service management practices, particularly change, release, incident, and operational management. * Experience with ServiceNow and/or PowerShell scripting. * Strong interest in emerging technologies, particularly AI, agentic systems, automation, and intelligent platforms. * jobs.title: Marketing AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** Avenue Z is a digital marketing and PR agency engineered to move fast. Brands partner with us to drive revenue and reputation through high\-impact public relations, performance media, AI search optimization (AEO), and our creator network. Trusted by leaders in emerging tech, finance and consumer brands, ***we drive influence*** across all channels \- from AI Search to The Wall Street Journal, Shopify to TikTok, Meta to Google. **The role** ------------ You are a growth marketer who builds. You have bought media on Meta, Google, or TikTok with your own hands, you know what a good ROAS looks like before the dashboard loads, and when something is manual, repetitive, or slow, your instinct is to open an editor and wire it to the platform API rather than schedule a working session. The Marketing AI Engineer builds and ships the AI agents, automations, and reporting systems that run paid media, creator and affiliate campaigns, CRO, and client reporting at Avenue Z. The work is concrete: agents that launch and QA ads across Meta, TikTok, and Snap; systems that reallocate budget toward top\-performing creators; reporting that ties creator content, ad spend, and attributed revenue into one picture; alerts that catch an expiring TikTok Shop affiliate code or a Meta partnership permission before spend stalls. You are also the technical lead for our AI builders. You set the standard for how agents are designed, reviewed, and shipped across service lines, you review their work, and you are the person leadership turns to when a build needs a decision. You will embed with the paid media, creator, and ecommerce teams to find where throughput or margin is lost, build the system that fixes it, drive adoption, and move to the next one. This is a builder and a leader role. You ship working systems yourself, and you raise the bar for everyone else who ships them. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Build against the marketing platforms our revenue runs on** * Integrate with the Meta Marketing API, TikTok Business and TikTok Shop APIs, Google Ads API, Snap, Shopify, and affiliate and creator platform APIs: OAuth and token refresh, rate limits, webhooks, and partnership\-access flows. * Build agents and automations for ad launching and QA, budget pacing and reallocation, creative tagging and performance intelligence, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform commission tracking. * Build the reporting layer that shows a brand what actually drove revenue, cross\-referenced against Shopify as the source of truth. **Embed with the teams and ship against real problems** * Sit with paid media, creator and affiliate, CRO, and ecommerce teams. Audit how they work today, map the workflow from input to output, and find the steps that should run automatically. * Turn a messy manual process into a working system inside weeks, not quarters. Define where a human approves and where the system acts on its own, especially where money or brand safety is on the line. * Drive adoption. A system that ships and sits unused does not count. Train the team, gather feedback, and iterate. **Build Innovative AI Driven Marketing SolutionsAI** * Provide technical leadership on product roadmap. Be an expert in building and shipping production ready solutions. * Set the standard for how Avenue Z designs, reviews, documents, and ships agents and automations across service lines, and enforce it through code review and design review. * Review and mentor the engineers and builders already working on AI automation across PR, SEO and AEO, organic social, and ecommerce. Unblock them, raise their quality bar, and own the outcome of their work. * Run the intake and prioritization of automation requests so the team builds what moves revenue, time saved, or client retention, in that order. * Report progress, blockers, and measured impact to the CTO and present to leadership. **Invent new capability** * Build things that create new advantages for the business, not just faster versions of old tasks: autonomous media buying, creative\-to\-landing\-page pipelines, creator performance ranking, and whatever you see next that we have not. **What you won't do** --------------------- * Be a passive project coordinator or a pure strategist with no build capability. * Spend months planning without shipping. * Wait for perfect requirements before building. * Build for novelty instead of business value. * Replace human judgment where brand, strategy, or client context still matters. * Treat marketing as someone else's domain. You have to understand the ad account as well as the people running it. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A background in growth marketing. You have personally run paid media on at least one of Instagram and Facebook, Google, or TikTok, and you understand campaign structure, pixels and events, attribution windows, creative testing, and what the numbers mean. * Hands\-on experience working with the Meta Marketing API and the TikTok Business or TikTok Shop APIs, plus other marketing platform APIs (Google Ads, Shopify, Klaviyo, affiliate and creator platforms). jobs.title: Electronic Sourcing Engineer II (Onsite)
jobs.description: #### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.** At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. #### **Your Impact** Does the thought of finding ways to leverage technology to help others excite you? Do you enjoy transforming requirements into real products and helping to bridge the gap between technical and non\-technical parties? The mission as the Electronics Sourcing Engineer is to build a world\-class electronics supplier network for our products that can ensure continuity of supply and scale to support demand, provide cost reduction, and anticipate and mitigate supply chain risks. You will work throughout the product development lifecycle executing strategic projects to optimize commodities, sub\-commodities and individual suppliers; executing detailed projects with suppliers to implement changes and improvements affecting quality, cost, capacity, risk, and sub\-supplier management and to launch new products. #### **What You'll Do** * Proactively communicate with the design engineering and product teams prior to and during the NPI development process to understand their current \& future needs for new product components; influencing by leveraging industry experience. * Work with the Electronics Category Managers on sourcing decisions that are aligned with their strategies. Seek cross\-functional team agreement on discrepancies. * Establish strong relationships with manufacturers and their associated representatives to understand product roadmaps and availability to support future product development. * Work with the sourcing team to develop and ramp component sources for new products and support the NPI purchasing team's efforts to ensure components are purchased in a timely manner for the different engineering builds. * Lead RFX process with electronics supply base to establish costing for all electronic components. * Own quarterly Material Spend Reporting. * Assist the respective Category Managers and cross\-functional category teams in developing and executing multi\-dimensional commodity strategies that support the NPI work stream with an emphasis on cost optimization, time to market, technology, quality, supply continuity, supply chain consolidation, service and risk mitigation. * Support negotiations of Axon pricing at the component level for electronics; partner with the category managers to develop and execute negotiation strategies with new product suppliers to achieve specific targets for pricing, service, quality \& delivery. Ensure supplier awards for new business are leveraged in pricing negotiations. * Identify and manage the implementation of cost reduction opportunities on new and existing products in collaboration with the category management and continuous engineering teams. * Identify risks in our current supply chain and work together with the electronics category managers, continuous engineering team and component engineer to qualify additional sources of supply for critical components on our BOM's. * Assist the Electronics Category Managers \& Legal teams in negotiating and executing optimal contract terms with key new suppliers. * Lead supplier selection process and ensure supplier selections are based on sound selection criteria for new product introduction activities to select the right supplier for the part, considering long term fit and total cost of ownership. * Participate in periodic business reviews with key suppliers to review supplier performance. * Own the development and maintenance of the approved manufacturer's list. * Other sourcing and procurement related duties as business requirements dictate. #### **What You Bring** * BS in Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain or related field * 3\+ years of experience in supply chain, technical sourcing, and/or engineering * Proven success developing strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive proper rigor in supplier selection process * Skilled at should\-cost modeling, pricing and terms \& conditions negotiations * Work experience in a new product introduction (NPI) sourcing environment with an ability to manage rapid changes typical during the NPI development process * Experience dealing with electronics supply base * Experience with a high mix/low volume procurement environment * Located or willing to relocate to Scottsdale, AZ #### **Benefits that Benefit You** * Competitive salary and 401k with employer match * Discretionary paid time off * Paid parental leave for all * Medical, Dental, Vision plans * Fitness Programs * Emotional \& Mental Wellness support * Learning \& Development programs * And yes, we have snacks in our offices *Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work* Don't meet every single requirement? The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.* *Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.* *We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.* *Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well\-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** BCC Software develops innovative software and data solutions that power critical customer communications for organizations across North America. With more than 45 years of industry leadership, we combine deep postal expertise with modern technology to help our customers streamline operations, improve efficiency, and drive growth. **Job Description** **Job Objective** BCC Software is seeking a senior engineer who can sustain and evolve business\-critical C/C\+\+ products while helping shape their path to a modern Microsoft technology stack. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience in C\# and .NET, sound architectural judgment, and experience using AI responsibly to improve engineering productivity, modernize and create new product capabilities. This is a hands\-on role with meaningful technical influence; prior team leadership or technical mentorship is a major plus. **Essential Functions** * Enhance, troubleshoot, and maintain established C and C\+\+ applications across Windows and Linux environments. * Design and deliver new capabilities using C\#, modern .NET, service\-oriented architecture and contemporary APIs and integration patterns. * Assess legacy components and help define pragmatic modernization approaches, including incremental replacement, service extraction, interoperability, and risk\-managed migration rather than unnecessary rewrites. * Use AI\-assisted engineering tools appropriately for code comprehension, refactoring, test generation, documentation, defect analysis, and delivery acceleration while protecting source code, customer data, and intellectual property. * Write, review, test, and document maintainable code, including automated unit, integration, and regression tests. * Estimate and size user stories, define technical tasks, and consistently meet individual and team commitments within an Agile Scrum delivery model. * Partner with Product Owners and QA to refine requirements, define acceptance criteria, identify technical risks, and plan stories, epics, and releases. * Take ownership of complex problems from investigation through production validation, not just isolated coding tasks. * Contribute to architecture discussions, engineering standards, CI/CD improvements, security practices, observability, and cross\-team initiatives. **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Provide technical direction on complex work, facilitate design and code reviews, and help the team make balanced decisions across delivery speed, maintainability, reliability, and security. * Mentor engineers through pairing, feedback, knowledge sharing, and practical guidance in both legacy and modern technologies. * Lead a workstream or small project team when needed, coordinate dependencies, surface risks early, and communicate progress clearly to technical and non\-technical partners. * Help establish modernization patterns that other teams can reuse, including coding standards, testing approaches, migration playbooks, and definition\-of\-done expectations. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * 15\+ years of professional software development experience, including meaningful hands\-on experience with C and/or C\+\+ in production systems. * Ability to read, diagnose, safely modify, and test a mature C/C\+\+ codebase; familiarity with compilers, linkers, debuggers, memory management, performance profiling, and native interoperability. * Professional experience with C\# and .NET or demonstrated ability to apply comparable object\-oriented and service\-development experience to the modern Microsoft stack. * Experience developing for Windows and Linux and working with relational databases, data modeling, and application integration. * Experience with automated testing, mocking frameworks, source control, pull\-request reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and modern branching strategies. * Working knowledge of secure software development practices, dependency management, secrets handling, authentication/authorization, and common application security risks. * Strong analytical, written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with a methodical approach to ambiguous technical problems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, Entity Framework Core, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Functions, App Service, containers, or comparable Azure services. * Experience modernizing desktop, native, or monolithic applications through staged migration, APIs, services, or modular architecture. * Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, GitHub Copilot or comparable AI coding assistants, and governance practices for enterprise AI use. * Experience evaluating or implementing generative AI capabilities using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt evaluation, content safety, or human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Experience with Python, PowerShell, telemetry, and production diagnostics. * Previous experience as a technical lead, feature lead, team lead, mentor, or acting lead. Formal people\-management experience is welcome but not required. **Additional Information** **Supervisory Responsibility** This position does not have formal supervisory responsibility at hire. The role may provide technical leadership, mentorship, work coordination, and project\-level guidance. Candidates interested in growing into broader team leadership are encouraged to apply. **Location** This position offers a hybrid work option for Rochester\-based employees and may be remote for employees outside the area. Occasional travel to BCC Software headquarters in Rochester, New York, may be required. **Position Type and Expected Hours of Work** Some flexibility in hours is allowed, but the employee must be available during core business hours, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Evening or weekend work may occasionally be required as job duties demand. **Physical Demands** This is primarily an office\-based role requiring extended periods of sitting, computer use, typing, writing, and verbal and written communication. Occasional standing, walking, or bending may be required. The employee must be able to lift up to 10 pounds regularly and up to 25 pounds occasionally. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role. **AAP/EEO Statement** BCC Software provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of age, race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, veteran or military status, marital status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, familial status, reproductive health decisions, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other basis protected by applicable law. The company takes affirmative action to ensure that applicants and employees are treated without regard to these characteristics. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated.

jobs.title: Software Engineer

Previous professional experience building and shipping web applications, including front\-end interfaces, back\-end services, and relational databases is required. Experience in logistics, transportation, or fuel distribution is a plus. This is a hands\-on position with responsibility from initial requirements through deployment and ongoing support. The engineer works independently, sets priorities with the Director of Data and Technology, and contributes to the security and reliability of the company's technology. **Experience with C\#/.NET, TypeScript and SvelteKit, SQL Server, and Python is preferred.** The ideal candidate is detail oriented, has time management skills, and is collaborative. Teamwork, Resourceful \& Creative, and Accountability are three of our company values that are also attributes of someone who will be successful in this position. The position is hybrid with our Athens, Ga location as the office location. The typical schedule will be Monday through Friday 8a\-5p. Occasional after\-hours response may be needed for urgent production issues. Compensation will be commensurate with experience. Boswell Oil Co. offers a competitive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, 401k with matching, other ancillary insurance options, paid time off, and paid holidays. The **Software Engineer** develops and maintains internal software that supports Boswell Oil Company's business operations. The role works directly with department leaders to understand their needs, improve processes, and deliver reliable applications, integrations, reporting, and automation. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include the following. These are functions a qualified incumbent or applicant must be able to perform with or without reasonable accommodation. * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain internal software within the architecture and technology standards set by the supervisor. * Work directly with department leaders to understand their processes, define requirements, and deliver software that fits how the company operates. * Maintain and support new and existing internal software, resolve defects, respond to user feedback, document systems, and train users. Keep documentation and deployment procedures current so other team members can also maintain and support the software. * Respond to urgent issues affecting production systems when they occur, including occasionally outside normal business hours. * Build and maintain reports, dashboards, data pipelines, and databases that support the company's operations and decision\-making. * Integrate business systems and automate data exchanges to reduce manual re\-entry. * Identify repetitive work across departments and automate it. * Build security into the design, development, deployment, and ongoing support of internal software and integrations. Protect company data and address security vulnerabilities as part of normal engineering work. * Work with IT staff and vendors on the infrastructure, access, deployment, and security needs of internal software. * Manage a backlog of requests, prioritize with the supervisor, and keep work moving without day\-to\-day supervision. * Keep skills current in software development, cybersecurity, and the technologies the company uses through continued education, such as courses, certifications, and training agreed upon with the supervisor. * Assist in the implementation of improvement projects or system enhancements, which will result in efficiency improvements, quality improvements, and/or cost savings. * Maintain adherence to Company policies, safety standards, and good housekeeping practices. * Problem solves issues as necessary. * Maintain cleanliness of work area and equipment. * Follow all department work instructions. * Follows prescribed safety rules and fosters an environment where employee safety is a top priority. * Performs other related duties as assigned. **SAFETY REQUIREMENTS:** Required and responsible for employee safety, attending safety training, complying with all company safety and work policies and reporting all accidents/injuries immediately to Manager and HR Department. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:** No direct supervisory responsibilities. **QUALIFICATIONS:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:** The minimum education required for this position is a high school diploma or equivalent, with preference for a Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, software engineering, or related field. Industry specific certifications may be considered in lieu of degree(s). Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role; or equivalent combination of education and experience. **LANGUAGE SKILLS:** Ability to read, analyze, and interpret documents. Ability to read, speak, and write the English language. Ability to gather information from and present prepared information to a variety of non\-technical groups including drivers, employees, and management. **MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:** Ability to comprehend and apply the principles of mathematics. Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios and proportions to practical solutions. **REASONING ABILITY:** This position requires an ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. **CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:** Preferred to possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and a driving record satisfactory to the Company and its insurers. **OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:** Computer software and technology skills to include professional experience building and shipping web applications, including front\-end interfaces, back\-end services, and relational databases. Experience taking a production application or substantial feature from initial requirements through deployment and ongoing support. Working proficiency in C\#/.NET or a comparable language and framework. Experience integrating third\-party systems through APIs, files, or database connections, with data modeling and building reports or dashboards, and working knowledge of cybersecurity practices, including secure coding, access control, and vulnerability management. Ability to learn new technologies quickly. Ability to gather requirements directly from non\-technical users and translate them into working software. Clear written and verbal communication skills; comfortable training users and documenting systems. Able to work independently, manage a backlog, and own a system end to end. Experience working as part of a team, collaborating with leadership, IT staff, and managers across departments to deliver shared results. **Experience with Python, TypeScript and SvelteKit or a comparable front\-end framework, and SQL Server, Entity Framework, and Linux server environments is preferred.**

With a buy\-grow\-and\-hold\-for\-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. ### **Overview** We are looking for an exceptional full\-stack software engineer who will act as a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, **accelerated adoption of AI\-assisted SDLC practices**, and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high\-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud\-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams. ### **Key Responsibilities** * **Application Modernization Execution:** Embed with application teams to provide hands\-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re\-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud\-native architectures. * **AI\-First SDLC Adoption \& Upskilling:** Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI\-assisted software development practices into the team's daily workflow. * **Consultative Engineering \& Change Management:** Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team\-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change. * **Hands\-on Software Development:** Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team. * **Feedback Loop:** Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities. * **Standards \& Quality:** Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve\-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high\-quality coding standards. ### **Required Qualifications \& Experience** * **Experience:** **5\+ years** of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization. * **Full Stack Proficiency:** Strong hands\-on experience across the full application stack (front\-end, back\-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C\#, Java). * **Cloud Native \& IaC:** Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform. * **Consulting \& Change Management:** Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams. * **DevSecOps \& CI/CD:** Hands\-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices. * **Architectural Understanding:** Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event\-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain\-Driven Design (DDD). * **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills:** Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. jobs.title: Marketing Engineer
jobs.description: **About Basata** ---------------- Basata is an AI\-powered platform transforming how specialty healthcare organizations operate. Its AI agents automate complex administrative and clinical workflows, from patient calls and referral management to scheduling and medical records. By integrating with existing EHRs and practice systems, Basata helps organizations reduce administrative burden, improve operational efficiency, and expand capacity for patient care. We are hiring our first Marketing Engineer. **About the role** ------------------ This role focuses on two areas: driving measurable revenue through SEO, AEO (answer engine optimization), and website conversion, and building AI\-powered workflows that make the whole marketing department faster, starting with events and webinars. You recommend the strategy, own it once the VP of Marketing approves it, and ship the pages, schema, experiments, and automations yourself. You'll be measured on a qualified pipeline from organic and website channels. **What you'll do** ------------------ 1\. Drive revenue through SEO, AEO, and website conversion * Own Basata's organic strategy end to end: keyword research, site architecture, technical SEO, and useful programmatic pages (by specialty, use case, EMR, and integration), built around what our buyers search for. * Build our AEO program so the major AI answer engines cite and recommend Basata. Track prompt sets and citation share, act on the results, and earn mentions where citations originate, such as healthcare review sites, directories, communities, and industry press. * Write the copy for website, landing, and SEO pages, and run it through content optimization and AI\-visibility tools. Implement structured data (JSON\-LD), semantic HTML, internal linking, and page\-speed improvements directly on the site. * Run a steady program of conversion experiments on landing pages, forms, demo flows, and calls to action to lift visit\-to\-opportunity conversion. * Own HubSpot lead capture, routing, and attribution for organic and website leads, plus the dashboards that tie rankings, AI visibility, traffic, and conversion to sales\-accepted pipeline. 2\. Build AI\-powered marketing workflows * Map how the marketing team works today, find the manual steps, and replace them with agents and automations the team uses every day. Build with LLM APIs, MCP, and automation tools, with evals and guardrails for accurate, on\-brand output. * Start with events and webinars: automate pre\-event research and outreach, registration and follow\-up sequences, attendee enrichment, session recaps, and the handoff of event leads to sales. * Build a workflow that turns webinar and event content into blog posts, social posts, emails, and AEO\-ready pages, with human review before anything is published. * Document each workflow, page template, and experiment as you build it, and train the team to run and extend it on their own. * Help set marketing's AI standards and tool choices, with extra care for accuracy and compliance in healthcare. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 3–5 years in B2B SEO, growth marketing, web or marketing operations, or growth engineering, including owning an SEO or website program and a track record of organic or website\-sourced pipeline. * Hands\-on technical SEO (crawling and indexing, site architecture, structured data and JSON\-LD, Core Web Vitals) and working knowledge of how LLMs retrieve and cite sources. Experience with AI\-visibility tools such as Profound, Peec AI, or Scrunch. * Strong writing skills, with content credible to physicians and practice administrators, and experience running website conversion experiments. * Fluency with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, HubSpot, and a modern CMS such as Webflow or WordPress, plus comfort editing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. * Experience building AI agents or automations that a team uses every day, and daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor. Nice to have * Experience marketing to healthcare providers, or in another regulated category. * Python or SQL to pull and analyze your own data. * Experience automating event and webinar marketing. * Early\-stage startup experience as the first or only person in a function. **Why Join Basata?** -------------------- * Drive real impact. Your work helps clinics run more smoothly and gets patients care faster, with fewer headaches. * Shape something meaningful. You'll play a real role in both the systems and the experience, not just execute someone else's design. * High ownership. We trust you to lead, build, and bring ideas to life. * Work with purpose. We're solving real problems in healthcare with tools people rely on every day. **Our Core Values** ------------------- * Find a way: We own outcomes — no excuses, no shortcuts. Whatever the challenge, we find a way. * Dream big: We refuse to accept that healthcare has to be broken, and we act deliberately to build a better version of it. * Obsess over the customer: Every decision starts with empathy for the people we serve — without compromising ethics, privacy, or trust. * Always be learning: We're relentless about growth — our own and each other's — because it makes us better teammates and leaders. * Move fast, deliver excellence: Speed unlocks momentum, but only paired with precision. We test, ship, and iterate quickly, and hold a high bar.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer II
jobs.description: **Date:** Nov 12, 2026 **Location:** US\-FL\-Clearwater, US **Company:** Bausch\+Lomb Companies Inc. Bausch \+ Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world—from the moment of birth through every phase of life. Our mission is simple, yet powerful: helping you see better, to live better. Our comprehensive portfolio of over 400 products is fully integrated and built to serve our customers across the full spectrum of their eye health needs throughout their lives. Our iconic brand is built on the deep trust and loyalty of our customers established over our 170\-year history. We have a significant global research, development, manufacturing and commercial footprint of approximately 13,000 employees and a presence in approximately 100 countries, extending our reach to billions of potential customers across the globe. We have long been associated with many of the most significant advances in eye health, and we believe we are well positioned to continue leading the advancement of eye health in the future. **Objective:** * Quality Engineer II provides quality engineering support to ensure product compliance and processes throughout the product lifecycle, including development, manufacturing, and post\-market in medical device regulated environment. * This position partners closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, R\&D, Supply Chain, and Quality Operations to ensure products and manufacturing processes consistently meet established specifications, quality system requirements, and applicable medical\-device regulatory requirements for release of Intraocular Lens (IOL) and Insertion Devices. **Responsibilities:** **Manufacturing Quality Support** * Provide day\-to\-day quality engineering support for IOL and Inserter manufacturing, inspection, testing, packaging, and related operations. * Evaluate manufacturing quality issues and provide timely quality\-engineering guidance to Operations and Engineering. * Review Lot History Records (LHRs) and evaluate production issues to confirm adherence to established product and process quality requirements. * Review and support disposition of nonconforming materials, components, work\-in\-process, and finished product. * Assess manufacturing deviations and nonconformances for product\-quality and patient\-risk implications. * Monitor manufacturing trends and identify opportunities to improve product quality, process consistency, and yield. * Supports the complaint investigation process. Interacts with Global Complaint Management group and other functions to investigate and as appropriate initiate corrective actions for complaints. **Investigation, CAPA and Process Improvements** * Support investigations involving process excursions, specification failures, inspection failures, and recurring manufacturing defects. * Lead or support investigations using structured root\-cause analysis methodologies such as 5 Whys, Fishbone/Ishikawa analysis, fault\-tree analysis, and data\-driven troubleshooting. * Partner with manufacturing teams to identify and implement effective corrective actions while maintaining compliance with approved procedures and specifications. * Develop and evaluate corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to address systemic quality issues. * Establish appropriate effectiveness checks and evaluate objective evidence to confirm corrective actions remain effective. * Perform trend analysis of nonconformances, defects, deviations, complaints, and other quality indicators as applicable. * Escalate significant or recurring quality issues in accordance with established quality\-system requirements. **Process Validation and Qualification** * Review and/or approve validation protocols and reports, including IQ/OQ/PQ/PV activities, as applicable * Evaluate proposed manufacturing and process changes for validation, documentation, and quality\-system impact. * Provide quality\-engineering support for manufacturing transfers, new or modified equipment, new processes, and product/process changes. * Support product and manufacturing\-process risk\-management activities throughout the product lifecycle process. **Quality System and Compliance** * Support internal, external, customer, and regulatory audits by preparing objective evidence and responding to auditor questions within assigned areas. * Maintain audit readiness through routine record and compliance reviews; support investigation, corrective\-action implementation, timely responses, and closure of audit observations. * Communicate quality issues, risks, investigation status, and recommendations clearly to technical teams and management. * Provides routine analysis of performance indicators (yield, NCs, Complaints, etc.) and identifies trends. Presents this information to management, supervisors, and manufacturing operators during Management Review and Annual Product Review. **Change Control and Risk Management** * Initiate, prepare, review, and approve Quality Change Requests (QCRs), Document Change Requests (DCRs), process deviations, and quality\-system changes; participate in Local Change Board (LCB) reviews as the Quality representative. * Perform documented risk assessments for nonconformances, CAPAs, manufacturing processes, equipment, and quality\-system changes. **Qualifications:** **Required Education:** * Bachelor’s degree (BS) in engineering or equivalent science degree. **Required Experience:** * Minimum of 3 years of Quality Engineering experience supporting medical device and/or pharmaceutical manufacturing. **Preferred Experience:** * Experience in medical\-device manufacturing, preferably ophthalmic, implantable, sterile, or other highly controlled products. * Knowledgeable of ISO 13485 and FDA/QSR requirements and quality system development and management. * Knowledge of statistical techniques and application experience. * Demonstrated project management and leadership skills, strong written and oral communication and interpersonal skills. * Working knowledge of FDA regulatory necessary experience with managing external agency audits necessary. * Training in problem solving tools is required (Process Mapping, Histograms, FMEA, Risk Assessment, Cause \& Effect Diagrams, PCDA, Pareto Analysis) * Strong Computer \& Information Technology Skills (Windows, Word, Excel, Access, Power Point, Project, Visio, statistical software usage \& principles.) jobs.title: Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (AI Products)
jobs.description: **About BizzyCar** BizzyCar is a B2B SaaS company transforming the automotive care experience for consumers, dealerships, and manufacturers. Our mission is to simplify car repairs, enabling consumers to resolve issues like recalls without leaving home or work. Through our automated platform, we streamline the process from manufacturers to dealers to customers, significantly reducing notification times and making repair scheduling seamless. Dealers benefit from increased repair revenue and strengthened customer relationships, while OEMs avoid costly fines. We are solving a $22B industry challenge, with over 70 million cars on the road having unresolved recalls. Employees enjoy competitive pay, equity opportunities, and medical benefits. While we’re a dispersed team, we prioritize collaboration and meet quarterly to maintain our strong culture. **About the role** As BizzyCar’s founding Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (FDSE), you will help our customers implement, adopt, and maximize our most cutting edge solutions. We're hiring a curious professional to own product launches on the ground: configuring the product to each dealership's systems and operations, training their staff, and being the calm, credible presence in the building when a brand\-new AI product starts automating processes at the dealership. In this role, you will be assigned to and become a subject matter expert on a specific product being rolled out to dealerships. Your training will make you comfortable with the automotive retail industry, customer processes, BizzyCar, frontier AI technology, application layer AI technology. You will be expected to use your knowledge and skills to make your implemented solutions maximally impactful to our customers and achieve loyalty from customers through delight. through structured discovery and engineering team collaboration * Validate that customer, availability, recall, and RO data flow correctly across systems before go\-live * Train non\-technical dealership staff to full adoption, and manage the change along the way * Run the implementation like a project — own the timeline, the stakeholders, and the go\-live date * Troubleshoot live: reproduce issues, read logs, tell a configuration problem from a product bug, and write clean repro steps * Know what to fix yourself versus what to escalate, and package escalations cleanly for engineering * Write the runbooks and SOPs that let this be repeatable — for the next dealer, and for the support team that eventually takes over steady\-state * Be the feedback loop — route what you learn on\-site back to product, reliably and specifically **What You'll Need****Required*** **Hands\-on integration \& configuration experience** — you've wired a product to external systems via APIs, Experience delivering customer training or enablement, ideally to non\-technical audiences * Implementation or deployment project management — you've run a kickoff\-to\-go\-live timeline and owned the stakeholders in it * Comfort validating and verifying data across systems (e.g., confirming records, statuses, or availability sync correctly) **Preferred** * Discovery and workflow\-mapping experience — translating a customer's process into product configuration * Issue triage and escalation experience in a customer\-facing technical role * Light scripting or SQL — enough to query data or script a quick validation (a plus, not a requirement) * Experience writing runbooks, SOPs, or setup documentation for handoff to a support team **Helpful Background** *You don't need deep expertise in all of these on day one, but familiarity with several will help you ramp fast:* * SaaS implementation and deployment methodology — onboarding lifecycle, go\-live, hypercare * APIs and integration patterns — REST, webhooks, authentication, and how systems talk to each other * Automotive retail or fixed\-ops experience — the service drive, repair orders, recalls, and the dealership's daily rhythm * The DMS and scheduling ecosystem — e.g., CDK, Reynolds, Tekion, Xtime, myKaarma * Data structure and validation concepts * Support and escalation processes — tiers, SLAs, and clean handoffs * Change management or adoption principles * Security and compliance basics — PII handling, call\-recording consent **Who You Are*** **Ownership** — you see things through to go\-live, not just to the jobs.title: Innovation & Data Analytics, Associate – Liquidity & Financing
jobs.description: Location: New York, New York Team: Data Analytics Job Requisition \#: R267125 Date posted: Nov. 12, 2026 **Job description** ------------------- **About this role** **Your team** The Innovation, Data \& Analytics (IDA) team sits across Liquidity \& Financing (L\&F) within BlackRock Global Markets and Index Investments (BGM). The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: * **Innovation \& Emerging Technology:** Research, evaluate, document, and test new and emerging technologies, identifying opportunities to generate revenue, improve productivity and scale, and mitigate risk. * **Derived Data Strategy:** Develop proprietary business data transformations and analytical logic through deep\-dive research into trading, market, product, and client dynamics. * **Analytics \& Business Intelligence:** Partner within multidisciplinary teams to develop and expand analytics and business intelligence capabilities based on business impact and demand. * **Data Platform \& Tooling:** Contribute to the development and evolution of L\&F's data platform and tooling, enabling scalable access to trusted data and supporting data\-driven decision making. * **Partnerships \& Collaboration:** Build and expand data, analytics, and research partnerships with key stakeholders across L\&F and the broader firm. **Your experience** * Undergraduate or graduate degree in a quantitative field such as Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related discipline, with strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. * 4\+ years of relevant experience in data strategy, analytics, or technology innovation within financial services or a related setting; experience in Securities Lending, Securities Financing, Cash Management, or adjacent markets is preferred. * Advanced proficiency in SQL and programming languages such as Python, with experience in data engineering workflows (ETL/ELT) and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau. * Familiarity with APIs, distributed data systems, cloud and UNIX/Linux environments, Git, and modern development workflows such as Azure DevOps is preferred. * Curiosity and demonstrated interest in AI, automation, and emerging technologies; experience with AI/ML/LLM techniques, agentic systems, or AI\-enhanced coding is a plus. * Exceptional problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex challenges into practical solutions while managing competing priorities with attention to detail. * Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to articulate findings, influence decisions, and drive alignment across diverse groups. For New York, NY Only the salary range for this position is USD$132,500\.00 \- USD$162,000\.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay\-for\-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance. **Our benefits** To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. **Our hybrid work model** BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. **Guidance on AI use for candidates** At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Payments)
jobs.description: At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose. We champion the power and potential of nonprofits, igniting next\-level impact with the team and technology built for purpose. That's why, even as the nonprofit sector sees declines in giving, Bloomerang customers raise more year over year. We're also in the business of creating thriving employees. Join a mission\-driven culture built on our core values of Simplify, Care and Act. We know our people are the key to our success, and we're proud to be home to some of the most innovative and skilled individuals in the workforce today. Come feel invigorated and unstoppable with us! ### **The Role** As a Senior Software Engineer at Bloomerang, you'll be a hands\-on engineer and a key driver of technical success on your team. You'll design, build, and ship production software that helps nonprofits raise the money that powers their missions. Agentic AI tools are part of how we build every day, across the whole delivery lifecycle, and how we work keeps changing as those tools do. You'll join Paid in Dreams, the team that owns payments at Bloomerang. In payments, reliability and security can't be compromised. A bug here can mean a donation that didn't go through or money that didn't land where it should. Stripe is our primary processor, and the work covers processor integrations, webhooks, and the donor\-facing experiences built on top of them. We're looking for a pragmatic engineer who sees the bigger picture. You understand how a change ripples across systems, products, and the people who use them. You find the real problem before reaching for a solution, and you know when something needs rigor and when good enough is fine. You bring ideas without assuming you have all the answers, and you're curious about the customer problem behind the ticket. ### **How You'll Show Up** * **Own your work and drive it to done.** Treat commitments as promises, push through the murky middle, and share bad news early. * **Communicate directly.** Ask the question, raise the concern, and keep the team in the loop. * **Use good judgment and welcome feedback.** Make sound decisions with incomplete information, and treat feedback as useful information to act on. * **Keep learning.** Pick up new tools quickly and let go of approaches that no longer fit. * **Think like a product engineer.** Connect technical work to business goals and to the experience of nonprofits and their donors. ### **What You Will Do** * Design, build, test, and ship features and integrations across the payments stack, from processor APIs and webhooks to the UI. Partner with product, design, and support to understand the problem nonprofits and their donors face before you build. * Use agentic AI tools every day to deliver value faster, and help shape the harnesses, guardrails, and conventions that keep AI\-generated code aligned with our architecture. * Keep payment flows secure, reliable, and observable. Debug production issues to the root cause, and improve the live codebase, including legacy code, step by step with the team's agreement instead of through unilateral rewrites. * Make the team better. Review code, pair with teammates, and share what you know so it doesn't stay siloed. Represent payments in cross\-team work and bring that context back. ### **What You Need to Succeed** **AI Fluency** * Hands\-on experience taking AI\-assisted or AI\-driven work to production, beyond writing prompts, in large, established codebases, not just greenfield projects. * Enough architectural understanding to codify it into the harnesses, instructions, and reviews that keep AI tools producing code that fits the system. **Technical Depth** * Strong recent experience as a hands\-on senior engineer shipping and supporting a live production app. * A deep understanding of software architecture, which matters more to us than any specific language. Our stack includes .NET/C\#, TypeScript/Node, React, and SQL, and strong engineers from similar ecosystems will ramp up quickly. This includes: + object\-oriented design, distributed systems, and event\-driven architecture + asynchronous programming + relational databases and ORMs + automated testing + modern front\-end and component architecture, including micro\-frontends * Experience with modern payment processing at scale. That means immediate API responses confirmed later by asynchronous webhooks, and the failure modes that come with them. It also means third\-party rate limits, queuing and retries, and traffic spikes. Experience with Stripe, PayPal, or similar processors. * A working knowledge of modern security practices for web and payment systems, and the instinct to spot a brittle or insecure design before it ships. **Collaboration** * You thrive on a tight\-knit, highly communicative team that talks every day and jumps on quick calls to work through problems together. **Benefits** **Health \+ Wellness** You'll have access to generous health, vision, and dental insurance options as well as HealthiestYou, a healthcare service that offers convenient, confidential access to quality doctors 24/7, anytime, anywhere. **Time Off** You'll get a competitive PTO package that includes 20 PTO days, 3 flex days, 4 optional volunteer days, 12 paid holidays, as well as paid parental leave. More is more! **401k** You'll receive a 401k match to help invest in your future. **Equipment** Everything you need to be successful, shipped right to your door. You got this. We got you. **Compensation** The salary range for this position is $114,800 \- $191,400\. You may also be eligible for a discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, as well as applicable employment laws **Location** This is a permanent, full\-time, fully remote position (within the U.S. and select Canadian Provinces only). Employees living in Indianapolis, IN are welcome to work from our company headquarters. We do not offer Visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time. **Accommodations** Applicants who require accommodations may contact careers@bloomerang.com to request an accommodation in completing an application. *Bloomerang is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **What You Will Be Doing:** The AI/ML Engineer is an AI\-first technical expert responsible for designing, building, and deploying intelligent solutions that improve how Bolton \& Menk delivers its work. Machine learning, generative AI, and agentic solutions are the primary focus of this role and represent the largest share of its work. The role also spans software development, business intelligence development, data science, and analytics, each approached with an AI\-first mindset. Working alongside engineering, GIS, CAD, and corporate teams, the AI/ML Engineer has the opportunity to touch many aspects of a project throughout its lifecycle, from initial discovery through production and adoption. * Design, build, and deploy generative AI and agentic solutions, including LLM applications, retrieval\-augmented generation, and multi\-step agent workflows with appropriate human review. * Design and implement ML models for structured and unstructured data, including prediction, classification, and computer vision, and apply classical AI techniques where appropriate. * Evaluate, monitor, and improve models and agents in production for quality, cost, and risk. * Develop web applications, APIs, integrations, and automations that support project delivery and business operations. * Write clean, modular, and testable code, adhering to software engineering best practices and using AI coding assistants to accelerate development. * Design and build data pipelines, data models, dashboards, and reports that give leaders and project teams trusted, self\-service access to business information. * Conduct statistical analysis, forecasting, and ad hoc analytics to answer business questions and inform decisions. * Collaborate with IT, security, and platform teams to ensure responsible deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of solutions. * Engage with stakeholders across practices and business units to identify opportunities for AI, software, and analytics solutions, translate business needs into technical solutions, and deliver measurable impact. **What We Are Looking For:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent experience;
