jobs.title: Staff AI Systems Thermal Engineer
jobs.description: **Please Note:** **1\. If you are a first time user, please create your candidate login account before you apply for a job.** **2\. If you already have a Candidate Account, please Sign\-In before you apply.** **Job Description:** -------------------- We are looking for an experienced **AI Systems Thermal Engineer** to lead the end\-to\-end thermal design, simulation, optimization, and physical validation of Direct\-to\-Chip (D2C) liquid cooling solutions for next\-generation AI accelerators and high\-density compute platforms. In this role, you will own the thermal\-hydraulic performance of custom cold plates, interface materials, and fluid delivery subsystems—ensuring our high\-power ASICs operate within safe thermal limits at peak workloads. You will collaborate closely with silicon package designers, board layout teams, mechanical housing engineers, and manufacturing partners from concept through mass production. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Thermal \& CFD Modeling:** Build and run detailed Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and thermal\-resistance network models to evaluate temperature distribution, pressure drop, and flow balancing across cold plates, trays, and racks. * **Advanced Technology Implementation:** Research advanced cooling technologies and develop integration and test plans to validate these technologies and convert them into production solutions. * **Cold Plate Design \& Optimization:** Co\-design high\-performance liquid cold plates with strategic industry partners to cool high\-heat\-flux AI processors. * **Thermal Interface Materials (TIM):** Specify, select, and qualify thermal interface materials for large, high warpage, devices to minimize contact resistance between silicon dies and cold plates on large devices * **System \& Hydraulic Integration:** Design coolant flow paths, quick\-disconnects (QDs), hoses, and cold\-plate retention/loading mechanisms in alignment with server chassis and OCP (Open Compute Project) standards. * **Lab Validation \& Testing:** Plan and execute physical thermal testing in the lab—including thermocouple instrumentation, pressure/flow mapping, thermal test vehicle (TTV) bring\-up, and simulation\-to\-test correlation. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with mechanical, electrical, firmware (thermal control algorithms), and supply chain teams to drive PCBA, tray and system level designs from NPI (New Product Introduction) to high\-volume manufacturing. **Qualifications \& Requirements:** * **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Mechanical or Thermal Engineering** (M.S. preferred), or equivalent. * **Experience:** Bachelors plus 8\+ years of experience, or Masters plus 6\+ years of experience. Hands\-on experience in thermal/mechanical design for high\-power electronics, AI hardware, servers, or HPC systems. * Proven, direct experience designing and deploying **Direct Liquid Cooling (DLC)** systems, specifically **liquid cold plates**, coolant distribution units (CDUs), and manifold loops. **Technical Skills:** * **Electronics Cooling:** Deep understanding of single\-phase and/or two\-phase heat transfer, fluid dynamics, pressure drop calculations, and electronics packaging interactions. Experience with air cooled systems also an asset. * **Simulation Tools:** High proficiency in CFD and thermal analysis software (preferably Flotherm, FloEFD, and MacroFlow.). * **Lab Instrumentation:** Experience with thermal data acquisition systems, flow meters, pressure transducers, and lab automation (Python, MATLAB, or LabVIEW). * **CAD \& Mechanical Design:** Experience with electronics packaging and CAD platforms, preferably CREO, an asset. **Compensation and Benefits** The annual base salary range for this position is USD To USD As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements. Broadcom offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401(K) participation including company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company paid holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time. The company follows all applicable laws for Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence. **Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with local law.** **If you are located outside USA, please be sure to fill out a home address as this will be used for future correspondence.**

Please send to Tommy.Grace@livebryten.com** At **Bryten,** we're more than just a place to live—we're a community where residents feel welcomed, valued, and connected. We are seeking a data\-driven **AI Solutions Analyst** to join our team and help transform the way we work through innovative AI solutions, intelligent automation, and data\-driven insights. jobs.description: Burro is the leading robotics company in the world by number of robots working outdoors in the field with real customers. simulation\-based testing frameworks with Isaac and Gazebo, creating scenarios for our virtual fleet in industrial and agricultural environments. * Create and maintain ROS\-based testing frameworks software, and cloud\-based services. * Drive the integration of QA processes into continuous integration, deployment, and testing (CI/CD/CT) pipelines, ensuring consistency and reliability. * Build and maintain internal tools and dashboards to monitor the health and performance of testing systems, collaborating with the Platform team on shared monitoring infrastructure to provide critical insights. * Identify, document, and track software defects and bugs, working closely with development teams for efficient resolution. * Support field testing and validation of autonomous systems in jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Environments and Data
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build evaluation environments and benchmarks that measure whether AI agents can perform real company work and match or exceed human performance. jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a research and engineering team building privacy and anonymization systems for sensitive data used in AI training. You will help protect personal and confidential information while preserving the structure and utility of data for downstream workflows. ### **What You'll Do** * Build systems to detect personally identifiable information, quasi\-identifiers, credentials, and other sensitive content, then select transformations suited to the data and its intended use. * Develop and benchmark detection methods that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers, and language models. * Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it reaches processing, training, evaluation, or synthetic data workflows. * Create evaluation frameworks for privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall\-weighted metrics, leakage tests, and adversarial re\-identification attempts. * Design robust systems that handle new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats, and sensitive information in unexpected fields. * Work with engineering, research, operations, and customers to turn privacy requirements into practical policies and safeguards. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 2 years of experience building production data or machine learning systems in Python, with strong Python proficiency. * A technical education or equivalent technical background, and experience building end\-to\-end data processing pipelines. * Hands\-on experience detecting, removing, or anonymizing PII while preserving useful characteristics, using information extraction, named\-entity recognition, classification, or related methods. * Experience benchmarking detection methods and evaluating recall, precision, latency, cost, and downstream data utility. * Understanding of redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization, and synthetic data generation. * Experience designing systems resilient to schema drift, unusual data formats, and processing edge cases. * Experience with privacy\-enhancing technologies such as differential privacy, k\-anonymity, secure aggregation, or format\-preserving encryption is valuable. * Experience with high\-throughput or low\-latency inference, sensitive data in areas such as healthcare, finance, or security, or taking research systems into production is also valuable. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $130,000 to $225,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States. Compensation Range: $130K \- $225K

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer, Perception

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Security
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** The Crusoe Cloud Software Development team is seeking a passionate and experienced Senior Software Engineer specializing in Linux Kernel Security. This critical role is essential in strengthening the security posture of our core Linux kernel and operating system components, which underpin our cutting\-edge hardware and software solutions for the AI cloud. A deep understanding of Linux kernel internals, security vulnerabilities, mitigation techniques, and secure development practices is paramount for developing reliable, high\-assurance systems. This is a full\-time position. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Kernel Hardening \& CVE Triage**: Implement kernel security enhancements, manage configuration hardening, and triage incoming CVEs to assess severity and exploitability. * **Access Control, Boot Security \& Guardrails: Enforce mandatory access controls, secure the boot path, and establish CI guardrails and fuzzing coverage to prevent regressions.** * **Vulnerability Research \& Analysis**: Research vulnerabilities across kernel, driver, and OS components to build proactive mitigations and backport non\-trivial upstream fixes to production. * **Secure Development Practices**: Establish and advocate for secure coding standards and best practices for kernel\-level development. Conduct security\-focused code reviews to identify and eliminate potential vulnerabilities early in the development lifecycle. * **Security Auditing \& Tools**: Utilize and develop specialized tools for kernel security auditing, fuzzing, static analysis, and dynamic analysis to uncover hidden vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security policies. * **Incident Response Support**: Provide expert support during security incidents involving kernel or OS\-level compromises, assisting with root\-cause analysis, containment, and recovery efforts. * **Performance and Security Balance**: Work to ensure that security enhancements do not unduly impact system performance, especially critical for our high\-performance AI infrastructure. * **First 90 days: Own kernel CVE triage end to end and have shipped at least one backported fix through our full release path. You have an independent read on where our kernel configuration is weakest.** * **First year: Kernel security response has a defined SLA by severity and we consistently hit it. A hardening baseline is defined, enforced in CI, and rolled out across supported SKUs. Cloud Hypervisor has been audited and the highest\-value isolation gaps are closed or scheduled.** * **Cloud Hypervisor \& Isolation**: Audit, harden, and reduce privilege across Cloud Hypervisor device models and vhost\-user datapaths, contributing upstream security fixes and advancing confidential computing primitives (AMD SEV\-SNP, Intel TDX). * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Collaborate closely with other engineering teams (hardware, hypervisor, OS development, cloud infrastructure, and security operations) to integrate security best practices and ensure a comprehensive security strategy across the stack. * **Technical Leadership**: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers on kernel security best practices, fostering a culture of security awareness and excellence. * **Debugging and Root\-Cause Analysis**: Debug and root\-cause a variety of complex security\-related issues at the kernel level. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Linux Kernel Security Expertise**: Proven deep knowledge of Linux kernel internals (e.g., memory management, process scheduling, system calls, I/O subsystems) with a strong focus on security aspects. * **Vulnerability \& Exploitation Knowledge**: Solid understanding of common kernel vulnerabilities (e.g., privilege escalation, information disclosure, denial of service) and associated exploitation techniques. * **Security Mitigations**: Experience with existing Linux kernel security mitigations (e.g., ASLR, DEP/NX, SMEP/SMAP, KASLR, namespaces, cgroups, LSMs like SELinux/AppArmor). * **Secure Coding**: Strong background in secure coding principles and experience conducting security\-focused code reviews, particularly in C. * **Debugging \& Analysis Tools**: Proficiency with kernel debugging tools (e.g., GDB, crash, kgdb) and security analysis tools (e.g., valgrind, address sanitizers, fuzzers). * **Hardware Security Concepts**: Familiarity with hardware\-assisted security features (e.g., Intel SGX, AMD SEV, ARM TrustZone) and their relevance to kernel security. * **Education \& Experience**: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, and a minimum of 5 years of relevant industry experience with at least 3 years focused on low\-level operating systems or kernel security. * **Safety and Compliance**: Must be able to pass a background check. * **Company Values**: Embody the Company values. * Experience dealing with CVE Remediation and automation * First 90 days: **You own kernel CVE triage** end to end and have shipped at least one backported fix through our full release path. You have an independent read on where our kernel configuration is weakest. * First year: **Kernel security response has a defined SLA** by severity and we consistently hit it.A hardening baseline is defined, enforced in CI, and rolled out across supported SKUs. Cloud Hypervisor has been audited and the highest\-value isolation gaps are closed or scheduled. **Bonus Points** * Experience with specific kernel security projects or contributions to open\-source kernel security initiatives. * Familiarity with hypervisor security and the interaction between the hypervisor and the guest kernel’s security. * Experience with hardware security modules (HSMs) or Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs). * Background in offensive security or penetration testing at the kernel level. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 \- $205,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Validation Engineer
jobs.description: **This role requires working from Canopy headquarter in Detroit and various testing facilities in the Metro Detroit/Dearborn area. Candidates should be prepared to work onsite testing and collaboration within this geographical area on a weekly basis.** **The Senior Hardware Validation Engineer leads end\-to\-end hardware validation activities across the product\-development lifecycle for Canopy products. This role is responsible for establishing validation strategies, managing test plans and execution, maintaining requirements traceability, and driving testing best practices and process improvements.** **The engineer will combine hands\-on testing and test\-rig development with validation\-management responsibilities, including coordinating with cross\-functional teams and suppliers, tracking test progress and risks, and communicating validation readiness. The role also leads technical issue triage and root\-cause analysis to ensure timely containment and corrective actions. This position provides technical leadership and mentorship but does not include direct people\-management responsibility.** **Responsibilities:** * **Validation Management: Lead and manage end\-to\-end hardware validation activities across all development phases, ensuring plans, schedules, execution, and deliverables align with product requirements and program milestones.** * **Test Strategy and Planning: Develop and maintain validation plans, test procedures, test cases, and execution strategies that provide complete requirements coverage and traceability.** * **Testing Best Practices and Process Excellence: Establish, champion, and continuously improve testing standards, tools, workflows, and validation processes to drive consistency, efficiency, quality, and repeatability.** * **Test Execution and Reporting: Oversee and participate in hardware, vehicle\-level, and controlled\-environment testing; clearly communicate test status, results, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.** * **Issue Triage and Root\-Cause Analysis: Lead the investigation of hardware defects and test failures, partnering with engineering teams and suppliers to identify root causes, define containment actions, and implement permanent corrective actions** * **Supplier and Cross\-Functional Coordination: Manage validation activities with suppliers and collaborate with hardware, software, systems, quality, DFMEA/PFMEA, and vehicle integration teams to resolve risks and ensure product readiness.** * **Test Infrastructure and Documentation: Support the development of test rigs and test environments, and maintain validation documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures, test reports, lessons learned, and Interface Control Document verification.** * **Technical Leadership: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers while promoting a disciplined, data\-driven validation culture across the organization.** **Requirements** **Minimum Requirements and Qualifications:** * Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * Relevant Experience: Five or more years of experience in hardware validation, hardware test engineering, quality engineering, or a similar product\-development role. * Hardware Validation Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing and executing hardware validation plans, test procedures, test cases, and test reports across product\-development phases. * Test Equipment and Test Rig Experience: Hands\-on experience building or supporting test rigs and using bench\-level test equipment, including oscilloscopes, programmable power supplies, CAN analyzers, digital multimeters, and spectrum analyzers. * Testing and Troubleshooting Skills: Strong knowledge of hardware, sensors, and peripherals, with the ability to execute tests, triage failures, perform root\-cause analysis, and support corrective\-action development. * Requirements and Documentation Discipline: Experience translating hardware requirements into test cases, maintaining requirements traceability, and documenting test results, issues, and lessons learned. * Collaboration and Communication: Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional engineering teams, suppliers, and quality stakeholders in a fast\-paced product\-development environment. * Vehicle Testing Capability: Valid driver’s license and ability to support vehicle testing as needed. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Education: M.Sc degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * Automotive Experience: Previous experience in automotive product development, ideally within an OEM, Tier 1 supplier, or automotive technology organization. * Vehicle Network Knowledge: Proficiency with automotive communication protocols, including CAN 2\.0, CAN FD, Ethernet, LIN, SENT, and FlexRay. * Systems and Vehicle Integration: Experience with vehicle\-level integration testing, Interface Control Document (ICD) verification, and automotive electronic systems architecture. * Quality and Risk Management Methods: Working knowledge of structured problem\-solving and quality methods, including 8D, DFMEA, PFMEA, change management, and Six Sigma principles. * Test Automation and Development Tools: Experience with test automation, continuous integration or deployment pipelines, and tools such as GitLab, AWS services, Jira, Zephyr, Asana, or Microsoft Office applications. * Embedded and Linux Testing: Hands\-on experience testing Linux\-based or embedded hardware devices, including integration, regression, performance, stress, end\-to\-end, and security testing. * Electronics and Compliance Knowledge: Ability to interpret electronic schematics and PCB layouts, with practical experience supporting EMC/EMI design compliance and validation. **Working Conditions For Roles in the US Region only:** * Work is generally performed in a well\-lit, temperature\-controlled indoor environment with occasional exposure to the outdoors or any number of elements. * Work is performed with exposure to any number of elements which may occasionally require some precautions such as safety glasses, protective clothing, gear protection, etc. * Ability to travel in\-state and out\-of\-state or globally. * Ability to work irregular shifts and extended hours, including evenings and weekends. **Benefits** * Comprehensive medical benefits coverage, dental plans and vision coverage. * Health care and dependent care spending accounts. * Employee and Family Assistance Program (EAP). * Employee discount programs. * Retirement plan with a generous company match. * Generous Paid Time Off, Sick, and Holidays * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Short\- and long\-term disability * Life insurance and accidental death \& dismemberment insurance Compensation Range Compensation may vary depending on skills and experience. **Base Salary: $111,775 \- $136,935** **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion:** At Canopy, we're on a mission to end theft from vehicles and revolutionize vehicle security by building cutting\-edge technology. We will achieve this by prioritizing individuals and staying attuned to the evolving needs of our people, users, and industry trends. We foster a workplace culture that embraces diversity and authenticity, enabling us to flourish as a team of exceptional individuals working towards a common purpose. We gain a deeper understanding of our users' experiences by continuously improving our skills and expanding our knowledge. A more diverse, equitable, and inclusive Canopy leads to greater innovation and success. **Equal Opportunity:** Canopy does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (On-site)
jobs.description: **We’re Canvas Credit Union** We’re passionate about transforming financial services. Our members, families, and the communities we call home motivate everything we do. As part of the credit union movement, we believe in providing our members with education, support, and guidance to build strong financial futures. Canvas "It's About More" Video \- YouTube (Click here \- or, visit https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=z8WAm\_TDRdk ) (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=z8WAm\_TDRdk) **Why Canvas?** At Canvas, we’re dedicated to transforming financial services from the inside out. Our culture is a top priority and second to none. We strive to balance hard work and high achievement with a fun, supportive environment. At Canvas, there are 5 behaviors we live by each day that will continue to help us be known for our heart and our people: **What’s In It For You** * **Seriously good benefits**: Beyond healthcare, dental, and life insurance, we make it so worth your while. Canvas employees get up to a 10% company contribution to their 401k, generous personal time off, and employee discounts on loans (that includes cars and houses!). The starting pay range for this position is $99,000\.00\-$118,113\.00/annual, and final pay rate and job level will be determined based on experience, education, skills, and internal equity factors. Canvas benefits include: * + Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance + Paid Vacation + Paid Sick Time + Paid Holidays + Paid Wellness Day + Paid Volunteer Time + Flexible Spending Account + Health Savings Account + World Class 401(k) Plan + Tuition Reimbursement + Rate Discounts on Qualifying Loans + May be eligible for incentives or discretionary bonus based on results **What you'll do** The Full Stack Developer will work with internal clients to design, develop, test, and implement web sites, web applications, and APIs. Our team is small, highly collaborative, and friendly. The team works with C\#, React, TypeScript, and SQL. Our ideal candidate is diligent, eager, easy to work with, and humble. **We are considering candidates for both Full Stack Developer I and Full Stack Developer II positions. The level at which the selected candidate is hired, along with the corresponding compensation, will be determined based on their qualifications, skills, experience, and alignment with the requirements of the role.** **Essential Duties/Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, and continuously improve web sites, web applications, and APIs. * Work closely with product owners, business analysts, software architects, UI/UX designers, QA testers, and other developers to iron out and implement requirements. * Be a solid knowledgebase for best practices in React, CSS, C\#, and SQL. * Evaluate and test third\-party software packages for compatibility with existing systems and ease of use and determine if software meets our needs and priorities. * Mentor junior programmers. * Embrace ongoing education and learn/apply new skills and software applications. * Keep informed about relevant technologies and trends. * Conduct software demos, share progress updates, and provide guidance to team members. * Assist and participate in software deployments. * Proactively support applications by monitoring helpdesk tickets, investigating production errors, reviewing security reports, creating user stories, and updating documentation as needed. * Initiate and coordinate meetings with users, system administrators, and cross\-functional teams as needed. **Job Qualifications** Knowledge, Skill and Ability: * Advanced knowledge of C\#, Entity Framework, React, JavaScript, Typescript, HTML, CSS, Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio, Git, SQL Server, XML, RESTful, and SOAP based web services. * Understanding of Scrum/Agile software development principles. * Experience and knowledge of MS Azure DevOps (or similar) and CI/CD processes. * Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to interact with technical colleagues and other senior management/credit union employees as appropriate. * Strong relationship building and teamwork skills with ability to develop and maintain consultative relationships with Canvas colleagues. **General Employment Requirements** * Exhibit support for the organization’s goals, values, initiatives, and cost control. * Recommend and help develop and implement new policies and procedures. * Comply with the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and other compliance requests and requirements. * Keep informed on developments and trends in report writing including new products, services, and technological advances. * Follow all safety and security guidelines to properly safeguard member and organization assets. * Embrace ongoing education and learn/apply new skills and software applications. * Regular attendance and punctuality are essential functions of the job. * Perform other job\-related duties as assigned. * Working knowledge of Windows operating systems, Workstations, Microsoft Office, and other software packages to diagnose equipment, software or operational problems. * Working knowledge of using, troubleshooting, and maintaining computer and networking equipment. * Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. * Ability to maintain confidences. * Pre\-employment background review (components include criminal, employment, address, social security number, motor vehicle record, global sanctions, and sex offender). **Education or Formal Training:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field with an emphasis on development, or equivalent experience. If you’re good at what you do, we want you on the team. **Experience:** Minimum of two to five years of development experience. Experience with Agile/Scrum development frameworks desired. **For Current Canvas Employees:** To be considered, you must be meeting performance expectations, consistently demonstrating HEART behaviors, **and** **must submit** an up\-to\-date resume **or** update your Work History profile with your current responsibilities and accomplishments. **Working Environment/Physical Activities** High volume, fast\-paced, dynamic office environment with some travel. Must be able to attend meetings and events outside of regular business hours. The job routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, copiers, fax machines and filing cabinets. The position requires manual dexterity, the ability to lift files and open filing cabinets. The position requires bending, stooping, or standing as necessary. **Other Duties** Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Applications for this position will be accepted through December 3, 2026\. For consideration, applications must be received by 11:59 PM MST on December 3, 2026\. *\#LI\-Onsite* Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: MuleSoft Developer
jobs.description: **Company Description** CapTech is an award\-winning consulting firm that collaborates with clients to achieve what’s possible through the power of technology. At CapTech, we’re passionate about the work we do and the results we achieve for our clients. From the outset, our founders shared a collective passion to create a consultancy centered on strong relationships that would stand the test of time. Today we work alongside clients that include Fortune 100 companies, mid\-sized enterprises, and government agencies, a list that spans across the country. **Job Description** MuleSoft Developers at CapTech are part of a capable, highly motivated community that continuously develops its technical skills and delivers innovative solutions for our clients. Our consultants design, develop, and deliver high\-quality enterprise applications and integrations in a collaborative, project\-based consulting environment. CapTech consultants have opportunities to work alongside developers, technical leads, architects, and clients while gaining exposure to a variety of technologies and industries. Our solutions include API\-driven applications, microservice architectures, event\-driven integrations, cloud deployments, serverless applications, and web and portal front ends. **Specific responsibilities for the MuleSoft Developer position include:** * Collaborate with team members and clients todesign, develop, and deliver technical solutions that meet the unique needs of our clients. * Partner with clients on cross\-functional, team\-based projects to deliver scalable MuleSoft solutions across the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) using Agile methodologies. * Contribute to technical design decisions and integration approaches while aligning solutions with established architecture and business requirements. * Design, build, test, deploy, and support MuleSoft integrations and APIs using Anypoint Platform. * Communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders to clarify requirements, explain technical solutions, and support project decision\-making. * Create high\-quality technical deliverables, including integration designs, API specifications, documentation, and implementation artifacts. * Apply integration patterns, development standards, and engineering best practices to deliver maintainable and scalable solutions. * Participate in code reviews and technical discussions while sharing knowledge and best practices with other team members. * Troubleshoot complex integration issues across applications, APIs, data sources, and cloud environments. * Leverage CapTech’s internal programs and self\-directed training to continually develop industry\-relevant technical knowledge and skills. * Gain exposure to a variety of clients, business models, technologies, and industry verticals. **Qualifications** Required Qualifications: * 5\+ years of software development or systems integration experience, with hands\-on experience delivering MuleSoft solutions. * Experience developing integrations using MuleSoft 4\.x and Anypoint Platform. * Experience creating Mule applications using Anypoint Studio. * Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and API\-led connectivity. * Experience designing, developing, and publishing APIs to Anypoint Exchange. * Experience designing APIs using RAML and/or OpenAPI specifications. * Applied knowledge of API development using REST and/or SOAP. * Experience integrating enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Workday, Oracle ERP, or similar platforms. * Familiarity with microservice architectures, asynchronous/event\-driven integration patterns, and application monitoring. * Experience troubleshooting and supporting integrations across distributed enterprise environments. * Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and/or GCP is a plus. * Experience with relational database technologies and familiarity with NoSQL technologies. * Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing, and modern DevOps practices. * Understanding of enterprise security practices related to APIs and integrations, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and secure data handling. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Preferred/Additional Experience:** * Experience integrating applications or APIs with LLM\-based solutions such as GPT, Claude, or Mistral. * Familiarity with prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agentic AI concepts. * Exposure to AI/agent frameworks or orchestration tools such as LangChain, n8n, or Pydantic\-based solutions. * Familiarity with conversational AI, prompt evaluation, and multi\-agent workflows. **Additional Information** We want everyone at CapTech to be able to envision a lasting and rewarding career here, which is why we offer a variety of career paths based on your skills and passions. You decide where and how you want to develop, and we help get you there with customizable career progression and a comprehensive benefits package to support you along the way. * Learning \& Development – Programs offering certification and tuition support, digital on\-demand learning courses, mentorship, and skill development paths * Modern Health –A mental health and well\-being platform that provides 1:1 care, group support sessions, and self\-serve resources to support employees and their families through life’s ups and downs * Carrot Fertility –Inclusive fertility and family\-forming coverage for all paths to parenthood – including adoption, surrogacy, fertility treatments, pregnancy, and more – and opportunities for employer\-sponsored funds to help pay for care * Fringe –A company paid stipend program for personalized lifestyle benefits, allowing employees to choose benefits that matter most to them – ranging from vendors like Netflix, Spotify, and GrubHub to services like student loan repayment, travel, fitness, and more * Employee Resource Groups – Employee\-led committees that embrace and incorporate diversity and inclusion into our day\-to\-day operations * Philanthropic Partnerships – Opportunities to engage in partnerships and pro\-bono projects that support our communities. * 401(k) Matching – Generous matching and no vesting period to help you continue to build financial wellness *CapTech is committed to providing a flexible work environment and helping our employees achieve a work\-life balance that suits their individual needs. Employees must be available to work onsite in a client location or a CapTech office as requested. We allow CapTech employees to work remotely when compatible with CapTech and client needs.* CapTech supports Equal Pay for all. In addition, in the State of Virginia, we are committed to Equal Pay for ALL in accordance with the Virginia Transparency Law. Compensation for this role will be commensurate with the candidate’s skills, total relevant experience, job level, and geographic location. The base pay range for this role is: $90,000\-$180,000\. CapTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a culture of equality, inclusion and fairness — each foundational to our core values. We strive to create a diverse environment where each employee is encouraged to bring their unique ideas, backgrounds and experiences to the workplace. For more information about our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging efforts, click HERE. **At this time, CapTech cannot transfer nor sponsor a work visa for this position. Applicants must be authorized to work directly for any employer in the United States without visa sponsorship.**

Our core mission is to engineer outcomes that strategically enable the Finance organization and the broader Enterprise to remain efficient. This mission is driven by four technical and functional pillars: Forecasting \& Resiliency, providing advanced decision support; Treasury \& Trade managing sophisticated cash and investment lifecycles; and Accounting \& Reporting, ensuring the integrity of our general ledger and regulatory commitments. jobs.description: ***What Application Development \& Maintenance contributes to Cardinal Health*** Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services. This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value. Application Development \& Maintenance performs configuration or coding to develop, enhance and sustain the organization's software systems in a cross\-functional team environment through adherence to established design control processes and good engineering practices. This job family programs and configures end user applications, systems, databases and websites to achieve the organization's internal needs and externally\-facing business needs. Application Development \& Maintenance partners with business leaders, investigates user needs and conducts regular assessments, maintenance and enhancements of existing applications. The Engineer will play a key role in supporting the Pharmaceutical and Specialty Distribution and Product and Solutions Marketing organizations along with the larger enterprise. We are seeking an experienced OutSystems Engineer with a proven record of delivering results to be a core builder on our new Low\-Code Center of Excellence. This is a hands\-on development role for someone who turns business needs into high\-quality, working applications. You will be the strongest hands\-on\-keyboard developer on the team, building and delivering mission\-critical applications that directly impact our business in medical, pharmaceutical, and nuclear medicine manufacturing. ***Responsibilities*** * Be the Team's Hands\-On Technical Anchor: As the most experienced hands\-on developer on our OutSystems team, you will build, deliver, and support high\-quality applications and set the standard for code quality by example. You will follow and apply established SDLC best practices and governance standards to ensure security and quality in everything you ship. * Develop and Enhance Core Platform Capabilities: Build and enhance capabilities of our low\-code platform, with a focus on creating robust, scalable integrations with our enterprise software solutions. * Build Mission\-Critical Applications: Take hands\-on ownership of developing complex web and native mobile applications using OutSystems that solve key business challenges in areas like business process management and partner relationship management. * Turn Requirements into Working Solutions: Work closely with the Technical Product Manager and the team to break initiatives into actionable technical stories, then deliver them on time with well\-tested, maintainable code. Raise risks and technical considerations early so that plans stay realistic and achievable. * Support the Federated CoE: Contribute to our federated development community by participating in code reviews, sharing practical guidance, and following and reinforcing the "golden path" for development teams across the organization. * Results\-driven, practical mindset with a focus on delivering, troubleshooting, and continuously improving applications. Skilled in turning technical stories into working, well\-tested solutions and sharing knowledge with teammates ***Qualifications*** * 4\-8 years of software development experience, including hands\-on OutSystems delivery, with a proven track record of building, launching, and supporting applications preferred. * A bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience is preferred. * Working knowledge of a backend language (.NET, Java, PHP) and a front\-end JavaScript framework (React, Angular, Vue). We value your coding experience to solve problems that go beyond the visual development capabilities of low\-code platforms. * Proven, hands\-on experience developing and delivering applications using OutSystems, with demonstrable results. You should be able to demonstrate experience building and supporting multi\-system integrations. **What is expected of you and others at this level** * Applies comprehensive knowledge and a thorough understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to perform varied tasks and projects * May contribute to the development of policies and procedures * Works on complex projects of large scope * Develops technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems * Solutions are innovative and consistent with organization objectives * Completes work; independently receives general guidance on new projects * Work reviewed for purpose of meeting objectives * May act as a mentor to less experienced colleague Anticipated salary range: $96,300 \- $137,600 Bonus eligible: No Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well\-being. * Medical, dental and vision coverage * Paid time off plan * Health savings account (HSA) * 401k savings plan * Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay * Flexible spending accounts (FSAs) * Short\- and long\-term disability coverage * Work\-Life resources * Paid parental leave * Healthy lifestyle programs Application window anticipated to close: 01/10/2026 \*if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible. jobs.company: Center for a New American Security
jobs.title: AI Engineer/Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Policy research needs to catch up to AI. Researchers at the Center for a New American Security (CNAS) are pushing today’s AI tools to their limits, and the next generation of research and product tools for national security analysis hasn’t been built yet. CNAS is seeking an AI Engineer / Senior AI Engineer to embed with some of the nation’s top AI and national security researchers, editors, and designers. You will prototype AI\-enabled tools and products, refine the ones that work, and scale the best of them across the Center. CNAS is making a substantial investment in its well\-established AI and national security team by launching the AI Policy Lab, and the AI Engineer / Senior AI Engineer will be instrumental to that effort. You will report to the Vice President of Strategy and Communications. As an early member of the AI Policy Lab, you’ll help shape how the lab operates from the ground floor. In this role, you’ll design, build, and deploy custom software, applications, and AI agent workflows that expand what CNAS researchers can accomplish in their work on AI policy, national security, and AI\-related economic competition. You will serve as a technical partner embedded with CNAS research and business teams to build out innovative solutions to increase productivity and maximize policy impact. The ideal candidate has a software engineering or computer science background, is highly proficient at using AI coding tools and agents to build applications and automated workflows and has a genuine interest in AI policy and national security. You enjoy working alongside non\-engineers, turning research questions into durable, reusable tools, and teaching colleagues to get the most out of what you build. This is a hands\-on technical role with significant autonomy. This is not a research position. You might be well\-suited for this role if you’re: * Experienced at building working software with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Cursor, from quick prototypes to tools colleagues rely on daily. * Excited to work alongside researchers, learn how they work, and build custom tools and agent workflows that take their research further. * Skilled at explaining technical concepts to non\-engineers and helping colleagues become more capable AI users. * Interested in how AI is reshaping national security. * Comfortable with shifting priorities in a field that moves fast. * Able to juggle short\- and long\-term projects while building durable tools others can use. * Motivated by seeing your work used, not just shipped. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Build Custom Software and Tools** + Embed with CNAS researchers to build custom code, applications, and AI agent workflows that support their research and analysis. + Rapidly prototype tools and refine them based on how colleagues use them. + Build agents and pipelines that gather, process, analyze, and visualize documents, transcripts, and datasets for CNAS research. + Build custom tools and software to automate business functions and accelerate productivity. * **Train and Empower Staff** + Train staff to use, adapt, and build on the tools you create, and document best practices for advanced AI use. + Help CNAS researchers who are already proficient AI users push their work further with code, agents, and advanced AI capabilities. + Track new AI models, harnesses, systems, and capabilities and assess which are worth adopting. * **Sustain AI Integration** + Standardize AI\-enabled workflows for recurring tasks such as baseline research, copy editing, citations, contact management, and data tracking. + Test, refine, document, and maintain AI tools for durable use. + Test AI\-assisted outputs for accuracy, objectivity, and sourcing to meet CNAS’s quality standards for independent, fact\-based research. + Ensure tools meet CNAS standards for data security and responsible AI use. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor) and demonstrated ability to explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the resulting code. * Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript) including work with APIs and software integration. * Full\-stack engineering experience building and deploying custom software, agent workflows, or data pipelines with AI coding tools. * Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and train non\-technical colleagues. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities. * Legal right to work in the United States. **Preferred:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Interest in AI policy, national security, or AI safety and security. * Experience with think tank, government, or academic research analysis and workflows. * Experience with data visualization and web development. **COMPENSATI \& BENEFITS** * $125,000 – $215,000, depending on qualifications and experience. * CNAS offers a complete and competitive benefits package for employees which includes medical, dental, vision, life and AD\&D insurance, short\- and long\-term disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, 403(b) retirement accounts, transportation subsidies, and an employee assistance program. **LOGISTICS** * This is a full\-time, in\-person role based in Washington, D.C. * Occasional travel to the San Francisco Bay Area and other locations may be required. * This role is within the CNAS AI Policy Lab and reports to the Vice President of Strategy and Communications. * This is a two\-year, term\-limited appointment. * We are open to hiring a range of experience levels. Title and compensation will be commensurate with experience. * Applications will be considered on a rolling basis. Candidates are encouraged to apply early. * Candidates may start as soon as available. **About the CNAS AI Policy Lab** AI progress is fast outpacing policy. The opportunities and challenges of the AI age demand bold new ideas for U.S. national security that meet the moment. The CNAS AI Policy Lab fuses in\-depth AI and national security expertise to produce cutting\-edge, technically informed policy analysis. The United States and its allies must harness the benefits, manage the risks, and ensure democracies lead in this era\-defining technology. The AI Policy Lab integrates CNAS’s technology, defense, regional, and economic expertise to address how AI is reshaping every dimension of national power and geopolitical competition. The Lab will serve as a hub for curated workshops, discussions, partnerships, and other convenings to bring industry, researchers, and the national security community to develop policy solutions. By bridging the divide between innovators and national security policymakers, the Lab will ensure that policy can match the unprecedented pace of technological innovation, harnessing the transformative power of AI while managing risks. The AI Policy Lab builds on a sustained track record of CNAS leadership in AI policymaking. CNAS experts and alumni have written the rules for how the Pentagon incorporates autonomous systems, developed policies intended to preserve the United States’s AI lead, and served in the highest levels of AI policymaking. **About CNAS** The Center for a New American Security develops bold, innovative, and bipartisan national security and defense policies that promote and protect American interests and values. Building on the deep expertise and broad experience of its staff and advisors, CNAS engages policymakers, experts, and the public with innovative fact\-based research, ideas, and analysis to shape and elevate the national security debate. As an independent 501(c)(3\) non\-profit research organization, CNAS leads efforts to help inform and prepare the national security leaders of today and tomorrow. CNAS is located in Washington, D.C. CNAS is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. **To Apply** CNAS accepts online applications only. A complete application will include a cover letter explaining your interest in and qualifications for the position, along with your resume or CV and a link to a portfolio, GitHub profile, or other examples of software, applications, or agent workflows you have built. Your cover letter should explain, in your voice, why this role fits your interests and experience. Candidates who advance in the process will be asked to share references and will also be asked to complete a timed practical technical exercise. Because this role centers on AI tools, we encourage you to use AI freely in your application materials and in the work samples you share and to tell us how you used it.

The team partners with Schwab business units to identify high‑impact use cases, pilot innovative analytical solutions, and transition successful models into compliant, resilient production systems. and elevate engineering standards for data science** by establishing best practices that treat data science as a rigorous engineering discipline, including modular code design, testing, version control, and production readiness. * **Advance technical capabilities in emerging areas** by leading complex initiatives involving advanced machine learning, recommender systems, real‑time and in data science and machine learning. * Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in a quantitative field such as computer engineering, statistics, mathematics, physics, chemistry, or related discipline. * Hands‑on experience using Python and SQL to develop production‑grade, modular, and optimized code. * Proven ability to convert business requirements into technical end\-to\-end machine learning solutions delivered against roadmap milestones for two or more lines of business. * Proven experience developing supervised and unsupervised machine learning solutions, with delivery of three or more distinct models supported by documented evaluation metrics, performance tracking, and value measurement. * Experience in ing natural language processing techniques to unstructured data with at least one solution delivered to production. * Practical experience designing LLM solutions (such as retrieval‑augmented generation, agent workflows, or fine‑tuning), including at least one LLM system deployed for internal use. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control, CI/CD, and MLOps practices, demonstrated through three or more production deployments. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working in financial services or other highly regulated industries. * Strong background in statistics, forecasting, or causal inference. * Hands‑on experience architecting machine learning solutions within cloud ecosystems. * Experience building, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines that support machine learning workflows. * Experience developing large‑scale recommender or personalization systems. * A demonstrated commitment to mentorship, including coaching senior data scientists or engineers and elevating team capability through feedback and code quality. * Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization. * Self\-starter with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and desire to continually reevaluate existing products and processes. * Comfort in a dynamic, fast\-moving environment, with a positive attitude, solid work ethic, and strong track records of performance. jobs.title: AI Agent Developer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Overview:** We don’t simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you — offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day. We are seeking an AI Agent Developer to design, build, and deploy AI agents that transform how teams at Chatham work. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who wants to apply modern AI to real business problems and see the impact firsthand. You will report to one of our Software Engineering Directors to maintain alignment with our organizational AI objectives. In each role, you will embed with a partner team as a forward\-deployed engineer. You will review past work, shadow team members on live tasks, and map where time is spent and why. From there, you will identify and prioritize the highest\-value opportunities, then build, evaluate, and release agents that triage requests, research and draft answers, investigate issues across systems and data, and prepare work for review. The team’s experts stay in the loop throughout, and people review agent output before it reaches a client or a production system. Once a team’s agents are running reliably, you will hand them over to the people who own the work and bring the same approach to the next team. Over time, you will partner with teams across the firm, from engineering and operations to client service and Marketing, wherever repetitive work can be improved through agentic means. You will work closely with Chatham’s AI evaluation and platform teams and help set the standards that other teams adopt. This is a new role at Chatham and an opportunity to help define how the firm builds and scales agentic capabilities. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic engineer who enjoys learning new domains from the people who do the work, collaborates easily with technical and non\-technical colleagues, and measures success by the problems solved for users. **In this role you will:** Discovery \& Partnership * Embed in a partner team and learn how it works. Review past work, shadow live tasks, and map the steps that the team repeats. * Find and rank the tasks where agents can save the most time or improve quality and agree on priorities with the team’s leaders. * Work closely with the team’s experts. They supply the domain knowledge and test cases, and they review agent output. Agent Development * Design, build, and deploy cloud\-native AI agents that do repetitive work from documented processes, with a person in the loop where judgment is necessary. * Build agents that triage and route incoming requests, research questions and draft answers, and investigate issues across systems, logs, and data. * Build agents that prepare work for people to review, such as draft responses, reports, and code changes as merge requests. * Turn each team’s playbooks and procedures into agent instructions and tools and keep them current as processes change. Evaluation \& Quality * Create evaluation sets from real past work. Measure each agent’s accuracy before release and whenever models or techniques change and monitor the results in production. * Partner with our AI evaluation team, and adopt its tools, techniques, and processes as they mature. * Follow Chatham’s standards for security, data handling, and the responsible use of AI. Reuse \& Handover * Document each agent’s purpose, tools, and limits so that other teams can adopt and extend it. * Build reusable tools and patterns that make each new team’s agents faster to deliver. Hand each team’s agents over to the people who own the work, then move to the next team. * **Your Impact:** For each partner team * Agents do a growing share of the team’s routine work correctly, and people review the output. * The team spends less time on repetitive tasks and more time on work that needs judgment. * Requests that wait in a queue today get faster and more consistent answers. * Each agent meets its accuracy targets before release and keeps them in production. Across Chatham * Each agent has documentation and tests, and other teams reuse its tools and patterns. * Each engagement ends with a clean handover to the people who own the work. A ranked list of agent opportunities is ready for the next team before you move to it. * **Contributors to your success:** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong proficiency in Python or C\#, with experience in APIs, services, or automation. * Hands\-on experience with applications built on large language models (LLMs), including prompt and context design, tool use, and agent workflows. * Experience with evaluation of AI output: test sets, accuracy measures, and regression checks for systems that do not always return the same answer. * Solid SQL skills, and comfort with logs and telemetry to find the root cause of a problem. * Experience with Git, code review, and CI/CD. * Curiosity and patience to learn complex business domains from the people who do the work. * Ability to turn a business process into clear steps that an agent can follow, and to judge where a person must stay in the loop. * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Experience with tools and integrations built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience with platforms or frameworks for AI agents, such as Microsoft Foundry or the Claude Agent SDK. * Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot. * Experience in a forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, or internal tools role, or a background in operations, technical support, or site reliability engineering. * Experience with Azure. Familiarity with tools such as GitHub, Grafana, Jira, and Confluence. * **About Chatham Financial:** Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. Our technology platform unifies data across assets, debt, and derivatives, giving you unmatched agility, transparency, and insight. **It’s clear ahead.** Our commitment is to carry that light forward in every partnership, every solution, and every market we serve. We help guide the way—giving clients the insight and momentum to move forward with confidence, no matter what lies ahead.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Circadia Health** Circadia Health is a growth\-stage healthcare AI company on a mission to prevent avoidable hospitalizations and transform senior\-care operations. Our Circadia Intelligence Platform combines: * Contactless sensing that monitors respiration and motion with medical\-grade accuracy * Native predictive models that detect 85% of preventable adverse events several days in advance * Enterprise integrations that operationalize predictions directly inside EHR, care\-coordination, billing, and compliance workflows Today, our technology touches 40,000\+ post\-acute patients daily across skilled\-nursing, home\-health, and home\-care networks. We are backed by leading healthcare and AI investors and headquartered in El Segundo, CA. **About the Role** As our Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you’ll sit at the point where Circadia’s AI meets our customers’ day\-to\-day care operations. You’ll work hands\-on with skilled\-nursing, home\-health and home\-care partners to deploy, integrate and tailor the Circadia Intelligence Platform to their workflows. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Product and Customer Success to turn customer needs into working solutions, and bring what you learn in the field back into the core product. ### **What You’ll Do** * Lead technical deployments of the Circadia Intelligence Platform at customer sites, from scoping through go\-live and adoption * Build and maintain integrations that bring Circadia’s predictions into customer EHR, care\-coordination, billing and compliance workflows * Configure, adapt and evaluate AI and predictive\-model workflows (including LLM\-based tools) for each customer’s clinical and operational context * Work directly with clinical and operations stakeholders to understand their workflows and translate their needs into technical requirements and working solutions * Diagnose and resolve deployment, data\-quality and integration issues in production * Feed field insights back to Product, Engineering and Data Science to shape the roadmap and make future deployments faster and repeatable * Build reusable tooling, documentation and playbooks for customer onboarding ### **Must\-Have Qualifications** * Degree (in progress or completed) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science or a related field * Relevant AI/ML coursework and hands\-on projects, including LLM\-based applications * Programming skills in Python, with familiarity with APIs and SQL * Clear communication with technical and non\-technical people ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience with healthcare data, EHR systems or post\-acute / senior\-care settings * Familiarity with HIPAA and working with protected health information * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) and containerized deployments * Experience at an early\- or growth\-stage startup As a full\-time **Forward Deployed AI Engineer**, you will be employed by Circadia Health, Inc. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full\-time position is **$90,000 \- $120,000**. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job\-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Annual salary is only one part of an employee’s total compensation package at Circadia Health. We also offer: * 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) * Competitive time off with pay policies including vacation, sick days, and company holidays * Impact: your work will influence care decisions for tens of thousands of seniors every day. * Culture: hard\-working, mission\-driven, and collaborative — with weekly and monthly social events like yoga, beach bonfires, and Wednesday/Friday team lunches. Circadia Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by law. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Markets Technology - Site Reliability Engineer, VP
jobs.description: **Discover your future at Citi** -------------------------------- Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. **Job Overview** ---------------- Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations \& Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first\-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well\-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together. **Position Overview:** The Site Reliability Engineer is based in North America (NAM) to serve as the regional pillar of our global reliability engineering function within Markets Technology. In this role, you will be part of a distributed, high\-impact three\-person global team, working closely with your counterparts in EMEA and APAC to provide resilient, round\-the\-clock ("follow\-the\-sun") operational excellence, infrastructure automation, and architecture reliability for mission\-critical enterprise systems. As a VP\-level Individual Contributor, you will operate as a technical authority for the NAM region. You will champion modern SRE principles—bridging software engineering, systems architecture, and production operations—to maximize service uptime, optimize performance, and drive end\-to\-end automation across hybrid\-cloud and on\-premises environments. **Key Responsibilities:** **Reliability Engineering, Observability \& Incident Governance** * **SLO/SLI Framework Ownership:** Define, monitor, and enforce Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Error Budgets across core regional and global platforms in collaboration with development and product teams. * **Incident Management \& Root Cause Elimination:** Act as the Tier\-3 technical escalation authority for critical production incidents during NAM market/operational hours. ability to articulate complex technical issues and trade\-offs to senior leadership and cross\-functional engineering teams. * **Problem\-Solving \& Bias for Action:** Calm under pressure during high\-severity production incidents, with an analytical mindset focused on data\-driven decision\-making. **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** * **Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) \& Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)** across NAM service components. * **Service Availability \& SLO Attainment** against target thresholds. * **Toil Reduction Rate:** Quantifiable percentage of operational tasks automated and transitioned to self\-service. * **Change Failure Rate \& Rollback Frequency:** Reduction in deployment\-related service disruptions. * **Quality of Global Handoffs:** Zero\-drop continuity across NAM/EMEA/APAC shift transitions. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience * Master’s degree preferred This job description provides a high\-level review of the types of work performed.
