jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers
jobs.description: CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market\-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of more than 1\.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low\-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever\-changing world. Visit our website at **www.cleanspark.com**. **Job Overview** The Senior Director, Data Center Design \& Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner\-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in\-house engineering capabilities. Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines * Define and approve system architecture for medium\-voltage and low\-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high\-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N\+1, 2N) and associated trade\-offs * Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path\-to\-power planning * Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single\-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate * Lead constructability, value engineering, and design\-for\-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre\-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project\-team authority * Own the owner\-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness * Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as\-builts, O\&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements * Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long\-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work * Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans * Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums * Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance * Build and mentor the in\-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows * Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team\-oriented, inclusive environment. ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline * 15\+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission\-critical, or large\-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role * Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high\-density compute * Demonstrated experience defining redundancy and resilience topologies and translating availability targets into design criteria * Hands\-on experience with utility interconnection, substation design, and energization planning for large loads * Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission\-critical projects * Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners * Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred * Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid\-cooled and high\-density rack deployments * Owner\-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer * Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites * Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9\.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and applicable energy codes * Master’s degree in engineering or an MBA * Experience in a fast\-growth owner organization building in\-house technical capability This position may involve duties that require operation of a company vehicle or travel between job sites. As such, candidates must be insurable under CleanSpark's vehicle insurance policy. CleanSpark is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Clear Capital is building the future of real estate data. Our goal is knowing more about a property than anybody else and in the process, making home ownership valuations more fair and equitable for millions of people.Every project our data team works on ships as a product or directly supports one that does. We are not a reporting team, our work moves Clear Capital's revenue. As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the data pipelines and platforms behind our data \& analytics products. You will work closely with the entire engineering organization to turn large, messy, multi\-source datasets into reliable, product\-ready data. You will also be a force multiplier for your team. You will raise the technical bar through design reviews, mentorship, and clear documentation, and you will anticipate what others need before they ask. ### **What You Will Work On** * Design, build, and maintain ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, object stores, databases, and streaming or queue\-based sources. * Build scalable data models and transformations that serve analytics, machine learning, and operational use cases. * Own and improve existing production data pipelines, including modernizing legacy workflows. * Standardize and match data across sources, including entity resolution and address normalization. * Build and maintain data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting so issues are caught early. * Partner with ML, BI, and data operations teams to understand their needs and deliver the data they rely on. * Champion engineering best practices: code review, testing, documentation, and version ### **Who We Are Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\-5\+ years of overall experience in software or data engineering. * 3\+ years of professional Python development. * Strong understanding of data modeling, data lake architecture, and master data management concepts. * Familiarity with ELT standards and best practices. * Hands\-on experience with AWS services such as IAM, S3, Glue, RDS or Aurora, EKS, SQS, DynamoDB, and Lambda. * Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow) and SQL\-based transformation (e.g., dbt). * Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). * Proficiency with Git and collaborative development on a shared codebase. * Comfortable with the command line. Preferred * Experience with open table formats such as Apache Iceberg. * Experience working with MLS, real estate, property, or other large public\-record datasets. * Experience building platforms or internal tools that other engineers use. * Experience with data lake or lakehouse architectures at scale. ### **Why Join Us** * Your work ships to customers and directly drives revenue. It is not BI or internal reporting. * Work on data that affects how people value and finance their homes. * Partner closely with product management on a roadmap that you help shape. * Shape the architecture and standards for a growing data platform. ### **What You Can Expect** * Compensation: The base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $153,700 annually, depending on your location, experience, and qualifications. Additional compensation offerings include company profit\-sharing bonus program, communication stipends, and referral bonuses. * Inclusive benefits package offering: Comprehensive medical, dental, and company paid vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, voluntary life and AD\&D insurance options, voluntary supplemental insurances for accident, critical illness, and legal services, paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays, employee assistance and wellness programs, company paid short term disability coverage, company contributions to health saving funds (with participation in the high deductible health plan. We offer company paid access to Galileo for virtual primary care and Rula for virtual mental health resources. * Through our Anniversary Program, we celebrate the meaningful milestones and long tenure that reflect how much we value your contributions and commitment to our team. * Career and skill development resources to help advance your career and personal growth. * A mission\-driven environment where your work makes a measurable impact on the real estate industry. ### **What We Value** * Wherever it Leads, Whatever it Takes® \- No matter how remote, complex, or unexpected. Our commitment never wavers. * Hire NICE people \- Skills can be taught but character shines through. We seek those who bring integrity, kindness, and grit. * Lift others up \- We lead with empathy and strive to improve the lives of those around us. * Sweat the details \- Excellence lives in the little things. Getting it just so is how we make a big impact. * Raise the bar \- We don’t settle for industry standards, we redefine them. About Us Clear Capital is a national real estate analytics, data solutions and valuation technology company with a simple purpose: to build confidence in real estate decisions to strengthen communities and improve lives. Our goal is to provide customers with a complete understanding of nearly every U.S. property through our AI\-driven analytics, data solutions, valuation services and automated appraisal review platforms. Our commitment to excellence \- wherever it leads, whatever it takes® \- is embodied by our team members across our brands and has remained steadfast in this pursuit since our first order in 2001\. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Risk
jobs.description: CWAN is seeking a Program Manager to join the Risk team. This is a collaborative, cross\-functional role: you will work alongside risk engineering leads, product, solutions, and delivery teams, acting as the connective thread between stakeholder needs and technical delivery. You will translate roadmap decisions into well\-scoped, validated work, keep overlapping workstreams aligned, and partner with other CWAN teams that build on or integrate with our platform. This role connects Solutions, Product, Engineering, and Delivery, keeping the engineering teams that build our risk capabilities aligned with what is sold, planned, and delivered. **Requirements \& Scope** * Partner with product owners, engineering leads, and business stakeholders to translate high\-level roadmap, strategic decisions, and sales commitments into clear, well\-specified requirements, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Jira. * Help distinguish between commoditized and bespoke deliverables, and coordinate with product and engineering so each is scoped, sized, prioritized, and routed to the appropriate engineering team. * Help ensure that committed dates and deliverables are backed by a credible plan, and drive resolution of any gaps between the commitment and that plan — working with engineering to agree scope, acceptance criteria, and sequencing. * Work with product and engineering to break large initiatives and incoming product and client asks into right\-sized units of work that can be planned, assigned, and tracked to show regular, visible progress. * Balance tactical, sales\-driven, client\-driven, and strategic work in line with the product owner's priorities and engineering capacity, and represent engineering and delivery constraints back into product planning. **Coordination \& Risk Management** * Serve as the primary point of contact for cross\-team coordination — tracking dependencies, clarifying ownership across overlapping workstreams, and keeping a shared record of design decisions so decisions are clear and work isn't duplicated across teams. * Establish structured working groups that connect client\-facing staff with the engineers building the corresponding capability, so requirements and feedback flow continuously rather than through one\-off handoffs. * Get early visibility into pipeline and committed deals from solutions/pre\-sales, and proactively share it with engineering leads so they have early awareness of what has been sold or promised. * Identify risks, roadblocks, and cross\-team dependencies early, and drive them to resolution — escalating to leadership and external stakeholders when needed. **Progress Tracking \& Reporting** * Own a consolidated view of program status, pulling metrics and progress updates from across workstreams into a single, reliable source of truth, and move toward automated metrics and away from manual status collection. * Validate reported progress against delivery evidence, staying close enough to the technical work to understand delivery status alongside engineering teams. * Facilitate agreement on shared milestones, track progress against them, and translate program status into clear, regular reporting for stakeholders and leadership, keeping product and solutions current so client expectations are set accurately. **Process \& Standardization** * Define and drive repeatable processes for planning, prioritization, status reporting, and issue escalation across teams, working through engineering leaders and building on existing organizational standards wherever possible. * Coordinate with client onboarding and delivery teams on incoming demand, and define clear rules for how work transfers between engineering and delivery, with onboarding and support handoffs standardized and documented. Requirements * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Economics, or a related discipline. * 5\+ years of experience in program management, product management, or business analysis within SaaS, cloud platforms, capital markets technology, or risk/analytics. * Technical fluency to engage directly with engineers, read specifications, and discuss trade\-offs, and the ability to work independently. * Proven ability to coordinate across multiple teams and drive agreed milestones without relying on formal authority alone. * Excellent communication skills — able to bridge engineering and business stakeholders with clarity and precision, while adapting as priorities evolve. * Self\-motivated and adaptable, with a high standard for reliability and delivery impact. * Nice to have: familiarity with SDLC practices and agile delivery tooling such as Jira. * Nice to have: familiarity with cloud infrastructure and modern SaaS security patterns; relevant training will be provided. **Salary Range** $88,800\.00 \- $115,200\.00*This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job\-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. For this role, benefits include: health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), PTO, parental leave, and medical leave, STD/LTD insurance benefits. Clearwater Analytics is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.*

jobs.title: Junior Legal AI Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Cleary Gottlieb is a pioneer in globalizing the legal profession. We have 14 offices in major financial centers around the world, but we operate as a single, integrated global partnership and not as a U.S. firm with a network of overseas locations. The firm employs approximately 1,100 lawyers from more than 50 countries. Since 1946 our lawyers and staff have worked across practices, industries, jurisdictions, and continents to provide clients with simple, actionable approaches to their most complex legal and business challenges, whether domestic or international. We support every client relationship with intellectual agility, commercial acumen, and a human touch. Cleary Gottlieb’s AI Acceleration Team combines frontier AI with elite legal expertise to redesign legal work from first principles. We are AI engineers, data scientists, software engineers and lawyers. We began as Springbok AI, a startup, and still run like one: we ship bespoke AI workflows, co\-pilots and tools that lawyers choose to use, backed by a world\-class law firm. Responsibilities: **The Role:** We’re hiring a Junior Legal AI Engineer fluent with both lawyers and technical teams. In the morning you’ll analyze a workflow with a partner; in the afternoon you’ll discuss knowledge graphs with our data scientists and engineers. You translate between them, and the product improves as a result. Ideally, you’ve trained and worked as a lawyer, however, we are considering alternative legal / legaltech backgrounds. You don’t need to code, or to have used code editor; you do need to be willing to learn both. **What You’ll Be Doing:** * **Design legal workflows**: Turn legal processes into automations lawyers adopt and find where automation can save time or reduce errors. * **Engineer prompts**: Write, review and refine prompts with our NLP specialists until outputs meet a lawyer’s standard. * **Bridge law and engineering**: Translate legal requirements into technical specifications, and technical constraints into terms lawyers trust. * **Configure and test**: Tailor our AI tools to real legal use cases; test and iterate until they work in practice, not just in a demo. * **Champion our users**: Provide first\-line support to our lawyers and turn their feedback into prioritized input for engineers. * **Get hands\-on**: Work alongside our engineers with AI coding assistants and at the command line: edit templates and configuration, run scripts and inspect outputs. We’ll teach you the tools. Qualifications: **What You Bring:*** 3\+ years’ experience in or alongside legal teams, including drafting, review, summarization and data extraction * You meet the requirements but don’t have a JD or extensive legal experience beyond the minimum * Command of the principles of legal work: accuracy, explainability, confidentiality and privilege, rigor, risk\-awareness and accountability * Working knowledge of AI concepts such as agents, retrieval, chain\-of\-thought prompting and few\-shot learning, and the ability to discuss them with data scientists and engineers. We’ll make you an expert within 90 days. * Familiarity with the legal AI landscape (Harvey, Legora, Thomson Reuters, LexisNexis) and a view on its direction * Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain a model’s limitations to a partner and a lawyer’s risk concerns to an engineer * Self\-direction: you build processes where none exist and dig in when something isn’t working * Willingness to learn how to use a code editor and basic scripting; no prior experience required **Bonus Points:*** Experience in practice development, knowledge management, legal operations or legal service delivery * Startup or legal tech experience, ideally in agile or product\-led teams * Experience with no\-code or low\-code builders (e.g. Framer, Squarespace) * Existing comfort with code editors or scripting, or something real you’ve vibe\-coded **Why You’ll Love It Here:*** Build from the ground up and change how lawyers at a world\-class firm practice * Join a small, ambitious team * Learn across AI, product, design and engineering * Have a voice: we want your ideas, not just your execution The estimated base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on a variety of job\-related factors, including skills, education, training, credentials, experience, scope and complexity of role responsibilities, geographic location, and performance. This role is exempt meaning it is not overtime pay eligible. Cleary provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health care benefits. More information can be found here: Benefits We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination based on any category protected by law. Cleary provides reasonable accommodations to enable otherwise qualified employees to perform the essential functions of their position, provided the accommodation does not pose an undue hardship to the Firm. jobs.title: Data Engineer II - Databricks
jobs.description: CLA is a top 10 national professional services firm wur purpose is to create opportunities every day, for our clients, our people, and our communities through industry\-focused wealth advisory, digital, audit, tax, consulting, and outsourcing services. Even with more than 8,500 people, 130 U.S. locations, and a global reach, we promise to know you and help you. CLA is dedicated to building a culture that invites different beliefs and perspectives to the table, so we can truly know and help our clients, communities, and each other. **About the role:** ------------------- CLA is looking to hire a Data Engineer II to join our growing team. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Claims & AI Billing
jobs.description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** ------------------ Running a healthcare practice is hard. It's a highly regulated, low\-margin business. Practices deliver care upfront, then have to navigate a complex insurance system to get paid. Much of that work is manual, and it isn't always clear which claims or tasks are worth tackling first. When a practice can't operate efficiently, patients are impacted through reduced access to care or unexpected out\-of\-pocket costs. Our Claims team builds software that helps clinics and hospitals get paid for the care they deliver. We build automations that can be configured to fit each practice's needs, ensuring their entire business pipeline functions smoothly. We also build tools that help billers and administrators figure out where their time will have the biggest impact. We help them go after the highest ROI work first, work claims in bulk, and spot trends early that need their attention. We're also building AI agents as coworkers that can take on work between fixed automations and fully manual workflows and make customer onboarding and billing setup more accurate and automated. The end goal is to help clinics and hospitals work more efficiently and collect more of the revenue they've earned. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll work across the stack, from data\-dense workflows in the UI to the backend pipelines, integrations, and rule engines that power them. You'll own important projects and subsystems, make thoughtful technical decisions, and help us solve the right problems for the people working through claims every day. Our scope is broad: you might build a CDC pipeline, design an API, or create a new automation workflow on any given day. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll own multi\-component projects where requirements may be incomplete or evolving. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **About us** ============ Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI\-first e\-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e\-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. **About the team** ================== The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse \& recommendations) \& executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents. Our team owns both platform \& product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery\-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services. All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down. The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on\-call. **About you** ============= You're a senior engineer who wants to own features end to end, not just close tickets. You've built and run production Python services, ideally high\-traffic or latency\-sensitive ones, and you've been on\-call for them. You think in trade\-offs: latency versus cost, a quick fix versus a durable one, a new parameter versus a public API customers can't afford to see break. You can take a feature from a rough problem statement to a design, ship it, and then make sure it behaves in production. You're comfortable leading a project with one or two other engineers and helping teammates grow along the way. When a problem is only partly defined, you ask the right questions to pin it down. When you meet an unfamiliar protocol or system, you read the spec and work out how it fits. You change your mind when someone has a better argument, and you still care about your code long after it merges. **What you will do** ==================== * Own the design and delivery of features and components in our services. * Design and evolve public API endpoints with backward compatibility in mind, and contribute to architecture discussions for our services. * Improve performance and reliability: find latency and failure hotspots, add the observability needed to understand them, and fix them. * Take an active part in design and code review, and mentor mid\-level engineers. * Work with product, solutions/support, and other engineering teams to understand customer needs and turn them into solid technical solutions * Take part in on\-call for the systems you own, and lead incident response and follow\-through when things break. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- ### **Technical** * Solid experience building and operating backend services in production, ideally high\-traffic or low\-latency ones. * Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language). * Hands\-on experience with observability (metrics, logs, traces) and debugging performance issues in live systems. * Experience designing and evolving public APIs that external customers depend on. * Experience designing \& implementing scalable service\-oriented architectures. ### **Beyond the code** * Track record of delivering projects end to end, including leading small efforts with other engineers. * Collaborative mindset: open to feedback, and willing to change your position when someone has a better argument. * Clear written communication \- design docs, RFCs, postmortems. * Good judgment about trade\-offs and scope. * Comfort with ambiguity and loosely defined problems. * Ownership that extends past merge, to how the system behaves in production. ### **Nice to have** * Experience with AWS * Background in search, ranking, information retrieval, or e\-commerce product discovery. * Exposure to AI/LLM\-facing infrastructure (MCP, agent tooling, or similar). **Benefits** ============ ️ Unlimited vacation time \- we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year Fully remote team \- choose where you live ️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office Apple laptops provided for new employees ‍ Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year Maternity \& Paternity leave for qualified employees Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact Base salary: $80k–$120k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results TBD Stock options \- offered in addition to the base salary Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor** =================================================== At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group. Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of our listed qualifications. How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized. **How we handle your data.** By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

jobs.title: AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: ConRes helps organizations adopt AI across public cloud, government cloud, and local and air\-gapped data centers. As clients move AI from pilots into production, their security, compliance and audit teams need an independent answer to one question: is this AI system safe to run? The AI Security Engineer provides that answer. You will assess, test and help govern our clients' AI systems, and turn findings into prioritized, defensible remediation they can act on. **Responsibilities** AI Security Assessments * Lead AI security assessments of LLM applications, RAG pipelines and AI agents: architecture review, data flows, identity, tenancy and data separation, logging and model\-provider configuration. * Run threat\-modeling workshops using STRIDE with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP Agentic AI guidance and MITRE ATLAS. * Map findings to AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) and to the client's control baseline (NIST SP 800\-53, NIST SP 800\-171 / CMMC, FedRAMP, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001\) so stakeholders can defend severity and remediation decisions and produce audit\-ready evidence. * Write executive\-ready reports and present results to client security, compliance and leadership teams. Adversarial Testing * Plan and execute AI red\-team exercises: direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, system\-prompt and data leakage, insecure output handling, excessive agency and tool abuse in agents, RAG and vector\-store poisoning. * Validate that guardrails and content filters (native guardrail services in public and government cloud, and self\-hosted guardrail models in air\-gapped environments) actually hold under attack. Local and Air\-gapped AI Deployments * Define and verify security controls for self\-hosted and air\-gapped AI: inference servers (i.e., vLLM, Ollama, NVIDIA NIM), GPU hosts, local vector stores and the networks around them. * Secure the model supply chain without internet access: provenance and hash/signature verification of model weights, scanning for unsafe serialization, and an approved internal model and package registry. * Design and audit controlled data\-transfer processes for moving models, updates, containers and datasets across the air gap. * Harden hosts and containers; ensure logging, monitoring and incident response work without cloud services. * Assess data\-isolation guarantees and document them for accreditors and auditors. AI Governance and Risk * Help clients develop AI acceptable\-use, data\-handling and model/vendor risk standards suited to their regulatory obligations. * Assess the AI vendors and SaaS tools clients are adopting: data residency, retention, training\-data use, SOC 2 / ISO 42001 posture. * Define AI security requirements and acceptance criteria for client solutions, working with the client's teams and ConRes delivery teams. * Help clients detect and manage shadow AI and AI\-related data loss (data classification, DLP and AI threat\-protection tooling). Incident Response and Enablement * Support clients in investigating and responding to AI\-related incidents: data leakage, model abuse, compromised AI identities or keys. * Track emerging AI attack techniques and regulation, and keep client assessments and test cases current. * Deliver AI security training and workshops for client teams, and help shape ConRes's AI security services and thought leadership. The pay range for this position begins at $180,000 up to $200,000 per year. This range reflects the annual salary that Continental Resources reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of posting, consistent with the Massachusetts Pay Transparency Law (M.G.L. c. 149, § 105E). \#ConRes \# of Hires Needed 1 Exemption Type Exempt Hiring Manager Job Requirements **Requirements** * 5\+ years in information security (application security, cloud security, penetration testing or security architecture), including 2\+ years focused on AI/ML or LLM security. * Hands\-on experience testing LLM applications or agents for prompt injection, jailbreaks and data leakage. * Strong, hands\-on experience securing local and air\-gapped AI deployments: self\-hosted open\-weight models, offline model and package supply chains, cross\-domain transfer, and host hardening. * Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS and NIST AI RMF. * Familiarity with compliance frameworks and audit evidence: NIST SP 800\-53, NIST SP 800\-171 / CMMC, FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001\. * Strong understanding of how LLM apps, RAG and agent frameworks (including MCP) are built, enough to find where they break. * Security experience across public cloud, government cloud (FedRAMP / DoD IL environments) and local or air\-gapped data centers: identity, network isolation, key management, logging. * Python scripting for test automation and analysis. * Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable leading client workshops and presenting technical risk to executives and auditors. **Preferred** * Prior consulting or professional\-services experience. * Experience with healthcare (HIPAA/PHI), financial\-services or defense/government compliance, including supporting an ATO or CMMC assessment. * Certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, CISSP, CCSP, IAPP AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor, CompTIA SecAI\+ or cloud\-provider certifications. * Published AI security research, CVEs, bug\-bounty findings or AI CTF participation.

jobs.title: Product Manager 1 - AI
jobs.description: The Product Manager, AI Platform \& Ecosystem is a product management role on Cook Medical's AI \& Innovation (AI\&I) team responsible for how the organization's people experience, adopt, and get value from AI tools. The role owns the product experience across Cook's AI platform ecosystem, starting with Claude Enterprise and expanding to adjacent tools and capabilities as they come online; manages the AI Ambassador program; curates the internal marketplace of AI skills and applications; and connects platform capabilities to business value. This is a product role, not an IT administration role: IT manages infrastructure, licensing, security, and provisioning, while this role manages the product experience, ecosystem strategy, adoption enablement, and capability roadmap, working closely with IT under a shared governance model. The role partners with a peer Product Manager who owns AI Governance, together forming the PM function within AI\&I.* **Own the AI platform ecosystem product experience.** Own the product experience across Claude Enterprise and adjacent AI tools, define what belongs in the marketplace, set quality standards for skills and plugins, evaluate new platform capabilities, and translate them into actionable recommendations for AI\&I's roadmap. * **Curate and govern the internal AI marketplace.** Curate and govern the marketplace of skills, plugins, and applications published for enterprise use, and define quality standards, versioning practices, and publishing workflows for marketplace content. * **Maintain the connected ecosystem roadmap.** Maintain the roadmap across Claude Enterprise, Foundry, CookGPT, and future tools, and evaluate new platform features as they release to assess fit with Cook's AI strategy and recommend adoption or deferral. * **Own the AI Ambassador program lifecycle.** Own the full lifecycle of the AI Ambassador program, including recruitment, onboarding, training, ongoing enablement, and performance measurement. * **Manage regional ambassador cohorts.** Ensure each region has active, equipped ambassadors who drive local adoption, and serve as the hub connecting the ambassador network in partnership with leaders, functions, and Human Resources. **Develop ambassador enablement content.** Develop and distribute enablement content, including best practices, prompt engineering guides, use case libraries, and capability updates while partnering with Human Resources to enable learning, establish feedback loops, and support adoption across the ecosystem. * **Build community across the ambassador network.** Hold regular check\-ins, maintain shared channels, and support knowledge exchange; track program metrics such as adoption lift, engagement, and feedback quality. * **Monitor the AI platform landscape.** Track releases, roadmaps, and strategic direction from Anthropic, Palantir, and the broader AI platform landscape. * **Brief AI\&I leadership on platform developments.** Produce regular briefings that translate platform developments into implications for Cook's AI strategy and feed them into AI\&I's roadmap. * **Coordinate integration architecture with Foundry.** Work with the Foundry team and Forward Deployed Engineers to ensure Claude's MCP protocol layer connects cleanly to the ontology, so that what users access through AI tools connects to the enterprise data and intelligence layer. * **Identify new use cases unlocked by platform capabilities.** Recognize opportunities where new platform capabilities make previously out\-of\-reach use cases possible. * **Monitor adoption analytics.** Review usage patterns from a product lens, not for security or compliance, to understand which teams are adopting, which capabilities are gaining traction, where the gaps are, and where the Ambassador program should focus next. * **Operate within the shared governance model with IT.** Recognize that AI\&I owns product strategy, ecosystem, and adoption while IT owns infrastructure, licensing, security, and provisioning, and coordinate with IT on access management, compliance requirements, and security policies as they relate to platform capabilities. * **Communicate platform updates to stakeholders.** Share platform updates, capability changes, and strategic direction with stakeholders across the organization, and support AI\&I leadership in articulating ecosystem strategy to senior leadership and cross\-functional partners. **Education requirement:*** **Bachelor’s degree in business, Management, or a related field. Master's degree or higher is preferred.** * **4\+ year of experience in product management or related roles, with a preferred focus on AI or technology products.** * Combinations of education and experience will be considered. * **Strong communication and stakeholder management skills;** able to translate technical capabilities into business language for diverse audiences. * **Program management discipline;** able to run multiple workstreams, track progress, and keep a distributed network aligned. * **Technical awareness of how APIs, integrations, and platform ecosystems work;** sufficient to make informed product decisions without needing to write code. * **Comfort with ambiguity and fast\-moving environments;** the AI platform landscape evolves weekly, and this role evolves with it. * **Willingness to upskill continuously;** expected to stay hands\-on with the tools managed, learn new capabilities as they ship, and teach others. **Preferred Qualifications:** * **AI/ML or data platform experience.** Experience with AI/ML platforms, developer tools, or data platforms in a product management capacity. * **Palantir Foundry familiarity.** Familiarity with Palantir Foundry, enterprise AI orchestration layers, or similar data and intelligence platforms. * **Marketplace or plugin ecosystem experience.** Experience with marketplace or plugin ecosystem management, including curation, quality control, and developer relations. * **Change management background.** Background in change management, organizational enablement, or enterprise technology adoption. * **Integration protocol knowledge.** Understanding of integration protocols and connector architectures (e.g., MCP, APIs, webhooks). * **Regulated industry experience.** Experience in healthcare, medical devices, or regulated industries. **Physical Requirements:*** **Works under general office environmental conditions.** * **Some travel may be required** for regional Ambassador program support, cross\-functional coordination with the Foundry team, or professional development. **Employee Requirements:** Compliance with all policies of the company including without limitation the Employee Manual/Handbook (both local and/or regional), Code of Conduct, Electronic Information Policy, HIPAA regulations, Non Competition and Confidentiality Agreement. **Acknowledgement:** This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed. jobs.title: Process Data Scientist
jobs.description: Requisition Number: 79606 **The company built on breakthroughs.** **Join us.** Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible. How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward. At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more. Come break through with us. Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry\-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical\-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical\-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use. **Purpose of Position** The Process Data Scientist will serve as an embedded technical partner to process engineering and manufacturing teams, applying traditional statistics, advanced analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to improve process understanding, control, capability, quality, yield, and cost. The role connects rigorous statistical thinking with modern data\-science methods to convert manufacturing and quality data into practical, scalable solutions. The individual will work with data from manufacturing execution systems, measurement and inspection equipment, process\-control systems, sensors, ERP systems, and quality systems. Work will range from designed experiments and statistical process control to predictive modeling, anomaly detection, optimization, computer vision, and responsible use of generative AI. The role requires hands\-on analysis, close collaboration with process experts, and clear communication of methods, assumptions, uncertainty, and business impact. This person will be expected to work independently in ambiguous problem spaces, select methods appropriate to the process and data, and help move successful analytical solutions from exploratory analysis into sustained use across manufacturing sites. **Key Responsibilities** * Partner with process engineering, manufacturing, quality, technology, IT, and data engineering teams to frame business and technical questions as well\-defined analytical problems. * Plan, execute, and analyze designed experiments, statistical process control, measurement system analyses, hypothesis tests, and other statistical methods. * Analyze manufacturing and quality data to identify sources of variation, quantify relationships among inputs and outputs, establish evidence\-based conclusions, and recommend actions. * Develop predictive and prescriptive models using machine learning and statistical techniques for applications such as anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, throughput improvement, process optimization, and defect reduction. * Explore and apply AI capabilities, including computer vision and generative AI, in a manufacturing setting. * Use Python, SQL, and big\-data platforms including Databricks to prepare data, engineer features, build reproducible analyses, and work effectively with large and complex datasets. * Collaborate with data engineering and IT partners to define analysis\-ready datasets, data\-quality checks, contextual data requirements, and scalable analytical workflows. * Create dashboards, reports, visualizations, and technical summaries that communicate process performance, analytical findings, limitations, and recommended actions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Develop reusable analytical methods, code, templates, and standards that improve consistency across sites and reduce duplicated effort. * Train and coach engineers and other stakeholders in statistical thinking, data interpretation, and appropriate use of advanced analytics and AI. * Deliver value where problems may be loosely defined and data may be incomplete, requiring initiative, sound judgment, scientific rigor, and attention to detail. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field. * 3\+ years of experience in data science, statistics, or a related field, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial setting. * Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using big data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Spark, and Hadoop). * Strong foundation in statistical mod ommunication and leadership skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree or Ph.D. in a data\-related field, such as statistics, data science, computer science, or a related discipline. * Experience with manufacturing systems (MES, ERP) and industrial data platforms (e.g., OSI PI). * Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools for model deployment and monitoring. * Experience with JMP and/or Minitab statistical software. * Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma, quality engineering, process improvement, and Manufacturing 4\.0 concepts. * Bilingual or multilingual capability and experience working with global teams. **Soft Skills** * Strong collaborator who can build productive relationships with process experts and cross\-functional partners. * Curious and hypothesis\-driven, with the judgment to distinguish correlation, prediction, and causation. * Self\-motivated and able to define a path forward with limited direction. * Comfortable balancing analytical rigor, speed, practical constraints, and business value. * Able to challenge assumptions constructively and communicate limitations transparently. * Able to train, coach, and influence others in statistical and data\-driven thinking. * Detail\-oriented, with a strong focus on accuracy, reproducibility, documentation, and follow\-through. **Travel Requirements** * Up to 20%, including international travel to support global teams and initiatives. * Normal business hours are expected, with flexibility to collaborate across regions and time zones as needed. **This position does not support immigration sponsorship.** The range for this position is $91,311\.00 \- $125,553\.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job\-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education. **A job that shapes a life.** **Corning offers you the total package.** Your well\-being is our priority. Our compensation and benefits package supports your health and wellness, financial aspirations, and career from day one. * Company\-wide bonuses and long\-term incentives align with key business results and ensure you are rewarded when the company performs well. When Corning wins, we all win. * As part of our commitment to your financial well\-being, we provide a 100% company\-paid pension benefit with fixed contributions that grow throughout your career. Combined with matching contributions to your 401(k) savings plan, Corning’s total contributions to your retirement accounts can reach between 7% and 12% of your pay, depending on your age and years of service. * Our health and well\-being benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, family building support, fitness, company\-paid life insurance, disability, disease management programs, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your family. * Getting paid for our work is important, but feeling appreciated and recognized for those contributions motivates us much more. That’s why Corning offers a recognition program to celebrate successes and reward colleagues who make exceptional contributions. We prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Corning is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and considers requests for reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. Individuals with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs may request reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access other benefits and privileges of employment. To submit a request for reasonable accommodation related to disability or religion, please contact us at accommodations@corning.com.

jobs.description: At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with expertise in full\-stack engineering. In this role, you will collaborate with developers, data scientists, healthcare professionals, and product managers to build tools that improve real\-world health outcomes. **As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:** * Simplify the complexities of healthcare by building scalable, efficient systems that enhance human efforts. * Stay up\-to\-date with new tools and technologies to solve challenges and advance our goals. * Help define and maintain development practices that enable fast iteration while ensuring quality, including writing tests and documenting key implementations. * Collaborate with Product Managers and operational teams to conceptualize and develop new features. **You should get in touch if:** * You have 5\+ years of experience as a Software Engineer with proficiency in Python, Ruby, Go, C, or Java. * You approach building and maintaining systems with maturity, rigor, and attention to scalability. * you are comfortable working across different technical systems and concerns. * You have experience building and refactoring complex (often distributed) systems. **Benefits Overview**: * **Financial Well\-Being**: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value\-based care. Implement human\-in\-the\-loop review and feedback mechanisms. **Build Detection and Risk Analytics** Design and implement detection logic for suspicious or high\-risk activity. Improve quality and coverage of existing detection capabilities. **Develop Data and Signal Pipelines** Build scalable batch and streaming pipelines for AI and analytics workloads. Develop feature engineering workflows used by AI models and detection systems. Create data products that support investigation, automation, and risk assessment. Improve data quality, observability, and operational reliability. **Build Production AI Services** Design and implement APIs, backend services, and distributed systems that support AI applications. Develop frameworks that make AI workflows easier to deploy, evaluate, and operate. Monitor production systems and troubleshoot reliability or quality issues. jobs.title: Director of Architecture and Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Who is Credible?** Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre\-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third\-party partners and distribution channels. About the Role Credible is looking for a motivated, experienced Director of Architecture and Infrastructure to join our growing team. This is a remote, player\-coach leadership role reporting to the SVP of Technology. You will directly lead two platform teams of four engineers each, the foundation that every Credible customer\- and partner\-facing application runs on: * Infrastructure Platform (DevOps): infrastructure, AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD processes, and the internally developed applications that support them. This team works primarily in Golang. * Application Platform: the shared services and libraries used across our customer\- and partner\-facing applications, primarily written in Ruby. Examples include authentication, user disclosures, logging, integrations with SaaS products (such as email marketing systems), Kafka tooling, and GraphQL API tooling. You will also partner with other engineering teams during the architecture and design phase of larger projects, and help advance how we approach architecture and design review across the broader engineering organization. Your work will sit closely alongside our Security team. This role is posted at the Director level; an exceptionally qualified candidate may be hired at the Senior Director level. Responsibilities * Lead, mentor, and grow the Infrastructure Platform and Application Platform teams; hire well, set clear expectations, and develop future leaders * Make stability the first priority: drive reliability, resilience, and operational excellence across our infrastructure and shared services * Bring a security mindset to every decision, working in close partnership with our Security Director and team * Support SOC 2 and SOX compliance through well\-designed controls, processes, and tooling * Own the on\-call rotation for the Infrastructure Platform team, ensuring it is sustainable, well\-documented, and continuously improving * Provide architecture and design guidance on larger projects, partnering with other engineering teams in the design phase and leading design reviews * Help evolve our architecture and design review process across the engineering organization * Guide our microservices architecture, including the thoughtful decomposition of remaining larger components * Set technical direction for CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and developer tooling so that engineers across Credible can ship quickly and safely * Stay close to the code: contribute hands\-on where it adds value (coding is welcome, though not required) * Collaborate with Product, Security, Operations, and engineering leaders to align platform priorities with business goals Education and Experience * 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure, or platform engineering * 7\+ years of experience managing engineering teams, with strong people management skills * Strong software architecture and design skills, with experience leading architecture and design reviews * Deep experience with AWS and Kubernetes, and with infrastructure as code and deployment tooling such as Terraform, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, and Helm * Experience building and operating microservices\-based systems, including decomposing larger components * Experience with event\-driven systems (Kafka) and API design (REST and/or GraphQL) * Familiarity with SOC 2 and SOX compliance requirements * A strong security mindset, with experience working closely alongside a security organization * Experience running on\-call rotations and driving reliability improvements * Experience with Go and/or Ruby is preferred; experience with similar languages is welcome * Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, but not required Technical Taste We are looking for someone who does more than "get something working." You have strong aesthetic leanings about how systems should be built, and you can explain why. For us, that means: * Results\-oriented simplicity: you don't overcomplicate things and keep solutions simple wherever possible * Intelligent abstractions: you know when an abstraction earns its keep, and when it doesn't * Systems thinking: you build once and create leverage far into the future * Strong API design: you care deeply about the interfaces that teams and services build on **Why work at Credible?** We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we're the friend you always wish you had in finance. We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we'll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world. We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

DESTACO is based in Auburn Hills, Michigan, and operates globally through \~700 employees across 11 locations. Motivates and manages the team to achieve annual goals/objectives set at the individual and organizational level. * Improves manufacturing efficiency by creating and optimizing programming methodologies and leveraging the most efficient fixture and tooling available. Completes ongoing industry/trade related training to maintain a suitable understanding of industry best practices related to machining practices and processes. * Makes recommendations to modify or replace equipment as necessary to support new products, demand or improve productivity. * Participates in new product development and launch using the defined stage gate process. * Analyze and design lean manufacturing cells using effective systems and simulation tools to optimize, use of space, equipment, material, and personnel. * Assist in developing plant layout in planning rearrangement of facilities, equipment, and operations for better utilization of space. * Work closely with research and development, quality assurance and maintenance personnel to prevent problems with products and tooling/fixtures. * Ensure all manufacturing safety regulatory policies and procedures are implemented and always maintained. * Stay informed concerning new manufacturing technologies and equipment to manufacture and reduce cost through efficiencies. * Support all current and new product introductions. * Determine and eliminate root causes and diminish occurrences in the manufacturing process. * Able to assist in reducing cost through re\-engineering product/material. * Assist in the assessment of vendor/subcontractor evaluation for consideration. * Responsible for training vendors/subcontractors on new product launches to meet target date. * Works closely with engineering, new product development team, production and quality. * Supports Destaco policies and procedures, including those governing the quality system as defined by ISO 9001\. Leadership Competenciesaligned with Stabilus and executed in Destaco with appropriate expectations for the job level: * **Attracts, Develops and Retains Talent –** Creates a learning environment that recognizes and maximizes the potential of all employees. Develops high potential individuals for future strategic needs. * **Results Driven –** Produces results that exceed Dover’s strategic objectives via a combination of planning and implementation, while living the Dover Values. * **Change Leadership –** Aligns an organization and its people to drive for improvement and adopt new, challenging directions. Energizes a whole organization to want to change in the same direction. Influences others in a mature and empowering manner. **Job Requirements:** * Minimum 5 years experience in manufacturing engineering and maintenance. * Experienced in continuous improvement. * Demonstrated proficiency with MS Office tools (Word, Excel). * Analyzes, solves, and implements solutions independently. * Ability to read and interpret blueprints. * In\-depth understanding of assembly processes * Strong organizational skills, keeps timelines and meets deadlines. * Ability to direct and guide from others. * Working knowledge of manufacturing methods, tooling, fixturing and materials * High energy, tenacity to get results, does what it takes to win. * Self\-starter prefers to work in a strong team environment. * Excellent communicator including verbal, and written skills. **Education and Certification Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering or related technical field **Travel Requirements:** * Ability to travel up to 10% of the time. jobs.description: Diamond Foundry Inc. is solving the thermal limitation at the foundation of today's most exciting tech industries \- AI \& cloud compute, electric\-car power electronics, and 5G/6G wireless. We have managed to produce the world's first single\-crystal diamond wafers and are now on a mission to put a diamond behind every chip. We are the rare unicorn that has grown fast and profitably. We received $515m in funding and are executing a multi\-$B expansion plan for one of the greenest forms of tech manufacturing: converting greenhouse gas into diamond wafers using zero\-emission energy. We are looking for an experienced, communicative Senior Software Engineer to own the data pipelines, internal systems, and APIs that power our real\-time manufacturing and R\&D operations. What we need from you is deep, production\-grade Python expertise and the ability to own a project end\-to\-end: partnering directly with material engineers, technicians, and hardware engineers to turn ambiguous operational challenges into working production software. This role will be on\-site 5 days a week in either our South San Francisco office or our Fremont, CA office. ### **Responsibilities** * Own technical initiatives from inception to delivery: translate operational needs into technical roadmaps, architectural specs, and deployable code. * Architect and scale end\-to\-end Python backends, spanning high\-throughput event pipelines, internal REST APIs, and automated data processing tools. * Interface directly with internal clients (production technicians, metrology specialists, and R\&D engineers) to diagnose workflow bottlenecks and validate solutions on the floor. * Optimize database performance and schema design for high\-frequency telemetry, process metrics, and traceability data. * Partner with our front\-end engineers to define clean API contracts and data models for operator\-facing UI’s. ### **Requirements** * 4\+ years of software engineering experience with production Python as your primary language *(experience with industrial protocols like MQTT, Modbus, OPC\-UA, or PLCs is a strong plus).* * Proven end\-to\-end project ownership with the ability to define roadmaps, write specs, and execute code independently *(experience working in manufacturing, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, or physical R\&D environments is a plus).* * Full\-lifecycle Python backend expertise across REST APIs, event/data pipelines, and automation scripts *(hands\-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, or async processing is a plus).* * Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to run discovery directly with non\-software stakeholders like scientists, technicians, and operations teams *(experience scoping technical requirements directly from physical shop\-floor workflows is a plus).* * Strong querying skills with schema design fundamentals. The position is eligible for company shares. Actual compensation may be higher or lower in the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to a candidate’s job duties, experience, and location. We will also consider higher\-level candidates and salary will be adjusted accordingly. Diamond Foundry believes in supporting our employees from the workplace to their personal and home life. We provide eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Odoo)
jobs.description: Headquartered in Irvine, California, EBizCharge specializes in developing integrated payment solutions that facilitate electronic payment processing within ERP, CRM, Mobile, and eCommerce applications. Our applications are PCI compliant and fully integrated with major ERP/accounting systems, including QuickBooks, Sage, SAP Business One, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, Epicor, Acumatica, and major online shopping carts, including Magento and WooCommerce. EBizCharge offers its employees tremendous learning opportunities, career growth potential, and a dynamic work environment. We are adding a second senior Odoo developer to work alongside our existing Odoo developer on our payment integration for Odoo 19\. The module covers POS card terminals, website payments, saved cards (card on file), and batch reconciliation. The two developers will own separate workstreams, review each other’s code, and share the roadmap. The existing developer has about three years of Odoo experience across POS, Sales, Inventory, Manufacturing, and Payroll, with REST APIs, cron jobs, and PDF reports. We want the new hire to add depth in payment security, testing, and integration design, so the profile below is more senior and more security\-focused. You will build and maintain Odoo modules that connect to SOAP and REST payment APIs, handle failure cases safely, and keep card data and credentials out of Odoo. You will review pull requests and help raise the quality bar for the whole team. **Responsibilities*** Build and maintain Odoo modules in Python and JavaScript (OWL), including payment provider, POS payment interface, and website payment flows. * Integrate with SOAP and REST payment APIs: device pairing, payment requests with polling and cancellation, tokenized cards, and batch reconciliation. * Move syncing and scheduled work to background jobs, so no gateway call blocks a login or a save. * Apply secure\-by\-default practices: access rights and record rules, authenticated routes with ownership checks, signed tokens, rate limiting, and no card numbers, CVV, or credentials stored in Odoo. * Write unit and integration tests, including failure paths such as gateway down, duplicate requests, and customers not yet synced. * Complete a pre\-QA checklist and a code quality scan on every ticket, and review pull requests, especially payment\-related ones. * Support upgrades across Odoo versions and troubleshoot merchant issues. **Qualifications*** 5\+ years of Odoo development, including 3\+ years on Odoo 16 or later. * Strong Python, plus JavaScript with OWL for POS and website front ends. * Hands\-on experience with Odoo POS, payments, or accounting modules. * Experience integrating REST and SOAP APIs (for example requests, zeep) with retries, timeouts, and idempotent handling. * Solid understanding of Odoo access control (ir.model.access, record rules, groups) and controller authentication. * Working knowledge of PCI DSS basics: tokenization, hosted forms, and why card numbers and CVV must not be stored. * PostgreSQL and SQL skills; Git and pull\-request workflows. **Preferred*** Payment gateway, terminal (EMV), or surcharging experience. * Familiarity with Odoo’s payment and point\_of\_sale modules internals. * Automated testing with Odoo’s test framework and tours. * Experience with other platforms we support (NetSuite, Business Central, Magento). **Benefits** * Employer paid benefits (including Medical, Dental, Vision, \& life insurance) for selected plans for the employee. * Retirement 401(k) plan with company match. * Gym access, dry cleaners, car wash conveniently located within building. * Generous PTO plan with an additional 9 Days Company Paid Holidays per year. Job Type: Full\-time The Company is committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all persons involved in Company operations. The Company prohibits unlawful discrimination against any job applicant, employee or unpaid intern by any employee of the Company, including supervisors and coworkers. Pay discrimination between employees of the opposite sex or between employees of another race or ethnicity performing substantially similar work, as defined by the California Fair Pay Act and federal law, is prohibited. \#LI\-DNP
