jobs.title: Energy Analyst III
jobs.description: About Us: At ENFRA, we blend a rich history with a forward\-looking vision. With over 100 years of experience, we are a pillar of stability in the energy infrastructure industry and a leader in innovative energy solutions. Our commitment to leveraging emerging technologies ensures that we remain at the forefront of the Energy\-as\-a\-Service sector. We believe in growth—not just for our business, but for our people. Our team members have the opportunity to advance their careers in a supportive environment that values continuous learning and development. We embrace innovation and encourage creative problem solving to tackle the energy infrastructure and energy challenges of tomorrow. Inclusion is at the heart of our culture. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard and valued, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive our success. Join us to be part of a legacy of excellence and a future of groundbreaking advancements. At ENFRA, stability, innovation, and growth are more than just values—they are the pillars of our continued success. Overview: The Energy Analyst III is responsible for organizing and analyzing utility and supporting energy use data to assist with the review and evaluation of energy and cost efficiency opportunities. An Energy Analyst will frequently interact with clients, contractors, and engineers to fulfill the essential duties and responsibilities of the position. Responsibilities: * Energy Procurement and Analytics + Collect, compile, organize, and analyze utility consumption data and rates. + Develop a comprehensive understanding of utility supply\-side opportunities. + Develop a comprehensive understanding of utility procurement logistics. + Develop a comprehensive understanding of possible utility energy efficiency rebate and incentive programs. + Research utility rate changes and deregulated energy cost trends. + Conduct energy benchmarks using internal and external tools such as EPA Energy Star. + Review utility invoices for errors and work to resolve the errors with the utility. + Create utility budgets. * Energy Auditing + Assist with the collection, review, and analysis of data collected from field surveys and utility data. + Develop a thorough understanding of existing building and its MEP systems. + Assist with the identification and evaluation of improvements for energy or cost reductions. + Assist with the development of associated technical reports. * Measurement and Verification + Develop and Implement IPVMP \- Adherent Measurement and Verification (M\&V) Plans. + Develop energy consumption baselines and adjustments through regression analysis and other appropriate methods. + Coordinate with clients, utility representatives, energy analysts, engineers, construction managers, and commission agents during all appropriate project stages to assist in the design and implementation of M\&V plans for continuous monitoring of energy and water performance. + Assist with the review of design documents, M\&E specifications, and shop drawings of applicable metering systems to confirm all M\&V requirements are met. + Verify utility performance of facilities and validate savings. + Review and analyze energy performance including data collection, utility bill accounting, sub\-metering data analysis, and utility cost analysis. + Create, maintain, and distribute M\&V dashboards and reports through multiple software platforms. * Remote Monitoring + Assist with the collection and evaluation of energy, weather, and building automation data on some periodic basis. + Assist with the review of data and identification of facility operational issues affecting energy consumption, comfort, and/or code compliance. + Assist with the development of recommendations to address any identified operational issues. + Assist with the preparation of reports for project stakeholders summarizing all discoveries. * Energy Modeling + Develop engineering\-based energy models to simulate existing and proposed operations of buildings or systems. + Work collaboratively with team members to identify and evaluate scope of potential improvements. + Develop life cycle cost analyses and other engineering economic analyses. + Develop supporting documentation on engineering calculations, methodologies, etc. as required. * Other + Uphold the Company owner advocacy philosophy, mission, and core values. + Perform Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.** **Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!** As a **Data Scientist – R\&D Systems \& Data Governance** at Elanco, you will serve as a strategic technical leader bridging advanced data science and data governance. In this role, you will define, establish, and operationalize R\&D wide data governance, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) from a systems perspective. You will provide critical advisory on which data attributes, metadata standards, ontologies, and master data models must be controlled, standardized, and harmonized at R\&D specific levels. Reporting into the R\&D organization and closely partnering with Enterprise Data Office (EDO), Operations, and IT, you will drive foundational data readiness across key R\&D scientific platforms—including **ARCHI**, **Benchling** (ELN / Registry / Inventory), **Revvity** (Signals / Informatics), and **Clinical Systems** (EDC, CTMS, eCOA/ePRO). You will ensure that research, discovery, and clinical trial data are structured, lineage\-tracked, and AI\-ready to accelerate pipeline breakthroughs and regulatory submissions. **This includes four strategic priorities:** * **R\&D Governance \& Systems Policy:** Support the interoperability of Data across R\&D and Enterprise\-wide ecosystems. * **Attribute\-Level Data Architecture:** Determine and advise on critical R\&D data attributes, controlled vocabularies, schemas, and master data entities required to ensure cross\-system interoperability. * **Pipeline Acceleration \& AI Readiness:** Optimize data capture, extraction, and standardization across preclinical and clinical workflows to power machine learning, generative AI, and predictive modeling. * **Data Quality \& Compliance Excellence:** Establish automated data quality frameworks, lineage monitoring, and compliance controls (FAIR principles, GxP, ALCOA\+) across interconnected scientific systems. **Your Responsibilities:** * **R\&D Data Governance \& Policy Formulation:** Author, establish, and govern enterprise\-wide data policies, standards, data classification, and operating procedures across R\&D software platforms, ensuring seamless alignment between scientific workflows and enterprise IT architecture. * **Attribute\-Level Control \& Metadata Management:** Evaluate data models across scientific applications to define what must be controlled at the enterprise level (e.g., compound IDs, study attributes, subject identifiers, assay parameters) versus local system configurations; establish standardized ontologies and controlled vocabularies. * **R\&D Systems Integration \& Data Strategy:** Serve as the lead data science advisor for core discovery and development platforms: + **ARCHI:** Standardize enterprise architecture definitions, repository schemas, and data pipelines. + **Benchling:** Oversee data schema design, entity registration, inventory tracking, and API\-based data extraction for downstream analytics. + **Revvity :** Guide assay data capture, screening data harmonization, and analytical workflow standardization. + **Clinical Systems:** Ensure clinical trial data attributes (EDC, CTMS, CDISC/SDTM models) adhere to enterprise standards for traceability and submission readiness. * **End\-to\-End Data Science \& Modeling:** Design, build, and deploy machine learning and statistical models that leverage harmonized data assets from Benchling, Revvity, and Clinical platforms to solve complex R\&D challenges (e.g., predictive screening, clinical outcome modeling). * **Data Quality Frameworks \& Automated Monitoring:** Implement automated data validation, anomaly detection, and data completeness metrics at ingestion points across enterprise endpoints. * **Cross\-Functional Influence \& Stakeholder Management:** Partner with senior stakeholders across Discovery, Translational Medicine, Clinical Operations, Regulatory, Quality Assurance, and IT to drive adoption of data governance practices without impeding scientific velocity. * **Collaborate on Infrastructure \& Deployment:** Work alongside Data Engineers, ML Engineers, and Cloud Solution Architects (Azure / GCP) to design scalable data pipelines, data mesh/lakehouse architectures, and secure data ac ecifically: + Electronic Lab Notebooks \& Registries (e.g., Benchling). + Scientific Informatics \& Chemistry/Biology platforms (e.g., Revvity Signals, PerkinElmer informatics). + Architecture \& Enterprise modeling tools (e.g., ARCHI / ArchiMate). + Clinical data platforms (EDC, CTMS, CDISC standards). * **Programming \& Querying Proficiency:** Strong programming skills in Python or R, along with advanced SQL capabilities for relational, document, and graph database querying. * **Data Science \& ML Capabilities:** Demonstrated experience developing and applying statistical and machine learning models (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, NLP for scientific text, predictive modeling). * **Communication \& Data Storytelling:** Exceptional ability to synthesize complex data architecture and analytical concepts into actionable recommendations for scientific, operational, and executive stakeholders. **What Will Give You the Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):** * **Life Science Ontologies \& Metadata Standards:** Deep familiarity with biomedical ontologies (e.g., MeSH, SNOMED, ChEMBL, CDISC/SDTM/ADaM) and FAIR data implementation frameworks. * **API \& Pipeline Engineering:** Experience with REST APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, and integration of computerized system validation (CSV) in life science environments. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: ##### ***Electrosoft Services, LLC is an award\-winning company that provides comprehensive technology\-based solutions and services to federal customers. While cybersecurity is our specialty, we also focus on ICAM, Zero Trust, digital engineering and transformation, and enterprise AI and intelligent automation. We always seek to delight our customers, so we retain highly qualified employees and offer them meaningful work, growth opportunities, and work\-life balance. What sets us apart from all other contractors is the sense of*** ***teamwork*** ***our employees feel – and the knowledge that outstanding effort is recognized and rewarded. The camaraderie we share emanates from Lunch \& Learn sessions where we explore new ideas together, fun group activities ranging from escape rooms to miniature golf, and much, much more. If we've described you and your dream workplace, please apply and share in the many benefits and opportunities we offer.*** **Data Engineer – Scientific Document and Data Pipelines** Responsible for designing, developing, and implementing automated scientific data extraction and standardization solutions supporting the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) CHIPS METIS initiative. Develops advanced Python\-based pipelines to extract figures, charts, and tables from scientific documents and transform non\-standard research data into structured, machine\-readable formats. Implements Optical Character Recognition (OCR), document layout analysis, data normalization, and schema validation capabilities. Integrates data processing tools and microservices into existing web applications and research data repositories. Works closely with government scientists and technical stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and interoperability. Develops technical documentation, maintains source code repositories, and supports the delivery of reliable, reusable software solutions. **Responsibilities / Tasks** * Design and implement automated OCR and document layout analysis pipelines to extract scientific figures, charts, and tables from PDF and Microsoft Word documents. * Develop algorithms to identify and extract figure captions, axis labels, measurement units, and associated scientific metadata. * Implement table extraction capabilities that preserve row and column structures, headers, and data relationships. * Integrate extracted metadata with established controlled vocabularies and ontologies within the Controlled Vocabulary Curation System (CVCS). * Develop and enhance user interfaces that enable scientific domain experts to validate extracted content and correct OCR errors. * Develop Python\-based parser libraries to convert proprietary instrument outputs, legacy spreadsheets, and non\-standard text files into standardized CSV formats. * Implement automated data normalization, schema validation, and quality assurance procedures to ensure compliance with METIS data schemas. * Develop heuristic data\-cleaning capabilities to address missing values, merged cells, inconsistent headers, and extraneous metadata. * Integrate extraction and standardization tools as microservices or software modules within the existing CVCS web application architecture. * Develop data export capabilities to support integration with the METIS Discovery Portal. * Prepare design documentation, implementation guides, API specifications, and deployment procedures. * Develop, test, and maintain documented source code within GitHub repositories, including code intended for public release. * Prepare and deliver technical demonstrations of extraction workflows, data conversion capabilities, and system enhancements. * Monitor and report technical performance metrics, including document processing volumes, OCR accuracy, data conversion success rates, and system integration status. * Collaborate with government scientists, developers, and technical stakeholders to identify requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, and improve system functionality. **Required Skills:** * Bachelor's degree (four\-year) in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field. * Four (4\) years of advanced Python programming experience, specifically with Pandas and OCR libraries. * Four (4\) years of experience with OCR pipelines and table extraction logic. * Four (4\) years of experience with data format normalization and schema validation. * Four (4\) years of experience integrating microservices into web applications. * Experience developing and maintaining automated data processing and transformation pipelines. * Knowledge of OCR and document processing technologies such as Tesseract, PaddleOCR, pdfplumber, Camelot, LayoutParser, or comparable tools. * Familiarity with JSON Schema, XML/XSD, controlled vocabularies, and ontology\-based metadata tagging. * Experience with REST APIs, GitHub, and software development and deployment practices. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, technical documentation, and communication skills. * Must be able to successfully complete a federal background investigation appropriate for an IT\-Low Risk position and meet applicable HSPD\-12/PIV credentialing requirements. * Must be able to work on\-site at the NIST campus in Gaithersburg, Maryland. * This position is contingent upon contract award. #### ***Electrosoft is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled***

jobs.title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer (Engineer Senior)
jobs.description: **Senior AI Solutions Engineer (Engineer Senior)** **Location:** This role requires associates to be in\-office 1\-2 days per week, fostering collaboration and connectivity, while providing flexibility to support productivity and work\-life balance. This approach combines structured office engagement with the autonomy of virtual work, promoting a dynamic and adaptable workplace. Ideal candidates will be able to report to our Pulse Point location in Atlanta, GA. Alternate locations may be considered if candidates reside within a commuting distance from an office. Please note that per our policy on hybrid/virtual work, candidates not within a reasonable commuting distance from the posting location(s) will not be considered for employment, unless an accommodation is granted as required by law. The **Senior AI Solutions Engineer (Engineer Senior)** will build and scale intelligent systems that improve healthcare outcomes. You will design, build, and deploy machine learning and LLM\-based systems, taking models from experimentation to production within assigned client group, business unit or corporate department and utilizing various customer technology platforms. Also responsible for delivery of end\-to\-end application, system development and maintenance on complex multi technology platforms within assigned client group, business unit or corporate department and utilizing various customer technology platforms. **How you will make an impact:** * Maintains active relationships with product, data, engineering, architecture, and business teams to translate business problems into scalable AI/ML solutions. * Applies AI/ML capabilities and modern AI tools to solve meaningful business problems, improve healthcare outcomes, and enable practical adoption across business workflows, digital products, and enterprise applications. * Owns the change request process and may coordinate with other teams as necessary. * Provides technical advice and weighs in on technical decisions that impact cross\-functional teams, including AI/ML and advanced analytics solutions. * Researches and proposes new technologies, keeping abreast of developments in AI and applying them to enterprise use cases where relevant. * Designs, builds, and deploys end\-to\-end ML and LLM\-based systems (data pipelines, models, prompts, APIs, and monitoring). * Develops, evaluates, deploys, and monitors machine learning models for predictive, classification, optimization, personalization, and decision\-support use cases. * Builds applied AI solutions such as semantic search, RAG pipelines, and embedding\-based systems. * Develops production\-ready AI/ML services, APIs, pipelines, and reusable components; improves performance, scalability, reliability, usability, and operational readiness in production. * Performs technical design reviews and code reviews; provides technical leadership through solution design, best practices, troubleshooting, and mentoring junior team members. * Assesses status and supports data information planning. * Coordinates on\-call support and ensures effective monitoring of systems, including AI/ML model performance and reliability. * Mentors others and may lead multiple or small to medium\-sized projects. * Influences engineering standards and technical direction. * Identifies and proposes strategies around technical problems affecting the team, communicates standards, and gains buy\-in on solutions. **Minimum Requirements:** Requires a BA/BS degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field of study and a minimum of 5 years related experience; experience working with multi\-dimensional platforms, and business and technical applications also required; or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background. **Preferred Skills, Capabilities and Experiences:** * Masters or PhD preferred. * Advanced Python skills for machine learning and data processing preferred. * Experience across the full ML lifecycle (development, deployment and monitoring) preferred. * Hands\-on experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, or modern NLP techniques using vector search technologies like OpenSearch preferred. * Experience building production AI systems (APIs, pipelines, microservices) preferred. * Experience designing evaluation frameworks for ML/LLM systems preferred. * Familiarity with responsible AI principles (fairness, explainability, privacy) preferred. * Experience with cloud\-based ML platforms and scalable architectures (AWS Bedrock, or equivalent AI model cloud providers) preferred. * Healthcare domain experience, including familiarity with data privacy and regulatory requirements preferred. * Multi database and/or multi language preferred. * Experience mentoring others, leading multiple small projects and providing troubleshooting support preferred. Please be advised that Elevance Health only accepts resumes for compensation from agencies that have a signed agreement with Elevance Health. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Elevance Health. Who We Are Elevance Health is a health company dedicated to improving lives and communities – and making healthcare simpler. We are a Fortune 25 company with a longstanding history in the healthcare industry, looking for leaders at all levels of the organization who are passionate about making an impact on our members and the communities we serve. How We Work At Elevance Health, we are creating a culture that is designed to advance our strategy but will also lead to personal and professional growth for our associates. Our values and behaviors are the root of our culture. They are how we achieve our strategy, power our business outcomes and drive our shared success \- for our consumers, our associates, our communities and our business. We offer a range of market\-competitive total rewards that include merit increases, paid holidays, Paid Time Off, and incentive bonus programs (unless covered by a collective bargaining agreement), medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) \+match, stock purchase plan, life insurance, wellness programs and financial education resources, to name a few. Elevance Health operates in a Hybrid Workforce Strategy. Unless specified as primarily virtual by the hiring manager, associates are required to work at an Elevance Health location at least once per week, and potentially several times per week. Specific requirements and expectations for time onsite will be discussed as part of the hiring process. The health of our associates and communities is a top priority for Elevance Health. We require all new candidates in certain patient/member\-facing roles to become vaccinated against COVID\-19 and Influenza. If you are not vaccinated, your offer will be rescinded unless you provide an acceptable explanation. Elevance Health will also follow all relevant federal, state and local laws. Elevance Health is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, citizenship status, color, creed, disability, ethnicity, genetic information, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), marital status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other status or condition protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process should submit the Accessibility Accommodation Request Form and a member of the team will be in contact. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws, including, but not limited to, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act. Prospective employees required to be screened under Florida law should review the education and awareness resources at HB531 \| Florida Agency for Health Care Administration.

jobs.description: **Empowerly** (empowerly.com) personalizes college and career counseling with data\-driven technology and former Admissions Officers. Our Empowerly Score™ is a predictive model that evaluates each student across academics, essays, and extracurriculars. We are a fully remote, venture\-backed team, and this hire will shape what our platform looks like next. **About the Role** Empowerly helps students and families navigate college admissions, pairing data\-driven technology with counselors who are former Admissions Officers. As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will work closely with counselors, operations, and product partners to understand what slows them down, then build the software that fixes it, from React front\-end to backend services, APIs, and AI features. A senior engineer will review your work and coach your decisions, and you will own real problems from your first month. We care more about what you have built and how you think than how many years you have been doing it. We hire for strong computer science fundamentals and the ability to go deep. When we ask how something works, we want you to be able to explain it all the way down. **What you'll do** * Solve the real problem behind a request from counselors, operations, or product * Ship tested, full\-stack features end to end: React, backend services, APIs, and the database underneath * Build and improve AI\-powered features using LLMs and AI APIs, and check whether they help the people using them * Turn ambiguous requests into a scoped plan and a working first version quickly, then iterate on feedback * Debug production issues across the stack, with a senior engineer at first and on your own over time **What you'll bring** * Experience shipping software that other people use, from a job, internship, freelance work, open source, or a substantial project of your own. We care about what you built and your role in it, not how long you have been doing it * Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, networking, and how the web works. This usually means a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, EECS, or a related field, or equivalent depth you can show us * The ability to sketch a simple system design for a feature, explain the tradeoffs, and go into detail when asked * Solid React and TypeScript, with strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals * Working knowledge of the backend: APIs, databases, and third\-party integrations * Hands\-on experience using AI APIs or LLMs inside an application, beyond using AI coding assistants to write code * Comfort with Git, code review, and writing tests * A methodical approach to debugging: you find the root cause instead of guessing * Clear communication: you can explain technical decisions to people who are not engineers, and you follow problems through to done **Nice to have** * Experience building Agentic AI workflows * Experience building internal tools or working directly with non\-engineering teammates or customers * Exposure to a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and CI/CD * Time at a startup or in a fast\-moving environment **The pay range for this role is:** 125,000 \- 145,000 USD per year(Remote, US)

jobs.title: Interconnection Sales Specialist (DOD/Intel)
jobs.description: ### **Interconnection Sales Specialist (DOD/Intel)** * JR\-164637 * Hybrid * Ashburn * Sales * Full time **Who are we?** Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work. **Job Summary** The Interconnection Sales Specialist (ICS) is an architecture\-led seller who grows interconnection revenue across Equinix's full physical and virtual portfolio in new and existing Commercial accounts. The role helps mid\-market and enterprise customers modernize their networks, connect hybrid and multicloud environments, scale digital operations, improve application performance, and accelerate AI adoption. An ICS sells architectures, not transactions. They work with customers to design how their networks, clouds, applications, partners, customers, and AI workloads connect, then land that design on Platform Equinix as a repeatable pattern. Each landed architecture is a design win: a durable position in the account through which additional connections, locations, applications, and workloads can scale. The ICS partners with Account Executives, Solution Architects, Sales Engineers, Technical Account Managers, Customer Success, and channel and alliance partners to create pull\-through for the whole account team. What You'll Sell The ICS sells every Equinix interconnection service, combined into the architecture the customer needs rather than one product at a time. Typical architectures include: * WAN core and network modernization using Equinix Fabric and Network Edge * Hybrid and multicloud connectivity using Fabric Cloud Router and private cloud on\-ramps * Data center consolidation, cloud adjacency, and distributed infrastructure architectures * Distributed AI hubs, GPU connectivity, and high\-capacity data\-movement interconnect * AI inference, application delivery, and low\-latency digital experiences at the edge * Private connectivity to SaaS platforms, AI services, customers, suppliers, and ecosystem partners * Digital supply\-chain and B2B ecosystems built on cross connects, peering, and Metro Connect * Business continuity, disaster recovery, cybersecurity, and zero\-trust connectivity architectures * Architectures supporting mergers and acquisitions, geographic expansion, digital commerce, and distributed workforces **Responsibilities** Main Responsibilities Architecture\-Led Selling and Design Wins * Lead design conversations with customer network, cloud, infrastructure, security, application, and data teams to understand business drivers, technical requirements, and pain points * Map customer needs to proven interconnection architectures, combining physical and virtual services into a unified design * Partner with Solution Architects on presales feasibility and solution design, and produce blueprints that account and delivery teams can execute * Register the architecture scope early and drive it from customer commitment through the first production connection and a published blueprint * Build value cases using measurable outcomes such as network cost reduction, application performance, cloud egress optimization, deployment speed, resiliency, and revenue enablement * Engage CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, cloud leaders, application owners, procurement, finance, and business stakeholders to align the architecture with growth, efficiency, customer experience, and transformation priorities * Design for resiliency, security, regulatory compliance, data governance, zero\-trust networking, disaster recovery, global expansion, and secure access to clouds, SaaS platforms, partners, customers, and distributed locations Account and Territory Planning * Run joint account planning with Account Executives and Sales Engineers for assigned accounts, territories, or industry segments * Analyze the installed base, network topology, cloud footprint, application landscape, and interconnection maturity to identify accounts ready for a new architecture * Drive expansion in existing accounts and help open new logos, including magnet customers that attract partners, suppliers, carriers, clouds, and digital ecosystems * Identify opportunities tied to network modernization, jobs.title: Machine Learning (ML) Engineer - Applied
jobs.description: **ModelCat \| Remote from Europe** **About ModelCat** ------------------ ModelCat is transforming how companies develop AI models for embedded, edge, and IoT devices. Our innovative platform uses AI to build AI — turning model architecture selection, training, optimization, and validation into a single powerful step. ModelCat takes what was previously a 12–24 month process requiring highly skilled AI professionals and reduces it to a 24–48 hour AI\-powered job that can be run by developers, data scientists, and product owners. Trusted by industry leaders like NXP and Silicon Labs, ModelCat is a venture\-backed startup headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. **The Role** ------------ We're seeking a motivated ML Engineer to help advance our AutoML platform. You'll play a key role in expanding its capabilities, onboarding new ML use\-cases across vision, time\-series, and beyond, and improving the product as we scale. This role offers meaningful growth potential toward a technical leadership track. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **AutoML Platform Development** * Contribute to the development and enhancement of our AutoML system for Edge AI, including pipelines that combine deep\-learning and conventional algorithms for embedded devices. This includes object tracking, multi\-model pipelines, and emerging use\-cases. * Build and improve platform features across compute clusters and our web application. * Define abstractions and contribute to the architecture of cloud, cluster, and embedded components. ### **ML Use\-Case Expansion** * Integrate new ML use\-cases across a broad range of data domains and maintain and improve existing ones. * This includes time\-series and audio, object re\-identification, segmentation and keypoints. * Includes action recognition (video), radar and point cloud data, and multi\-modal systems (vision \+ audio \+ sensor). * Also includes small language models (NLP/SLM), classification, and object detection. * Work with foundational computer vision and non\-CV ML models — train, evaluate, modify, and combine them to unlock new functionality. ### **Edge AI Optimization \& Deployment** * Optimize AI solutions for edge devices using TinyML frameworks, creating models that fit a range of chip sizes and memory constraints. * Deploy ML and non\-ML algorithms on embedded targets (MCU and application\-class microprocessors). * Productize research\-quality code into robust, production\-ready systems. ### **Collaboration \& Craft** * Partner on data strategies, preprocessing pipelines, and model training workflows. * Stay current with Edge AI and AutoML advancements. * Document your work and contribute to technical reports. **Who You Are** --------------- ### **Required** * Master's degree in CS, EE, or a related field (PhD a plus). * 4\+ years of relevant industry experience in ML (AutoML and Edge AI experience highly valued). * Strong Python skills with the ability to write production\-quality code; C/C\+\+ a plus. * Solid command of ML frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX. * Proficient with the standard DS toolset: scikit\-learn, OpenCV, pandas. * Comfortable working in Linux\-based development environments. * Experience onboarding new ML use\-cases and expanding into new data domains. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and strong written and verbal English communication. ### **Preferred** * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS) and web technologies (Node.js, REST APIs). * Familiarity with compute cluster tools such as Ray and Optuna. * Knowledge of model compression techniques: pruning, quantization, transfer learning, knowledge distillation. * Experience defining software architecture for ML systems. * Familiarity with CI/CD practices. * Understanding of embedded systems concepts. * Experience with non\-ML algorithms and signal processing. **Mindset** ----------- * Proactive, entrepreneurial approach — you thrive with ownership and ambiguity. * Startup mentality: you move fast, learn faster, and care deeply about the outcome. **Why Join ModelCat** --------------------- **Market Opportunity** — Edge AI is exploding, and we're solving a critical pain point in a massive and growing market. **Real Customer Impact** — Our platform compresses 12–24 months of model development into 24–48 hours — validated by customers like NXP and Silicon Labs. **Technical Depth** — Work on hard, meaningful problems at the intersection of AutoML, TinyML, and embedded systems. **Growth Trajectory** — Join during a pivotal growth phase with significant room to grow into technical leadership. **Competitive Compensation** — Base salary, performance\-based bonus, and meaningful equity stake. ‍ *ModelCat is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.*

jobs.title: Data Science Engineer III
jobs.description: * Engineering * Miami * Full\-time ### **Description** Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. At the core of the company is the Market Model \- a proprietary AI\-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real\-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass\-box architecture, it uses market data \- not personal data \- with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry\-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul. While Fetcherr initially focused on the airline industry, the company is now expanding into additional verticals, bringing its dynamic AI\-driven optimization capabilities to new industries such as travel, mobility, retail, e\-commerce, and beyond. **About the Role** This is not a pure research role but one that is actively involved in building our product. You will be joining a team of Data Science Engineers and you will be directly contributing to code. You will own well\- scoped modeling problems end to end, from exploring market data and designing features to validating models and getting them running in production, so that our pricing, inventory, and network optimization engines make better decisions in real time. This is a high\-impact individual contributor role at the intersection of applied AI and production software, working directly with other data scientists, ML and data engineers, and product teams. **What you will do:** * Develop, validate, and iterate on demand forecasting, pricing, and optimization models using large\-scale, high\-velocity market data. * Explore and analyze data from diverse internal and external sources to uncover signals, define features, and identify opportunities to improve model accuracy and business impact. * Design and run offline experiments, backtests, and online evaluations to measure model performance and profit uplift. * Write production\-grade Python code and work with ML and data engineers to productionize models, ensuring they are reliable, observable, and cost\-efficient. * Monitor deployed models for drift, accuracy, and data quality issues, and troubleshoot and fix problems quickly. * Keep our glass\-box principles front and center: build models whose logic and outcomes can be explained to commercial teams and customers. * Partner with product and commercial stakeholders to translate business problems into clear modeling approaches and communicate results. * Contribute to the technical direction of the modeling stack as Fetcherr scales across new customers, verticals, and product lines. ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of full\-time experience as a Data Scientist, Applied Scientist, ML Engineer, or similar role building models that run in production. Lab, proof of concept, prototype, academic, and part\-time experience does not count toward this requirement. * Strong programming skills in Python, with production\-grade coding practices (testing, code review, version control). * Solid foundation in statistics, machine learning, and time\-series forecasting, with sound judgment on model validation and experiment design. * Strong SQL skills and experience working with large relational and non\-relational datasets. * Experience and comfort with AI\-assisted software development, along with the ability to write and reason about code yourself. * Experience with cloud platforms (GCP and BigQuery preferred) and modern data warehouse and lakehouse technologies. * Familiarity with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster) and CI/CD practices for ML and data pipelines. * Strong analytical mindset and a pragmatic, get\-it\-done approach. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills, comfortable working cross\-functionally with engineering and product teams. **Nice to Have** * Experience with dynamic pricing, revenue management, or optimization problems. * Experience in travel, e\-commerce, logistics, or other real\-time decisioning domains. * Exposure to MLOps practices such as model registries, monitoring, and automated retraining. * Experience with real\-time OLAP engines such as ClickHouse. * Experience in a Software\-as\-a\-Service environment.

jobs.title: Director, Cloud Engineering
jobs.description: **Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.** ### **Job Description:** **The Role** We are seeking a seasoned and technically strong Director, Workflow Automation and Platform Engineering to lead the evolution of OpsWorX from an operations workstation into an enterprise platform. This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of a transformational modernization journey — reimagining a mission\-critical workstation as a platform where domain teams contribute their own UI experiences, built from reusable, connected components. You will play a defining role in shaping how operations users interact with technology, modernizing aging systems onto a container\-based, interop\-connected architecture, integrating BPMN workflow orchestration, and embedding agentic AI into operations workflows. Beyond engineering delivery, you will own the delivery roadmap, drive technology strategy, and lead a high\-performing team, operating independently toward high\-level objectives. **Key Responsibilities** Strategy, Roadmap and Planning * Assisting the VP of Engineering in developing and implementing a multi\-year technology strategy for OpsWorX platform modernization and workflow automation * Partnering closely with the Product Manager and VP of Engineering to build a delivery roadmap balancing modernization, automation, regulatory compliance, and operational stability * Translating high\-level objectives into actionable engineering plans with clear milestones, resource requirements, and success metrics * Defining a reusable component strategy — workflow patterns, connectors, task UIs, and SDKs — that domain teams adopt to build experiences and automate processes * Partnering with product management, UX, operations, domain teams, and business stakeholders to align technology delivery with business goals * Driving a consistent, seamless platform experience across interop\-connected applications, workflows, and components * Establishing design principles, platform standards, and a governance and contribution model so OpsWorX evolves as a coherent platform * Communicating technical strategy and delivery roadmaps clearly to technical and non\-technical executive audiences Organizational Leadership * Leading, mentoring, and developing a team of engineers, including talent development, resource planning, and associate growth * Fostering a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement * Inspiring and aligning the team around a shared platform modernization and automation vision through a complex transformation Delivery and Execution * Owning end\-to\-end engineering delivery — from backlog refinement and sprint planning through release management and production deployment — balancing velocity with quality, reliability, and security in a regulated financial environment * Establishing and monitoring KPIs for delivery health, reliability, platform adoption, component reuse, and business outcomes such as manual effort eliminated * Removing organizational blockers and dependencies that impede engineering execution, escalating appropriately and decisively * Driving incident management, root cause analysis, and operational stability improvements across the platform * Owning technology lifecycle management, keeping applications and platform components on current versions, standards, and best practices * Leading delivery of agentic AI within operations workflows — BPMN\-orchestrated LLM agents with policy controls, human review steps, and audit trails * Championing AI\-assisted development across the SDLC — code generation, automated testing, and code review — to accelerate delivery **The Expertise and Skills You Bring** You bring a track record of significant, quantified delivery (cost, cycle time, productivity) leading engineering teams through complex, multi\-year modernization programs in a fast\-paced, regulated environment. Ideally you have 8–12 years in software engineering leadership, including Director\-level experience, along with excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to set direction from high\-level objectives and drive outcomes without detailed guidance. Domain knowledge in brokerage, financial services operations, or back\-office processing is required. **Key differentiators for this role:** * Delivering production Gen AI — LLM and agentic AI solutions with guardrails, evaluation, and governance * Hands\-on BPMN workflow orchestration and process automation at enterprise scale (e.g., Camunda/FluxNova) * Container\-based application architecture and platform interoperability — context sharing, event broadcasting, and workflow integration across workstation applications * Building reusable platforms, shared components, or SDKs adopted by multiple teams through a contribution model You also bring a solid grasp of software architecture, distributed systems, and event\-driven integration, CI/CD and DevOps experience, and a proven ability to modernize legacy technology stacks while maintaining system stability and operational continuity. Familiarity with Interop.io/FDC3, Angular, Java/Spring Boot, brokerage back\-office systems, and regulatory frameworks such as FINRA, SEC Rule 15c3, or SOX is preferred. Series 99 is a nice\-to\-have. **The Team** We are the OpsWorX team within Brokerage Record Keeping Technology (BRT). We build the operations workstation platform and workflow automation capabilities used across multiple Fidelity Business Units operations teams, helping our partners serve clients with speed, accuracy, and control. We work closely with product management, UX, operations, and domain teams, and we are focused on a culture of learning and mobility. Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model Fidelity is transitioning to a full\-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles. ### **Certifications:** ### **Category:** Information Technology Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement\-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self\-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager - Mechanical/Plumbing
jobs.description: **Great work starts with great people. At Flintco, you’ll find respect, stability, and opportunity to grow your career.** Established in 1908, Flintco maintains offices in 8 major cities and employs more than 900 talented and humble professionals. Ranked among the largest and safest contractors in the nation, we deliver projects across a wide range of market sectors, including healthcare, education, hospitality, sports, mixed\-use/residential, advanced industries, and renewable energy. With self\-perform capabilities in concrete, steel fabrication and erection, site work, and other critical services, we bring a distinct in\-house advantage to every project. Guided by the core principles of our Ethos — Safety, Quality, Honesty, Integrity, and Innovation — our culture is rooted in accountability, collaboration, and commitment to shared success. Beyond the jobsite, we invest in the communities we call home, strengthening the places where we live, work, and build. **Job Summary** **The Flintco Quality Assurance Manager** is responsible for the development, review, and implementation of company\-wide and project\-specific quality documentation and processes. This individual will be focus on the Mechanical/Plumbing portion of a large Healthcare Campus project in NW Arkansas. This position is part of the Construction Support Services (CSS) team: **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** All duties and responsibilities include the following; however, other duties may be assigned. To perform in this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Assists CSS staff in the creation, adoption, maintenance, and change/configuration management of company\-wide Quality policies, processes, procedures, tools, and templates. * Assists CSS staff in the development and maintenance of technology platforms used to host Quality programming information. * Assists Operations staff in the development of project\-specific Quality Assurance Plans (QAP), inclusive of mandatory and elective programming requirements. * Facilitates initiation, planning, and kickoff meetings between CSS staff, Operations staff, and affected stakeholders – utilized to perform risk assessments, identify definable features of work, develop conditions of satisfaction, delineate roles and responsibilities, and define trade partner solicitation requirements. * Facilitates early review of project design configuation for key assemblies/installations with a focus on design quality, design clarity and constructability. * Facilitates pre\-installation and pre\-commissioning meetings for various building systems and trade partners. * Integrates quality management elements into operational practices, such as Last Planner System® implementation. * Generates project\-specific forms, inspections, and agenda templates using company\-wide baselines available in corporate tools, such as Procore. * Integrates with Flintco’s Visual Design \& Construction (VDC) team to ensure appropriate technologies are utilized on a project\-level for quality assurance and control activities. * Manages and oversees inspections of construction systems, investigates non\-conformances through the use of root cause analysis, and initiates, implements, and coordinates corrective/preventative actions, as appropriate. * Interacts with trade partners, architects, and engineers on behalf of project staff regarding technical issues, specification requirements, and inspection methods and scheduling. * Keeps management team abreast of significant issues or developments identified during quality activities and corrective/preventative actions are taken to assure continuous process improvement. * Investigates customer complaints regarding quality. * Mentors and assists project staff in quality assurance and control activities, including advising management on implementation and effectiveness of Quality Management tools, following and enforcing Safety Rules and Practices. Provides oversight of testing logs for specific scopes and installations, and consults on the development of subcontractor inspection and test plans. Accurately tracks status of milestones. * Performs audits, assessments, and non\-advocate reviews to ensure Flintco’s Quality Assurance Plan is up to date and being executed. Communicates and teams with peers, supervisors, and managers on assignments. Helps management to prioritize effort for installed products. * Performs audits, assessments and non\-advocate reviews to ensure Flintco's Quality Assurance Plan is up to date and is being executed. * Assists in generating site\-specific QA/QC inspection reports and checklists. * Ensure that assessment reports, proposals, inspection reports and information required are properly prepared and reported. Also, verifies that select routine company administrative policies are followed. * Monitors and reports on the status of all issued non\-conformance reports using company\-wide tools, such as Procore. **Management Responsibilities** May supervise junior members of the CSS team **Knowledge/Skills/Ability** Able to work independently. Expertise and experience in the following construction trades. AISC, ASME, NBIC, and project specific quality management systems. Ability and expectation to spend 70 percent of time in the field and 30 documenting findings. Identify and complete training to become Flintco SME for Lean and other value\-added programs. Data analytics and problem solving. Ability to stop work if necessary, to resolve matters that affect safety, quality and/or inhibit the logical progress of work. Able to accurately and timely verify control and archiving of all quality documentation. **Education** BS degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Experience** 5\-10 years of Commercial/Industrial inspection, construction supervision, or hands on related experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Physical Requirements * Physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. * The employee is occasionally required to sit and smell. * The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. * Occasionally, especially when managing multiple projects and during problematic opening and/or closing phases of projects, mental stress can be taxing. * May be required to work long hours for extended periods of time. **Special Job Dimensions** The office provides a safe and healthy work environment, is adequately heated and cooled, is free from exposure and extreme conditions, has appropriate lighting and office furnishings, and is smoke\-free and drug\-free. While performing the duties of this position in the fabrication shop, warehouse, maintenance shop or at a project site, the employee could be regularly exposed to any number of the following, including, but not limited to: moving mechanical parts; moving machinery; high, precarious places (including, but not limited to, being raised several hundred feet in a bucket); close tight quarters; rough and sloped terrain; fumes or airborne particles; drilling and blasting activities; welding activities; toxic or caustic chemicals; the potential of falling rock; and outside weather conditions. AI agents take an issue, gather approved evidence from plant systems, connect it to what the plant already knows, and recommend a fix that a person reviews and approves. As an AI Agent Engineer (Controls), you build those agents: how they plan an investigation, which tools and data they use, and how they explain what they found. manufacturing ontology and knowledge graph, which gives plant data one shared meaning across systems and plants. * Rank and filter evidence so agents reason on the right sources, and show those sources in every output. * Have agents flag low confidence or missing data and hand off to a person. **Measure and Improve** * Test agents against the shared evaluation sets before each release, and add cases from plant experts. * Analyze failures, compare approaches, and improve accuracy, cost, and response time. * Turn user feedback and confirmed fixes into better agent behavior. **Learn From the Floor** * Spend time with supervisors and engineers at Kentucky Truck Plant to see how problems really get solved. **Success in Role** * Agents complete investigation steps reliably, with sources jobs.title: Materials Sourcing Lead
jobs.description: **About Formlabs:** A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build. Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron\-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem. That's what we do. At Formlabs, we're building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they're building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. **Your Impact:** Our Manufacturing team makes 3D printing materials at scale, and Materials is one of the fastest\-growing and most strategically important parts of our product portfolio. Our powders for our SLS printers are produced by a network of contract manufacturers, and we're increasingly looking at ways to make the supply chain more agile. We're looking for a commercially minded Materials Sourcing Lead to own our powder supply base. You'll manage contract manufacturer relationships, negotiate the agreements that govern them, and keep cost, capacity, and risk in balance as the business grows. You'll also help shape our long\-term strategy, including where vertical integration can improve our cost position, supply security, or control over quality. This is a role for someone who has managed suppliers and contracts at a strategic level and wants to influence how a fast\-growing materials business is built. **The Job:** **Contract Manufacturer Management** * Own relationships with powder contract manufacturers and key suppliers, serving as the primary commercial point of contact. * Run quarterly business reviews with scorecards for quality, delivery, cost, capacity, and responsiveness, and hold partners accountable to their commitments. * Manage volume allocation across contract manufacturers to balance cost, capacity, and supply risk. * Partner with Quality to resolve supplier quality issues and make sure corrective actions are delivered. * Own supplier qualification and onboarding for new contract manufacturers, and maintain the Approved Supplier List. **Commercial Strategy \& Negotiation** * Lead negotiations for supply agreements, including pricing, volume commitments, capacity reservations, lead times, payment terms, and continuity provisions. * Build and maintain total\-cost and should\-cost models to understand cost drivers and support negotiations. * Drive annual cost reduction targets and report savings and commercial performance to leadership. * Manage pricebooks and execute price change workflows in partnership with Finance. **Vertical Integration \& Network Strategy** * Evaluate make\-versus\-buy opportunities across the powder value chain, building business cases that weigh cost, capital investment, risk, and strategic control. * Support execution of vertical integration initiatives, coordinating with Finance, Manufacturing, and R\&D, and managing the transition with existing partners. * Develop a multi\-year sourcing strategy for powder that supports growth, new product launches, and supply resilience. **Supply Risk \& Continuity** * Maintain a live supply risk tracker covering capacity constraints, concentration risk, partner financial health, and geopolitical exposure. * Surface emerging risks proactively and lead mitigation planning, including dual\-sourcing, capacity agreements, and inventory strategy. * Monitor market conditions for polymer feedstocks and translate them into commercial recommendations. **New Materials \& NPI** * Identify and source new powder materials and partners that expand our product portfolio. * Support NPI by setting cost targets, securing supply, and ensuring contract manufacturer readiness ahead of launch. **Cost Visibility \& Operations** * Build and maintain dashboards tracking current and forward\-looking powder COGS. * Lead process improvement projects that make sourcing and supplier management more scalable. **You:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, category management, or supplier management, ideally in manufacturing, chemicals, or materials. * Proven track record managing contract manufacturers or strategic suppliers, including leading complex negotiations with measurable results. * Experience building business cases and financial models for sourcing, make\-versus\-buy, or investment decisions. * Strong analytical skills: advanced Excel/Sheets required; SQL, Python, or Tableau a plus. * Enough technical fluency to engage credibly with supplier engineers and our R\&D team on materials and processes. * Confident communicator and negotiator with external partners and senior leadership. **Bonus Points** * MBA or graduate degree in business or engineering. * Experience with polymers, plastics, or powder materials (e.g., nylon, TPU, polypropylene). * Experience supporting vertical integration, M\&A, or new\-site projects. * Background in procurement or operations consulting. * ERP experience (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle). **Our Benefits \& Perks:** * Unlimited 3D printing with any Formlabs material on any Formlabs printer * An equity program that will let you build wealth through RSUs * Healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision) that includes a totally free employee\-only plan, effective starting on your first day on the job * 401K matching with no vesting or tenure requirement * Generous parental leave (fully paid up to 16 weeks) * Flexible time off so you can take time when you need it * Six\-week fully paid sabbatical after hitting tenure milestones (with the option to take an additional six weeks after that) * Free on\-site parking \& pre\-tax commuter benefits * Free on\-site lunch, snacks, beverages, treats, beer kegs, and employee\-favorite local coffee and espresso * Self\-driven professional development opportunities like conferences, trade shows, and hackathons * One\-of\-a\-kind activities and events like monthly socials, the annual weekend summer camp, a can't\-miss company hackathon, and lots of other social opportunities **You don't need to check every box to apply for a role. If you love working with hardware, spending time with smart people, solving hard problems, and winning, we want to hear from you.** *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available **here**. Please give them a read.

jobs.title: Power Systems AI/ML Software Engineer
jobs.description: GE Vernova is an energy company that helps electrify and decarbonize the world. Retirement benefits include the GE Vernova Retirement Savings Plan, a tax\-advantaged 401(k) savings opportunity with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and financial planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability benefits, life insurance, 12 paid holidays, and permissive time off. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer | Robotics
jobs.description: **What We Do** ============== Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall\-climbing robots, industry\-leading sensors, and an AI\-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real\-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure. **Role at a Glance** ==================== We’re looking for a **Full Stack Software Engineer, Robotics** to own and improve the software that supports robotic inspections, from the application operators use on their laptops to software deployed on the robot. This full\-stack role spans user interfaces, Python services, and hardware integration, with most software running locally on field laptops and robot computers. You will work closely with field operators to improve robot controls, inspection monitoring, and visibility into data quality. The application allows operators to monitor live camera feeds and view ultrasonic thickness measurements mapped onto 2D or 3D models of the asset as the robot scans it. Projects may include extending support to new asset types, integrating sensors and cameras, and improving calibration and diagnostics. This role is based in our Pittsburgh office, with potential for occasional field visits. **What you will do** ==================== * **Partner with field operators.** Understand inspection workflows, gather feedback, and translate operational needs into software improvements. * **Develop across the software stack.** Build and maintain the operator application and software deployed to the robot, integrating user interfaces, backend services, and hardware. * **Expand inspection capabilities.** Extend support to additional asset types, such as tank roofs and horizontal tanks, and integrate new sensors and cameras, including LiDAR. * **Improve operator controls and visibility.** Develop robot controls, live camera feeds, 2D and 3D data views, calibration workflows, and inspection monitoring and review tools. * **Integrate and troubleshoot connected systems.** Coordinate robot motion, localization, cameras, sensor data acquisition and processing, calibration, and inspection management. Diagnose issues across hardware communication, services, and the operator interface. * **Deliver reliable field software.** Test and release software for field laptops and robot computers. Improve logging, recording, and diagnostics, and support recovery from dropped connections, disconnected sensors, and interrupted inspections. **Technologies We Use** ======================= * Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript * Svelte and FastAPI * Message\-based services, real\-time data streaming, and 3D visualization in the browser * ROS, ZMQ, and Docker * Linux, macOS, and Windows, including embedded Linux computers on robots **About You** ============= **Required Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 2\+ years developing user\-facing desktop applications. * 2\+ years working on distributed systems for real\-time data processing. * Experience building and maintaining production applications or services in Python that communicate with hardware and process sensor data. * Experience developing user\-facing applications with a modern JavaScript frontend framework, such as Svelte or React. * Clear written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and collaborate across software, hardware, and field operations teams. **Preferred Skills** * Robotics software development experience, including software that interacts with embedded Linux computers, hardware, or sensors. * Experience with real\-time or streaming data, where information arrives continuously and timing matters. **Who We Are** ============== At Gecko, our people are our greatest investment. In addition to competitive compensation packages, we offer company equity, 401(k) matching, gender\-neutral parental leave, full medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health, ongoing professional development, family planning assistance, and flexible paid time off. Gecko values collaboration, innovation, and partnership, and we believe we do our best work when we're together in person. We’re an office\-first culture but understand that sometimes you may need to work from home. Many people are in the office five days a week, others need a bit more flexibility. Ultimately, we care about the outcomes we achieve \- and creating a culture of autonomy and trust that enables that impact. Gecko is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission to protect today’s infrastructure and give form to tomorrow’s. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our critical mission, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AV Data & Analysis Tools
jobs.description: **Job Description** General Motors is a global leader in advanced driver assistance. With Super Cruise hands\-free technology in more than 500,000 Super Cruise–equipped vehicles on the road and over 700 million hands\-free miles driven, GM is proving that automation can be trusted, intuitive, and helpful. GM has the global reach to bring cutting\-edge advances to everyday drivers at unprecedented scale. Join us to help deliver the next generation of safe and delightful personal autonomous vehicle experiences. **About the Team** Every autonomous\-driving engineer at GM eventually asks the same questions: *What happened on that drive? Where else has this happened? Why did the vehicle do that? Did my change fix it?* The AV Analysis team builds the tools that answer them, across the full life of AV data: * Record and catalog new data as it comes in from the fleet, so engineers know what exists, where it came from, and whether it's ready to use. * Index and mine road data alongside simulation output, so engineers can find the scenes that matter using structured filters, similarity search, and natural\-language queries. Analyze what happened by replaying sensor data, perception output, and planner decisions in synchronized 3D, camera, plot, and map views. Engineers do this to triage and diagnose an issue, or to validate a new change. * Perception, planning, simulation, mapping, validation, and data teams use these tools every day. That work spans next\-generation autonomous development vehicles, Super Cruise programs, and autonomous mobile robots in GM factories. We're part of AV Tooling, which also builds GM's fleet\-operations tools and AI\-assisted triage. We share one goal: shorten the loop from collecting data, to understanding it, to fixing the vehicle. **About the Role** Our senior engineers don't wait for a spec. Demand for our tools outpaces any roadmap, so the most valuable thing you'll do is decide what to build. That means finding the problem that's quietly costing engineers hours every week, designing the tool that removes it, and shipping it. You'll own a major part of the data lifecycle end to end, such as how engineers search and mine data, or how they analyze and debug it. You'll also help connect cataloging, search, and analysis into one workflow. **What You'll Do** * Find the highest\-leverage gaps in how engineers find, analyze, and debug AV data. Work alongside users, read support channels and bug reports, and notice where teams are building their own workarounds. Then turn those gaps into tools people adopt. * Record and catalog new AV data as it arrives, with the context engineers need to trust and use it: vehicle, software version, location, and ingestion status. * Index and mine road data alongside simulation output. Build search that combines structured metadata queries in SQL with embedding\-based similarity search in vector databases, plus natural\-language queries and LLM\- and VLM\-powered curation. * Build high\-performance tools for analyzing what happened, with synchronized replay of camera video, lidar, 3D scenes, plots, and maps. Engineers use them to triage and diagnose issues, to validate new software changes, and to debug live in the vehicle during testing. * Take ambiguous requests from idea to shipped. Write requirements and design docs that weigh options, build consensus with stakeholders, and deliver iteratively so users are unblocked early. * Serve as technical lead for a multi\-project workstream. Plan and break down the work, delegate, hold a high bar in design and code reviews, and guide engineers across GM who contribute to our tools. * Keep tools fast and reliable in production, and raise the bar for the team's engineering systems: tests, CI speed, developer experience, observability, and on\-call. Mentor engineers, and use AI\-assisted development and agentic workflows to multiply what a small team can deliver. * **Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications)** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3\+ years building complex, data\-intensive web applications with TypeScript/JavaScript and React. * A track record of spotting an unmet user need yourself, building the tool or feature that addressed it, and driving it to real adoption. * Hands\-on experience building on both SQL and vector databases, including data modeling, indexing, and query performance (e.g., PostgreSQL or BigQuery, and Vespa, Milvus, pgvector, or OpenSearch). * Comfort working across the stack, designing APIs and building services in Node.js or Python. * Deep experience diagnosing and fixing web application performance problems (rendering, memory, large\-data and streaming throughput) through profiling and measurement. * Demonstrated technical leadership: leading multi\-person projects, writing design docs, and driving decisions across teams. * Clear written and verbal communication with technical users whose needs differ widely, from perception researchers t cataloging at scale: metadata, provenance, and lineage for large sensor datasets; workflow engines such as Temporal; Kubernetes and Google Cloud. Our goal is to increase our direct payer integrations 100x over the next 12 months. You almost never drop balls. * **You have a systems mindset.** You go beyond helping with the task at hand. You are able to intuitively understand gaps as you work through implementations and are able to articulate those to both the network operations and engineering team. * **You are a creative problem solver** and you don’t stop at solving the problem once.
