jobs.description: **Posting Details** ------------------- I. DEPARTMENT INFORMATION **Job Description Summary:** The Biostatistics Center (BSC) of the Milken Institute School of Public Health is an off\-campus research facility of The George Washington University located in Rockville, Maryland. The BSC serves as the coordinating center for large scale multi\-center clinical trials and epidemiological studies funded by federal agencies including the National Institutes of Health. The BSC is a leader in the statistical coordination of major medical research programs of national and international scope. Visit our website at: **www.bsc.gwu.edu**. We are seeking a **Research Scientist** specializing in **Machine Learning, Data Science, Data Harmonization, and Synthetic Data Generation** to lead the integration, standardization, and privacy\-preserving algorithmic modeling of complex, multi\-site datasets. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex data infrastructure, cutting\-edge machine learning, and synthetic data generation—building automated transformation pipelines, harmonizing disparate clinical/observational data structures (e.g., OMOP CDM, FHIR), and generating high\-fidelity synthetic datasets to accelerate secure collaborative research without compromising data privacy. **Experience with high\-dimensional multi\-omics data analysis and integration is highly desirable.** **Key Responsibilities:** **Synthetic Data Generation \& Privacy Engineering** * **Generative Modeling:** Design, train, and validate generative machine learning models (GANs, VAEs, diffusion models, and LLM\-based tabular synthesizers) to generate high\-fidelity synthetic tabular, longitudinal, and multi\-omic datasets. * **Privacy Assurance \& Risk Assessment:** Implement rigorous privacy\-preserving methodologies (differential privacy, membership inference attack testing, re\-identification risk metrics) to guarantee synthetic datasets meet strict governance and compliance standards. * **Utility \& Fidelity Evaluation:** Establish automated benchmark suites comparing distributional fidelity, feature correlations, cross\-sectional/longitudinal validity, and downstream task performance between real and synthetic cohorts. **Data Harmonization \& Infrastructure** * **ETL** **\& Data Standardization:** Design, execute, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to map complex, longitudinal datasets from multi\-center registries and disparate source systems into common data models (e.g., OMOP CDM, PCORnet). * **Ontology Mapping \& Quality Control:** Implement vocabulary mappings (SNOMED, RxNorm, LOINC, ICD\-10\) and robust data quality frameworks to handle missingness, inconsistent formatting, and cross\-site measurement variation across clinical and molecular datasets. * **Registry \& Pipeline Integration:** Architect automated validation workflows ensuring privacy preservation, site blinding, and reproducible data harmonization across large\-scale cohort studies. **Machine Learning, Omics \& Statistical Modeling** * **Multi\-Omics Data Integration:** Analyze, harmonize, and model high\-dimensional biological data layers (e.g., genomics, transcriptomics, metabolomics, proteomics) alongside EHR and clinical registry data. * **Algorithmic Modeling:** Develop, evaluate, and deploy advanced machine learning models (gradient boosted trees, neural architectures, ensemble learning) and semi\-parametric causal inference techniques on high\-dimensional harmonized and synthetic data. * **Longitudinal \& Trajectory Analysis:** Build statistical and ML frameworks for analyzing longitudinal trajectories, biological aging markers, and time\-varying exposures. * **Model Explainability \& Transportability:** Conduct rigorous cross\-validation, sensitivity analyses, and transportability evaluations to ensure model fairness, robustness, and biological/clinical validity when trained on real vs. synthetic inputs. **Collaborative Research \& Leadership** * **Interdisciplinary Collaboration:** Work closely with biostatisticians, bioinformaticians, privacy officers, software engineers, and domain experts to translate scientific hypotheses into secure, end\-to\-end data products. * **Methodological Dissemination:** Lead the drafting of peer\-reviewed scientific publications, technical whitepapers, and method documentation regarding privacy metrics, synthetic data utility, and multi\-omic modeling. * **Pipeline Open\-Sourcing \& Mentorship:** Contribute to reproducible codebases (R, Python, SQL) and mentor junior data engineers and graduate research assistants. Performs other work duties as assigned. The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning tasks logically related to the position. **Minimum Qualifications:** Qualified candidates will hold a Master’s degree plus 5 years of experience or a PhD and 2 years of experience in a related discipline to include at least 2 years of research and/or college level teaching in a field basic to the ate of the position. **Additional Required Licenses/Certifications/Posting Specific Minimum Qualifications:** **Preferred Qualifications:** * **Synthetic Data \& Generative AI Expertise:** Demonstrated experience with tabular synthetic data frameworks (e.g., CTGAN, TVAE, Synthcity, differentially private generative models) and privacy measurement frameworks (membership inference, attribute disclosure risk). * **Programming \& Tooling:** + **Languages:** Advanced proficiency in **Python** (PyTorch/TensorFlow, Pandas, Scikit\-Learn, Synthcity/Diffprivlib) and/or **R** (synthpop, Bioconductor, caret, SuperLearner, targetML) is highly preferred. + **Databases \& Data Engineering:** Strong SQL mastery; experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Snowflake) and distributed processing tools (Spark, dbt) is highly desired. * **Data Harmonization Expertise:** Hands\-on experience working with standardized healthcare/biobank data models (e.g., **OMOP** **Common Data Model**) and clinical terminology standards. * **Machine Learning \& Statistics:** Deep expertise in supervised/unsupervised learning, ensemble methods, survival analysis, and causal inference techniques is desired. * Multi\-Omics Expertise: Strongly Desirable: Hands\-on experience processing, harmonizing, and analyzing high\-throughput omics datasets (e.g., genomic variants, RNA\-seq, untargeted metabolomics, panel proteomics) using standard bioinformatics pipelines (e.g., Bioconductor, PLINK, Nextflow/Snakemake) and integrating them with clinical EHR/registry frameworks. * Experience evaluating the “train on synthetic, test on real” (TSTR) paradigm across diverse biomedical, multi\-omic, or observational datasets. * Experience working with federal funding frameworks (NIH, NSF, PCORI) or multi\-center research coordinating centers (BRCCs). * Familiarity with privacy\-preserving technologies (federated learning, differential privacy, secure enclave research environments). * Knowledge of containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes) and version\-controlled workflow tools (Git). * Potential to lead first\-author publications in peer\-reviewed journals or top\-tier machine learning/data science/bioinformatics conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, KDD, JAMIA, Biometrics, Bioinformatics). **Hiring Range** $70,429\.80 \- $135,080\.76 **GW Staff Approach to Pay** How is pay for new employees determined at GW? jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Testing
jobs.description: **About Glasslake** Glasslake is building the operating system for SAP delivery — the infrastructure layer underneath the most complex and expensive IT projects companies run. SAP implementations move billions of dollars and thousands of consultants, but the knowledge generated in these projects is never captured: it lives in people’s heads, disappears when the project ends, and gets rebuilt from scratch on every new engagement. Glasslake solves this with an agentic orchestration platform that coordinates every phase of SAP transformation, capturing decisions, tests, and context as a byproduct of work already underway — building an organizational memory that accumulates across projects instead of resetting. We’re a team based in San Francisco and São Paulo, moving fast and already deployed with some of the largest SAP integrators in the world, including Delaware Consulting, KPMG, and NTT Data. The team comes from Stanford, Meta, Two Sigma, Microsoft, and NASA. **The Opportunity** You’ll own some of the hardest problems in applied AI: making agents reliable, fast, and trustworthy on enterprise systems where being wrong is expensive. Testing is one of the most critical and labor\-intensive parts of any SAP transformation. Our AI agents plan, execute, and validate tests of business processes inside real customer SAP landscapes, work that has traditionally taken teams of consultants weeks to do by hand. Making agents perform at that level is an open frontier. You’ll take on problems with no off\-the\-shelf answers, explore them, define what success looks like, and carry the solution all the way to production with real customers. **What You’ll Do** **Explore and define the problem** * **Frame the problem.** Turn observed agent behaviors into a clear problem statement, backed by evidence and your own experiments. * **Define success.** Set the metrics, benchmarks, and evals that measure agent performance. **Build and own the solution** * **Ship end to end.** Design and ship agent and LLM features, from prompts and orchestration to the infrastructure behind them. * **Own the results.** Watch how your work performs in production and keep improving it. **Work with experts and raise the bar** * **Validate with experts.** Work with SAP domain experts and present findings and decisions clearly. * **Raise the bar.** Review code and designs, and help shape the team’s AI engineering practices. **What We’re Looking For** * **6\+ years of engineering experience**, including building AI agents or LLM features from scratch and shipping them to production with full ownership. * **A research\-like approach.** You set hypotheses, run experiments, and verify results before you build. * **Evaluation rigor.** Experience measuring agent performance through evals, benchmarks, or regression suites, and acting on what they show. * **Strong Python and SQL**, with hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and agent frameworks. * **Infrastructure ownership.** Comfortable running the workflow orchestration and cloud services behind your features. * **Production investigation.** You query databases and read logs and traces to find out what actually happened. * **Self\-direction and clear communication**, including with domain experts who aren’t engineers. * **AI native.** You use AI tooling daily as a force multiplier. **Nice to have** * **Experience with computer\-use or browser\-automation agents.** * **Software testing background**, such as test automation or QA for complex systems, or familiarity with SAP testing. * **Familiarity with enterprise software ecosystems** (SAP, ERP, CRM). * **Ability to work in TypeScript** when a feature needs it. * **Early\-stage startup experience** where you owned a problem with no playbook. * **Experience mentoring engineers** or acting as a technical reference on a team. **Why Join Glasslake Now** * Own open\-ended agent problems end to end, from the first exploration to results in production. * Time to explore a problem and test ideas before committing to a solution. * Your agents run inside multi\-million dollar transformations at the largest SAP integrators in the world, in a category being defined right now. * Direct access to the founding team, customers, and SAP domain experts.

jobs.title: Prototype Assembly Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** Our catalog model depends on moving many new designs quickly and reliably from tape\-out to first samples. The Prototype Assembly Engineer owns that handoff. You are the technical bridge between our RF IC designers and our outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) partners. You turn design ideas into machine\-assembled products, drive prototype builds to schedule, and close the feedback loop to the factory for continuous improvement. **Roles \& Responsibilities:** **Design Team Interface** · Engage with RF IC designers early in each program to select package type(s) that meet RF, thermal, and cost targets. · Own bonding diagrams, package outline selection, and assembly drawings for each new prototype. · Translate lessons from each build back into design rules and packaging guidelines for the design team. **OSAT Interface** · Serve as the primary technical contact with OSAT partners for all assemblies. · Prepare and release complete build packages: bonding diagrams, BOMs, wafer maps, marking, tape\-and\-reel requirements, and special instructions. · Review and approve OSAT engineering deliverables, including substrate and lead frame drawings. · Lead technical calls to resolve assembly issues and drive yield improvement. **Prototype Build Management** · Plan and track prototype builds from wafer ship to sample delivery, holding OSATs and internal teams to committed dates. · Run multiple concurrent prototype programs across QFN, DFN, Air\-cavity, WLCSP, flip\-chip, and laminate module packages. **Package Development \& Continuous Improvement** · Evaluate new package platforms, materials, and processes to extend our catalog, including laminate SiP and multi\-die modules. · Drive 8D corrective actions with OSATs when assembly defects occur. **Transfer to Production \& Qualification** · Support package and reliability qualification (MSL, HAST/THB, temperature cycling, HTOL) in partnership with quality engineering. · Transition validated prototype assemblies into robust, production\-ready products for high\-volume manufacturing. · Maintain accurate records in document control for every assembly configuration. · Support technical issues as needed after release to production. **Minimum Educational Qualifications:** · BS in Electrical, Mechanical, Materials, or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field. **Preferred Previous Experience:** · 3\+ years of semiconductor packaging or assembly engineering experience · Experience working with OSATs on new product builds is desired, including preparation of OSAT assembly request forms. · Hands\-on knowledge of wire bond, die attach, molding, singulation, and tape\-and\-reel processes. · Familiarity with JEDEC package and reliability standards. · Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain trade\-offs clearly to designers, OSATs, and management. **Key Competencies:** · **Bridge builder:** earns the trust of both designers and OSAT engineers and gets them to agreement quickly. · **Schedule owner:** treats prototype dates as commitments and escalates early when they are at risk. · **Hands\-on problem solver:** comfortable at the microscope, in the lab, or on the factory floor. · **Speed with discipline:** moves many designs in parallel without cutting corners on documentation or quality. · **Clear communicator:** writes build instructions and reports that leave no room for misinterpretation. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior JavaScript Front-End Developer - Angular and React.js
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- We are building a browser\-based 3D virtual science lab. Students assemble apparatus, perform experiments, and are assessed on their technique — all rendered in real time with React 19, React Three Fiber (Three.js), and Zustand, built with Vite. The simulation runs on ordinary school hardware, including low\-end Chromebooks, so it has to be both convincing and fast, and its behavior has to be deterministic enough to score reliably **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Build and own complex React Three Fiber features: interactive 3D equipment, a selection\-driven action system, real\-time visual effects, and the UI around them. * Keep the app fast on low\-end hardware — profile and tune the render loop, manage GPU/CPU cost, and hold a frame budget on Chromebook\-class devices. * Keep application state coherent as it grows (simulation state, equipment state, an event log used for assessment, and UI state) using Zustand. * Make accessibility real: full keyboard operation, focus management, ARIA, and screen\-reader support are core requirements here, not polish. * Direct Claude Code effectively — decompose work into well\-specified, agent\-sized tasks, review the output with a senior eye, and know when to write something by hand instead. * Help maintain the conventions, CLAUDE.md guidance, and repo structure that keep AI\-generated code consistent and safe. * Collaborate with our 3D technical artist to integrate assets and shaders cleanly. **Skill Requirements** ---------------------- * Deep, senior\-level React (React 19 / modern React): the render model, hooks discipline, memoization, effect timing, and a real feel for where re\-renders and stale closures come from — which matter acutely in an app running a physics loop every frame. * Three.js and React Three Fiber in production. Real command of the scene graph, geometry and materials, the useFrame render loop, and disposal / memory management (WebGL leaks are a real hazard). This is the heart of the role and the skill we weight most heavily — React experience without R3F is not a substitute. * Real\-time performance discipline. You think in frame budgets, know what drives GPU vs CPU cost, can profile a render loop, and habitually design for the weakest target device. * State management at scale with Zustand (or clearly transferable experience), keeping a growing state model coherent rather than tangled. * Accessibility as a first\-class skill — keyboard navigation, focus management, ARIA, WCAG AA, screen\-reader testing. For an education product this is a core requirement and a procurement gate, not an afterthought **Must Have Skill** ------------------- Angular,React.js,JavaScript **Good to Have Skill** ---------------------- **Other Requirements** ----------------------

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Enginner, AI Platform
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote; New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- All Cost CentersResearch \& DevelopmentEngineering \& TechnologyEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $182,750 – $278,500 • Offers Equity We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential. 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2\.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. **About Eddy at Headway:** Eddy is Headway's in\-house AI agent platform and the highest\-leverage internal product we've shipped. It gives every Headwegian an agent harness pointed at Headway's own systems: an isolated sandbox per conversation, tool access to the third parties we depend on, and the ability to turn any of it into something durable, like a shareable interactive app, a workflow, a scheduled agent, a Slack teammate, or a webhook\-triggered automation. Today 850\+ Headwegians use Eddy daily, and 40k\+ scheduled agents and workflows run every week with no one in the loop. We sit in Engineering Foundations and own all of it: the chat product, the agent loop, the sandboxed runtime, the tool and integration layer, the artifact and app platform, the workflow engine, the eval harness, and the safety and access\-control model that lets this touch real production and healthcare data without causing incidents. We're a small team with a very large surface area. **About this role:** Self\-serve gets a function most of the way. It doesn't get them all the way. Legal still reads every provider contract and payer amendment by hand, because what would help isn't a chat window. It's a system that knows what a redline means here, what gets escalated, and what our position was the last four times. Credentialing, claims exceptions, and CX triage each have their own version: work that is obviously automatable but full of enough domain\-specific detail that nobody outside the function can build it, and nobody inside can build it alone. That's this role. You'll embed with one function at a time and build them a real product on top of Eddy. Then you'll do the harder half: work out which parts are specific to that function and which are primitives that belong in the platform, and land the primitives in Eddy so the next function gets them for free. Most quarters should end with a function measurably better off and a new capability in the platform. **What you'll do:** * Find the real bottleneck. Sit with a function long enough to see the work, and define success in their terms: turnaround time, escalation volume, error rate, headcount avoided. * Build the vertical. Skills, MCP integrations against their systems of record, subagents, scheduled and event\-driven agents, artifact apps, and whatever product surface the workflow needs. You own it end to end. * Ship in days, harden over weeks. Get a rough v1 in front of real users fast, then do the unglamorous work of making it dependable. * Own it in production. Evals, tracing, cost and latency, failure modes. If a function depends on it, you're on the hook for it. * Extract the primitives. Land the generalizable half in Eddy as a first\-class capability, with tests and docs. * Kill work that shouldn't exist. Some requests are better answered by a workaround, a config change, a process change, or nothing. Finding those is worth as much as building. * Design for PHI from the start. Eddy operates inside HIPAA. This is not solutions or sales engineering. There's no deal cycle, and your users are colleagues. It's not a pure platform role either: you'll spend real time inside other teams' problems. **Tools we use:** Languages: Python 3, TypeScript Frontend: React 19, React Router 7, Tailwind, Radix, TanStack Query Backend \& Storage: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2\.0 (async), Alembic, Postgres, Redis, DynamoDB, Snowflake AI: Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic API, Bedrock, LangSmith Infrastructure: AWS, EKS (a hardened pod per session), EC2 \+ CodeDeploy blue/green, Temporal, Kafka, Cloudflare Ops: Datadog, Sentry, PagerDuty, GitHub Actions AI tools: Cursor, Claude Code, and Eddy itself. We build Eddy with Eddy. **Who you are:** * An end\-to\-end product builder who moves between a React surface, a FastAPI service, and a container image without a handoff. * Serious about AI as engineering: tool use, agent loops, evals, context management, and cost and latency at volume. * Someone who likes users you can see. You've gravitated toward internal platform or developer tooling work, or taught something and enjoyed it. * Able to hold a scope conversation: push back, renegotiate, say no, and leave people wanting to work with you again. * A platform thinker who starts specific, and has the judgment to tell which half of a build is which. * Comfortable owning outcomes with no spec and no backlog. * Guardrails by instinct, and precise in communication with people who don't write code. **Experience we're seeking:** * 5\+ years shipping production software end to end. * Has built and shipped LLM/agent\-powered products to real users. * Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer, internal platform engineer, or founder is a plus, as is work on agent frameworks or developer platforms. Healthcare experience is not required, but you should be able to dive into an exception\-heavy domain and build a working mental model fast, several times a year. **You'll love this role if you want to:** * See a real business problem through to a shipped product your colleagues depend on. * Shape an AI platform from the outside in. * Have the most cross\-functional engineering role at Headway. **Comprehensive benefits:** --------------------------- Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave. We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview. Headway participates in E\-Verify. A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com email address. jobs.title: AI-First Software Developer - Softeon
jobs.description: **Company Description** IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 6,000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters, at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge. IFS Softeon builds warehouse management and supply chain execution software (WMS, WES, distributed order management and the Elastic UI platform) for some of the most demanding fulfillment operations in the world. At IFS, we are flexible, we are innovative, and we are focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive workforce that represents the many cultures, backgrounds and viewpoints of our customers, partners and communities. We are looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can \#MakeYourMoment, so that we can help others make theirs. Join Team Purple. Join IFS. **Job Description** Ship more of what customers need, faster, and prove every change works. Our applications run the warehouses that get orders out the door on time. We are changing how that software gets built: AI agents and AI\-assisted CI/CD help us deliver more functionality to our customers, faster, with higher quality. We are looking for an AI\-first developer: someone who treats AI agents as a team to direct, not a fancy autocomplete. You will pair deep Java engineering with hands\-on experience building through agents to deliver great new functionality across our applications, and you will help set the standard for how the rest of engineering works this way. You know that speed only counts if it comes with proof, so automated testing, validation and agent\-assisted review are part of how you ship every change. **What you will do** * Deliver great product functionality. Design and build new features and enhancements across our Java applications (receiving, inventory, picking, replenishment, shipping, integrations and user experience) that customers value and rely on. * Build with agents every day. Use Claude Code and similar coding agents to plan, implement, refactor and test features. Break work into clear specs, give agents strong context, and know when to delegate and when to step in. * Author and maintain agent skills. Write and refine skills, prompts, tool definitions and MCP servers that encode Softeon's domain knowledge, such as Elastic UI form and flow authoring, WMS configuration and integration patterns. * Own a fully automated delivery pipeline. Build and run CI/CD where every change passes automated builds, unit and integration tests, static analysis, security scanning and AI agent code review before a human approves it. * Make quality provable. Build and extend automated validation (unit, API and Playwright end\-to\-end tests) so that AI\-generated code, configuration and integrations are verified automatically, with evidence. * Operate what you ship. Build the telemetry, logging and monitoring your features need, and treat performance and reliability as product requirements rather than a late pass. * Modernize with confidence. Use agents to understand, refactor and modernize existing code, add missing test coverage, and pay down technical debt without slowing feature delivery. * Measure velocity and quality. Track cycle time, defect rates and escaped bugs, and use the data to keep improving how agents and pipelines are used. * Work with product and customers. Turn real warehouse and supply chain needs into well\-specified, testable software, and talk with product managers, customers and Ops teams in their language. * Raise the bar for the team. Share patterns, review others' agent workflows, measure what works, and help colleagues become effective AI\-first developers. **Why it is interesting** * Agents can write code faster than any team can review it. The hard part is no longer typing; it is deciding what to build, giving agents the right context, and proving that what comes back is correct in a domain where a plausible answer can still stop a warehouse. That means designing the specs, skills, tests and pipeline gates that let a small team ship enterprise software at a pace that used to need a much larger one, and there is no settled playbook to copy. * You will do this on mature, mission\-critical applications with real customers, real data and real operational stakes, which is a harder and more rewarding problem than a greenfield demo. **Frameworks and tools you will work with:** **Languages \& core** * Java 17\+, Spring / Spring Boot, REST and messaging APIs, SQL and relational databases **Front end** * TypeScript, Angular, and Elastic UI, our met  skills: clear written specs, structured prompts and the judgment to evaluate and correct agent output. * Comfortable across the boundary: you can write the front\-end, service and database code a feature needs end to end. * Solid fundamentals in relational databases and SQL, system design, and secure coding practices. * Permanent resident of the United States, legally authorized to work in the US without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. **Also valuable** * A platform where behavior is configured through data or metadata rather than written in code, such as low\-code, rules engines or schema\-driven UI. * Modern TypeScript and Angular (or React), including component architecture and design\-system work. * Direct experience with warehouse management (WMS), warehouse execution (WES), transportation management (TMS) or MRP/ERP platforms, as a developer, implementer or operator. * Experience with warehouse automation: conveyors, sortation, pick\-to\-light, AMRs, goods\-to\-person systems or their control software. * Mobile or progressive web applications, including RF/handheld devices, offline behavior and poor connectivity. * Experience building MCP servers, custom agent tooling or AI\-powered developer workflows. * Familiarity with XSLT and Groovy, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP). * Based in the US Eastern or Central time zone. **How we work** * AI\-first by default. Agents are part of the team; you are responsible for their output. * No change ships without proof. Automated tests, agent review and validation evidence on every pull request. * Close to customers. We learn from warehouse floors and Ops leaders, not just tickets. * Small, senior and fast. High ownership, low ceremony, measurable results. **What success looks like** * First 30 days: you ship production changes through the full agent\-assisted pipeline and know our Java platform and WMS domain. * First 90 days: you own a feature area end to end, have contributed new agent skills or pipeline checks, and have measurably sped up delivery without lowering quality. * First year: you have delivered significant product functionality and are a go\-to person for AI\-first engineering practices across Softeon engineering. **Location and eligibility** This is a remote, US\-based role. Candidates must be permanent residents of the United States. We prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones to support collaboration with our teams and customers. Occasional travel to customer sites or company offices may be required. **Additional Information** **What We’re Offering** * Salary Range: $114,000 to $152,500 annually \+ bonus * Flexible paid time off, including sick and holiday * Medical, dental, \& vision insurance * 401K with Company contribution * Flexible spending accounts * Life insurance and disability benefits * Tuition assistance * Community involvement and volunteering events M/F/Disabled/Vet VEVRAA Federal Contractor. We are a Drug\-Free Workplace. Interested candidates should apply at: www.ifs.com/about/careers\-at\-ifs All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. VEVRAA Federal Contractor, Equal Opportunity Employer *We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.* All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. VEVRAA Federal Contractor, Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Experienced Technology New York **Machine Learning Engineers** at IMC play a pivotal role in building the systems that drive training and deployment of large\-scale ML models across IMC's global operations. They collaborate with quantitative researchers, hardware specialists and software engineers to build robust systems that get the most out of GPU acceleration, distributed computing and the broader open\-source ML ecosystem. ML Engineers' work directly shapes how fast we can experiment, iterate and deploy — accelerating the cycle that turns a research idea into a live trading strategy. This is a unique opportunity to solve problems at the intersection of advanced machine learning and trading, where your contributions will shape the future of IMC's technology and trading capabilities. As a team, our Machine Learning Engineers broadly work across two areas: **ML Research Engineering**, focused on the systems and frameworks researchers use to train, evaluate and iterate on models at scale; and **ML Performance Engineering**, focused on making ML workloads execute as efficiently as possible, typically through GPU and low\-level systems optimization. These aren't rigid tracks, and there is overlap between them. You will bring depth of expertise in at least one of these focus areas and collaborate closely with global team members. **Your Core Responsibilities** *The responsibilities below are representative of the role — the exact mix depends on your team, area of expertise and location.* **ML Research Engineering** * Develop large\-scale distributed training pipelines that manage complex datasets and models. * Partner with quantitative researchers to automate ML experiments, hyperparameter tuning and model retraining. * Work with HPC specialists to optimise workflows, improve training speed and reduce compute cost. **ML Performance Engineering** * Build and optimise low\-latency inference pipelines, ensuring models deliver real\-time predictions in production systems. * Maximise performance in training and inference using GPU hardware and acceleration libraries. **Across both areas** * Extend and improve the internals of machine learning frameworks and open\-source tools to raise their performance for our workloads. * Design scalable model infrastructure capable of handling high\-volume trading data and delivering real\-time, high\-accuracy predictions. * Evaluate and roll out third\-party tools that enhance model development, training and inference capabilities. **Your Skills and Experience** **Core, regardless of focus area:** * 3\+ years of experience in machine learning, with a focus on training or inference systems. * **Production software engineering —** Python, testing discipline and genuine ownership of systems once they ship. * **Machine learning fundamentals —** you understand modern ML workloads beyond high\-level APIs and can reason about model behaviour, correctness and performance at the level relevant to your area of expertise. * **A systems mindset —** you reach for measurement before opinion on performance, scale or reliability issues, and can make sound build\-versus\-buy decisions. * **Strong collaboration —** comfortable explaining the reasoning behind your technical decisions, working through differing perspectives with researchers and adapting your approach when the evidence supports it. **Depth in one or more of the following:** * **Distributed training and large\-scale systems —** parallelism strategy, data pipelines and checkpointing; frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX. * **GPU performance and low\-level optimisation —** reasoning about memory, compute and latency at the device level, and optimising performance across kernels, compilers and hardware (e.g. CUDA, Triton or equivalent). * **Production inference systems —** hands\-on experience building and hardening real\-time, low\-latency prediction pipelines in high\-performance environments. * **Numerics and correctness at scale —** low\-precision effects, KV caching, batching, and knowing which optimisations stay bit\-exact. *Technologies listed above are examples rather than requirements; equivalent depth developed using other stacks or hardware platforms is equally relevant.* **Also a plus:** * Exposure to cloud platforms and orchestration tools. * A track record of contributing to open\-source projects in machine learning, data science or distributed systems. **Not sure this is the one?** If your strength is mainly in modelling and research direction, our Deep Learning Researcher roles are likely a closer fit. If your strength is in general infrastructure rather than ML\-specific systems, take a look at our broader infrastructure engineering roles. \#LI\-DNP **About Us** *IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.* We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist our recruiting team review applications (for example, to help match applications against job criteria and organize large volumes of submissions). All hiring decisions are made by people, not AI. We continuously monitor our AI tools to ensure they are used responsibly, with appropriate human oversight. Your personal data will be handled in line with applicable privacy and data protection laws. For more information, please see the IMC Privacy Statement. Where legally required, you may have the right to request human review of any AI\-assisted decision, to object to the use of AI in your application, or to obtain further information about how your data is processed. To exercise these rights, please contact us at uscvreview@imc.com. We use Tofu AI Resume Review as part of our hiring process for jobs in certain locations. The Tofu tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: AI Assurance Dashboard \- Tofu. The Base Salary range for the role is included below. Base salary is only one component of total compensation; all full\-time, permanent positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits, including paid leave and insurance. Please visit Benefits \- US \| IMC Trading for more comprehensive information. ##### **Salary Range** $175,000 \- $250,000 USD Get Notified about the latest career opportunitiesSign up to receive weekly updates on vacancies at IMC.

jobs.description: **Position:** Full Stack Engineer **Reports to: Sr. Director of Engineering** **Location:** Frisco, TX Informativ LLC offers credit report and compliance solutions to the automotive and general consumer finance industries across the United States. The Company optimizes and automates the consumer finance qualification process through a fast, easy\-to\-use, and secure software platform made available to its extensive network of software affiliate partners. Informativ’s products and solutions place a heavy emphasis on compliance and identity verification to support the credit application and credit report process. Please visit www.informativ.com for additional information. **Position Description:** As a Full Stack Engineer at Informativ, LLC you will build and maintain the web applications and services that power our credit report and compliance platform. You will work across the full stack, from responsive, user\-friendly front\-end interfaces to the APIs, cloud services, and databases behind them. You will partner closely with product managers, QA, and fellow engineers to deliver secure, reliable features that meet customer needs and drive business growth. **Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and maintain responsive web applications and the back\-end services and APIs that support them. * Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate requirements into well\-scoped technical solutions. * Write clean, well\-documented, and testable code across the front end and back end. * Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and cloud\-based services in Microsoft Azure. * Participate in code reviews, providing and receiving constructive feedback to raise code quality. * Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve issues across the application stack, including in production. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and monitoring to support reliable releases. * Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies and apply them to our projects when relevant. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software development experience across both front\-end and back\-end systems. * Proficiency in C\# and .NET Core / Web API. * Strong experience with React, Angular, or Blazor, and with TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3\. * Experience developing Single\-Page Applications (SPAs) with responsive user interfaces. * Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, or MariaDB). * Experience with Azure services such as Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Cosmos DB, and Application Insights. * Solid understanding of object\-oriented programming, SOLID principles, and async/await. * Experience writing unit and integration tests; familiarity with Test\-Driven Development (TDD). * Experience with DevOps CI/CD pipelines and source control using GitHub. * Understanding of web security concepts, including OAuth, OpenID, SSO, and JWT. * Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum or Kanban. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and teamwork skills. * Preferred: experience with messaging technologies (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, or Kafka), microservices or event\-driven architecture, and compliance\-driven development (SOC 2\). Informativ is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to building a "best in class" work environment. We offer a rich benefit package including paid time off, health insurance, and 401(k).

while aligning with enterprise standards, governance, and architectural frameworks. ***Responsibilities:*** **Business Engagement \& Solution Discovery** * Partners directly with business stakeholders LLMs, automation, and data\-driven techniques. * Facilitates discovery sessions to align on problem definition, success criteria, and measurable outcomes. **Rapid Prototyping \& Iterative Delivery** * agentic workflows, and orchestration frameworks. * Refines solutions based on stakeholder feedback, usage patterns, and observed outcomes. **AI Solution Development** * Builds end\-to\-end AI in a clear, actionable manner to non\-technical audiences. * Shares knowledge and best practices across teams, contributing to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. ***Qualifications:*** software engineering, data engineering, machine learning engineering, or AI system development. * Demonstrated experience delivering solutions in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments, with a focus on business outcomes. * Strong proficiency in software engineering, including Python, APIs, and modern application development practices. * Hands\-on experience designing and building AI/LLM\-based applications, including prompt engineering, RAG, and agentic workflows. * Experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar. * Ability technical roadmap and architecture for Ads Manager’s web applications, balancing near\-term delivery with long\-term scalability and extensibility. * Design, build, and maintain high\-quality React UIs for campaign creation, management, reporting, and optimization. * Define and evolve shared components, state management, and abstractions that make the surface easier to extend and maintain. * flows. * Proactively drive modernization and technical debt paydown, including migrations and refactors of legacy frontend code. * Embed security\-by\-design into frontend architecture and lead execution across Ads and partner teams. * Actively work with designers to build a best\-in\-class experience for users. * Mentor and sponsor engineers up to L5, improve onboarding and team practices, and help resolve cross\-team execution issues. * Help define how the team uses AI\-assisted development tools (for code, tests, and refactors), including patterns and best practices. ### **About You** #### **Minimum Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience building modern web applications, with substantial ownership of complex, user\-facing products. * Deep expertise in Node.js and React (hooks, state management, performance tuning) in large codebases. * Strong skills in frontend architecture: modularization, shared components, routing, data fetching, and error handling. * Experience designing and integrating with REST and/or GraphQL APIs, working closely with backend teams. * Proven track record leading large, ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder projects from design through rollout and operations. * Demonstrated impact on team productivity and code health through abstractions, tooling, testing, and CI improvements. * Experience with monitoring and observability for web apps (e.g., Datadog or similar). * Comfortable using AI\-assisted developer tools in day\-to\-day work and interested in scaling their use across the team. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with engineers, PMs, designers, and other partners. #### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience leading large\-scale, data\-heavy UIs such as analytics dashboards, editors, or complex workflows. * frontend performance and reliability (bundle optimization, code\-splitting, resiliency patterns). * Led modernization efforts or major migrations (framework upgrades, design system adoption, legacy deprecation). * Experience with common design tools such as Figma. * Track record mentoring L3–L5 engineers and acting as a go\-to expert for a domain or surface area. \#LI\-Remote Instacart provides jobs.description: Job Description: The New York Stock Exchange is seeking a senior developer to join the team responsible for data analytics workflows for trading data. market analytics. **Responsibilities** * Data engineering and analytics solutions + Design, write and optimize SQL to develop and maintain data science and analytics solutions in partnership with writing complex programs and implementing custom algorithms, including adapting open\-source frameworks to specific needs. * Proficiency with Git and experience working in Agile teams of 5 to 8 Deephaven, kdb\+, InfluxDB or TimescaleDB. * Experience with data visualization and analytics tools such as Tableau, Power BI or Alteryx. * Scripting experience in bash or AWK. * Experience in data management, analytics middleware or platform infrastructure. * Experience in an applied R\&D or innovation lab setting. **New York Base Salary Range** The expected base salary for this role, if jobs.description: **Position Title:** **Data Engineer III** **Pay Rate** : $83,000 \- $121,000 *Multiple factors, including Individual experience, skills and abilities will determine where an employee is ultimately placed in the pay range.* **Category/Shift** : Salaried Full\-Time **Physical Location** : 75 5th Street NW Atlanta, GA 30308 United States **The Job You Will Perform:** The Data Engineer is an important member of the Cost Innovation Team, which is a strategic, innovative, and cross\-functional team that is focused on creating value for the company through the advanced analytics of manufacturing data. This position offers a flexible working arrangement provided that the home office is within a typical commuting distance to the A2C office. **Core Responsibilities** **Analytics \& Data Science Enablement** * Partner with analysts, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into scalable technical data solutions. * Deliver self\-service, analytics\-ready datasets that empower downstream teams to consume data without deep knowledge of underlying source systems. * Enable industrial analytics use cases by providing trusted, contextualized time\-series, asset, event, and operational data for analytics platforms and applications. * Eliminate redundant data\-preparation and contextualization efforts across disparate analytics and application teams. * Help establish standard data definitions, reusable data products, and consistent business context across enterprise and industrial analytics environments. * Support downstream analytics workflows, including advanced analytics, data science, visualization, and industrial process analytics. **Data Ingestion \& Integration** * Design, build, and maintain robust pipelines to ingest data from relational databases, operational systems, industrial historians, APIs, cloud platforms, and flat files. * Establish reliable and secure connections between source systems, cloud data platforms, and industrial data platforms. * Write optimized SQL queries and extraction logic for high\-performance data retrieval. * Implement flexible ingestion patterns including batch, incremental, streaming, and replication\-based approaches based on business latency requirements. * Integrate high\-volume time\-series data and industrial metadata while maintaining relationships between assets, measurements, events, and other operational entities. * Support ingestion and integration patterns used by platforms such as Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), Seeq, and Microsoft Fabric. **Data Storage \& Lakehouse Engineering** * Design and manage scalable storage structures across raw (bronze), intermediate (silver), and curated (gold) layers. * Leverage Spark\-native formats and engines such as Delta Lake to support scalable analytics workloads. * Design curated data structures that support both enterprise analytics and industrial data consumption. * Enforce data retention, archiving, and purging policies to manage data lifecycles. * Monitor and optimize storage, compute costs, and cloud resource utilization. **Data Transformation** * Develop Python and SQL\-based transformations to clean, standardize, enrich, and unify data. * Develop, tune, and proactively optimize scalable PySpark applications to efficiently process high\-volume datasets. * Build modular, reusable transformation components rather than siloed, application\-specific logic. * Resolve complex data\-quality anomalies including schema drift, missing values, duplicates, timestamp alignment, and inconsistent identifiers. * Engineer efficient incremental processing patterns to handle high\-volume, frequently changing datasets. * Transform raw operational and historian data into analytics\-ready time series, calculations, conditions, events, and contextualized datasets for downstream consumption. * Enable reusable data transformations that can support platforms such as Seeq, Cognite, Fabric, and custom analytics applications. **Semantic Modeling \& Industrial Data Contextualization** * Translate complex source schemas into intuitive, business\-aligned semantic entities, asset hierarchies, and industrial data models. * Build and maintain relationships between assets, equipment, time series, events, files, and other operational data. * Standardize naming conventions, identifiers, metadata, and relationship mappings across source systems. * Perform data contextualization to connect operational data with relevant equipment, process, and business context. * Support asset\-centric and knowledge\-graph\-style data models commonly used in industrial data platforms such as Cognite. **Pipeline Orchestration \& Operations** * Architect end\-to\-end workflows that seamlessly coordinate ingestion, transformation, contextualization, validation, and publication. * Orchestrate data movement between source systems, lakehouse environments, industrial data platforms, and analytics applications. * Implement resilient error handling including retries, automated recovery, checkpointing, and alerting. * Monitor pipeline health, SLA compliance, data freshness, and data drift using centralized observability tools. * Design pipelines capable of supporting both traditional enterprise data and high\-frequency industrial time\-series workloads. **Data Governance, Security \& DevOps** * Enforce data security and privacy standards, including row\- and column\-level security, RBAC (Role\-Based Access Control), and masking of sensitive data. * Apply consistent access\-control and governance patterns across enterprise data platforms and industrial analytics environments. * Embed automated validation checks as needed to enforce data quality. * Maintain Git\-based development workflows using branching, code reviews, and pull requests. * Implement automated CI/CD pipelines for code testing, data validation, configuration management, and repeatable environment deployments. * Support deployment and lifecycle management of data pipelines, transformation logic, semantic models, and analytics configurations across development, test, and production environments. * Maintain comprehensive documentation of data architectures, pipeline schemas, source\-to\-target mappings, contextual relationships, and lineage maps. **Preferred Experience** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering, or related field \+ 2 years of relevant experience; equivalent Master’s degree accepted; non\-relevant bachelor’s degree requires 5\+ years of equivalent hands\-on experience. * Experience working with: + SQL and Python for data engineering and transformation. + PySpark and Microsoft Fabric for lakehouse transformations.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: At Journal Technologies, we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society \- the courts and justice system. We create and implement enterprise software that supports the administration of justice, currently in the United States, Canada, and Australia. While our eSeries product suite enables governments and their employees to deliver continued foundational court processes, our R\&D focuses on leveraging emerging possibilities with technology to improve access and efficiency. Headquartered in Los Angeles, Journal Technologies is a long\-time, wholly\-owned subsidiary of Daily Journal Corporation (NASDAQ: DJCO). We also have a major office in Logan, Utah, a team in Melbourne, Australia, an office in Victoria, Canada and a growing number of remote staff across North America. Under our next generation of leadership, we're implementing a vision for the company that prioritizes building an extraordinary workplace with empowered people at the heart of our business. Great people want to collaborate with great people, and we are actively looking for smart, motivated people who care deeply about the work they do. **Chief Technology Officer** The Chief Technology Officer leads technology strategy, architecture, product development, and engineering across Journal Technologies. This leader sets and champions the technical vision, brings strong product and engineering thinking to every initiative, and ensures the company's platforms remain secure, reliable, and positioned for growth. The CTO works cross\-functionally with every department and plays a central role in building out the new technology team described above, helping recruit talent and shape how new ideas are evaluated, developed, and scaled. **What you'll do** * Develop and lead a multi\-year technology vision and roadmap aligned with the long\-term goals of Journal Technologies and drive it across the organization. * Bring a customer\-centric, problem\-first approach to product development, ensuring teams deeply understand user needs before committing to solutions. * Identify emerging technologies and market opportunities that strengthen existing products and open new areas of value for the company. * Advise executive leadership on technology investments, build\-versus\-buy decisions, and potential acquisitions or partnerships. * Define architectural vision and principles, ensuring systems are configurable, repeatable, scalable, secure, appropriately modular, and engineered to upgrade and evolve over time. * Apply platform thinking by promoting reusable services, APIs, and shared components that serve multiple products and business units. * Own the modernization of the Company's technology jobs.description: **Location:** Any US Office including Boston, MA ### **LOCATION INFORMATION** In order to be considered for a position, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the location specified without relocation support or visa sponsorship now or in the future, unless explicitly noted otherwise in the position overview. If a position does not specify a location, applicants whose primary residence is a location where JSI is registered to conduct business will be considered: * **U.S. Locations:** AZ, AR, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, HI, IN, IL, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MN, NH, NJ, NM, NY, NC, PA, RI, TN, TX, VT, VA, WA, DC, and WI. * **Global Locations:** Bangladesh, Benin, Cambodia, Cote d'Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Ethiopia, Haiti, Laos, Madagascar, Mali, Mozambique, Niger, Nigeria, Pakistan, Tanzania, Uganda, and U.S. **Position Category:** Direct hire, paid in US **Posting Date:** 11/11/2026 **Deadline Date:** 11/24/2026 **Salary Range**: $94,774 \- $166,270 Commensurate with experience and location. #### **Description** **Organizational overview** JSI is dedicated to strengthening health and education systems to improve the lives of individuals, families, and communities. We believe all people should have what they need to live their healthiest lives and reach their full potential. To accomplish this, JSI works hand\-in\-hand with government agencies, community organizations, and the private sector to design pragmatic strategies for complex problems. We drive measurable impact in public health, health care, and education to enhance the well\-being of people in the United States and around the world. As a global organization, JSI has designed, delivered, and scaled programs in more than 50 countries worldwide. In the U.S., JSI has worked in evaluation, training and technical assistance, policy, and strategy in all 50 states and has teams in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, DC, Georgia, Colorado, and California. **Position overview** As part of the Corporate Information Technology team, the AI Engineer serves as an enterprise catalyst for internal AI adoption, connecting technical execution with practical governance. This role designs, builds, and deploys practical AI\-driven solutions—including prompt architectures, automated workflows, and light application integrations—to resolve operational bottlenecks across divisions. Blending a hands\-on builder mindset with technical oversight, the AI Engineer ensures all internal AI implementations achieve measurable operational efficiencies while adhering to strict safety, security, and ethical standards. This full\-time role reports to the Chief Information Technology Officer and can be located in the U.S. where JSI is registered. #### **RESPONSIBILITIES** Results \& Execution * Creative Problem Solving: Actively seek out complex internal operational challenges across the organization, applying a creative and analytical mindset to design tailored AI interventions that eliminate redundancies and save staff time. * Prototyping \& Development: Design, build, test, and deploy practical AI solutions, including prompt engineering architectures, custom GPTs, workflow automations, and light application integrations via APIs, low\-code/no\-code platforms, or scripts. * Implementation \& Rollout: Lead end\-to\-end implementation of approved AI tools, working alongside business unit leads to embed AI into daily workflows and track operational ROI/efficiency gains. * Access Control \& Asset Lifecycle: Define user permissions, data access controls, and usage monitoring protocols across all regional and divisional teams. People \& Influence * Use Case Discovery: Partner with division leadership to evaluate internal processes and pinpoint high\-impact opportunities for AI integration. * User Enablement: Serve as an internal champion for AI, generating excitement and buy\-in across all levels of the organization. Develop internal prompt libraries, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and targeted training programs to elevate AI literacy and adoption across teams. Thought \& Strategy * AI Strategy: In collaboration with IT leadership develop and execute JSI’s AI strategy, aligning technical initiatives with long\-term enterprise goals. * Environment Architecture \& Management: Provide operational oversight of the company’s enterprise AI environment, including vendor platforms (e.g., OpenAI Enterprise, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Anthropic), internal tools, and API usage across global sites. * Vendor \& Tool Evaluation: Benchmark, select, and manage relationships with third\-party AI vendors, ensuring platform reliability, scalability, alignment with corporate strategy, and cost optimization. Expertise \& Growth * Framework Enforcement: Establish and enforce guardrails for safe, transparent, and ethical AI deployment across the global organization. * Data Security Partnership: Collaborate closely with InfoSec and Legal teams to ensure enterprise data remains secure, non\-public data is protected from LLM training sets, and output integrity is maintained. * Stay Current: Maintain subject matter expertise in modern generative AI architectures, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) concepts, and emerging automation technologies to continuously modernize internal toolkits. Finance \& Resource Management * Risk \& Compliance Reviews: Evaluate prospective AI use cases for data privacy risks, intellectual property concerns, algorithmic bias, and compliance with emerging regional regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, global privacy laws). * Financial Acumen :Conduct cost\-benefit and procurement analyses for off\-the\-shelf and custom AI tools, tracking quantified labor efficiencies to ensure execution within approved budget parameters. #### **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education, experience, skills, and competencies** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Formal background or certification in AI Ethics, Enterprise Risk Management, or IT Governance (e.g., CRISC, CGEIT) is preferred. * 8\+ years of relevant, progressive experience in technology deployment, digital transformation, or systems engineering including leadership experience; with 2\+ years of direct experience building with and implementing Generative AI tools in an enterprise environment. Experience scaling AI solutions across a global organization with multi\-regional compliance needs is preferred. * Demonstrated track record of identifying business pain points and successfully deploying technology to resolve them; and passion for operational efficiency and creative problem solving. * Demonstrated skill in prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) concepts, and building workflows using modern AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Make/Zapier, or internal platform builders). * Proficiency in basic scripting (Python, JavaScript) for API integration and data processing is preferred. Familiarity with enterprise automation suites (UiPath, Power Automate) integrated with AI modules is preferred. * Deep knowledge of data security, privacy standards (GDPR, CCPA), IP protection, and ethical AI principles. * Exceptional analytical and cross\-cultural communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues and partner effectively across matrixed technical and non\-technical teams. **Language** * Fluent oral and written English communication skills. Fluency in a second language (French, Spanish, Portuguese, or others) is preferred. **Travel expectation** * Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally, if necessary (up to 10%). **Work environment** * Mostly operates a computer in a virtual first environment. * Ability to maintain a comfortable and ergonomic posture while working. **Work authorization/visa requirements/sponsorship** * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States, without visa sponsorship now or in the future. **Other duties** * Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **Interested candidates should submit their resumes and cover letters online by 11/24/2026\.** **No phone calls please.** **Principals only please.**

escalation. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, customer\-service skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently on routine assignments. * Ability to learn networking, infrastructure, cloud services, or IT operations. * Demonstrated experience troubleshooting hardware, software, network, endpoint, account, and system issues and supporting enterprise operating systems and business applications. * Experience with technology deployment, endpoint/account administration, ticketing, documentation, asset management, or IT operational procedures. * jobs.title: VDC Coordinator
jobs.description: **VDC Coordinator** =================== **Company** ----------- Kunz is a model\-based design and engineering firm focused on improving how complex, mission\-critical facilities are designed and delivered. We work at the intersection of engineering, product development, digital design, and construction to create repeatable solutions for large\-scale infrastructure programs. Our teams work on complex technical challenges where design information must move reliably across disciplines and from engineering through construction. By combining deep technical expertise with model\-based workflows, we help improve the quality, consistency, and scalability of project delivery. **Location** ------------ San Francisco, California or Golden, Colorado **Job Description** ------------------- Kunz is expanding its BIM/VDC team to support global hyperscale data center programs. We are seeking technically driven professionals who want to apply their expertise to complex building systems, solve multidisciplinary design challenges, and advance how model\-based information moves from engineering into construction. The work extends beyond individual projects. Models, content, and workflows developed here support repeatable building systems deployed across a broader infrastructure program. This is an opportunity to influence both the technical deliverables and the methods used to produce them at scale. We welcome BIM/VDC practitioners and experienced technical specialists from architecture, engineering, construction, and design technology. Previous data center experience is valuable, but not required. Working across engineering, product architecture, VDC, and construction, you will help turn complex design and product information into coordinated, reusable digital deliverables. The role combines hands\-on Revit development, multidisciplinary coordination, model quality, and the improvement of digital delivery workflows. Assignments may include developing configurable Revit content, integrating manufacturer equipment models, resolving interfaces between building systems, or establishing the information standards that make models reliable for downstream teams. You will work directly with engineers, vendors, A/E partners, construction teams, and owner stakeholders to address technical challenges and move deliverables forward. Opportunities are available across multiple experience levels. Experienced candidates can take greater ownership of technical scopes, contribute to program standards, and mentor colleagues while remaining closely involved in the technical work. At Kunz, the opportunity is to do more than deliver the next model. It is to help establish how complex design information is structured, coordinated, and used across an infrastructure program. For professionals who want to deepen their technical expertise and influence how projects are delivered, this role offers both hands\-on work and a broader field of impact. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Develop and maintain Revit models, families, structured parameters, and reusable content that support coordinated building systems and consistent deployment across projects. * Translate engineering and manufacturer information into usable BIM deliverables, including support for MCAD\-to\-BIM workflows and configurable product models. * Coordinate interfaces between disciplines, equipment, and building systems, working with project partners to resolve technical issues and communicate design changes. * Review models for geometric accuracy, data quality, completeness, and readiness for downstream design and construction use. * Maintain Autodesk Construction Cloud environments, model structures, information exchanges, and issue workflows. * Plan, track, and deliver assigned BIM/VDC scopes, identifying dependencies and communicating decisions, priorities, and outstanding issues. * Improve templates, standards, and quality\-control methods to make digital delivery more reliable and repeatable. **Minimum Requirements** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering, construction management, design technology, or a related field. * Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in BIM, VDC, architectural or engineering design, design technology, or model\-based project delivery. * Professional experience using Autodesk Revit for building design, engineering, construction, or BIM/VDC applications. * Professional experience developing or maintaining Revit models, families, parameters, schedules, or other model content. **Desired Qualifications** -------------------------- * Strong hands\-on Revit skills, with demonstrated capability in model development, families, parameters, schedules, or model organization. * Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud, Navisworks, or comparable coordination tools. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, product information, and construction documents, with a practical understanding of how building systems fit together. * Clear technical communication, sound judgment, and the ability to manage priorities and take responsibility for deliverables. * Experience with hyperscale data centers, mission\-critical facilities, or other complex commercial, industrial, or institutional projects. * Experience with modular or configurable building systems or product\-based design. * Experience with MCAD\-to\-BIM workflows, manufacturer equipment models, or configurable product models. * For senior\-level consideration, demonstrated ownership of complex technical scopes, experience improving standards or workflows, and the ability to guide others through coordination and delivery challenges. Candidates are not expected to bring expertise in every area. We are building a team with complementary strengths in model development, coordination, information quality, and digital delivery. **Position Details** -------------------- This is a full\-time position based in either San Francisco, California or Golden, Colorado. Opportunities are available at the VDC Coordinator Level 2 and Level 3, with the position level determined based on the candidate's experience, technical background, and scope of responsibility. **Benefits** ------------ Kunz offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off * Paid company holidays * Annual performance\-based bonus eligibility **Compensation** ---------------- Kunz is hiring for VDC Coordinator Level 2 and Level 3 positions. The level offered will be based on the candidate's experience and technical background. The anticipated base salary ranges for the positions covered by this posting vary by work location: * San Francisco, California: $80,000 to $140,000 annually * Golden, Colorado: $70,000 to $115,000 annually Individual compensation will be based on position level, work location, relevant experience, skills, technical background, and internal equity. Employees may also be eligible for an annual performance\-based bonus. **Work Authorization** ---------------------- Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Kunz is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this position.
