jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades. Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter\-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI\-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years. This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies. Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital. **Location** New York, NY (Hybrid). In office Monday to Thursday. Candidates must live in or be able to commute to New York City. **The Role** Most companies building with AI connect someone else's models to their software. Kaizen's AI\-native platform turns requirements into working applications, and today much of that intelligence comes from general\-purpose models that carry capabilities we don't need, lack knowledge we do, and leave us and our customers paying frontier\-model token costs for intelligence we don't control. This role changes that. You'll fine\-tune, adapt and distill open\-weight models into specialized intelligence Kaizen owns, and prove where it beats the general\-purpose alternative. The goal isn't the biggest model or the most papers: it's public\-sector software that works better, costs less to run, and is harder to replicate. **What You'll Do** * Fine\-tune, adapt and distill open\-weight models for requirements interpretation, code generation, repository understanding, structured output and software validation. * Own the experiment loop: curate datasets, build training pipelines, and test architectures and techniques until a promising idea becomes a working model. * Build evaluations on real software engineering tasks that set baselines, expose failure modes, and separate real gains from benchmark noise. * Work with platform engineers to find where current models fall short, then build the capabilities that close those gaps and ship them into production. * Experiment with supervised fine\-tuning, synthetic data, preference optimization and reinforcement learning to improve model behavior on specialized tasks. * Deliver applications built around each customer's needs without frontier\-model token spend, so public budgets go to residents, not inference. * Lay the groundwork (datasets, evals, research practices) for Kaizen to eventually train its own models from scratch. **What You'll Bring** * Hands\-on experience training, fine\-tuning or adapting language models. You've worked with model weights, not just model APIs or prompts. * Strong software engineering fundamentals. You build reliable training pipelines, debug complex systems, and write code other engineers build on. * Strong Python and PyTorch, with a working understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization and language model training. * Something you've built that shows real model engineering ability: a fine\-tuned model, an original training approach, or a meaningful open\-source ML contribution. Industry, research or independent work all count; demonstrated ability matters more than years or credentials. **Strong Candidates May Also...** * Have fine\-tuned models for code generation, program synthesis or repository understanding. * Design experiments and evaluation sets that tell a meaningful improvement from noise or overfitting. * Bring experience with synthetic data, distillation, quantization, or preference optimization and RL with verifiable rewards. * Have contributed to open\-source model development, published applied ML research, or reproduced significant research results. **Don't Apply If...** * Your model experience is prompt engineering and API calls. * You'd rather publish a result than ship a model people use every day. * You hand off notebooks and expect someone else to make them run in production. * You assume the biggest model is the right answer and don't want to think about cost. Residents and public servants rely on the software we build because they don't have another option. The models underneath it have to earn that. **What Kaizen Offers** ---------------------- **Health \& Insurance** * 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents. * $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA. * One Medical membership, on us — same\-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city. * Fertility and family\-building support through Carrot. * 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match. **Family \& Time Off** * 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non\-birthing parents. * Unlimited PTO, with a two\-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!) * Closed for all federal holidays. * Company\-wide winter break the week of Christmas. * Company offsites throughout the year. **Office \& Remote Setup** * Up to $750 one\-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC\-based employees. $500 for remote employees. * $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution). * Expensed lunch while in the office. * Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you choose to work in the office past 7pm. * Company\-provided laptop of your choice. **Wellness** * NYC employees: Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us. * Non\-NYC employees: $100 per month, dedicated to gym / physical fitness reimbursement. **Stipends** * $100/month utility stipend. * $250/quarter home cleaning stipend * $500/year professional development. * $250/year recreation. * $300/quarter pet care stipend. Compensation Range: $240K \- $280K

jobs.description: **About Kendra Scott** We are a fashion\-lifestyle brand of big dreams, colorful confidence, and inspired design. Establish production controls and support practices * Evaluate AI outputs and workflow behavior against defined acceptance criteria before deployment. * Implement approved access permissions, including limits on the actions automated workflows can perform. * Establish audit logs, monitoring and exception handling. * Design workflows so they can be stopped safely, with recovery or reversal procedures where feasible. * Apply data protection requirements in partnership with Information Security and designated governance owners. * Coordinate deployment and production support with shared technical resources, including clear escalation paths and backup coverage. * Monitor solution operating costs and recommend changes that improve value. issues and verify fixes * Develop a deep understanding of the product to identify edge cases, usability issues, and quality risks * Validate complex teacher and student workflows, including AI\-generated outputs and interactive experiences * Evaluate features not only for correctness but also usability, clarity, and user experience * Help prioritize testing efforts based on product impact and risk * Contribute to QA documentation, testing checklists, and release validation processes * Participate in release readiness and post\-release validation to ensure product stability **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of experience in manual software testing or quality assurance * Experience and expertise in QA processes and UI/UX testing on web, including across devices and browsers * Strong experience performing manual regression, exploratory, and functional testing * Experience testing web applications and user\-facing products * Ability to write clear and actionable bug reports * Strong debugging skills and ability to work closely with engineers to reproduce issues * High attention to detail and strong product intuition * Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and design * Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup environment * Strong curiosity and willingness to deeply understand product behavior and edge cases * Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently **Nice to Have** * Experience testing AI or LLM\-powered products * Testing complex workflows that involve APIs, backend systems, or data or modern web stacks Our services currently span: * Next.js \+ React frontend * Kotlin \+ Java Spring Boot backend * Python FastAPI AI services * Langsmith agent workflows **What Success Looks Like** bug reports that speed up debugging * Product releases ship with high confidence and minimal regressions * AI\-driven features behave reliably and degrade gracefully when issues occur **What We HMI, SCADA, historian, and visualization systems. * Experience with Ignition, AVEVA, or other industrial SCADA and supervisory control platforms. * Experience designing industrial control panels in instrumentation, motor control systems, variable frequency drives (VFDs), industrial networking, communications infrastructure, and remote\-access technologies. * Experience supporting factory classify sensitive data (PII, payment card data, health information, and confidential business data) across cloud, SaaS, and on\-premises environments * Drive remediation of overexposed, misclassified, and abandoned data with data owners, including data exposed to AI tools and assistants * Help select, deploy, and tune data loss prevention (DLP) controls across endpoint, email, web, management for data at rest and in transit * Enforce least\-privilege access to sensitive data and secure cloud data platforms through access reviews, guardrails, and remediation * Triage data detection and response alerts and build alerting for anomalous data access and exfiltration with our Security Operations Center * Participate in incident response involving data exposure as a responder, subject matter expert, and/or liaison to technology, legal, and business teams * Develop data security standards, procedures, runbooks, and automations, support compliance efforts (e.g., PCI DSS, HIPAA for applicable business units, state privacy laws), and share data security knowledge with Security Analysts **Position Requirements** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience * 3\+ years of experience in cybersecurity or a similar role, including at least 2 years focused on data security or data protection * Extensive understanding of modern data security concepts and privacy\-by\-design principles * Deep understanding of one or more security or privacy frameworks (NIST CSF, NIST Privacy Framework, CIS, etc.) and how to incorporate them * Hands\-on experience with at least two of the following: DSPM, data classification, DLP, or data access governance tools * Working knowledge of encryption, tokenization, and key management concepts (PKI, cloud KMS) * Experience securing data in public cloud, cloud data warehouse, and SaaS productivity environments * Familiarity with PCI DSS, HIPAA, and U.S. state privacy laws (e.g., CCPA/CPRA) * Familiarity with SIEM and logging platforms, SQL, and scripting (Python, PowerShell, or similar) * Excellent customer service, communication, and documentation skills **Pay** ------- This is a salaried position starting at $94,000\.00(or applicable minimum salary, if higher) and pays up to $129,000\.00, based on experience and qualifications.**Benefits** ------------ All team members receive the following benefits while working for Life Time: * A fully subsidized membership * Discounts on Life Time products and services * 401(k) retirement savings plan with company discretionary match (21 years of age and older) * Training and professional development * Paid sick leave where required by law Full\-time Team Members jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **About Lumafield:** Lumafield was founded in 2019 to upgrade manufacturing. We are engineers with deep experience across the product development cycle, from initial ideas to shipping hardware, across industries and specializations, who became frustrated by the cost and complexity of modern manufacturing. So we decided to upgrade it. Engineers make million\-dollar decisions every day, and they need tools that give them the greatest possible insight into their products. By offering unprecedented visibility into products, as well as AI\-driven tools that highlight problems and generate quantitative data, Lumafield promises to revolutionize the way complex products are created, manufactured, and used across industries. We started with industrial CT scanning, which for us was the most valuable but underutilized tool in the manufacturing toolbox, enabling us to rapidly inspect essential components non\-destructively. We rebuilt the whole system, from X\-ray capture, to computer vision analysis, to web\-based collaboration, to the entire business model, making the most advanced manufacturing tech more accessible to every industry. Our company, like our platform, is designed for upgrades. We’re building for greater intelligence, autonomy, and speed. For deeper vision, operational excellence, and powerful insights. And then we'll upgrade it all again. Lumafield is headquartered in San Francisco, CA. and has an office in Cambridge, MA. **About the role:** Lumafield is seeking a highly proactive Manufacturing Engineer to drive continuous improvement of our production processes and ensure that our hardware products maintain high quality standards. As a member of the Manufacturing Team, you’ll collaborate closely with our Hardware and Build teams to identify and resolve production issues and drive excellence in our manufacturing operations across all product lines. This role offers a unique blend of influence and scope, where you’ll be making a tangible impact on hardware that’s revolutionizing the way physical products are manufactured everywhere. If you are interested in joining a well\-funded growth stage company, this is the perfect opportunity for you to become a part of the Lumafield team! ### **What you'll do:** * Work closely with our build team to identify and correct production issues, implement process improvements, and help us get our scanners out the door on time. * Identify and execute process changes to improve the safety, quality, ease, ergonomics, and speed of assembly of all our hardware products. * Triage electromechanical issues on the production floor and execute short\-term corrections \& long\-term corrective actions. * Conduct root cause analysis studies and determine appropriate material disposition for nonconforming items. * Execute design changes and documentation updates using sound CAD and 2D drawing best practices. * Develop and document SOPs for manufacturing processes, including assembly instructions and IQC. * Design, build, and evaluate jigs and/or fixtures to improve assembly tasks. * Collaborate with the Hardware Engineering team to ensure smooth transition of products from design through NPI and mass production. ### **About you:** * 3\-5 years of relevant engineering experience. * Are a hands\-on, deeply detail\-oriented engineer, well versed in quality control and testing/validation. * Have strong knowledge of 3D modeling best practices, particularly in OnShape or Solidworks. * Have experience working with product lifecycle management systems. * Have a desire to deeply understand the interactions of complex electromechanical products. * Have excellent written and graphical communication skills. * Have a Bachelor's degree in an applicable engineering field. (Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, etc.) ### **Bonus:** * Aptitude for electronics and reading electrical schematics. * Have experience working in an ISO 9001 quality system or a regulated field industry like Aerospace or Medical Devices (e.g. an AS9100 or ISO 13485 quality system). * Have experience working directly with assembly technicians. Lumafield offers both competitive cash and equity compensation, as well as a health \& wellness stipend, 401k, parental leave, flexible PTO, commuter benefits, company wide events and more! Lumafield is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, because the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We encourage you to apply anyway – If you’re excited about our technology, the opportunity, and are eager to learn more we’d love to hear from you! jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React/Rails & AI-Assisted Development)
jobs.description: **Job Overview:** **You’ll be engineer \#3\.** We’re a small team, so you’ll have a real say in what we build and how we build it. Your work will ship to the people who use our platform every day, and you’ll help shape our engineering practices as we grow. There’s also room to grow from a senior role into a staff\-level role as the team expands. **You’ll help shape our frontend.** Our platform has a Rails API and two React applications: a customer\-facing storefront and an admin app. React already makes up most of our codebase, and we expect that to keep growing. We’re looking for someone who knows modern React well and can help guide the architecture and evolution of both applications. **AI agents are part of how we build.** We provide a generous monthly budget so you can use the AI tools that work best for you. We’re less concerned with which tools you choose and more interested in how you use agents to plan, build, test and debug as part of your everyday workflow. **Quality still matters.** We ship often and take pride in doing things well. AI helps us move faster, but we’re still responsible for understanding, testing and standing behind what we ship. \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- **What You’ll Do:** **Frontend Architecture \& Development** * Own the architecture of our two React apps, including component structure, state management, data fetching, routing and performance. * Build and maintain a shared design system that keeps our interfaces consistent and makes them easier to develop. * Bring modern React practices to both codebases and help them evolve with the ecosystem. * Improve older workflows and interfaces our internal teams use every day. * Build and ship features for the storefront and admin, from scoping through deployment and monitoring. * Write and maintain tests, including end\-to\-end tests with Playwright, to keep the frontend reliable. **Full\-Stack Product Engineering** * Work across the stack when needed, including our Rails API, Postgres database and AWS infrastructure managed with Terraform. We’re a small team, so everyone pitches in where the work needs to be done. * Help make system design decisions across the platform, beyond the frontend. * Work on different parts of the platform, including storefronts, punchouts, program stores, fulfillment and reporting. **AI\-Assisted Development** * Use AI agents throughout your workflow, from planning and implementation to testing, code review and debugging. * Break work into manageable pieces that agents can help with and you can verify. * Review AI\-generated code as carefully as any other code and take responsibility for what ships. * Know when an agent can help you move faster and when it makes more sense to work through a problem by hand. * Share what’s working and help the team improve how we build. **Collaboration** * Spend time with teams across the company, including fulfillment and account teams, to understand their workflows and where they need help. * Work directly with department leads and customers to turn their feedback into product improvements. * Work with leadership on priorities and product direction. * Explain technical decisions and tradeoffs in a way non\-technical teammates can understand. \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- **What You Bring** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong frontend focus and experience working across the stack. * Deep experience with modern **React**, including hooks, component architecture, state management, data fetching and performance. * Strong **TypeScript** skills. * Experience making frontend architecture decisions in production and explaining the tradeoffs behind them. * Experience building or maintaining a design system, ideally with Tailwind. * Strong system design skills and a willingness to work on backend code when needed. * Experience building frontends that work with REST or GraphQL APIs. * A habit of writing automated tests, including end\-to\-end tests. Playwright is a plus. * Experience using AI agents in your daily development work. You can walk us through your workflow, the tools you use and how you verify what they produce. * Strong communication skills and an interest in working with people outside engineering. * A self\-directed approach and comfort working through ambiguity in a startup environment. **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience with **Next.js**, especially App Router and server components. This is strongly preferred. * Experience with Ruby on Rails. * Experience with Postgres, AWS or Terraform. * Experience coordinating multiple agents or sub\-agents in your development workflow. * Experience with LLM integrations, prompt engineering, RAG or Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience in e\-commerce or B2B commerce, including punchout integrations (cXML/OCI). * Familiarity with the promotional products industry. * Experience at an early\-stage startup. **What Sets You Apart** * You have ideas about frontend architecture, but you’re open to changing your mind. * You think about the systems and workflows around the code, not just the code itself. * You’re always finding ways to improve how you work with AI agents. * You know when to move quickly and when a problem needs more care. * You’d rather talk to the people using the software than guess what they need. * You enjoy helping the people around you do their best work. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * React architecture: Tell us about a frontend architecture decision you made on a production React application. What problem were you solving, and what tradeoffs did you consider? * Design systems: Have you built or maintained a design system? Describe your role and how the system helped the team build consistent interfaces. * AI\-assisted development: How do you use AI agents in your development workflow? Share an example of how you verified their work or caught an issue * Full\-stack experience: Tell us about a feature you worked on beyond the frontend. What parts of the API, database or infrastructure did you work with? * Working with users: Tell us about a time you worked with a customer or someone outside engineering to understand a problem and improve a product. Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Purpose** *Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.* **Title and Summary** Senior Platform Engineer The Senior Platform Engineer is a hands\-on engineering role responsible for designing, implementing, operating, and continuously improving highly available, secure, scalable, and resilient platform infrastructure supporting enterprise applications and distributed data environments. This role partners closely with application, development, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver reliable platform capabilities, automate infrastructure and deployment processes, integrate evolving technologies, and improve the performance and operational efficiency of Mastercard's technology environments. Overview * Provide world\-class support and expertise to all of MasterCard’s Big Data environments. * Provide Big Data thought leadership and technology roadmaps to support MasterCard’s vision and evolution. * Purpose of the Job o Represent MasterCard’s Big Data Engineering team as a subject matter expert. o Support MasterCard’s present Big Data infrastructures. o Integrate new technologies and platforms into current environments as technologies evolve and demands change. Role * Design, build, operate, and maintain scalable, secure, resilient, and cost\-efficient cloud and platform infrastructure supporting mission\-critical applications and distributed systems. * Support and continuously improve highly available Big Data and distributed computing environments, ensuring reliability, performance, capacity, availability, and fault tolerance. * Deploy, administer, troubleshoot, and optimize container\-based platforms and orchestration environments, including Kubernetes. * Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate software integration, testing, security validation, and deployment processes. * Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management using Infrastructure as Code and automation technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent tools. * Develop software, scripts, and automation using Java, Python, or other appropriate programming languages to improve platform reliability, repeatability, and operational efficiency. * Support platform capabilities for microservices and independently deployable applications, enabling reliable and scalable application deployment. * Administer and troubleshoot Linux/Unix operating systems supporting enterprise platform environments. * Monitor platform health, capacity, availability, and performance; identify opportunities to improve scalability, reliability, efficiency, and operational resilience. * Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, application\-platform, networking, distributed\-system, and performance issues and drive problems through resolution. * Analyze infrastructure and platform security requirements and implement appropriate controls in accordance with Mastercard security, change\-management, and regulatory standards. * Partner directly with application and development teams to understand technical requirements and provide platform solutions that meet application performance, reliability, security, and scalability needs. * Evaluate emerging technologies and capabilities and integrate appropriate solutions into existing platform environments as technology and business requirements evolve. * Create and maintain platform documentation, procedures, operational standards, and engineering best practices. * Participate in operational support for mission\-critical platform environments and contribute to incident resolution, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities. * Share platform engineering knowledge and provide technical guidance and cross\-training to teammates. All About You Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience * Hands\-on experience designing, building, operating, or supporting enterprise cloud and platform infrastructure. * Experience operating highly available, mission\-critical distributed systems and troubleshooting complex infrastructure and platform issues. * Proficiency with Kubernetes, container technologies, and container orchestration concepts. * Experience implementing or supporting CI/CD pipelines and automated software deployment processes. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code and infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, or comparable technologies. * Strong Linux/Unix administration and troubleshooting skills, including shell scripting, system diagnostics, performance analysis, and operational support. * Proficiency in at least one pro Chef, Python, or similar technologies. * Understanding of enterprise networking in support of large\-scale IT environments. * Experience supporting large ETL or data\-processing pipelines. * Working knowledge of SQL, data warehousing, or massively parallel processing technologies. * Experience with observability, monitoring, metrics, and performance\-management technologies. * Understanding of statistics, machine learning, or data\-intensive workloads is beneficial. What Success Looks Like * Platform infrastructure is reliable, secure, scalable, observable, and effectively automated. * Infrastructure and application deployments are increasingly standardized through CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code. * Containerized and distributed workloads operate with appropriate availability, performance, resilience, and security. * Repetitive operational activities are reduced through software engineering and automation. * Platform capacity, performance, and reliability issues are identified proactively and resolved effectively. * Application and engineering teams receive dependable platform capabilities that allow them to deliver and operate applications efficiently. Mastercard is a merit\-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.**Corporate Security Responsibility** All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: * Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; * Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; * Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and * Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro\-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best\-in\-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on\-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on\-site fitness facilities in some locations. THIS POSTING RELECTS ONE OR MORE CURRENT VACANCIES ON OUR TEAM, AND MASTERCARD INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY 02/10/2027\. If the fill date has passed, Mastercard intends to fill this position as soon as possible. **Pay Ranges** O'Fallon, Missouri: $96,000 \- $163,000 USD

jobs.title: Principal AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Matter Health** Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. We are rapidly expanding and are seeking mission\-driven professionals who thrive in fast\-paced, people\-centered environments. **We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.** **About the Role** Matter Health is seeking a hands\-on, mission\-driven AI Automation Workflow Specialist to join our Information Technology team. This individual contributor role is responsible for building and deploying AI\-assisted workflow automations that support our operations, clinical, care support, and field\-based teams—helping them spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time on the patients and work that matter most. Working directly with business and clinical stakeholders, you will identify day\-to\-day workflow opportunities, configure and deploy automations using Matter Health's established AI tools and platform, and support adoption across the organization. This is a building and operational role—not a platform architecture or people management position. This role is ideal for someone who learns new AI tools quickly, enjoys partnering with non\-technical teams to solve real problems, and is excited about applying emerging AI capabilities in service of a genuine mission. This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer. This is a fully remote role with up to 10% travel for occasional in\-person meetings or team offsites. **Key Responsibilities** * Partner with clinical, care support, operations, and field\-based teams to understand day\-to\-day workflows, pain points, and opportunities for AI\-driven automation * Gather requirements from stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency and translate real operational problems into automation ideas that can be built and tested quickly * Collect structured and informal feedback from clinicians, care support agents, operations staff, and field\-based teams to guide ongoing iteration of deployed automations * Submit identified opportunities into the team's intake process and collaborate with the AI Platform Engineer and requesting\-team leadership to define priorities * Use approved AI tools, agent platforms, and automation software to configure, build, and deploy workflow automations and AI\-assisted processes for operations, clinical, care support, and field\-based teams * Write and refine prompts and configure workflow logic within existing platform tooling, templates, and standards to automate repetitive day\-to\-day tasks * Test and refine deployed automations with real users, iterating based on usage feedback and observed performance * Monitor day\-to\-day performance of deployed automations and escalate issues related to accuracy, reliability, or unexpected behavior to the AI Platform Engineer or Engineering team * Follow established platform standards, prompt and context templates, and controls when building and deploying automations—including those handling protected health information (PHI) * Create documentation, training materials, and enablement content to support successful adoption of new AI\-driven workflows * Maintain a library of deployed automations, prompts, and workflow configurations to support consistency, reuse, and knowledge sharing across the organization * Support change management and adoption efforts as new automations are rolled out across operational teams * Partner with the AI Platform Engineer and stakeholders to evaluate when a deployed automation is ready to expand, refine, or retire **Qualifications** Required * Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience * 1–3 years of experience in business operations, process improvement, workflow automation, or a related operational role * Hands\-on experience using AI tools, chatbots, or no\-code/low\-code automation platforms to build or configure workflows * Strong ability to gather requirements from business and clinical stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency * Comfortable working within established technical standards, prompt and context templates, and controls without needing to design underlying platform architecture * Experience documenting workflows and automation configurations clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences * Basic understanding of responsible AI practices and safe handling of sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI) * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain new tools clearly to non\-technical audiences Preferred * Experience in the healthcare industry; familiarity with clinical operations, call center or care support workflows, or field\-based care models is a plus * Experience with EMR systems, healthcare data, or clinical workflow tools * Familiarity with value\-based care, Medicare, or Medicare Advantage environments * Experience supporting distributed, remote, or field\-based teams * Background in change management, user training, or internal enablement * Comfort working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth organization where priorities evolve **What Success Looks Like** * Meaningful hours saved for operational, clinical, and field\-based teams through deployed automations * Strong adoption of deployed automations by their target teams and users * A growing library of automations successfully built, deployed, and actively maintained in production * Efficient intake\-to\-launch cycle time from approved automation request to deployment * Collaborative, trusted relationships with clinical and operational stakeholders across the organization * Clear and accessible documentation that enables teams to understand and build on deployed workflows * Active contribution to a growing culture of AI\-native thinking across the organization **Why Matter Health** At Matter Health, we believe that where you live should never determine the quality of care you receive. Every team member is vital in improving healthcare access for older adults who have historically been underserved by traditional healthcare systems. This isn't just a mission statement—it's the work we do every day. We Lead with Love in Everything We Do. **Working at Matter Health** We're committed to supporting our team both professionally and personally. Benefits for full\-time team members begin on the first of the month after your start date. Health \& Wellness * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Employer\-funded HSA options * Employer\-paid life and disability insurance * Voluntary illness, accident, and hospitalization coverage * Access to Matter Health's in\-person and virtual care services Financial Security * Competitive compensation * 401(k) with company match starting on Day 60 * Financial wellness resources and support Time Away * Up to 4 weeks of PTO * 10 paid company holidays * 2 volunteer days annually for meaningful causes Eligibility is based on full\-time employment status. Additional details will be shared during the interview process. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Matter Health is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and foster an environment where every team member feels valued, respected, and supported.

Pilot customers ask for a feature and see it working days later. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design and build backend services on Python, FastAPI and Postgres. * Build applied AI workflows with the OpenAI API, LangGraph, vector databases and search systems. * Develop ingestion, indexing and search pipelines for scientific and regulatory documents. * Build customer\-facing features end to end, from data model and API to the React/TypeScript frontend. * Ground AI outputs in source data with traceable, verifiable citations. * Work directly with founders, domain experts and early customers, owning outcomes. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 2\+ years shipping production software end to end. * Strong backend fundamentals: APIs, databases and services. * Comfortable through the frontend with React and TypeScript. * Hands\-on production experience with LLMs, agents, RAG or vector databases. * Fast, accountable builder who uses AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) daily. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * LangGraph, agent frameworks or RAG systems in production; semantic search and knowledge graphs. * Enterprise SaaS, healthcare or life sciences products; seed or early\-stage startup experience. **Work Arrangement** -------------------- On\-site role in Los Altos, CA (San Francisco Bay Area); fully remote is not possible. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Limited Tenure - Hybrid
jobs.description: CityRochester StateMN RemoteNO DepartmentInformation Technology **Why Mayo Clinic** Mayo Clinic is top\-ranked in more specialties than any other care provider according to U.S. News \& World Report. As we work together to put the needs of the patient first, we are also dedicated to our employees, investing in competitive compensation and comprehensive benefit plans – to take care of you and your family, now and in the future. And with continuing education and advancement opportunities at every turn, you can build a long, successful career with Mayo Clinic. **Benefits Highlights** * Medical: Multiple plan options. * Dental: Delta Dental or reimbursement account for flexible coverage. * Vision: Affordable plan with national network. * Pre\-Tax Savings: HSA and FSAs for eligible expenses. * Retirement: Competitive retirement package to secure your future. **Responsibilities** Mayo Clinic is seeking a Software Engineer to design and build back\-end services that support our portfolio of data\-centric clinical and analytic applications. These applications leverage cloud computing, big data, mobile, data science, data warehousing, machine learning using state of the art software development applications and frameworks. Our Software Engineers ensures that these cloud\-based micro\-services adhere to uptime and accuracy targets, are resilient, and scale as data volumes and traffic increase. They work closely with the data engineering, platform, and solutions teams to develop applications as required to benefit our practice and patients. Works closely with the Product Owners, Product Managers, Architects to translate requirements into code. Developing services around data warehousing, big data, cloud computing, business intelligence, analytics and machine learning. Participate in DevOps, Agile, continuous development and integration frameworks. Programming in high\-level languages such as Go, Python, Java etc. Work on deployment automation/configuration management with tools including but not limited to ADO, Puppet, Chef or Ansible or Azure Pipelines, CloudFormation, Terraform following a DevOps model. Ensure all appropriate documentation of processes and source code is created and maintained. Communicate effectively with peers, leaders, and customers throughout the organization. Participate in expert level troubleshooting and resolve problems through root cause analysis, data and system investigation. Continues to build knowledge of the organization, processes and customers. Performs a range of mainly straightforward assignments. Uses prescribed guidelines or policies to analyze and resolve problems. Receives a moderate level of guidance and direction. **This is a hybrid position and must be located within 100 miles of a Mayo Clinic campus for occasional on\-site expectations based on business needs.** **Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in computer science/engineering or related field; Or an Associate's degree in computer science/engineering or related field with an additional 2 years of experience as described below. * Have working knowledge and experience of Software Engineering with a minimum of internships and a minimum of 1 yr. of experience, or 2yrs of experience coding applications or services in a high\-level language (C, C\+\+, Golang, Java, C\# etc.). * Demonstrated problem solving and time management skills. * Possesses strong technical aptitude for designing and implementing software solutions. * Experience with modern application development frameworks. * Knowledge of professional software engineering practices \& best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations. * Deep hands\-on technical expertise, excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Experience with Agile software development techniques. **Preferred qualifications for this position include**: * Ability to use a wide variety of open\-source technologies and cloud\-based services. * Experience with Google and Azure cloud environments. * Experience in databases, analytics, big data systems or business intelligence products. * Experience with building high\-performance, highly available and scalable distributed systems. * Experience developing software for healthcare related industries. **This vacancy is not eligible for sponsorship/we will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position. Mayo Clinic DOES NOT participate in the F\-1 STEM OPT extension program.** **This position is Limited Tenure. Limited Tenure (LT) means that if you are offered the position and accept it:*** **You will be categorized as a regular employee during this tenure, but employment will be terminated at the established end date.** * **You commit to stay in this position until the end of the tenure (approximately 24 months from date of hire) before you become eligible to transfer to a new position.** * **After the completion of the limited tenure assignment, it is your responsibility to secure another role within Mayo through the job vacancy process or employment will be ended upon the completion of the limited tenure assignment.** **Exemption Status** Exempt **Compensation Detail** $97,448\.00 \- $143,270\.40 / year **Benefits Eligible** Yes **Schedule** Full Time **Hours/Pay Period** 80 **Schedule Details** Monday – Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. This is a hybrid position and must be located within 100 miles of a Mayo Clinic campus for occasional on\-site expectations based on business needs. **Weekend Schedule** Possible on\-call on weekends as per on\-call schedule. **International Assignment** No **Site Description** Just as our reputation has spread beyond our Minnesota roots, so have our locations. Today, our employees are located at our three major campuses in Phoenix/Scottsdale, Arizona, Jacksonville, Florida, Rochester, Minnesota, and at Mayo Clinic Health System campuses throughout Midwestern communities, and at our international locations. Each Mayo Clinic location is a special place where our employees thrive in both their work and personal lives. Learn more about what each unique Mayo Clinic campus has to offer, and where your best fit is. **Equal Opportunity** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Learn more about the "EOE is the Law". Mayo Clinic participates in E\-Verify and may provide the Social Security Administration and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security with information from each new employee's Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. **Recruiter** Jackie Mckay

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
jobs.description: Job ID: 114506 * Boston * Chicago * New York City * San Francisco * Seattle * Washington DC Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem\-solver who is energized by challenges? **You’ve come to the right place.** **YOUR IMPACT** --------------- You will lead technical teams, architect data platforms, and build scalable pipelines while mentoring colleagues and collaborating with clients at all levels. You’ll tackle impactful challenges, contribute to R\&D, and grow as a leader by working with diverse experts on cutting\-edge AI projects across industries. You will lead multiple technical teams and own the technology stack for enterprise data and AI platforms. You’ll design and build robust, scalable, and reproducible data pipelines for machine learning while ensuring information security standards are upheld. Additionally, you’ll mentor junior colleagues, contribute to R\&D projects, and drive innovation within the QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey Data Engineering community. Your work will address real\-world challenges across industries. Partnering with QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you’ll help create innovative machine learning systems that accelerate AI adoption and solve business problems at speed and scale, enabling clients to achieve meaningful and lasting impact. You will be based in one of our North America offices as part of our global Data Engineering community. You’ll work in cross\-functional Agile teams alongside Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and industry experts to deliver advanced analytics solutions. Collaborating with clients from data owners to C\-level executives, you’ll help architect impactful solutions that solve complex business problems and drive value. You will be in an exceptional environment to grow as a technologist and leader. You’ll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges. Surrounded by inspiring, multidisciplinary teams, you’ll gain a holistic understanding of AI while collaborating with some of the best design, technical, and business talent in the world. **YOUR GROWTH** --------------- Driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture \- doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: * **Continuous learning:** Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey. * **A voice that matters:** From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. * **Global community:** With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. * **World\-class benefits:** On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family. **YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS** ---------------------------------- * Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent experience * 10\+ years relevant professional experience * Ability to scope projects, define workstreams, and translate roadmaps into sprint goals, milestones, and deliverables within agile and iterative team environments * Proven experience architecting and building enterprise data and AI platforms as well as scalable data pipelines for advanced analytics use cases operating in production * Passion for and track record of effectively leading and mentoring more junior colleagues * Expertise in implementing software engineering best practices to drive enterprise\-wide improvement, including DevOps, DataOps, and MLOps * Strong software engineering and data engineering expertise, including distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Dask), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), analytics libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy, matplotlib), and modern data platforms and orchestration tools such as Databricks, Airflow, SQL, PySpark, Kedro, and RAPIDS * Ability to write clean, maintainable, scalable, and robust code in object\-oriented languages such as Python, Scala, or Java, and experience supporting the development of junior engineers through collaborative code reviews * Extensive commercial client\-facing or senior stakeholder management experience * Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment * Willingness to travel * Strong communication skills with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels Please review the additional requirements regarding essential job functions of McKinsey colleagues. Our unwavering commitment to integrity drives everything we do, guiding us to always act in the best interests of our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Analytics
jobs.description: MediaAlpha is a customer acquisition solutions provider powered by technology and data science. The company provides industry\-leading solutions designed to reach consumers shopping within high\-consideration categories such as property and casualty insurance, health insurance, life insurance, and more. **Senior Staff Product Manager, Analytics** ------------------------------------------- MediaAlpha is a customer acquisition solutions provider powered by technology and data science. The company provides industry\-leading solutions designed to reach consumers shopping within high\-consideration categories such as property and casualty insurance, health insurance, life insurance, and more. **Location:** Los Angeles \| Hybrid (3 days per week in office). ### **Role Overview** This role owns the vision, strategy, and business outcomes for how MediaAlpha turns its analytics and data science into products. Our Analytics team builds the models, signals, and optimization behind the MediaAlpha Marketplace. You'll set the long\-term direction for a family of intelligence products for advertisers, publishers, and agents, spanning bidding, predictive signals, performance guarantees, and partner\-facing reporting and forecasting. You'll define how proven analytics work becomes a product, and you'll be fully accountable for the outcomes those products produce. **The core challenge:** build a repeatable path from research to revenue. Analytics owns its models and roadmap. You'll own the moment proven work becomes a product, and everything after: whether it should be a product at all, who it's for, how it's packaged and priced, and how account teams take it to market. You'll balance one\-off requests from large partners against the discipline of standard products, consistent rules, and claims we've actually measured, and you'll make sure every product strengthens our marketplace. This is an individual contributor role. You'll partner closely with analytics and data science, engineering, product marketing, finance, legal and privacy, and our advertiser, publisher, and agent account management teams. You'll also mentor other product managers across the organization, raising the bar for data\-product thinking, commercial judgment, and product craft. ### **Responsibilities** * Own the vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for MediaAlpha's analytics products, translating analytics capabilities, partner needs, marketplace dynamics, and business goals into a clear long\-term direction and prioritized roadmap. * Be accountable for business outcomes by defining and measuring per\-partner impact, including revenue from analytics products, marketplace margin, partner retention and growth. * Own the path from research to launch: define what "ready" means for an analytics capability, accept handoffs from Analytics, and decide whether each one becomes a product. * Define the partner problem each product solves and which advertisers, publishers, or agents it fits, and own its packaging, naming, and positioning within a single product family. * Partner with finance and business leaders on pricing and commercial terms, including how products are offered across different marketplace and deal structures. * Design pilots with account managers, including partner selection, goals, and success criteria set up front. * Translate analytics work into product terms and partner needs into clear requests for Analytics, helping data scientists think about who a product is for and what it's worth to them. * Ensure product requirements give engineering clear context for building analytics into the Exchange, partner dashboards, reports, and tools. * Build launch kits and playbooks and train account managers to sell with them. * Leverage advanced AI tools to accelerate strategy development, requirement definition, and rapid prototyping across the product lifecycle. * Mentor other product managers and elevate product craft, strategic thinking, and execution standards across the team. * Communicate product strategy, progress, and trade\-offs to senior leadership and executive stakeholders. ### **Requirements** * 10\+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years at the Staff level or above. * Proven ownership of product vision, strategy, and measurable business outcomes for data, analytics, or machine learning\-powered products, ideally sold to enterprise customers. * **Strong data\-product instincts**: you're fluent in experimentation and lift measurement (A/B tests, holdouts, incrementality), understand what a model can and can't do, and can reason about auction and marketplace economics with data scientists and engineers. * Strong commercial judgment: you can size an opportunity, frame a pricing decision, and focus on strengthening the platform. * Experience designing cross\-team operating models, with clear handoffs, decision rights, and exception processes that hold up at scale. * Excellent written and verbal communication; you can explain a model in one sentence to a partner and defend the strategy behind it to an executive. * Positive, can\-do attitude and willingness to work in a fast\-moving environment, rolling up your sleeves to get things done. ### **Nice to Have** We value strong, general PM craft over specific domain familiarity. However, let us know if you have experience in any of these areas/fields: * Ad\-tech, performance marketing, or programmatic advertising, especially in marketplaces or exchanges. * Real\-time bidding (RTB), bid optimization, or managed and automated bidding products. * Predictive modeling, forecasting, or decision\-science products sold to external customers. * Track record of taking models, signals, or data science research from prototype to commercial product, including packaging, pricing, and launch. * Performance guarantees or outcome\-based pricing. * Publisher or supply\-side yield optimization. * Lead generation, call marketplaces, or click\-based performance products. * Insurance, personal finance, or Medicare verticals. * AI assistants or conversational commerce as a customer acquisition channel. * A background in data science, analytics, or economics before moving into product. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** We are excited to offer a competitive base pay range of $180,000 \- $210,000 per year for this position, based on experience and qualifications. But that's not all \- as a valued member of our team, you will also have access to an array of top\-notch benefits, including: * Annual bonus program and participation in our Restricted Stock Unit program * 100% Employer\-paid health, dental, and vision insurance for you, your dependents, and spouse or registered domestic partner * 100% employer\-paid long\-term disability and life insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with matching contributions to help you plan for your future * Open Paid Time Off policy with a birthday day off, 13 holidays, and 5 Recharge days * Professional development reimbursement * Cell Phone, Wellness, and Internet expense reimbursement, along with a subscription to the Calm App * 100% fully paid parental leave for team members up to 22 weeks for the primary caregiver and 12 weeks for the secondary caregiver * Dog\-friendly offices (LA and AZ) along with a $300 pet adoption reimbursement **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion** MediaAlpha is committed to fostering, cultivating, and maintaining a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our philosophy and actions are built on the premise that as an employer and citizens of our communities, we can create opportunities for lasting change. **Fair Chance** MediaAlpha will consider qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with state and local "Fair Chance" laws. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans in our application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at peopleops@mediaalpha.com or (213\) 316\-6256\.

jobs.title: IT Technician
jobs.description: **Job Overview** Medra builds Physical AI Scientists: robots and AI that run real biology experiments in our lab in San Francisco. As our team and lab operations expand, we need a reliable, resourceful IT Technician to keep our office and lab technology running smoothly. You will own setting up room systems, troubleshooting hardware and network issues, and handling general IT requests so our engineers and scientists can stay focused on their work. This is a flexible, part\-time, hourly (non\-exempt), on\-site role with an expected commitment of approximately 10–20 hours per week, including on\-call availability when urgent issues arise. **Responsibilities** * Set up, configure, and maintain conference room AV systems, displays, monitors, and workstation hardware. * Diagnose, debug, and resolve hardware, software, peripheral, and local network connectivity issues across the office and lab. * Handle general day\-to\-day IT support requests, including workstation provisioning, cable management, and equipment moves. * Maintain an organized inventory of IT hardware, cables, adapters, and spare parts. * Assist with onboarding and offboarding hardware setups for new and departing team members. * Escalate complex infrastructure or security issues when needed and document common fixes. * Follow all lab safety rules, including wearing required PPE when working inside lab spaces. **Requirements** * 1\+ year of experience in IT support, desktop support, AV setup, or a similar technical troubleshooting role. * Hands\-on experience setting up and debugging conference room systems, macOS/Windows/Linux workstations, printers, and basic networking (Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, switches). * Strong problem\-solving instincts—comfortable systematically isolating and debugging hardware or connectivity issues. * Reliable, responsive, and available for flexible on\-site hours (10–20 hrs/week) including occasional urgent call\-ins. * Clear communicator who is comfortable working alongside both software engineers and lab scientists. * Able to lift and move up to 40 lbs of equipment (monitors, desktops, networking gear) and work comfortably around racks and desks. **Nice to Have** * Experience supporting a startup, engineering team, lab, or biotech environment. * Familiarity with MDM tools (e.g., Jamf, Kandji), Google Workspace administration, or basic Linux command\-line troubleshooting. Pay: $50\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Privacy Security Engineer, Privacy & Data Protection - Applied AI
jobs.description: Meta is seeking Security Engineers with Privacy and Data protection expertise to join our Applied Artificial Intelligence (AAI) organization. You will apply deep privacy engineering expertise to hard, real\-world problems in how systems collect, use, retain, expose, and delete data. jobs.description: Electrical Engineer II **Job Description:** ***Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.*** **INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES!** At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in\-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence. Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest\-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen. Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE. As an **Electrical Engineer II** on the Advanced Fastening team, you will execute technically complex projects that help mature emerging electrical technologies for future product applications. You will design, build, and test prototypes, analyze data, document findings and tradeoffs, and recommend next steps while working with marketing, platform engineering, New Product Development teams as well as external suppliers and contract manufacturers. **You’ll also be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:** * Working as part of a cross\-functional team or independently design, test, and troubleshoot electrical or electromechanical prototypes and concept systems for technically complex projects. * Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, and data acquisition systems. * Conduct experiments, perform simulations, and draw concise, logical conclusions by analyzing data. * Develop practical plans for assigned work, track progress against the schedule, and communicate status, risks, and needed decisions to project leads and other partners. * Work with project leads and subject\-matter experts to translate technical problems into measurable requirements, testable questions, and appropriate validation activities. * Document prototype configurations, test methods, results, technical limitations, and recommended next steps so others can understand and build on the work. * Work with component suppliers and manufacturers for proper component selection on existing projects and provide input into future technology needs. * Facilitate technical reviews and communicate findings, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to cross\-functional teams and engineering leadership * Acquire knowledge and maintain an understanding of Milwaukee Tool’s development and manufacturing processes so advanced concepts are practical to transition into product development. * Support New Product Development teams during early evaluation and integration by providing technical information, prototype support, and knowledge transfer. * Consider applicable electrical safety, product, and regulatory standards when designing and evaluating new solutions. Role model Milwaukee Tool’s culture, collaborate effectively with peers, and share technical knowledge and lessons learned. * **What TOOLS you’ll bring with you:** * Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field. * 2\+ years of electrical engineering experience in product development, advanced development, embedded systems, power electronics, or a related technical field. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and e xercises independent judgement and works well under pressure in a dynamic environment. * Self\-motivated, organized, efficient, process oriented with a strong work ethic. * Hands\-on ability to design, build, instrument, test, and troubleshoot electrical or electromechanical systems using common laboratory equipment. * Ability to analyze experimental data and communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations through concise documentation and presentations. * Ability to travel 10% of the time (domestic and international). High proficiency in Microsoft Office programs. * **Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:** * Experience with one or more of the following: power tools, embedded systems, power electronics, motor controls, consumer electronics, sensors, simulation, or model\-based engineering. * Experience developing test plans, analyzing experimental data, or conducting root\-cause or failure analysis. * Familiarity with Python, Design of Experiments, statistical analysis, or similar engineering analysis tools. * Exposure to technology scouting, supplier collaboration, intellectual\-property disclosure, or transferring technical work into a product\-development organization. A curious mindset that challenges assumptions and uses quick experiments to learn fast. * **We provide these great perks and benefits:** * Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans. * Generous 401 (K) savings plan. * Education assistance. * On\-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service. * And many more, check out our benefits site HERE . *Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: AI Engineering Manager
jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 4 Dec 2026 At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world. **About the Role** ================== MiniMed is building a lean, high\-leverage AI \& Data Science team that designs, builds, and runs AI agents and models across the business. We are looking for a Manager, AI Engineering to lead our AI Agent Engineering team, including Principal AI Engineers, Senior AI Engineers, and contract engineers, and to turn a growing portfolio of AI use cases into reliable production systems. This is a player\-coach role. Most of your time goes to leading the team and its delivery. You also stay close to the work, spending about a quarter of your time reviewing designs and code, prototyping, and working on hard production problems, so your technical decisions reflect how the systems actually work. Principal AI Engineers set the team's technical standards; you make sure the team has the people, plan, and quality bar to deliver against them. What success looks like A strong, growing team. Engineers are hired well, developed, and retained, and Principal AI Engineers have room to lead technically. Predictable delivery. AI use cases move from approved idea to production on a plan the business can rely on. Reliable systems. What the team ships passes the readiness bar and holds up in production after handoff. This is a hybrid position based in Atlanta, GA or Northridge, CA **A Day in the Life** Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned. *Lead the team and its delivery (about 45%)* * **Build and grow the team.** Hire, onboard, and develop AI engineers; run performance and career conversations; give Principal AI Engineers the support and room to set the technical standard for the team. * **Run delivery.** Turn the team's part of the AI roadmap into a sequenced, predictable plan; run sprint planning and backlog prioritization; manage capacity across concurrent initiatives; raise risks with leadership early. * **Work with product managers and the business.** Partner with AI product managers, the enterprise transformation team, and business leaders to choose what to build, size the effort, and decide when a prototype is ready for engineering hardening. * **Represent the team.** Report progress, risk, cost, and value to the Data Science \& AI Lead and business stakeholders in clear, plain terms. *Own production readiness and standards (about 30%)* * **Set the production\-readiness bar.** Define what an agent needs before it ships: evaluation evidence, guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop where required, fallback behavior, monitoring, and an incident plan. You own this release gate for everything the team builds. * **Own escalation and shape the handoff.** Serve as the escalation point for production issues in the team's systems. As our platform and operations functions take shape, help define how capabilities move from build to steady\-state operation, including ownership, service levels, and runbooks. * **Set development standards.** With the Principal AI Engineers, define testing, documentation, versioning, and release practices, and make sure agents built by enablement engineers inside the business follow the same standards. * **Build in security and compliance.** Partner with AI governance and security on access controls, data flows, and prompt\-injection safeguards. Turn the safety, privacy, and compliance requirements of a medical\-device company into engineering controls, including auditability, documentation, and evaluation records. *Stay hands\-on (about* *25%)* * **Review designs and code.** Review high\-risk or cross\-cutting work before it ships. * **Prototype selectively.** Build proofs of concept and reference implementations on our internal AI platform (Databricks, LangGraph/LangSmith, and enterprise agent platforms) to de\-risk new patterns, while critical\-path delivery stays with the engineers who own it. * **Work the hard problems.** Triage and debug production issues alongside the team when a system is failing and the stakes are high. * **Use AI in how the team works.** Make AI coding and agent tools part of the team's standard workflow, and use them in your own management work. **Must Have: Minimum Requirements** To be considered for this role, please ensure the minimum requirements are evident in your applicant profile. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field and 5\+ years of software/ML engineering experience, including 2\+ years managing engineers (hiring, performance management, and career development). * OR Advanced degree and 3\+ years of the experience above, including 1\+ years managing engineers. * Delivered LLM\-powered or agent systems to  e salary and flexible benefits package** At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life. Salary ranges for U.S (excl. PR) locations (USD):$138,000\.00 \- $234,000\.00 For roles located in California, Seattle WA, Washington DC, Boston MA, and New York City, the base salary range is $153,000 to $261,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary based on factors including experience, education, certifications, skills, market conditions, internal equity, and geographic location. Compensation and benefits information pertains solely to candidates hired within the United States (local market compensation and benefits will apply for others). This position is eligible for a short\-term incentive called the Short Term Incentive (STI). At MiniMed, we are committed to supporting the well\-being and financial security of our employees. Regular employees working 20 or more hours per week are eligible for a robust benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, as well as access to a Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, life insurance, long\-term disability leave, and a dependent daycare spending account. In addition, all regular employees enjoy incentive plans, a 401(k) plan with company match, short\-term disability coverage, paid time off and holidays, participation in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and access to our Employee Assistance Program. Eligible employees may also benefit from our Non\-qualified Retirement Plan Supplement and Capital Accumulation Plan, subject to IRS minimum earnings requirements. Please note that “regular employees” refers to those who are not temporary staff, such as interns, and some benefits may not apply to employees in Puerto Rico. For further details about our comprehensive benefits, we encourage you to visit the link below. MiniMed Benefits Overview **About MiniMed** ================= MiniMed is a full\-stack insulin delivery company dedicated to supporting people living with diabetes through every step of their journey — when and how they need it. For more than 40 years, we’ve been committed to redefining what’s possible: intelligent dosing systems designed for real life, predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and always on support when it’s needed most. At the heart of everything we do is a simple Mission: to make every day a better day for people with diabetes. Learn more about our business, and our mission here .
