jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (Storage)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **About Mirantis** Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/ **Job Description** **Role Overview** Design and build the software that provisions, integrates, and operates high\-performance storage for GPU\-accelerated compute and AI platforms. You will own a Storage as a Service component of the platform end\-to\-end, working with the Product Management, other development teams, and partner engineers to deliver against a dynamic set of requirements. You will develop the control\-plane services, drivers, and tooling that connect enterprise and scale\-out storage systems to Kubernetes\-based workloads across hybrid, edge, and air\-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack. **About the Role** We are looking for a principal\-level software engineer who thinks in systems and data paths — someone who can reason about throughput, latency, consistency, and failure across a storage stack, then express that understanding as clean, testable Go. The right candidate has built production software against real storage systems (whether enterprise NAS, scale\-out, or object), understands what makes storage fast and reliable at scale, and has a track record of leading an engineering team, exerting influence across the whole organization. **Responsibilities** 1\. Storage Software \& Integration * Design and build control\-plane services, drivers (e.g., CSI), and tooling that provision, configure, and operate storage for Kubernetes\-based AI/compute workloads. * Integrate high\-performance storage platforms — Dell PowerScale, VAST, and comparable systems — into automated, declarative provisioning workflows. * Build data\-path, telemetry, and observability tooling to diagnose and resolve performance, reliability, and scaling issues. 2\. Software \& Automation * Write production\-quality software — primarily in Go — with strong testing, code review, and operational rigor. * Deliver infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and GitOps\-driven pipelines (ArgoCD or Flux) for storage configuration and lifecycle. * Support bare\-metal and hybrid provisioning where storage intersects host and cluster bring\-up. 3\. Platform \& Hybrid Delivery * Deliver storage integration for k0s\-based Kubernetes via Cluster API (CAPI) and K0rdent management/child cluster topologies. * Architect storage software for fully disconnected (air\-gapped) environments, including local artifact/mirror connectivity (Harbor) and PKI/TLS considerations. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of software development, including production systems, with Go as a primary language. * 5\+ years building or integrating storage systems (distributed, scale\-out, NAS, or object) at scale. * Solid understanding of storage fundamentals: file/block/object models, throughput and latency behavior, caching, consistency, and failure modes. * Experience with Kubernetes storage (CSI, persistent volumes, storage classes), and Kubernetes controllers and operators patterns. * Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences, non\-technical stakeholders, and executive leadership. **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience with high\-performance storage platforms such as Dell PowerScale, VAST, or comparable technologies. * Experience with the Mirantis K0rdent stack (K0rdent Enterprise, K0rdent AI, k0s, MKE) and Cluster API. * Experience developing storage for GPU/AI workloads (high\-throughput data pipelines, GPUDirect Storage). **Additional Information** **Why you’ll love Mirantis** * Build the foundation platform for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI\-first enterprises * Collaborate with a world\-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence * Shape the product narrative and influence go\-to\-market success **It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision\-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment\-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com** By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities. \#remote We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (\#2 after AWS)!

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Mission Critical Group (MCG**) is an end\-to\-end power solutions and services provider that accelerates time\-to\-power and delivers scalable, resilient infrastructure for mission critical environments. By integrating engineering, manufacturing, modular deployment, and lifecycle services under one platform, we streamline execution and bring complex projects online faster \- without compromising performance. With a robust U.S. manufacturing network, MCG supports data centers, power generation, healthcare, oil \& gas, pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and industrial facilities where uptime is non\-negotiable. Mission Critical Group designs, manufactures and provides value\-added services for customers requiring critical power solutions. Powering a new electric world for a brighter, more secure future. **Job Description** The primary role of the **Quality Engineer** will be to interpret, comply with and improve MCG's quality assurance standards. Essential to this responsibility will be the requirement to ensure quality assurance activities are documented, internal reporting processes adhered to, and regular audits implemented. The Quality Engineer will identify any training needs and ensure the company\-wide participation in the quality management system. **Essential Duties/Responsibilities:** *The following list of responsibilities is not all inclusive, additional projects and/or tasks may be assigned to meet operational needs. MCG retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position should operational needs warrant.* * Plan, execute, and document inspection and testing of products to verify conformance with specifications and deliverables. * Assist operations team in tracking, documenting, and reporting quality levels for performance, corporate social responsibility, environmental, health, and safety goals and key performance indicators. * Investigate product complaints and reported quality issues to ensure closure in accordance with company guidelines and external regulatory requirements. * Monitor risk\-management procedures using software and documentation to identify, investigate, and report issues to management and product development teams. * Identify and provide training and support to team members, focusing on systems, policies, procedures, and processes. * Support, participate in, or conduct external ISO, UL, or internal audits * Performs other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in engineering or related field. *(Required)* * 1\-3 years of applicable experience in a manufacturing/industrial or related setting. *(Required)* * Knowledge of quality assurance and continuous improvement standards, terminology, methods, and tools including ISO9001, version control procedures, non\-conformance/corrective action processes, auditing, 8D, 5Why, PFMEA, Kaizen, process flow mapping, etc. *(Preferred)* * Knowledge of low voltage switchboard / switchgear design, installation, and use. *(Preferred)* * Knowledge of local, state, and federal codes governing the installation and use of low voltage switchgear. *(Preferred)* * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, decision\-making skills. * Excellent technical writing and verbal communication skills. * Ability to interpret basic electro\-mechanical diagrams including front elevation, one\-line, manufacturing, and schematic drawings. * Proficient in all Microsoft office applications. **Physical Requirements:** * Must be able to use required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), to Good hand\-eye coordination and dexterity are essential. * Must be able to follow instructions and stay alert to potential hazards on the shop floor. * Must be able to access and navigate each department at the assigned facilities. * Manufacturing facilities can be loud and have bright lights. jobs.title: Complaint Investigations Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role:** The Complaint Investigations Engineer (QE) will be a key member of Modular Medical's Quality team, responsible for supporting post\-market complaint handling activities. This role will work cross\-functionally with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Engineering, Manufacturing, and other departments to ensure complaints are appropriately evaluated, investigated, documented, and closed in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and company procedures. The Engineer will support the complaint management process from initial intake and data review through investigation, root cause analysis, Medical Device Reporting (MDR) assessment, trending, and final closure. The role will also identify recurring product quality issues, evaluate potential product and patient safety risks, and drive continuous improvement through effective complaint investigations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering, or another technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Minimum of 5 years of experience in an FDA\-regulated environment, preferably within the medical device industry. * Experience with medical device complaint handling, quality investigations, or post\-market quality activities. * Working knowledge of FDA regulations, ISO 13485, and applicable medical device quality system requirements. * Understanding of Medical Device Reporting (MDR) requirements and complaint reportability assessments. * Experience conducting investigations and applying root cause analysis methodologies. * Experience with quality systems, nonconformances, CAPA, and quality documentation. * Ability to analyze quality data, identify trends, and recognize potential product quality issues. * Strong technical writing, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to prepare clear well\-supported investigation reports. * Ability to work independently under minimal supervision. * Ability to manage multiple investigations and competing priorities while meeting established deadlines. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience investigating complaints involving medical devices, insulin pumps, or other diabetes\-related products. * Experience evaluating medical device malfunctions, product performance issues, and potential patient safety concerns. * Experience with FDA MDR assessments and reporting requirements. * Experience with complaint trending, quality metrics, and establishing alert and action limits. * Experience with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS) and complaint management software platforms (I.e. Salesforce, Trackwise). * Experience supporting CAPA investigations. * Familiarity with risk management principles and standards applicable to medical devices. * Experience supporting internal and external regulatory audits. **Responsibilities:** * Manage post\-market complaint investigations ensuring accurate documentation, timely completion, and compliance with regulatory requirements. * Conduct technical investigations of medical device complaints, including review of device history records, returned product evaluations, device logs, and other failure mechanisms. * Perform root cause analysis, evaluate product performance issues, assess potential patient safety risks, and document investigation findings and conclusions. * Evaluate complaints for Medical Device Reporting (MDR) requirements to ensure appropriate reportability assessments, escalation, and regulatory timelines. * Analyze and trend complaint data to identify recurring issues, emerging product quality concerns, and opportunities for CAPA and continuous improvement. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Regulatory Affairs to drive investigation activities, implement corrective actions, improve product reliability, and ensure timely complaint resolution **Skills:** * Knowledge of medical device complaint handling processes, including complaint intake, triage, investigation coordination, documentation, and timely closure. * Proficiency in investigation methodologies such as 5 Whys, fault tree analysis, and other structured problem\-solving techniques. * Working knowledge of FDA medical device regulations, Medical Device Reporting (MDR), ISO 13485, and applicable quality system requirements. * Ability to analyze complaint data, identify recurring failure modes, establish quality metrics, and recognize trends requiring further investigation or CAPA. * Understanding of product risk evaluation, and patient safety considerations. * Experience with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), complaint management platforms, investigation reports, and maintaining accurate records. * Ability to work effectively with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs to coordinate investigations, communicate technical findings, and drive issue resolution.

Zapier for quick pilots * Data: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL * Languages: TypeScript/JavaScript and Python * DevOps / collaboration: Git, CI/CD, Cursor or Claude Code, work tracking (Azure DevOps / Jira), documentation (Confluence / SharePoint) * Telemetry: Application Insights / Log Analytics or equivalent; jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Compute Scheduling
jobs.description: NVIDIA is a pioneer in accelerated computing, known for inventing the GPU and driving breakthroughs in gaming, computer graphics, high\-performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Our technology powers everything from generative AI to autonomous systems, and we continue to shape the future of computing through innovation and collaboration. Within this mission, our team, Managed AI Research Superclusters (MARS), builds and scales the infrastructure, platforms, and tools that enable researchers and engineers to develop the next generation of AI/ML systems. By joining us, you'll help design solutions that power some of the world's most advanced computing workloads. The MARS Scheduling team decides how NVIDIA's AI research compute gets used. That fleet spans many of the largest GPU clusters in the world, across multiple clouds and partners, running everything from frontier\-model pretraining to reinforcement learning and agentic workloads. We run Slurm and Kubernetes at large scale. Our scheduling is coordinated and topology\-sensitive on rack\-scale systems. We manage fair sharing and quotas for hundreds of research teams. We support preemption and reservations. Elastic jobs recover from failure without losing progress. You will own real parts of the scheduling stack, and the opportunity to ship code into our open\-source and internal platform code, and see the result in GPU\-hours returned to researchers within days. The researchers training NVIDIA's own models are your users, and they will tell you quickly what works. **What you'll be doing:** * Design and build scheduling for large GPU fleets on both Slurm and Kubernetes. That covers queueing, gang and topology\-aware placement on rack\-scale NVLink systems, preemption, reservations and backfill that reaches the end of very deep queues. * Build the policy layer: fair share, quotas and allocations across many research teams, driven from a central allocation system and enforced the same way on every scheduler. * Run Slurm as a cloud\-native service on Kubernetes, and extend Kubernetes batch scheduling (Kueue and its ecosystem) for training, reinforcement learning, sandboxes and inference. * Build services around the scheduler: reservation automation, node\-health\-aware placement, workflow orchestration across clusters, and APIs that let other platforms submit and track work. * Measure and raise goodput: GPU occupancy, waste, fairness and time to start for large jobs. Use the data to choose what to build next. * Own reliability for the components you build: on\-call, incident analysis and fixes that remove whole classes of failure, so problems are found before researchers hit them. Work upstream and across teams: contribute to Slurm, Kubernetes and related open\-source projects, and partner with platform, storage, networking and research teams. * **What we need to see:** * BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 6\+ years building production systems software. * Deep experience with at least one batch or cluster scheduler, such as Slurm, Kueue, Volcano, KAI, YuniKorn or a scheduler you built. You should be able to explain its internals, not only its configuration. * Strong programming in Go, C or C\+\+, plus Python for tooling and analysis. * Hands\-on Kubernetes experience: controllers or operators, CRDs, scheduling and resource management. * Solid Linux systems knowledge: containers (Docker, Podman, Enroot or Apptainer), cgroups, networking basics and debugging under load. * A track record of owning a service in production and making it measurably better. Clear written and spoken communication with engineers and researchers. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience scheduling large\-scale AI training: thousands of GPUs, NVLink and InfiniBand or RoCE topology, multi\-node jobs that must start together. * Contributions to Slurm, Kubernetes SIG Scheduling, Kueue, Volcano, KAI or similar open\-source schedulers. * Experience running Slurm on Kubernetes (Slinky or similar), or building Kubernetes operators for batch or HPC workloads. * Familiarity with RL, agentic or inference workloads and what they need from a scheduler: heterogeneous jobs, sandboxes, elastic scale and fast restarts. * Experience with workflow orchestrators such as Flyte, Airflow, Ray or Kubeflow at scale. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. jobs.description: **About the Role** We are building a fleet of specialized AI services that improve high\-value human workflows across the company. As a **Senior Software Engineer, Core AI,** you will design, build, evaluate, and operate production\-grade AI services and agents. You will own work end to end—from data and context design through tool use, application logic, evaluation, and production monitoring. **What You'll Do:** * **Build specialized AI services:** design jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test 5 - Discovery & Viewing Experiences
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. We’re hiring a senior Software Engineer in Test to lead how Netflix tests the experiences members use on their TVs and phones. You’ll define what quality means for complex, fast\-moving features, build the tools and automation that prove it, and help every engineer around you ship with confidence. **The Teams** **Live UI** The Discovery and Viewing Experience (DVX) Live team owns the UI engineering and architecture that powers Live viewing experiences across TV, iOS, and Android. Members show up for live events once, with no second airing and no patch mid\-show, so every feature we build is a promise that it will work at that moment on every device that tunes in. As our senior SDET, you’ll lead the way we test Live: recreating the moments a live event creates, like a vote opening just as an ad ends, long before the event does, so we know we’re ready instead of finding out during the show. **What we’re working on:** * The FIFA Women's World Cup, coming to Netflix in 2027 and 2031, will feature new experiences built for global, multi\-match sport tournaments. * Interactive and navigational features that help members move through a live event and catch the moments that matter. * Real\-time voting , which lets members influence a live show as it unfolds, alongside millions of others watching at the same moment. **Mobile Core** The DVX Mobile Core team develops and advances the architecture of Netflix's Android member app. We leverage systems and infrastructure widely available at Netflix and determine the best way to adopt and apply them on Android, enabling easier, more efficient patterns for downstream product engineering teams. **What we’re working on** : * Modernizing our app architecture for the iOS and Android member app. This involves driving migrations and a cross\-platform Player rewrite, creating leverage for product teams to ship faster and more reliably on iOS and Android. * Driving Quality of Experience (QoE). Owning monitoring and performance improvements across Player UI and canvases, as we scale. **The Role** **Problem you’ll help solve:** * Testing and making sure millions of members see our Live\-specific UI features and capabilities at the right moment, on every TV and phone. * Giving every platform the same test plan, so TV, iOS, and Android are consistently validated the same way. * Making tests reliable enough that PMs, designers, engineers, and our partners trust them, and fast enough to run on every change. * Keeping quality steady while the iOS and Android apps modernize, including a cross\-platform player rewrite, so faster delivery doesn’t come with more regressions. **What you’ll do:** * **Lead testing for complex features across platforms.** Agree on one test plan per feature that teams can trust and validate together, and implement it on TV, iOS, and Android, rather than reconciling differences afterward. * **Build automation that people trust.** Evolve our test systems and CI integration across platforms so tests are fast and reliable. * **Make tricky live moments easy to test.** Build ways to recreate them on demand instead of waiting for a real event, using mocks, overrides, real devices, and test data that looks like a real event and doesn’t expire. * **Make large migrations safe.** Build the test strategy that lets the iOS and Android apps modernize without regressions reaching members * **Own quality metrics.** Track how well we’re covered, how reliable our tests are, and which bugs reach members, and use that to decide what to improve next. That includes the client metrics that reveal problems only scale shows, and the alerts that tell us about them quickly. * **Make sure bugs only surprise us once.** When a bug reaches members, make sure it comes back as a test, using agents to turn each finding into several, and document how to test each feature so the knowledge doesn’t live in one person’s head. * **Build and leverage AI tools.** Act as a force multiplier to flag unwanted behaviors before they reach members, and apply agents to test authoring, failure triage, and bug analysis. * **Shape testability from the first commit.** Partner with engineers on architecture and code that are easy to test, and help them write better tests themselves. * **Test where teams meet.** Agree with partner teams on the contracts between our features and theirs, so end\-to\-end tests verify where teams meet and rehearse what members experience, rather than retesting every team’s systems. * **Collaborate beyond the team.** Work with partner teams on shared test data, environments, and tools, and with teams that run live event ort working across platforms.** You’ve tested consumer apps on more than one platform, and you’re eager to learn the platforms you haven’t used yet. * **Strong coding skills,** with experience designing and building test frameworks and tools, not just writing test cases. * **Experience or strong interest in using AI for testing** , such as writing tests, triaging failures, or finding gaps in coverage, with clear ways to check its results. * Deep experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and diagnosing flaky tests, infrastructure failures, and dependency issues. * Experience with mocking, test data, or other ways to make hard\-to\-reproduce situations repeatable in tests. * A practical, risk\-based approach to quality: knowing where to invest in tests, which risks are acceptable, and when more testing isn’t the answer. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including explaining quality risks and trade\-offs to engineers, product managers, and partners in terms they can act on. * Alignment with Netflix's culture and values. **Nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with live streaming, video playback, ads, or other systems where split\-second timing matters. * Hands\-on experience with testing frameworks on several platforms, such as Jest, Puppeteer, Espresso, or XCUITest. * Experience driving shared testing infrastructure or quality strategies adopted by multiple teams. * Experience testing how systems behave when things go wrong, such as chaos testing or failure drills. **Growth opportunities:** We’re hiring a senior engineer, and we see this role growing into one that sets the standard for how Netflix tests its Live experiences and mobile apps at scale. Over time, you can: * **Lead testing strategy across teams** , creating the practices and tools that other teams adopt. * **Shape client architecture for testability** across platforms. * **Influence partner teams' tooling and roadmaps** , so our experiences are easy to test for everyone. * **Mentor and grow** engineers and SDETs across the organization. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $266,000\.00 \- $442,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. jobs.title: Process Chemist | Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a motivated, curious, and detail\-oriented **Process Chemist (or Engineer)** to join our R\&D team at Novex. This role focuses on laboratory studies and the development of processes to extract, separate, and purify elements from a variety of liquid and solid materials. You will plan and conduct experiments, evaluate how operating conditions affect process performance and product quality, analyze results, and recommend next steps. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science and engineering, hydrometallurgy, biotechnology, and pharmaceuticals, as well as other laboratory or manufacturing fields. Recent graduates and candidates interested in applying their experience to a new field are encouraged to apply. We value curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to tackle challenging and exciting experiments, learn new techniques, and explore unfamiliar problems. This position is based at our R\&D facility in Bellingham, WA, and offers substantial opportunities to learn, grow professionally, and take on increasing responsibility while contributing to innovative research and process development projects. ### **Why join us?** * **Work on meaningful scientific challenges.** Contribute to cutting\-edge projects focused on critical materials recovery, separation, and purification. * **Put advanced equipment to work.** Gain hands\-on access to a unique suite of analytical and materials characterization instruments, alongside laboratory automation and robotic platforms from **Hamilton, Chemspeed, Sirius Automation, ABB, and FESTO**. Connect detailed material analysis with automated experimentation to investigate complex problems and develop better processes. * **Keep learning and growing.** Expand your expertise across chemistry, engineering, materials science, and automation through challenging experiments and collaborative research. Take on increasing responsibility and help shape new research directions as your skills develop. * **Enjoy flexibility and professional development.** Benefit from flexible work arrangements that accommodate laboratory and project needs, along with opportunities to develop your technical skills and advance your career. * **Make an impact in a growing team.** Bring your ideas, contribute to technical decisions, and see your work help move promising concepts from laboratory studies toward practical applications. * **Live and work between the mountains and the sea.** Bellingham, Washington, offers access to skiing at Mount Baker, sailing in the San Juan Islands, and hiking through Pacific Northwest forests. Enjoy a vibrant local community, cultural attractions, and the character of a smaller city, with Seattle and Vancouver, BC, within reach. **Requirements** ### **Required qualifications and skills** * A bachelor’s or an advanced (M.Sc. or Ph.D.) degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science and engineering, metallurgy, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related scientific or engineering field. * Demonstrated hands\-on laboratory experience with strong understanding of relevant chemical principles and proficiency in laboratory calculations, including solution preparation, concentrations, dilutions, stoichiometry, and material balances. * Ability to plan, execute, and troubleshoot controlled experiments; identify relevant variables; and maintain consistent, reproducible test conditions. * Proficiency with quantitative data analysis, including evaluating variability, identifying trends and inconsistencies, and drawing conclusions supported by experimental evidence. * Ability to operate laboratory equipment, follow and critically evaluate experimental procedures, and maintain accurate, traceable records of samples, methods, conditions, and results. * Strong technical communication skills, including preparing clear experimental summaries, test reports, and recommendations for subsequent work. * Demonstrated commitment to laboratory safety, including chemical handling, hazard assessment, and proper waste management. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating effectively with the team. ### **Good to have:** * Experience with analytical instrumentation, experimental design, process development, or scale\-up. * Laboratory or process experience in chemical manufacturing, metallurgy and hydrometallurgy, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or environmental testing. * Experience with separation and purification methods, such as leaching, precipitation, solvent extraction, ion exchange, filtration, or electrochemistry. * **Experience working with laboratory automation**, including automated liquid handling, robotic platforms, instrument integration, or programming and troubleshooting automated experimental workflows. * **Experience using laboratory information management systems (LIMS)** for sample tracking, experimental documentation, data management, and workflow coordination. Novex provides training in its specific methods, equipment, and workflows. Candidates are expected to bring a solid foundation in laboratory practice, quantitative analysis, and scientific problem\-solving. ### **Work authorization** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States for Novex by their start date. Novex does not offer employment visa sponsorship. However, limited employer support for TN status may be considered for eligible Canadian citizens on a case\-by\-case basis, depending on the position’s duties, the applicant’s qualifications, and the required documentation. **Benefits** * Salary will be commensurate with experience and qualifications. * Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance. * Retirement savings plan with employer matching. * Paid time off, including vacation, sick leave, and holidays. * Professional development opportunities, including conference attendance and training support.

jobs.title: Process Engineer | Scientist - Materials Processing & Metallization
jobs.description: We are seeking a motivated, curious, and hands\-on **Process Engineer** with **at least five years of relevant experience** in materials processing, metallurgical process development, or related thermal and electrochemical technologies to join our R\&D team at Novex. This role combines **thermal processing, electrochemistry, and materials science** with laboratory and pilot\-scale engineering. A key responsibility is turning experimental concepts into working systems: designing and building custom equipment, testing and commissioning it, and integrating it into automated and robotic laboratory workflows supported by a laboratory information management system (LIMS). We welcome candidates who bring strong technical foundations, practical engineering skills, and a willingness to tackle challenging experiments and unfamiliar problems. This position is based at our R\&D facility in Bellingham, WA, and offers opportunities to expand your expertise, take ownership of technical projects, and help advance new materials processing and metallization technologies. ### **Why join us?** * **Work on meaningful scientific and engineering challenges.** Contribute to cutting\-edge projects focused on critical materials processing, metallization, and alloying. * **Put advanced equipment to work.** Gain hands\-on access to a unique suite of analytical and materials characterization instruments, alongside laboratory automation and robotic platforms from **Hamilton, Chemspeed, Sirius Automation, ABB, and FESTO**. Connect detailed material analysis with thermal processing, electrochemistry, and automated experimentation to develop better processes. * **Keep learning and growing.** Expand your expertise across metallurgy, chemistry, materials science, electrochemistry, and automation through challenging experiments and collaborative research. Take on increasing responsibility and help shape new research directions. * **Enjoy flexibility and professional development.** Benefit from flexible work arrangements that accommodate laboratory and project needs, along with opportunities to develop your technical skills and advance your career. * **Make an impact in a growing team.** Bring your ideas, contribute to technical decisions, and see your work move from experimental concepts to functioning equipment and pilot\-scale demonstrations. * **Live and work between the mountains and the sea.** Bellingham, Washington, offers access to skiing at Mount Baker, sailing in the San Juan Islands, and hiking through Pacific Northwest forests. Enjoy a vibrant local community, cultural attractions, and the character of a smaller city, with Seattle and Vancouver, BC, within reach. ### **Our in\-house capabilities** Our Innovation Center brings process development, advanced characterization, and pilot testing together, including: * **Materials characterization:** SEM, TEM, AFM, XRD, XRF, particle\-size analysis, and rheology. * **Chemical and thermal analysis:** ICP\-MS/OES, atomic absorption (AA), LC\-MS, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, and thermogravimetric analysis (TGA). * **Thermal and electrochemical processing:** Controlled\-atmosphere furnaces, potentiostats, galvanostats, impedance analysis, and electrochemical reactors. * **Laboratory and pilot equipment:** Reactors, pressure systems, milling, and powder preparation equipment. * **Automation and robotics:** Robotic sample handling, automated liquid and powder dosing, automated reaction platforms, instrumentation, and process monitoring. ### **What you jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer — Risk & AI
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: *We Before Me*, *Do the Right Thing*, and *Get Things Done*. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK\-er. **About the Opportunity** ------------------------- Building machine learning systems for risk at a global crypto exchange is fundamentally different from conventional ML engineering. The data spans on\-chain activity, fiat deposits and withdrawals, trading behaviour, account access patterns, device intelligence, identity information, and customer interactions—signals that very few organizations can analyze together. The problems are complex, adversarial, and constantly evolving. Models must identify emerging fraud patterns, scams, account takeovers, payment abuse, and other forms of financial risk while minimizing disruption to legitimate customers. Success is not measured only through offline model metrics. It is measured through prevented losses, improved approval rates, reduced false positives, faster investigations, and more reliable customer experience. This role sits within a multidisciplinary risk team of machine learning engineers, data scientists, risk strategy specialists, analytics engineers, product managers, and operations teams. You will work across the full ML lifecycle — from problem formulation, feature engineering, and model development to real\-time deployment, monitoring, experimentation, and continuous iteration. You will also help shape how AI is used across the risk organization. LLM\-assisted development, automated model workflows, AI\-powered investigations, and intelligent review agents are part of the team's daily work. We are looking for engineers who already use these tools effectively and can help establish safe, scalable, and production\-ready AI practices. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build models and AI tools that help detect fraud and protect users at a global crypto exchange. You'll apply deep learning and XGBoost, develop practical AI agents, and use AI coding tools in your daily work. * Build, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models for fraud and risk detection. * Improve data quality, features, and model performance, balancing fraud detection with customer experience. * Develop AI agents to support investigations, summarize cases, retrieve evidence, and automate routine workflows. * Use AI coding tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging while reviewing and validating their output. * Work with engineering, product, and risk teams to deploy solutions and monitor their impact. **What We Look For In You** --------------------------- * A strong foundation in machine learning, with hands\-on experience in deep learning and tree\-based models such as XGBoost or LightGBM. * Strong Python skills and experience training, evaluating, and deploying models. * Some practical experience building AI agents or LLM applications, including tool calling, retrieval, or workflow automation. Prototypes and personal projects are welcome. * Regular use of AI coding tools, with the ability to understand, test, and improve generated code. * Familiarity with databases and data pipelines for preparing training data and supporting ML workflows. * Good problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Experience in account takeover (ATO), scam detection, or other fraud and risk use cases. * Experience with LLM training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, and alignment. * Experience with reinforcement learning algorithms and their practical implementation. * Experience with real\-time ML systems, imbalanced datasets, or model explainability. * Prior fraud or risk experience is helpful * Fluency in Mandarin **Perks \& Benefits** --------------------- * Competitive total compensation package * L\&D programs for employees' growth and development * Various team building programs and company events * Wellness and meal allowances * Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants * More that we love to tell you along the process! **OKX** **Statement:** OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non\-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. The salary range for this position is $214,666 to $321,999 The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long\-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Applicants should apply via OKX internal or external careers site. \#LI\-SK1 \#LI\-HYBRID Notice: All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third\-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. **If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.** Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer, GTM
jobs.description: OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com. **Job Summary** --------------- OpenGov is seeking an AI Solutions Engineer to serve as a dedicated practitioner within the Applied AI team, focused on Sales/GTM use cases across the revenue organization — SDR outbound, AE pipeline and opportunity management, and CSM account management and renewals — along with the account/opportunity intelligence that feeds all three. This role sits at the intersection of seller workflows, revenue systems, and applied AI, and includes hands\-on GTM engineering: building the workflows, integrations, and automations across revenue systems that make sellers faster. It exists to systematically redesign how OpenGov's revenue organization runs its motion in an AI\-native world, from lead through cash and the renewals that follow. This is a technical role applied in a traditionally non\-technical space. You bring a sharp problem\-solving mind, comfort with modern AI tools, and the instinct to decompose a complex, manual seller workflow into its components — and then design something fundamentally better. You need the ability to think from first principles, build trust with sellers and RevOps before designing for them, and own the full lifecycle from problem discovery to solution adoption. You will build the agents and systems that turn raw go\-to\-market signal (procurement data, contract/vendor intelligence, account and contact records, call and email activity) into action sellers actually take — signal\-to\-sequence automation for SDR outbound, next\-best\-action and deal\-risk surfacing for AE opportunity management, and account\-health and renewal\-risk surfacing for CSMs. You will also serve as product owner for systems built entirely in house, and be the primary AI capability advisor for the revenue organization. This role operates within the Applied AI team's technical ecosystem. You will partner closely with a dedicated analytics/ops counterpart on the sales side, partner with AI and data engineers on complex builds, and work directly with sales leadership, RevOps, and SDR/AE/CSM teams for domain guidance and go\-to\-market context. Given the revenue\-centric focus of this work, this role requires a genuine interest in driving conversion across the funnel (such as contact\-to\-meeting rate, S1/S2 conversion, and win rate), along with deal\-cycle length and renewal outcomes. Pipeline management itself sits with sales leadership and RevOps, and you will work closely with them. You will not own KPI definitions or reporting, but you will apply the necessary rigor and ROI framing to make sure what gets built is actually moving those numbers. You will have access to data, ownership, and core responsibilities at a level comparable to senior sales leadership, and are expected to exercise that with corresponding discretion. **You Will…** ------------- * **Own the AI\-native signal\-to\-action layer for Sales**: design, build, and continuously improve the agents and automations that turn account/contact/product signal into qualified SDR sequences, AE opportunity actions, and CSM account and renewal actions, with clear human review and approval points before anything reaches a prospect or customer. * **Build for AE and CSM workflows specifically, not just top\-of\-funnel outbound**: deal\-risk and next\-best\-action surfacing for AEs managing opportunities through the pipeline, and account\-health, renewal\-risk, and expansion\-signal surfacing for CSMs managing customers through renewal — this role's scope is the revenue organization, not one segment of it. * **Serve as product owner for systems built entirely in house**: drive the roadmap, prioritization, and quality bar for the call\- and deal\-intelligence and other revenue systems the Applied AI team builds, in partnership with sales leadership and the RevOps/analytics counterpart. * **Design the human oversight for every agent you ship**: approval gates, escalation paths, and clear ownership boundaries so SDRs, AEs, and CSMs stay in control of what goes out under their name — an agent recommends and drafts, a human approves and sends. * **Build and run evaluation frameworks for agent behavi  tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar), and working fluency with SQL; able to extract insight from data and frame it clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Self\-starter with high initiative: you see opportunities, propose solutions, and drive them forward without waiting to be told. This role will involve significant ambiguity, and the right person will find that energizing rather than paralyzing. * Exceptional written and verbal communication: you write clearly, you do not create information silos, and you know how to tailor your message to the audience in front of you. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Prior experience in sales/revenue operations, customer success operations, or a forward\-deployed/solutions\-architecture role. * Experience with Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, or building MCP servers. * Familiarity with AI governance concepts: prompt design, data access controls, audit trails, and responsible AI principles in sensitive\-data environments. * Experience building or deploying workflow automations or internal tools without engineering support. * Familiarity with Snowflake, Looker, or similar data platforms at a data analysis level (not data engineering). * Applied ML and experimentation background: A/B testing, propensity models, recommendations, or lead/account scoring. * Experience working in a fast\-moving, high\-growth SaaS environment where the org is actively evolving and priorities shift quickly. * Experience working at the intersection of Sales and Marketing, or Sales and RevOps — roles that required navigating cross\-functional data ownership and system permissions. * Prior exposure to public sector or B2G sales, or other environments with elevated data handling standards. **Compensation** ---------------- Chicago, IL: $150,000 \- $165,000 On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance. The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location. **Why OpenGov?** ================ **A Mission That Matters.** At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy. **Opportunity to Innovate** The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started. **A Team of Passionate, Driven People** This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. **A Place to Make Your Mark** We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within. **Benefits That Work for You** Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including: * Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families * Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays * 401(k) with company match * Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions * Professional development and growth opportunities * A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches. Compensation Range: $150K \- $165K

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology, to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** As a **Senior AI/ML Engineer** within Optum Technology, you will design and deliver enterprise\-scale AI solutions, platforms, and automations that transform healthcare delivery and operations. In this role, you will build scalable ML models, optimize data pipelines, and integrate advanced artificial intelligence architectures into production environments with an emphasis on responsible AI use. Working alongside cross\-functional teams of data scientists, software engineers, and product leaders, you will evaluate emerging trends, streamline complex workflows, and deploy cutting\-edge technologies to solve high\-impact healthcare challenges. You will enjoy the flexibility to telecommute\* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with an emphasis on responsible use of AI * Design, develop, and deploy scalable artificial intelligence and machine learning models into cloud\-based production environments * Use enterprise\-approved AI tools to streamline workflows, automate tasks, and drive continuous improvement * Evaluate emerging trends in artificial intelligence and machine learning to inform solution design and strategic innovation * Build, optimize, and maintain robust data pipelines and ML architectures for training, evaluation, and real\-time inference * Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to translate healthcare business requirements into technical AI/ML architecture * Monitor, evaluate, and fine\-tune model performance, latency, and accuracy in production environments * Establish best practices for MLOps, including automated testing, model monitoring, version control, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) * Conduct code reviews, mentor technical team members, and drive engineering excellence across the team You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in. **Required Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of overall Software engineering experience * 3\+ years of experience with a focus on designing, building, and deploying AI/ML models into enterprise production environments * 3\+ years of experience leveraging AI engineering tools and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit\-learn) to build automated solutions * 3\+ years of programming experience in Python and utilizing modern cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP) for machine learning development * 3\+ years of experience building and optimizing data pipelines and database architectures (e.g., SQL, Spark, Kafka * 2\+ years of experience with containerization, orchestration, and MLOps tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Kubeflow, or Airflow) **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelors or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field * Experience with Generative AI frameworks, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures * Experience building AI solutions within healthcare, including working with healthcare data standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7\) and privacy/security guidelines * Demonstrated experience mentoring technical team members and evaluating emerging technology trends for enterprise integration * All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $120,100 \- $214,500 annually based on full\-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. ***Application Deadline:*** *This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.* *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups, and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.* *UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.* *UnitedHealth Group is a drug\-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.* \#RPO \#GREEN

jobs.title: IT Business Systems Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra\-low\-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore. The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries. ### **About the Job** Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention. We're looking for a Business Systems Engineer to own the platforms our company runs on day to day and the connective tissue between them. Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, and Slack are where work actually happens here. You'll own how they're configured, and how they talk to each other. This role is for someone who reaches for an API when the admin console runs out of road. A lot of the work is eliminating the manual handoffs between systems: the spreadsheet someone maintains by hand, the ticket someone copies into a second tool, the approval that lives in a DM. You'll find those and replace them with something that runs itself. You'll partner across Finance, People Ops, and Engineering to understand what they need, then build it. Our IAM Engineer owns the identity plane, so you'll work together on SSO and provisioning for the applications you administer. Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. ### **Responsibilities** #### **Business Platform Administration** * Own Google Workspace administration: tenant configuration, organizational units, Drive and sharing governance, email routing and security, and rollout of new capabilities * Administer Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including projects, workflows, custom fields, forms, permission schemes, automation rules, and reporting * Own Slack workspace configuration: channel standards, app and integration approvals, retention, and Slack Connect governance * Maintain a clear administration model for each platform, including who can change what and how changes are reviewed #### **Integrations and Automation** * Design and build integrations between business systems using APIs, webhooks, and automation platforms * Write and maintain code that automates recurring work across SaaS tools, with version control, monitoring, and error handling * Replace manual processes and shadow spreadsheets with reliable, observable workflows * Own the reliability of the integrations you build, including alerting when they fail and runbooks for when they need help #### **Business Partnership** * Work with Finance, People Ops, Legal, and Engineering to translate process problems into system designs * Drive intake, requirements, and rollout for new business applications, including evaluation, pilot, and adoption * Build reporting and dashboards that give teams visibility into their own work * Document configurations and workflows so the next person can pick them up #### **SaaS Stack Health** * Maintain our SaaS application inventory, including ownership, license counts, and renewal dates * Right\-size licensing and surface underused spend * Partner with our IAM Engineer to bring applications under SSO and automated provisioning * Own the application layer of our compliance framework (NIST or equivalent), including access control, audit logging, and data retention ### **Required Qualifications** * Experience administering business platforms such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Atlassian products, or Slack at an organization of meaningful size * Experience writing code against SaaS APIs to automate work the admin console couldn't do * Experience designing and maintaining integrations between business systems using REST APIs, webhooks, or an integration platform * Ability to work directly with non\-technical stakeholders, understand the underlying process problem, and propose a system that solves it * Ability to write clear documentation for both administrators and end users ### **Desired Qualifications** * Atlassian experience: Jira workflow and permission scheme design, JSM request types and queues, and Confluence space administration * Google Workspace administration experience, including Drive governance, Vault, and security settings * Scripting and development skills (Python, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script) with source control and testing practices * Experience with SaaS lifecycle management: evaluation, implementation, renewal, and license optimization * Familiarity with SSO and SCIM from the application administrator's side * Experience supporting a security or compliance framework (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or equivalent) The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed. ### **Additional Requirements** * Available for occasional off\-hours work to support platform migrations and integration cutovers that have to land outside business hours * Travel to the Portland office quarterly if working remotely * Intermittently able to work longer hours to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work\-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours. ### **Compensation and Benefits** If hired for this full\-time role, you will receive: * Cash compensation of $120,000 \- $180,000\. * Equity in the company. We're all owners and if we're successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation. * A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: + Flexible paid time off + Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold\-level PPO plan for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long\-term financial support if you become disabled) + Ability to contribute to tax\-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA * Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed). ### **Location** This is ideally an on\-site position, based at our offices, lab, and shop inPortland, Oregon. **We will consider exceptional remote candidates who can commit to being on\-site in Portland, Oregon at least one week per quarter**.

jobs.description: ### **About the Company** We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. You'll build that system and the automation behind it. This is a high\-ownership individual contributor role. You'll administer Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace identity, design Conditional Access and context\-aware policy, automate joiner/mover/leaver, and bring every SaaS application in our stack under SSO and automated provisioning. You'll also help govern the identities that aren't people: service accounts, OAuth grants, and workload credentials. We have an established zero trust roadmap and a security framework to comply with, and your job is to turn both into enforceable technical controls and explain the reasoning well enough that the rest of the company comes along with you. Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. ### **Responsibilities** #### **Identity Infrastructure** * Administer Microsoft Entra ID, including user lifecycle, group management, dynamic membership rules, and role assignment. * Design and maintain Conditional Access policy, tying device compliance posture, identity signals, risk, and location to resource access. * Own authentication standards: MFA, phishing\-resistant methods, passwordless rollout, and legacy auth retirement. * Partner with our Endpoint Engineer so access policy and device posture stay in sync. #### **Access Automation and Lifecycle** * Automate joiner, mover, and leaver so access is granted and revoked from a source of truth rather than a ticket. * Manage SSO integrations and application provisioning via SAML and SCIM across our SaaS stack. * Build and run access review and recertification cycles that produce evidence auditors accept. * Implement least privilege for privileged roles, including just\-in\-time elevation and break\-glass procedures. #### **Non\-Human Identity and Governance** * Govern service accounts, OAuth grants, and API credentials: naming conventions, ownership, scope review, and rotation. * Establish where secrets live and how they are issued, stored, and retired. * Maintain a defensible inventory of who and what can reach our systems. #### **Security and Compliance** * Advance our zero trust roadmap and translate policy into enforceable technical controls. * Own the access control domain of our compliance framework (NIST or equivalent), including documentation and evidence. * Partner with information security leadership on access control policy, identity threat detection, and incident response involving compromised accounts. ### **Required Qualifications** * Experience administering identity and access in a modern IdP, including user lifecycle, groups, and conditional or context\-aware access. * Experience implementing SSO and provisioning integrations (SAML, SCIM) across a SaaS stack. * Automation experience: scripting or API work against identity and SaaS platforms rather than console\-only administration. * Ability to write clear documentation and turn written policy into enforceable technical controls. * Ability to explain the reasoning behind an access decision to a non\-technical audience and get buy\-in. ### **Desired Qualifications** * Experience owning an IdP at a growing technology company. * Familiarity with zero trust architecture and how it translates into identity controls. * Experience with identity governance and administration: access reviews, entitlement management, and privileged access. * Experience governing non\-human identities, service accounts, and OAuth scopes. * Experience supporting or implementing a security or compliance framework (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or equivalent). * Experience with identity threat detection and response, or investigating account compromise. The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed. ### **Additional Requirements** * Available for occasional off\-hours work to support identity migrations, tenant changes, and access cutovers that have to land outside business hours. * Participate in incident response when accounts or credentials are involved, including outside business hours. * Travel to the Portland office quarterly if working remotely. * Intermittently able to work longer hours to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work\-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours. ### **Compensation and Benefits** If hired for this full\-time role, you will receive: * Cash compensation of $120,000 \- $180,000\. * Equity in the company. We're all owners and if we're successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation. * A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: + Flexible paid time off + Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold\-level PPO plan for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long\-term financial support if you become disabled) + Ability to contribute to tax\-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA * Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed). ### **Location** This is ideally an on\-site position, based at our offices, lab, and shop inPortland, Oregon. **We will consider exceptional remote candidates who can commit to being on\-site in Portland, Oregon at least one week per quarter.**
