jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Manufacturing Test
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip\-to\-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first\-generation Atlas systems are already in production on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders. **Role Overview** ----------------- As a Senior Software Engineer on our Manufacturing Test team, you will build the reliable test software that verifies the quality of Positron hardware, catches defects before systems ship, and produces diagnostics that engineers can act on. You will own tests from initial development through production deployment, partnering closely with hardware, firmware, and manufacturing teams to improve test coverage, repeatability, and failure isolation. This is a hands\-on senior role for an engineer who writes production Go, understands systems down to the hardware, and uses agentic coding tools to move fast without compromising rigor. This role is based in\-office at our Spokane Valley, WA location. Candidates must be able to work on\-site as required. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Test Development in Go*** Design, build, and maintain production\-quality manufacturing tests in Go with clearly defined pass/fail criteria, actionable diagnostics, and thorough documentation. * Develop hardware tests and diagnostics across PCIe/AER, CPU, memory, I²C, SPI, PRBS, NICs, BMC/IPMI/Redfish, and drive I/O. * Build system\-level functional, stress, reliability, and performance tests for Positron platforms. **Test Strategy and Validation*** Translate platform requirements and failure modes into prioritized coverage plans with measurable pass/fail criteria, balancing defect detection, runtime, and repeatability. * Validate test effectiveness against known\-good hardware and representative failures, and maintain automated regression coverage as tests evolve. **Failure Analysis and Cross\-Functional Partnership*** Investigate ambiguous failures and isolate root causes across hardware, firmware, and operating system boundaries. * Partner with hardware, firmware, and manufacturing teams to close coverage gaps, and clearly communicate risks and tradeoffs across teams. **Agentic Development*** Direct coding agents through well\-scoped tasks to accelerate implementation, debugging, and test development, while retaining full accountability for design, correctness, code review, and hardware validation. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 5\+ years demonstrated experience designing, shipping, debugging, and maintaining production\-quality Go software, including concurrency, error handling, automated testing, and maintainable interfaces. * Experience with FPGA, AI, Inference HW test. * A strong understanding of computer architecture, including CPUs, memory, PCIe, storage, networking, and the interactions among hardware, firmware, and operating systems. * Hands\-on experience writing hardware tests and isolating failures across multiple domains such as PCIe/AER, CPU, I²C, SPI, memory, PRBS, NICs, BMC/IPMI/Redfish, and drive I/O. * Proven ability to turn platform requirements and failure modes into prioritized coverage, measurable pass/fail criteria, and validation plans. * Practical skill directing coding agents through well\-scoped tasks, providing relevant context, critically reviewing generated changes, and verifying behavior through software tests and hardware validation. * Senior\-level engineering ownership, with the ability to independently drive test development and technical decisions and to communicate coverage gaps and tradeoffs across teams. * Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or similar equivalent additional years of experience **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * A track record of delivering and supporting hardware tests at contract manufacturers, including deployment, station qualification, documentation, and remote troubleshooting. * Familiarity with analyzing manufacturing test data to improve coverage, reduce false failures, and shorten debugging time. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines, automated regression infrastructure, and test release management processes. ### **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Success in this role means delivering production\-ready hardware tests in Go that carry clearly defined pass/fail criteria, actionable diagnostics, automated regression coverage, and solid documentation, with their effectiveness proven against both known\-good hardware and representative failures. It also means using agentic coding to accelerate implementation, debugging, and test development while remaining fully accountable for design, correctness, review, and hardware validation. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Own the test software that stands between a new class of AI inference hardware and production, with direct influence on the quality of every system Positron ships. * Work across the full stack, from PCIe and BMC to system\-level stress testing, alongside hardware, firmware, and manufacturing engineers bringing Asimov and Titan to market. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $250,000\. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.**Health and wellness*** Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available **Time off and flexibility*** Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge * 13 paid company holidays * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup **Compensation and future*** Competitive salary and equity * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of Software Architecture
jobs.description: **ABOUT POWER FACTORS** Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.\* Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data\-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end\-to\-end support, including solutions for SCADA \& PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management. With deep domain expertise, AI\-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code. * Outside China and India **ABOUT THE ROLE** Power Factors is scaling in complexity — more products, more platforms, more sophisticated buyers, and rapidly rising expectations for AI\-native capability across our renewable energy software suite. In that context, the absence of a single, accountable technical vision creates real risk: divergent architectural patterns across verticals, inconsistent approaches to AI and data platform investment, and technical debt that compounds faster than it can be paid down. The Head of Software Architecture exists to close that gap. This is a hands\-on, deeply technical leadership role responsible for defining and enforcing enterprise architecture standards across Power Factors' Product \& Technology organization — spanning Platform, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps, and CAM/FSM/Product Ops — while personally architecting and prototyping the hardest problems the organization faces, particularly around AI\-based product introductions, IoT data acquisition, and multi\-tenant SaaS scalability. This role combines the strategic scope of an enterprise architect with the credibility of a builder who still writes code, reviews pull requests, and is comfortable being the most technical person in the room. ### **Purpose of the Role** The Head of Software Architecture acts to define, evangelize, and enforce a coherent technical architecture strategy that allows Power Factors to scale product complexity without sacrificing reliability, security, or development velocity. * **Enterprise\-wide architectural coherence:** Technical decisions across verticals are grounded in shared architectural principles, not siloed team preferences. * **AI\-native product development:** New AI\-based product capabilities are architected end\-to\-end — from data pipeline to model integration to user\-facing experience — rather than bolted on. * **Development velocity multiplication:** Engineering teams are equipped with modern AI\-assisted development tooling and workflows that materially increase throughput. * **Deep technical credibility:** Engineering leaders and individual contributors alike see this role as a working architect, not a slide\-deck strategist. * **Domain\-informed design:** Architecture decisions reflect genuine understanding of renewable energy operations — SCADA, EMS, PPC, edge devices, and grid\-facing data systems. This role acts as the connective tissue between the CPTO's organizational strategy and the day\-to\-day technical decisions made by vertical engineering teams. ### **Core Responsibilities** ### **1\. Enterprise Architecture \& Complex System Design** * Define and maintain Power Factors' enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, and technical guardrails across all verticals * Lead architectural reviews for major initiatives, ensuring consistency, scalability, and long\-term maintainability * Own the technical roadmap for cross\-cutting platform capabilities (data platform, integration layer, identity, observability) * Design for complex, high\-availability systems where correctness, latency, and data integrity carry real operational and commercial consequences * Partner with vertical leaders (SCADA, EMS, APM, Platform, CloudOps) to ensure local architecture decisions align with enterprise direction ### **2\. Technical Team Leadership** * Build and lead a distributed architecture function that operates as a trusted technical authority across Greece, Montreal, and other regions * Mentor senior engineers and engineering leaders on architectural judgment, system design, and technical tradeoff analysis * Establish and run architecture governance forums (design reviews, RFC processes, technical steering committees) * Act as a technical escalation point for the highest\-stakes design decisions across the organ e energy or broader energy sector software (strongly preferred, not required) * **Machine Learning \& Data Science:** solid working knowledge sufficient to make informed architectural and platform decisions * **MCP \& LLM\-Based Products:** hands\-on experience with Model Context Protocol, development LLMs, and building LLM\-based product features * **Cloud Platforms:** deep experience with GCP and/or AWS at an architectural level * **AI Development Tooling:** experience selecting and rolling out AI dev tools that meaningfully increase engineering team productivity * **SaaS \& Multi\-Tenant Architecture:** advanced experience designing and scaling multi\-tenant SaaS applications * **Mobile App Development:** working knowledge of mobile architecture and delivery, sufficient to guide teams building mobile experiences ### **Core Capabilities** * Strong systems thinking with the ability to zoom between enterprise strategy and line\-level code * Executive\-level communication — able to translate architectural tradeoffs into business terms for the CPTO and executive team * Comfortable operating with significant technical authority while remaining collaborative and low\-ego * Genuine enthusiasm for staying current with the fast\-moving AI and LLM landscape ### **Background Fit** * Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, VP of Engineering, or Chief Architect background * Experience operating in a scaling, multi\-product SaaS organization * Comfortable being both the enterprise architecture authority and an individual contributor when the problem demands it ### **Success Metrics (KPIs)** * Number of AI\-based product capabilities architected and shipped to production per year * Measured productivity gains (velocity, cycle time) attributable to AI development tooling rollout * Reduction in cross\-vertical architectural inconsistency and duplicated platform investment * System reliability and performance metrics for enterprise\-critical and transactional systems * Adoption rate of architectural standards and reference designs across engineering teams * Qualitative 360° feedback from engineering leaders on technical leadership effectiveness ### **What This Role Is Not** This role is not a purely strategic or advisory position removed from the codebase, and it is not a people\-management role focused primarily on process and reporting. The Head of Software Architecture is expected to remain a credible, hands\-on technical contributor throughout their tenure. The role also does not own product roadmap prioritization or commercial strategy — those remain with Product Management and the CPTO — but it directly shapes what is technically possible and how quickly it can be delivered. **LIFE @ POWER FACTORS** We are an agile software development company – big enough to make an impact, but small enough to move quickly and execute in a growing industry. We are a team of bold and ingenious talents driven by results. We are passionate about making the world a better place. We seek fierce and humble people to help us achieve our ambitious plan. **WHY JOIN US** By joining the Power Factors team, you’ll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. Our culture runs deep and shows up in how we work together \- committed, conscientious and collaborative. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry. **WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** Power Factors is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to engaging a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - BESS

You will work hands\-on in Python and modern AI frameworks to develop production\-grade analytical models that address complex problems in battery performance, state\-of\-health estimation, degradation forecasting, dispatch optimization, and asset lifecycle management. You will collaborate closely with software development teams, product management, and technically sophisticated customers to translate real\-world operational challenges into robust analytical solutions integrated into Power Factors' core platform. Your work will directly inform product capabilities used by leading BESS asset owners and operators globally. This position offers the opportunity to apply advanced analytics at unprecedented scale to materially improve the performance and economics of battery energy storage assets worldwide. **ABOUT YOU** You are a **senior\-level data scientist and recognized BESS subject matter expert** with substantial experience working with utility\-scale battery energy storage systems. modeling * Augmentation strategy and capacity fade forecasting * Thermal runaway risk modeling or fault detection * Experience with real\-time or near\-real\-time analytics pipelines * Hands\-on experience with data engineering concepts, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and scalable data pipelines * Knowledge of power markets, capacity markets, ancillary services, PPAs, or grid jobs.title: System Administrator
jobs.description: **JOB TITLE:** System Administrator **DEPARTMENT:** Office \- IT **LOCATION:** Dublin, TX **PAY:** $60,000 \- $75,000/yr **BENEFITS:** Benefits include a full health insurance policy that is 100% covered by Prime, a 50% matching 401(k) package, and a $25,000 life insurance policy. Comprehensive dental, vision and supplemental life insurance options are also available. PTO is available after 6 months. 7 paid holidays. **SUMMARY:** Our System Administrator reports to the CIO and runs the day\-to\-day operation of Prime’s IT environment across all locations, including end\-user devices, Microsoft 365, networking, phones, servers, and backups. Working with our Senior Systems Engineer, they take over systems once they are built and are responsible for keeping them maintained, monitored, secure, and documented. They also handle escalated support issues and cover the help desk when needed. This is a hands\-on role on a small team, so the right person is comfortable working independently and owning their work from start to finish. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Serve as the escalation point for support issues and provide tier 1 help desk coverage as needed; troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, printer, and connectivity issues in person, by phone, and remotely. * Own the device lifecycle: set up, image, deploy, and retire computers, laptops, mobile devices, and peripherals for new hires, role changes, and departures. * Administer user accounts, groups, licenses, and permissions in Microsoft 365 and the company’s directory, collaboration, and file\-sharing services. * Maintain the IT asset inventory system, keeping device assignments, serial numbers, and warranty information current. * Administer and maintain the network across company locations, including firewalls, switches, and wireless access points; diagnose and resolve connectivity issues. * Administer the company VoIP phone system, including extensions, call routing, provisioning desk phones, and resolving call issues. * Maintain server and backup infrastructure, including patching and updates, verifying backups and restores, reviewing logs, and performing routine maintenance. * Enforce security best practices such as patching, endpoint protection, multi\-factor authentication, and least\-privilege access; investigate and respond to security alerts and suspicious activity. * Monitor alerts and system health across all sites and resolve issues before they affect users. * Take over new systems from the Senior Systems Engineer once built, and work with vendors on support cases and service issues. * Write and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, and checklists for systems, configurations, and procedures. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience. * 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in systems administration, IT administration, or desktop support. * Working knowledge of desktop and server operating systems, cloud productivity suites, and networking (IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Wi\-Fi). * Familiarity with command\-line tools or scripting is a plus. * Industry certifications in IT support, networking, or security are a plus. * Strong verbal communication skills and a patient, friendly approach when helping non\-technical employees. * Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and keep thorough documentation. * Valid driver’s license and ability to travel occasionally between company locations; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events. * **Analytical** \- Synthesizes complex or diverse information; Collects and researches data; Uses intuition and experience to complement data; Designs workflows and procedures. * **Attendance/Punctuality** \- Is consistently at work and on time; Ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent; Arrives at meetings and appointments on time. * **Dependability** \- Follows instructions, responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Keeps commitments; Is available for after\-hours support or maintenance when necessary; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan. * **Ethics** \- Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values. * **Initiative** \- Volunteers readily; Undertakes self\-development activities; Seeks increased responsibilities; Takes independent actions and calculated risks; Looks for and takes advantage of opportunities; Asks for and offers help when needed. * **Communication** \- Explains technical issues clearly to non\-technical employees; Listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions; Writes clear, accurate documentation and procedures. * **Problem Solving** \- Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics. * **Quality** \- Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality. * **Teamwork** \- Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed. * **Technical Skills** \- Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares expertise with others. *The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.* *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (GenAI, AWS)
jobs.description: **At Provectus**, you don’t prototype in a sandbox and hand a client a slide deck. You embed inside a bank, an insurer, or a health system, learn the work, and ship a Claude \+ AWS system into their real, regulated production. Then you watch the business number move. We’re an **Anthropic** and **AWS Partner** with 150\+ certified architects. That means the newest models, real budgets, and problems that matter, without the layers, politics, and long wait for impact of a firm with a hundred thousand people. 350\+ builders, 100\+ customers in production, led by our founders since 2010, offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA ### **Why Provectus?** * **Frontier access. Anthropic Preferred Partner:** newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems. * **Real tasks (not scope), real deployment.** You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive. * **Embedded, not engaged.** You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process, not a vendor running a project alongside it. Embedded is not staff augmentation. * **Autonomous**. You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. * **Your experience stays portable.** Every engagement is a new problem, often in a new industry, so your skills compound instead of narrowing to one product. No legacy maintenance grind, not a single stack. * **Craft \& growth.** Build beside senior FDEs on a Claude certified team, with a real platform (talks, OSS) to grow your name. * **We give you a stage:** Claude certification, conference talks, open source contributions, published work under your own name. ### **What you’ll do:** * Spend the first weeks of each engagement in the operator’s seat, learning the constraints from the inside, then rebuild the function from first principles alongside the client and a Forward Deployed Executive. You are the one who builds it * Be part of the customer’s team, inside their process; work on real tasks, not scoped deliverables, and own the method autonomously * You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry Blueprints, working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it * Deliver across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare * Help shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment; help build the tooling and frameworks of a growing AI delivery practice ### **What we look for:** * Typically 7\+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands on today and intend to stay that way * Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly * Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production, not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a nondeterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why * Strong engineering fundamentals. Dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack * Cloud native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus), including the operational reality of a system someone else inherits * Presales experience. Credible with senior stakeholders: you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job * Hands on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork (skills, workflows, MCP, integrations, connectors, custom harnesses) **Nice to have:** * Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and CI/CD in production * IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform * Open source contributions or public writing on applied AI ### **What We Offer:** * Full time * On site visits to client’s facilities and our office in NYC once a week * Unlimited Vacation policy * Generous health, vision, and dental insurance * 401(k) matching plan * Base salary $180k to $250k \+ bonuses; OTE up to $300k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data * No Visa sponsorship ### **We’re real:** * A person reads your application. We filter out AI generated and fraudulent submissions automatically. Every application that clears that filter is read by someone on our team * We may ask for a quick ID verification. Fraudulent applications are common, and this protects real candidates * You’ll meet the people you’d work with. We host AI engineering events in New York and San Francisco. We’d be happy to talk in person. Your interviews are with Pavel Borobov, Solutions Architect, and Stepan Pushkarev, Cofounder \& CEO ### **How we hire:** * Recruitment interview. * Tech interview with our FDE (30 min). * A live engineering building session (1\.5 hours). We hand you a business function and the constraints. You have to understand the job and rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. ***Use AI the way you normally would; we expect AI\-generated code. What we look at is how you used AI, the judgment behind your choices, and what you researched beyond what any LLM already knows.*** * Soft skills interview. * Offer discussion. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition & People Partner (AI Engineering, Product, GTM), New York / New Jersey
jobs.description: ### **About the Role:** The hiring problem you'd be solving We build AI systems that enterprises run their business on. Production systems inside banks, insurers, and health systems, where our engineers embed with the client, learn the work, and own the outcome. We call them Forward Deployed Engineers and Forward Deployed Executives. These people hold design conversations with a Chief Data Officer on Tuesday and ship to production next Monday. We are hiring a People \& Talent Partner to help us scale our FDE/FDX, Product, and GTM teams. Five open reqs at a time, none of them generic. We would rather you run five properly than twenty badly. Beyond filling roles, you will own the talent community strategy around Provectus, and you will build the people\-operations presence for our US team locally — be the person our US colleagues come to first. Location: Hybrid, New York: 2\-3 days onsite. Type: Full\-time (W2\). ### **What You'll Do:** **Recruiting:** * Full\-cycle hiring across the US for Forward Deployed Engineers (software, AI/ML, architects, leads), Forward Deployed Executives, Product Owners, and Business Development Managers. Intake to offer: * Partnership with the hiring managers. You'll run calibration with them and bring market data when a scorecard doesn't match what exists. * Architect and execute Provectus's talent community strategy in the US. Meetups, workshops, hackathons, university programs, and the AI/ML communities. You don't need to have run events before. You need to want to help with that, and there's a budget and support from marketing when you do. * US hiring strategy. Talent market intelligence, compensation benchmarking, and how we position Provectus against the companies competing for the same engineers. **People operations for the US team.** You'll be the on\-the\-ground people partner for our US\-based colleagues, working with the Head of People Operations: * Onboarding of US hires. * First point of contact for US employees on benefits, time off, policies, and day\-to\-day people questions. * Support for the performance review cycle for US\-based staff: scheduling, collecting feedback, tracking outcomes. * Team engagement and onsite days — the rhythm that makes a hybrid New York team feel like a team. **What's the split between Recruiting and HR?** 70/30### **What You'll Bring:** * 4\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience in a fast\-paced technical environment, ideally at an AI, cloud, or consulting firm * Proven track record of sourcing and hiring senior technical profiles — AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, or consulting leaders * Demonstrates personal AI adoption — uses AI tools as part of their recruiting workflow, not just aware of them * Experience building talent community: events, meetups, professional networks, or university programs — not just filling requisitions * Exposure to HR generalist or people\-operations work — onboarding, benefits, employee relations — or a clear appetite to build it. You don't need to have been an HRBP. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable partnering with C\-level and senior technical leadership * Highly organized, self\-directed, and comfortable with ambiguity in a distributed, global team * Commitment to Provectus's core values: Obsession, Ownership, Transparency, and Partnership * Based in the New York / New Jersey area and able to be onsite \[2\-3] days a week **Nice to have:** prior event or community building, familiarity with US benefits administration, onboarding, experience with an HRIS. **Where this goes:** This is a growing US function. The person who does this well takes on more of the community mandate, more senior searches, a deeper people\-partner role as the US team grows, and a path toward owning the US talent function. We'll talk about that trajectory. ### **What We Offer:** * Direct impact on Provectus's growth in the US market with direct visibility to leadership. * Access to the Provectus Learning Hub, Claude Code certification support * Collaborative culture that rewards ownership, curiosity, and continuous learning * B2B contract model or Full\-time W2 model. * Base $150k\- 170k. Final offer reflects experience, skills, and market data. * Health, vision, dental, disability, and life insurance; 401(k) plan; unlimited vacation. ### **About Provectus:** Provectus is an AWS Premier Partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner working at the front edge of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable outcomes through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory work. We focus on Financial Services \& Insurance and Healthcare \& Life Sciences, with offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA.### **Hiring Process:** * 30\-45\-minute call with the Head of Talent Acquisition * 30\-minute call with the Head of People Operations * On\-site meeting with the CEO We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Data Engineer – Mobile Monetization – Big Data, GenAI & Mobile AdTech
jobs.description: **About the Role** PubMatic is seeking for a passionate **Data Engineer** to join our Mobile Advertising Platform engineering team. In this role, you will build highly scalable data platforms powering **Mobile Programmatic Advertising, RTB bidding systems, attribution, campaign optimization, fraud detection, and real\-time analytics**. You will design and implement distributed systems capable of processing **billions of mobile advertising events** every day including **ad requests, impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, in\-app events, and auction logs**. You'll build both real\-time event processing and large\-scale batch processing systems on PubMatic's in\-house data centers, leveraging modern Big Data technologies (Spark, Kafka, Hadoop), high\-performance services in Go and Rust, and Generative AI to deliver intelligent analytics and automation solutions. You'll collaborate with Product Managers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and Backend Engineers to build next\-generation Mobile AdTech products. **What You'll Do:** * Design and build highly scalable data platforms capable of processing billions of **mobile advertising events** with low latency and high availability. * Design and build ultra\-low\-latency, high\-throughput data pipelines processing the full mobile event funnel — **ad request** **impression** **click** **install** **in\-app conversion event** — including **OpenRTB bid request/response logging**, auction analytics, and win\-rate/bid\-landscape reporting across multiple SSPs and ad exchanges, using Kafka, Spark Streaming, and Hadoop on our in\-house data centers. * Architect real\-time **campaign pacing and budget delivery systems**, applying bid optimization techniques so spend controls and bid strategy adjustments react to live auction signals within seconds. * Architect and implement real\-time streaming pipelines to ingest, process, and analyze billions of advertising events including impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, and in\-app events. * Build real\-time event processing systems with event\-time semantics, windowed aggregations, watermarking, late/out\-of\-order event handling, deduplication, and exactly\-once or idempotent delivery guarantees across Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming. * Design and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data models supporting Mobile AdTech use cases such as campaign reporting, attribution, audience segmentation, fraud detection, and revenue analytics. * Develop and tune large\-scale batch processing jobs on Spark and Hadoop (HDFS/YARN) — hourly and daily aggregations, backfills, reprocessing, and data reconciliation between real\-time and batch layers — with strong workflow orchestration, SLAs, and data\-quality checks. * Design large\-scale **Invalid Traffic (IVT) and ad fraud detection** systems — click spam, install hijacking, SDK spoofing, device farms — using rules\-based and ML\-driven detection across billions of daily events. * Develop high\-performance backend services and data processors (Java, Go, Rust, REST APIs, JDBC) supporting DSP bidding logic, campaign management tools, and reporting APIs. * Operate and scale data infrastructure in PubMatic's in\-house data centers — Kafka, Spark, and Hadoop clusters — including capacity planning, performance tuning, storage and compute efficiency, and cost optimization on bare\-metal hardware. * Design and develop GenAI\-powered agents for analytics, operations, and data enrichment using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or custom orchestration frameworks. * Design systems that are highly available, fault tolerant, and optimized for low latency and high throughput. * Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and customer experience. * Work with Product Managers to define and implement new analytics capabilities and platform features. * Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, estimation, retrospectives, and release planning. * Perform architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews while promoting software engineering best practices. **We'd Love for You to Have:** * 1–5\+ years of professional experience in Java backend development and data engineering. * Strong computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design principles. * Hands\-on experience developing scalable backend services using Java, REST APIs, JDBC, and relational databases. * Strong experience building distributed real\-time and batch data pipelines using Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, and SQL on on\-premise / in\-house data center infrastructure. * Experience designing and optimizing large\-scale analytical data platforms for Mobile AdTech using Java, Go, Rust, Spark, Kafka, and SQL. Strong understanding of real\-time event processing, distributed data systems, and data warehouse architectures. Familiarity with distributed quer hestration frameworks * Prompt engineering and prompt optimization * AI evaluation and observability * AI agents and workflow automation **Additional Preferred Skills** * Experience building scalable, production\-grade AI or data platforms. * Strong SQL optimization and query performance tuning skills. * Experience running Big Data platforms on\-premise — managing Kafka, Spark, and Hadoop/HDFS clusters, capacity planning, and hardware\-aware performance tuning in a private data center environment. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment on bare\-metal / in\-house data center infrastructure. * Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or similar. * Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills in distributed environments. * Demonstrated ability to achieve stretch goals in a fast\-paced, highly collaborative engineering environment. * Ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently. **Why Join Us?** * Work on high\-scale data infrastructure processing billions of mobile advertising events every day, directly impacting publisher revenue, DSP spend, and advertiser outcomes across the in\-app advertising ecosystem. * Help shape the future of real\-time analytics, attribution, campaign pacing, fraud/IVT detection, and GenAI\-powered automation for mobile app monetization. * Build modern data platforms with Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Go, and Rust on PubMatic's in\-house data centers at internet scale, with low latency and high availability. * Collaborate with industry\-leading engineers, product managers, data scientists, ML engineers, DSP partners, and publisher teams. * Competitive compensation, performance\-based incentives, and strong career growth opportunities in a globally recognized AdTech company. **AI\-Enabled Engineering Mindset** We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) to accelerate development, improve code and data quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI\-first thinking — using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution — will thrive in our high\-scale, data\-intensive environment. **Qualification:** Should have a bachelor's degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute/university. **Additional Information:** **Return to Office**: PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. **Benefits:** Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!. **Diversity and Inclusion**: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status **About PubMatic** PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- United States \& Canada **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering Small businesses represent 99\.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi\-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy\-to\-use, AI\-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated \#1 in customer satisfaction on G2\. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top\-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a QA Automation Engineer (SDET), Web to help build and maintain the shared test automation platform that Quo's engineering teams rely on. This is a mid\-level role on our growing Quality Engineering team — one of two Automation Engineer hires (this web\-focused role and a mobile\-focused counterpart) opening alongside a Quality Ambassador req from the same headcount round. Per our Test Automation Philosophy \& Ownership Framework, feature teams own the tests that validate what they build, at every layer including end\-to\-end; our Automation Engineers own the shared platform underneath — the frameworks, harnesses, and canonical patterns (Playwright, our API contract harness) — plus the specific cross\-team suites nobody else owns, like web smoke tests. You'll help build and maintain that platform, not absorb test\-writing from feature teams. You'll join a small, fast\-moving Quality Engineering team that's actively redefining how automation and manual QA work together, reporting to our Director of Quality Engineering. ### **Some of the things you'll do:** * Own and extend our shared web test platform: the Playwright framework feature teams build their own tests on top of, and our API contract harness, working alongside our mobile automation engineer who owns the Maestro side * Contribute to coverage\-gap audits across backend API and end\-to\-end tests, turning findings into real, owned test coverage * Diagnose and drive down flaky tests in CI — telling the difference between a flaky test, an unstable environment, and a real regression * Help maintain and extend tooling that turns customer\-reported bugs into scoped coverage\-gap work * Own specific cross\-team suites nobody else owns, including web smoke tests * Partner constantly with backend, web, and mobile engineers to embed testing patterns into their workflow * Help socialize canonical testing patterns and standards to squads as they mature **About You** ------------- * 3\+ years of professional software engineering or SDET experience, with meaningful time spent building and maintaining test automation, not just writing individual test cases * Strong TypeScript/Node.js skills, with hands\-on experience in tools like Playwright (web E2E) and Vitest (backend/unit) * Comfortable reasoning about cost/confidence tradeoffs — which layer of the test pyramid actually earns its cost for a given risk, rather than defaulting to end\-to\-end for everything * Interested in building shared harnesses and canonical patterns other engineers build on top of, not just adding one\-off tests * Able to systematically diagnose and drive down flake rate in CI * Understands how to validate a public or internal API's contract (auth, request/response shapes, error codes) independent of full end\-to\-end coverage * Comfortable working from coverage and defect\-escape dashboards to prioritize what gets automated next * Collaborative by default — you'll partner constantly with backend, web, and mobile developers ### **Nice to have:** * Exposure to declarative, YAML\-based mobile test automation (Maestro or similar) * Comfort reading someone else's test suite, extending it with new coverage, and debugging why a test broke * Experience working in a fast\-moving, still\-forming engineering organization **Compensation** ---------------- The annual base salary range for this position is as follow, plus equity and benefits: * SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $136,000 \- $159,000 USD * All other US Locations: $122,000 \- $143,000 USD * Canada: $124,000 \- $145,000 CAD The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process. Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy. **Who we are** ============== We're a remote\-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you. And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Quo is the type of company where you can grow, and we encourage you to apply for this role even if you don't think you meet all the requirements. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. It is important that you are able to bring your authentic self to work every day. jobs.title: Software Dev Staff Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **About One Identity** ---------------------- One Identity delivers trusted identity security solutions that help organizations protect, manage, and govern digital identities across their environments. Our solutions enable organizations to strengthen security, simplify identity management, and reduce risk through innovative Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Privileged Access Management (PAM) technologies. At One Identity, we are committed to building secure, scalable, and reliable software that empowers organizations around the world.**Overview** ------------ One Identity is seeking a talented and experienced Software Development Staff Engineer to join our dynamic Engineering team. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and delivery of enterprise\-grade software solutions that support our identity security platform. The ideal candidate is a highly skilled software engineer with deep technical expertise, strong problem\-solving abilities, and a passion for building high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable software. You will work closely with engineering leadership, architects, product management, and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into innovative technical solutions. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical leadership, influence architectural decisions, mentor fellow engineers, and drive engineering excellence across the organization. Responsibilities: **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality, scalable, secure, and reliable software applications. * Lead the technical design and implementation of complex software features and enhancements. * Collaborate with architects, product managers, and engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver solutions aligned with business objectives. * Drive architectural decisions and establish best practices for software development, design patterns, and coding standards. * Identify opportunities to improve application performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. * Lead code reviews and provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers across the team. * Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, and system tests to ensure software quality. * Troubleshoot complex technical issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective solutions. * Contribute to the modernization of existing applications and the adoption of emerging technologies. * Partner with DevOps and cloud engineering teams to improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and operational efficiency. * Champion secure software development practices, ensuring compliance with security standards and industry best practices. * Proactively identify technical debt and drive initiatives to improve engineering productivity and product quality. * Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications: * ### **Required Qualifications** + Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. + 8\+ years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated expertise in designing and delivering complex software systems. + Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming, software design principles, and common architectural patterns. + Experience developing enterprise\-scale applications using modern programming languages and frameworks. + Experience designing and implementing scalable, distributed, and highly available systems. + Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and database technologies. + Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases. + Experience with automated testing frameworks and modern software development practices. + Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. + Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control systems, and Agile development methodologies. + Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills. + Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.### **Preferred Qualifications** + Experience working within the Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance (IGA), or Privileged Access Management (PAM) domain. + Experience developing security\-focused enterprise software. + Familiarity with authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, and access control concepts. + Experience with cloud\-native application development and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. + Experience with event\-driven architecture and messaging technologies. + Familiarity with modern observability, monitoring, and application performance tools. + Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and drive technical initiatives across multiple teams. + Experience leveraging AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and testing effectiveness.**What You'll Bring** --------------------- + A passion for building jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, AI Enablement** RB Global is building the team that makes agentic software development standard, governed, and measurable across the company. We want every engineer to be able to delegate work to an agent and trust the result, with the right standards, guardrails, and visibility built into the path itself. This new team exists to make that the default: composing what already exists wherever it's good enough, and building only what doesn't. It's engineering excellence applied specifically to how we build software with AI. We're hiring the founding engineers for this team. You'll help shape the team's scope, standards, and first deliverables from day one, not inherit someone else's roadmap. * Help build secure, governed ways for agents to reach internal tools and data, with the scoping, credentials, and audit trails that make that access trustworthy. * Help build and run the containerized environments agents work in, where things like isolation, reproducibility, and model/cost choices are actually controlled. * Help turn the team's engineering standards and conventions into something tools and agents can actually consume and follow, not just documentation that drifts out of date. * Contribute to establishing the baselines and metrics the team doesn't have yet, so claims about speed, quality, and cost are backed by numbers. * Work with CI/CD, security, and platform teams to plug agent workflows into tools the company already uses, rather than reinventing them. * Help review and harden what the team ships with the same rigor you'd apply to any system other engineers depend on: tests, documentation, and a clear plan for who supports it. * Share your perspective with teammates on what the team takes on, and when to adopt an existing tool versus build something new. * Work with the team's technical product owner and stakeholders to understand priorities and turn ideas into delivered work. * Work closely with the other engineers on the team to reason through ambiguous problems together. We want your questions, ideas, and pushback, not just completed tasks. **Requirements** * Solid professional software engineering experience at a senior level (5\+ years of professional experience), with a record of delivering reliable work and speaking up to improve how the team approaches it. * Familiarity with internal developer platforms, "paved road" tooling, or developer\-enablement work, and an interest in making other engineers more effective. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, including quality gates defined as code. * Experience with Kubernetes or comparable container orchestration, and comfort supporting services from build through production operation. * Working knowledge of observability, such as structured logging, tracing, and metrics/dashboards (e.g., Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or similar), and using it to answer "is this actually working?" * Comfort working in Python; we care more about your ability to reason across a stack and pick up what's needed than mastery of any one language. * Curiosity and a genuine desire to learn: this space is moving fast, the right answers aren't settled yet, and the best candidates will enjoy figuring them out rather than expecting a playbook. This is essential for the role. * A habit of contributing to the discussion: you ask questions, offer ideas, and share your view, rather than waiting to be handed a task. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade\-offs clearly to teammates, other engineering teams, and stakeholders who weren't in the room when the decision was made. * Comfort working through ambiguous or evolving problems with teammates, since much of this team's early work won't have a settled playbook to follow. **Nice To Have** * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, agentic coding tools), and even better, experience building platforms, tooling, or guardrails around them. * Experience building AI tooling, personal or professional, and a natural enjoyment of experimenting with new approaches. * Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool\-access and governance patterns. RB Global (NYSE: RBA) RB Global (NYSE: RBA) (TSX: RBA) is a leading, omnichannel marketplace that provides value\-added insights, services and transaction solutions for buyers and sellers of commercial assets and vehicles worldwide. Through its auction sites in 13 countries and digital platform, RB Global serves customers in more than 170 countries across a variety of asset classes, including automotive, commercial transportation, construction, government surplus, lifting and material handling, energy, mining and agriculture. The company’s marketplace brands include Ritchie Bros., the world’s largest auctioneer of commercial assets and vehicles offering online bidding, and IAA, a leading global digital marketplace connecting vehicle buyers and sellers. RB Global’s portfolio of brands also includes Rouse Services, which provides a complete end\-to\-end asset management, data\-driven intelligence and performance benchmarking system; SmartEquip, an innovative technology platform that supports customers’ management of the equipment lifecycle and integrates parts procurement with both OEMs and dealers; Xcira, a leader in live simulcast auction technologies; and Veritread, an online marketplace for heavy haul transport. RB Global full\-time employees are offered medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurances. Employees are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan and RB Global will match 100% for the first 4% contributed. Employees will also receive 15 days of PTO each year.

jobs.title: EDW Technical Architect
jobs.description: For over twenty\-seven years RCR Technology Corporation has delivered the highest quality services to our clients with an expansive portfolio of industry\-relevant services, and deep technical capabilities around data management and application development. We are looking for an **EDW Technical Architect**. The ideal candidate will provide hands\-on architecture and engineering leadership for enterprise data warehousing, reporting, and analytics modernization. The role is responsible for architecting and delivering scalable reporting and analytics solutions across data integration, application, infrastructure, and cloud platforms, and for leading technical teams through solution design, proof\-of\-concept, development, testing, implementation, support, and operational efficiency. Experience supporting Medicaid or federal reporting modernization is preferred. Primary Responsibilities: * **Own end\-to\-end application and technical architecture** for reporting, analytics, data integration, and transaction\-based processing solutions across on\-premises platforms and future cloud services. * Translate business, operational, and regulatory requirements into maintainable system designs, including configurable business rules, effective\-dated reference data, traceability, auditability, and reconciliation. * **Design and lead modernization** of legacy ETL, SQL logic, Linux/Unix scripts, and manual processing into Python\-based applications and automation, using enterprise data platforms efficiently for high\-volume processing. * **Provide hands\-on technical leadership** across architecture, development, code review, testing, deployment, performance tuning, and production support to unblock the team. * **Build proof\-of\-concepts** that compare solution options, document measurable results, and support architecture decisions with the customer and leadership. * Define technical architecture across web/UI, API and service layers, processing engines, databases, orchestration, scheduling, security, identity/access, monitoring, and backup/recovery, in partnership with infrastructure, security, cloud, and data peers. * **Lead BI and analytics delivery** including enterprise report design, drill\-down and detail reporting, reconciliation, data quality, and modernization of legacy reporting capabilities. * **Establish engineering practices using Azure DevOps** or equivalent – epics and user stories, repositories, branching, pull requests, code review, CI/CD, release traceability, and production deployment – and apply AI and automation with appropriate governance to accelerate analysis, conversion, documentation, and testing. * Produce architecture diagrams, solution designs, technical specifications, dataflow and interface documentation, implementation of roadmaps, estimates, risks, and operational support models. * **Lead and mentor** architects, data engineers, ETL and BI developers, modelers, analysts, and testers; build backup coverage and develop team capability. * **Present architecture, options, risks, and recommendations** concisely to customer stakeholders and Optum leadership, creating clarity across ambiguous scope, legacy constraints, and accelerated timelines. Required Qualifications * *Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.* * 10\+ years of information technology experience, including senior\-level application, solution, technical, or data architecture for large enterprise systems. * Proven experience architecting enterprise data warehouse, reporting, analytics, and claims or transaction\-processing solutions from the ground up – architecture, infrastructure, design, development, proof\-of\-concept, testing, implementation, and support. * Hands\-on development experience with Python and advanced SQL, including automation, data processing, troubleshooting, and code review. * Experience designing application architecture including APIs, services, web components, databases, security, identity/access, job scheduling, monitoring, and environment management. * Hands\-on BI/reporting experience with BusinessObjects, Power BI, Tableau, SAS, or comparable enterprise reporting tools. * Experience implementing source control, branching, pull requests, CI/CD, and automated deployment in Azure DevOps or a similar platform. * People leadership experience leading BI, data, and engineering staff, with strong written, verbal, and presentation skills for customer and executive audiences. Preferred Qualifications * **Healthcare payer, Medicaid, managed care, or health\-insurance experience**, including claims, adjustments, voids, eligibility, providers, payments, and regulatory reporting data. * **Federal reporting experience**, especially CMS\-64, quarterly expenditure reporting, reconciliation, certification, or related state Medicaid reporting. * **On\-premises to cloud migration experience** with Microsoft Azure, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Data Lake Storage, Snowflake, or comparable cloud data services. * **ETL/ELT and data engineering experience** with Informatica, Teradata, or comparable enterprise integration and large\-scale MPP data warehouse platforms. * **Applying AI\-assisted engineering or automation** to code conversion, source\-to\-target mapping, testing, documentation, and data\-quality activities within enterprise governance. * Data modeling across conceptual, logical, and physical models, effective\-dated reference data, dimensional models, and transaction lineage; experience with Linux/Unix scripting and job orchestration. * Knowledge of HIPAA, PHI, PII, security architecture, and public\-sector compliance expectations; advanced degree or relevant architecture, cloud, data, or agile certifications.

jobs.title: Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) ETL/Data Engineer
jobs.description: For over twenty\-seven years RCR Technology Corporation has delivered the highest quality services to our clients with an expansive portfolio of industry\-relevant services, and deep technical capabilities around data management and application development. We are seeking a Senior Azure Data Engineer to help design, build, and operate our next\-generation enterprise data platform on Microsoft Azure. You will own end\-to\-end delivery of data pipelines and data products that power analytics, regulatory reporting, operational dashboards, and emerging AI/ML use cases. You will partner closely with data architects, analytics engineers, data scientists, business stakeholders, and platform engineering teams to deliver reliable, performance, secure, and cost\-efficient data solutions. This role is ideal for an engineer with strong hands\-on depth in Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics and/or Databricks, and modern Lakehouse patterns, who is comfortable leading migration programs (e.g., Informatica\-to\-ADF, on\-prem warehouse\-to\-cloud), mentoring mid\-level engineers, and shaping engineering standards across the team. Key Responsibilities: Pipeline Design \& Development * Design and build robust, reusable, parameter\-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines, Data Bricks and/or Microsoft Fabric Data Factory. * Implement medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold) on Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 using Delta Lake, Parquet, and structured streaming patterns. * Build performant ELT workflows that leverage pushdown to source systems (Synapse Dedicated SQL Pool, Azure SQL, Teradata) where appropriate. * Develop and optimize PySpark notebooks and jobs on Azure Databricks or Synapse Spark. Data Modeling \& Warehousing * Design dimensional models (Kimball star/snowflake) and data vault patterns for analytics consumption. * Implement Slowly Changing Dimensions (Type 1/2/3\), Change Data Capture, and late\-arriving data patterns. * Tune distributed SQL workloads in Synapse Dedicated SQL Pool / Fabric Warehouse, including distribution keys, partitioning, and clustered column store indexes. Platform Engineering \& DevOps * Implement CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps (YAML pipelines, ARM/Bicep/Terraform) across Dev / SIT / UAT / Prod environments. * Instrument pipelines with robust logging, auditing, and monitoring using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and KQL. * Define and enforce coding standards, code review practices, branching strategies, and release management. Migration \& Modernization * Lead or contribute to legacy\-to\-cloud migrations — e.g., Informatica PowerCenter to Azure Data Factory, on\-premises Teradata / Oracle / SQL Server to Synapse or Fabric. * Perform workload assessment, capacity planning, and cost modeling for target\-state architectures. * production incident response for critical pipelines. Required Qualifications: * Deep hands\-on expertise with Azure Data Factory: pipelines, datasets, linked services, triggers, parameterization, mapping data flows, and all three Integration Runtime types (Azure, Self\-hosted, SSIS). * Strong Experience in Data Bricks and PySpark. * Production experience with one or more of: Azure Synapse Analytics (Dedicated and Serverless SQL Pools, Spark Pools) OR Azure Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) OR Microsoft Fabric (Warehouse, Lakehouse, OneLake). * Strong working knowledge of Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (hierarchical namespace, RBAC \+ ACLs, lifecycle management, security). * Experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure AD / Entra ID (including managed identities and service principals), and private networking (VNet integration, private endpoints). * Monitoring and troubleshooting with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and KQL. * Advanced SQL — window functions, CTEs, query optimization, execution plan analysis, performance tuning. * Strong Python for data engineering — pandas, PySpark, REST API integration, unit testing (pytest). * Proficient in T\-SQL; familiarity with Spark SQL, KQL, PowerShell, and Bash shell scripting. Preferred Qualifications: * 5\+ years of data warehouse development experience. * 5\+ years of data modeling experience using ERWIN or similar tools. * 2\+ years of experience with Azure Data Factory and Snowflake. * Medicaid Domain Knowledge is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Health Data Modeler
jobs.description: For over twenty\-seven years RCR Technology Corporation has delivered the highest quality services to our clients with an expansive portfolio of industry\-relevant services, and deep technical capabilities around data management and application development. We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Health Data Modeler to support the Illinois Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) within the Enterprise Data Warehouse \& Analytics group. The Data Modeler will work with large healthcare datasets and translate the client’s business requirements into enterprise systems, applications, and process designs for large, complex health data solutions. This role owns the design, governance, and evolution of the conceptual, logical, and physical data models that underpin the EDW platform and its modernization initiatives. It drives and supports initiatives for the IL EDW while participating in the wider EDW group’s focus areas — data usage and governance, information management, privacy and security, data analytics and visualization, and information modeling — bridging the current\-state Teradata EDW to the future\-state cloud (Azure / Snowflake) architecture. Working closely with data architects, ETL/data engineers, BI developers, DBAs, and business subject matter experts, the Senior Health Data Modeler ensures data structures are scalable, standards\-compliant, well\-documented, and aligned to enterprise and regulatory requirements across the Health and Human Services ecosystem. Roles \& Responsibilities Data Architecture \& Strategy * Develop and deliver long\-term strategic goals for data architecture vision and standards in conjunction with data users, clients, and other key stakeholders. * Lead data architecture, data modeling, and data movement initiatives to enhance the data warehouse supporting analytics for Medicaid, Medicare, and Commercial healthcare data — including domains such as claims, provider, TPL, and member information subject areas. * Create an end\-to\-end vision for how logical design translates into one or more physical databases and how data flows through successive stages. * Document data architecture and the enterprise environment to maintain a current, accurate view that supports a single version of the truth and scales to future analytical needs. Data Modeling \& Design * Analyze and translate business needs into long\-term solution data models; evaluate existing data systems and work with the development team to create conceptual data models and data flows. * Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models across staging, integration, and semantic/presentation layers. * Develop dimensional models (Kimball star/snowflake), normalized (OLTP/3NF), OLAP, and Data Vault patterns; implement Slowly Changing Dimensions, role\-playing dimensions, dimensional hierarchies, surrogate keys, and data classification. * Define primary/foreign keys, indexes, partitioning, constraints, and referential integrity rules to ensure data quality and performance. * Produce and maintain entity\-relationship diagrams (ERDs), data flow diagrams, and model documentation using Erwin or equivalent tools. Governance, Quality \& Compliance * Ensure data strategies and architectures are in regulatory compliance; identify where existing policies and procedures require change or where new ones are needed. * Oversee the mapping of data sources, data movement, interfaces, and analytics with the goal of ensuring data quality. * Create and maintain data model and metadata policies and procedures for functional design; maintain data dictionaries, business glossaries, and lineage documentation. * Support classification and protection of sensitive data (PII, PHI) in alignment with HIPAA, PHI, and SOX requirements. Collaboration \& Delivery * Provide technical recommendations and engage with ETL Architects, Business SMEs, and other stakeholders throughout the Solution/Data Architecture and implementation lifecycle to develop high\-performance, highly scalable data solutions (data marts/warehouse, data mining, and advanced analytics). * Address data\-related problems regarding systems integration, compatibility, and multiple\-platform integration. * Develop and implement key components and testing criteria to guarantee the fidelity and performance of data architecture. * Communicate with the customer and project team in a timely manner and escalate issues and risks appropriately. Modernization \& Migration Support * Contribute to migration of legacy Teradata models to modern cloud platforms (Azure Synapse / Databricks Lakehouse, Snowflake). * Design target\-state models leveraging medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture, Delta Lake, and Parquet patterns. * Assess existing models for modernization opportunities, redundancy, and optimization; recommend improvements to architects. Qualifications: Education * BS or MS in Computer Science, Business Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. * 10 or more years of IT experience.
