jobs.title: Software Certification Engineer
jobs.description: At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing\-in\-ground\-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next\-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo \- connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before. Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward\-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production \- and building the team to make it happen. **Role Overview** ================= REGENT is hiring a Software Certification Engineer to hold engineering approval authority for Viceroy's software and airborne electronic hardware (AEH), and to help guide REGENT and its suppliers through a certification process built on RTCA DO\-178C but tailored for Seaglider certification with the U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) and a classification society such as Lloyd's Register (LR). You'll review and approve software and AEH compliance artifacts, both REGENT's own and those produced by key suppliers like motor, battery, and actuator vendors, act as an internal software quality assurance auditor, and help facilitate external software process audits from regulators. This is a hands\-on, high\-trust role for someone who already has software FAA Designated Engineering Representative (DER) experience, or an equivalent, and wants to put it to work on a new, all\-electric aircraft program early in its certification life. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Develop and approve compliance artifacts.** Help develop and review software and AEH certification data, and approve findings as REGENT's software certification lead on the program. * **Liaise with certifying and classification authorities.** Serve as a primary point of contact with USCG and Lloyd's Register on software and AEH compliance, with the FAA available in a supporting role to USCG. * **Guide certification strategy.** Help tailor REGENT's DO\-178C\-like process for Seaglider certification and establish methods of compliance for software and AEH. * **Oversee supplier artifacts.** Work with key suppliers, including motor, battery, and actuator vendors, to help them produce software and AEH certification artifacts acceptable to USCG and LR. * **Audit internal process adherence.** Act as REGENT's internal software quality assurance auditor, confirming the software team follows its defined development and verification processes. * **Facilitate external audits.** Help prepare for and facilitate software process audits from USCG, LR, and the FAA (under direction of USCG). * **Maintain the compliance record.** Keep an audit\-ready record of findings, methods of compliance, and supporting data, for REGENT and supplier artifacts alike. * **Build the practice.** Help REGENT establish a durable, in\-house software and AEH certification capability as Viceroy scales toward entry into service. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * Software Designated Engineering Representative (DER), or an equivalent experience, ideally covering airborne electronic hardware (AEH) as well. * Experience in software or AEH certification, including direct experience with RTCA DO\-178C (and ideally DO\-254\). * Experience approving certification artifacts and representing an engineering organization directly with a certifying or classification authority. * Experience overseeing supplier or subcontractor software/AEH design assurance. * Experience with internal software process audits and/or facilitating external regulatory or classification\-society audits. * Working knowledge of SAE ARP4754A/ARP4761 and the means\-of\-compliance process. * Comfort working across engineering teams, suppliers, and multiple certifying and classification authorities, without formal authority over any of them. **Who We're Looking For** ========================= * **Trusted regulatory voice.** You take delegated approval authority seriously and communicate clearly with regulators, engineers, suppliers, and leadership alike. * **Solutions\-oriented.** When a supplier's or engineering team's artifacts don't yet meet a compliance requirement, you help find a path to yes. * **Builder.** You want to help stand up a new certification practice, not just operate inside an established one. * **Cross\-functional connector.** You're comfortable being the link between REGENT's engineering teams, outside suppliers, and certifying and classification authorities. * **Adaptable \& agile.** You adapt quickly to changing priorities in a fast\-paced startup environment. **What We Offer** ================= * **Competitive compensation** including a robust equity incentive plan to reward your contributions to our success. * Comprehensive **health, dental, and vision insurance**, we cover **100%** of your premiums (including dependents!). * **401(k)** with company matching, so you can plan for the future. * Generous **flexible time off**, paid parental leave, and company\-wide holiday breaks. * **Relocation packages** available for those moving to join our team. * Daily, **free catered lunches**. * Learning \& professional development opportunities with the chance to make a direct impact on the company's growth and success. **If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you.** Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer** REGENT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Full time \| Remote\-friendly, NYC and New Orleans \| Reports to the CTO** ### **What is Rima** Rima's mission is to improve population health by giving people technology to make navigating their employer sponsored health plans easy. We see a world where it is possible to reduce the economic burden on employees and employers without sacrificing quality of care. This is both a moral imperative and a business opportunity. Rima is building an agentic navigation platform for self insured health plans to tackle the root cause underlying rising healthcare costs. We are empowering the individuals on which the entire system depends. We’re a small, fast\-moving team based in NYC and New Orleans. We are all in. ### **The Role** We're looking for a senior engineer to join the Platform team. Platform owns the core of Rima: the member experience, member management, the agent harness, the channels members reach it through, and the infrastructure underneath it all. A parent texts our agent at 9pm. Their son has a fever and the pediatrician is closed. Where should they go tonight, and what will it cost? Guiding them well depends on his coverage as a dependent, the family's deductible, and which urgent care and telehealth options their plan includes. It has to come together in seconds, from protected health data, and be right every time. That's the problem the Platform team exists to solve. At a larger company, each system you'll own would have its own team. Here it's yours: the architecture, the trade\-offs, and the results. You'll know these systems better than anyone and help decide where they go next. ### **Minimum qualifications** * You've built production software for 4\+ years, or built more in less time. We are impressed by results, not years and logos. * You've shipped complex, user\-facing systems end to end that you designed, from data model to API to UI. * You understand software design deeply. You model domains carefully, draw clean boundaries, plan for how things fail, and change systems without breaking what depends on them. * You've spent at least a year shipping production code mainly through coding agents, and you've built the tooling that keeps their output correct: rules, skills, tests, and evals. * You've built on regulated or sensitive data, with access control, audit trails, and least privilege designed in from the start. * You're an expert in TypeScript. * You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you can take a trade\-off from discussion to decision with an engineer, a designer, or a customer. ### **Nice to have** Bonus if you've: * Built LLM\-powered product features: agent tool design, context engineering, evals, guardrails, and trace interpretation. * Worked on multi\-tenant SaaS: tenancy, white\-labeling, and SSO (OIDC, SAML). * Used durable execution or workflow engines, such as Temporal, or built event\-driven systems. * Shipped across web, iOS, Android, browser extensions, and internal admin tooling. * Worked in healthcare, benefits, insurance, or payroll, including FHIR, EDI, or HL7\. * Built or maintained HIPAA\- or SOC 2\-compliant systems. ### **What you'll do** **Member experience and member management** * Build the features members expect from their health plan: insurance cards, claims, accumulators, dependents, and provider search. * Model benefits and entitlements precisely enough that a member reading the app and an agent answering a question reach the same correct answer. * Build member and company management for admins: onboarding, benefits configuration, and usage analytics. * Build internal admin tooling so our team can configure and support customers without an engineer. * Ship across web, iOS, Android, and our browser extension. * Work out requirements and trade\-offs with product and design before build. Talk to members and admins to see how the product actually gets used. **Agents and channels** * Build the features and data the member agent depends on, such as agent tools, entitlement data, and plan data, so it answers from what each member actually has. You'll work closely with the engineers who build the agent harness. * Build the channels the agent reaches members through, including web, mobile, SMS, Slack, Teams, and MCP clients, so it behaves the same in each one. * Add evals and tracing to the features you ship, so we know an answer is wrong before a member does. **Platform infrastructure and observability** * Own parts of our AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, and the pipeline from dev to production. * Strengthen observability: structured logs, metrics, traces, alerting, and incident response. * Treat security as architecture: PII minimization, envelope encryption with key rotation, least\-privilege access, purpose\-of\-use audit trails, and break\-glass workflows. **Developer tooling and practice** * Improve our developer tooling, including agent rules and skills, linting, CLI, and automated tests, so every engineer and agent ships faster and more safely. * Make good practice the default. When you find a better way to build, turn it into a rule, skill, or check so the whole team and every agent picks it up. * Bring consequential trade\-offs to the team early, with a recommendation. * Lead incident response for the systems you own. Our stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Hono, PostgreSQL, Temporal, Capacitor (web, iOS, Android), AWS with Terraform, Sentry, and Amplitude. ### **What success looks like in your first 90 days** * You own two or three platform systems. You know them better than anyone and are the first call when something goes wrong. * You've shipped at least one member\-facing feature end to end, from requirements through production monitoring. * You've closed one gap in observability, CI, or our developer tooling that makes the whole team faster. ### **How we work** * **Love and excellence.** We strive to win at the highest level and hold an extremely high bar, without losing the humanity that makes us who we are. * **High ownership.** You own problems end to end. No hand\-offs, no "not my problem." * **Crisp communication.** We say what we mean, raise problems early, and keep decisions easy to find. * **Fast iteration.** We ship in small batches, learn from members, and improve quickly. * **Results over process.** We care about what ships and how well it works, not how many meetings you attended. ### **Why work at Rima** * **Hard problems.** Health plans are complex, the data is regulated, and agents are capable, but new. You'll work where all three meet. * **Early in a category being reinvented.** Benefits navigation is being rebuilt around agents that reach members wherever they are. We're early, and you'll help shape what it becomes. * **Push agentic development forward.** We treat building software with agents as a system to engineer, and you'll help design it. * **Real impact, fast.** Our agents serve tens of thousands of members, and what you ship reaches them in days. * **Close to users.** You'll hear directly from the members and admins using what you built, not through layers of tickets. * **A team that pushes the tools.** Everyone here builds at the edge of what agents can do and shares what works. * **Competitive comp and benefits.** Base salary range $125,000\-$175,000, plus an equity package, flexible PTO, health insurance, dental, vision and more. Compensation Range: $125K \- $175K

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Operations Platform
jobs.description: **Full time \| On\-site in NYC (Union Square) \| 20% travel \| Reports to Chief Product Officer** ### **What is Rima** Rima's mission is to improve population health by giving people technology to make navigating their employer sponsored health plans easy. We see a world where it is possible to reduce the economic burden on employees and employers without sacrificing quality of care. This is both a moral imperative and a business opportunity. Rima is building an agentic navigation platform for self insured health plans to tackle the root cause underlying rising healthcare costs. We are empowering the individuals on which the entire system depends. We’re a small, fast\-moving team based in NYC and New Orleans. We are all in. ### **The Role** Our largest customer, a boutique health plan, uses our navigation platform and a custom operations platform purpose built for them. The operations platform covers payroll operations, enrollment, member management, employer communications, vendor integrations, and reporting for 100\+ employers across a dozen payroll providers. The purpose of the operations platform is to save our customer time. It is in production while also demanding rapid iteration and creative one\-off automations. A forward\-deployed team handles bug fixes and support, and builds automations such as ETL scripts, browser automation, Excel macros, and Google Apps Scripts. Your job is to make sure these automations are reusable, reliable in production, and integrated into the operations platform. We're a small team, and this is a high\-ownership role. You own the roadmap, the requirements, and the results, so our CPO can focus on the core platform. ### **Minimum qualifications** * You've shipped software products for 5\+ years, or shipped more in less time. We care more about what you’ve shipped than your tenure or previous employers. * You've built and delivered a longer\-term roadmap and tied each feature to KPIs and customer value. * You've shipped reliable, integration\-heavy software for operational workflows. * You use AI and agentic tools every day, including coding agents, LLM workflows, and autonomous background agents. You use them to prototype, analyze data, and write specs, and you know where they fall short. * You write detailed requirements, business rules, and edge cases that engineering can build from and that define clear acceptance criteria. * You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation. * You are excellent at making trade\-offs and facilitating trade\-off discussions with all stakeholders. * You listen closely, ask follow\-up questions, and distinguish the customer's underlying problem from the solution they initially request. ### **Preferred qualifications** * You've worked in payroll, benefits administration, or process automation. You are familiar with eligibility, deductions, enrollment, and reconciliation operations and the long tail of exceptions. * You've worked closely with forward\-deployed or customer\-facing engineers, and you can turn one customer's workarounds into a product that scales. * You've shipped products built on browser automation or browser extensions. You know where they break: changing UIs, authentication, session handling, and failures nobody notices. * Built automations yourself with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Chrome extensions, or RPA tools. * Turned custom, customer\-specific work into a multi\-tenant product. * Worked with PEOs, TPAs, payroll providers, or benefits carriers, including EDI 834 or carrier feeds. * Built operational reporting and dashboards that customers rely on. * Designed human review, approvals, and exception queues for automated work. * Worked on HIPAA or SOC 2\-compliant systems, or with PII and PHI. ### **What you'll do** **Own the roadmap** * Decide what the team builds and in what order, and turn down work that doesn't move a KPI. * Make scope, sequencing, and delivery commitments with engineering, based on estimates and capacity. Escalate consequential decisions to the CPO with a recommendation. **Talk to the customer directly** * Meet weekly with the customer's operations team, including on site on Long Island, to observe payroll, enrollment, and reconciliation workflows firsthand. * Walk the customer through the roadmap and trade\-offs, and communicate changes to scope, timing, or risk early. **Write requirements engineering can build from** * Write specs covering the user, business rules, edge cases, failure handling, and acceptance criteria before work reaches engineering. * Resolve unclear requests before they become engineering work. Check feasibility, sequencing and risk with the engineering team. * Break work into pieces that ship within a Monday\-to\-Friday sprint. Keep the spec current as decisions change. * Use coding agents to prototype an automation and test your assumptions before you write the spec. **Own product acceptance, release readiness, and rollout** * Test features with the customer's operati nds, and check that the new workflow works in practice. * Write the release notes, SOPs, and training material the customer's operations team needs. **Turn requests into structured product input** * Triage bugs, support requests and asks from the forward\-deployed team and the customer. Record the problem, the current workaround, how often it happens and the impact, not just the fix someone asked for. * Find the patterns behind repeat problems across employer clients and payroll providers. **Measure whether it worked** * Decide what to measure before a feature ships, and work with engineering on the instrumentation in Sentry and Amplitude. * Check after release whether the feature changed the KPI it was tied to. Use the results to decide what to build next. **What you won't own** * Pricing, contracts or commercial terms. * Day\-to\-day account management and support, which stay with the forward\-deployed team. * Engineering execution, technical quality, automated testing, deployment, and monitoring, which stay with the engineering team. ### **What success looks like in your first 90 days** * Document the customer's payroll, enrollment, reconciliation, and reporting workflows, including the automations, workarounds, and failure points. * Publish a proposed 6–12 month roadmap with the engineering team. Tie each item to a customer problem and KPI, and review priorities and trade\-offs with the customer and CPO. * Take at least one existing automation through requirements, customer acceptance, and production release, working with engineering on monitoring and failure handling. * Establish a recurring customer report showing automation activity, failures, and available evidence of time saved or errors prevented. Identify gaps where measurement is not yet available. ### **How we work** * **Love and excellence.** We strive to win at the highest level and hold an extremely high bar, without losing the humanity that makes us who we are. * **High ownership.** You own problems end to end. No hand\-offs, no "not my problem." * **Crisp communication.** We say what we mean, raise problems early, and keep decisions easy to find. * **Fast iteration.** We ship in small batches, learn from members, and improve quickly. * **Results over process.** We care about what ships and how well it works, not how many meetings you attended. * **Our tools.** Claude Code, Cursor, Grok Bot, Codex, Conductor, Notion, Figma, Storybook, GitHub, Slack, Google Workspace, Wispr Flow, Intercom, and 1Password. * **Our stack.** TypeScript, Next.js, Hono, PostgreSQL, Temporal, WXT, AWS with Terraform, Flagsmith, Sentry, and Amplitude. ### **Why work at Rima** * **Hard problems.** Payroll and benefits operations are complex, the data is regulated, and automation has to be right every pay period. plans, and operational procedures. * Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Ability to manage jobs.title: Application Security Engineer (AI Governance & Cloud Security)
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Position:**Application Security Engineer (AI Governance \& Cloud Security) ============================================================================ **Location:** Chicago/U.S. **Reports To:** Director, IT, Info Security and Compliance **Job Overview** Reveal is hiring an Application Security Engineer to secure how we build software and how we adopt AI. This role sits at the point where three things meet: the security of the code and services we ship, the governance of the AI agents and models we put into production, and the posture of the cloud they all run on. You will own the tooling that makes that possible — Onyx Security as the control plane for AI agents and models, and Wiz across our cloud accounts and repositories — and you will be the person engineering teams come to when a design, a pipeline or a new AI tool needs a security opinion. The work is hands\-on: threat modeling, code review, remediation alongside the teams that own the fix, and the policy and reporting that lets leadership and auditors see where we stand. This role follows a hybrid model (4 days in office, 1 day work from home) for candidates residing in Illinois. Candidates based outside of Illinois may be considered for a remote work arrangement. **Responsibilities \& Duties** * Application security: Run threat modeling and secure design reviews for new features, services and integrations. * Application security: Perform manual code review and triage findings from SAST, DAST, SCA and secrets scanning. * Application security: Embed security checks into CI/CD pipelines without slowing delivery. * Application security: Lead remediation with engineering teams and track findings to closure against SLAs. * Application security: Support penetration tests, bug reports and customer security questionnaires. * AI governance: Own the Onyx Security platform as the control plane for AI agents and models across SaaS, cloud, endpoints and code. * AI governance: Use Onyx AI Observability to discover sanctioned and shadow AI, and review prompts, responses and agent actions. * AI governance: Write and enforce natural\-language governance policies and real\-time guardrails in Onyx. * AI governance: Manage agent permissions and secure MCP server connections to prevent over\-privileged access. * AI governance: Detect and respond to prompt injection, data exfiltration and AI misuse, and tune Onyx Guardian Agent remediation. * AI governance: Maintain the AI acceptable\-use policy, AI inventory and risk assessments with GRC, mapped to NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001\. * AI governance: Evaluate new AI tools, agents and vendors before adoption, and report AI adoption and risk metrics to leadership. * Cloud and code security: Own Wiz configuration, integrations, policies and alert routing across cloud accounts. * Cloud and code security: Triage Wiz Issues and toxic combinations, and drive fixes for misconfigurations, vulnerabilities and exposed secrets. * Cloud and code security: Use Wiz Code and IaC scanning to catch risk in repositories and Terraform before deployment. * Cloud and code security: Use Wiz AI Security Posture Management (AI\-SPM) to inventory AI services and models running in the cloud. * Cloud and code security: Build reports and dashboards on cloud risk trends for Security leadership and audits. * Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support team, department, and organizational goals. **Characteristics** * Breadth across domains: comfortable moving between application security, AI governance and cloud posture rather than specialising in only one. * Investigative mindset: naturally curious, and inclined to dig into an alert or a finding until the underlying cause is understood. * Proactive problem solver: anticipates security issues at design time rather than discovering them at deployment. * Autonomous and collaborative: takes ownership of the role and works effectively with distributed engineering teams. * Clear communicator: can explain the same risk to an engineer, to leadership and to an auditor, and be understood by all three. **Education \& Experience** * 4\+ years in application security, product security or security engineering. * Solid grasp of OWASP Top 10, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and agentic AI risks, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) security. * Ability to read and review code in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java or C\#. * Experience securing AWS, Azure or GCP workloads, containers and Kubernetes. * Familiarity with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure DevOps) and infrastructure as code. * Clear written communication for engineers, leadership and auditors. **Preferred Experience** * Experience building an AI governance program: AI inventory, model risk reviews, acceptable\-use policy. * Hands\-on experience with Wiz, including policy tuning, Issue triage and integrations (Jira, Slack, SIEM). * Hands\-on experience with Onyx Security or a comparable AI security and governance platform, including AI discovery, guardrails and agent permissions. * Knowledge of NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act. * Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001 or FedRAMP audits. * Background in legal tech, eDiscovery or other environments handling sensitive client data. * Scripting for automation (Python, Bash, Ruby) and experience with the Wiz API. * Certifications such as OSWE, GWAPT, CSSLP, CCSP or AWS Security Specialty, or the Wiz certifications. **Benefits and Perks include but are not limited to:** * 401k match program * Comprehensive health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, and HSA/FSA) * Group Term Life Insurance and Voluntary Life Insurance option * Paid holidays * Paid vacation, sick, and personal days * FSA dependent care benefit * Childbirth recovery and bonding leave policies * Short and long\-term disability benefits * Access to onsite gym and recreational area at our Chicago office * Friendly, collaborative, in\-office work environment with ample opportunity for professional development. For Illinois\-based roles, the budgeted annual salary range is $ 136,000 to $ 160,000\. Compensation for this role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Reveal offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes the Benefits and Perks set forth above. *This job description reflects the present requirements of the position. As duties and responsibilities change and develop, the job description will be reviewed and subject to amendment.* **Hiring Policy** Reveal is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Reveal does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non\-merit factor. *Reveal considers candidates with existing visas but does not sponsor new visa applications.*

jobs.title: Front End Engineer (Hybrid)

By offering unique card\-linked offers, we introduce diners to fantastic restaurant experiences, leveraging advanced technology and data analytics to deliver value to restaurants, diners, and our strategic partners' loyalty programs. **Our Culture** At Rewards Network, you'll be part of a driven and diverse team that excels in collaboration, issue resolution, and taking ownership of both personal growth and the company's success. We take pride in partnering with the world's most powerful loyalty programs to drive full\-price paying customers to local restaurants through marketing services and flexible funding options. Our engaging and rewarding environment is designed to help you gain your full potential. **Job Overview** This engineer builds the front\-end applications that serve three audiences: members, internal employees, and restaurant owners. The role exists to ship polished, accessible, well\-tested products on shared foundations: a common design system, a shared API client, and a monorepo that serves many partner brands. **This is a hybrid position that requires in office presence 3 days a week (Tuesday\-Thursday) in Chicago.** ### **What** **you'll** **bring to the table:** **(Responsibilities)** * Design, build, and ship features across the member app, internal operations tools, and merchant portal, from technical approach through production release. * Build reusable components and design\-system primitives that serve production issues, and use logging and monitoring to find root causes. * Improve developer experience by contributing to shared tooling, templates, and documentation. ### **Do you have the right mix jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Rex Moore continues to be powered by amazing employees just like you for over 100 years. Together we are building a world that is safe, comfortable, and sustainable. Our diverse team of experts spreading to National territories create innovative, integrated solutions to make cities more connected, buildings more intelligent and environments more comfortable and secure. Watch Our Story: About Rex Moore Group, Inc. \- YouTube **Job Overview****:** This is a hands\-on role with three parts: building automations and AI workflows, running our company AI tools, and advising on where AI goes next at Rex Moore. Your first priority is building the foundation: our AI and automation platform and the architecture the rest of the work runs on. After that, most of your time is spent building. You will own each solution through its full lifecycle: discover the problem, build the solution, run it after launch, and keep improving it. You will be judged on one thing: did someone's work week measurably change because of what you shipped. This is not a help desk, strategy\-only or prompt\-writing role. We are not tied to one vendor; you choose the right tool for each problem. You build, ship and support what you build, working with data engineering, IT and compliance within IT's security and governance standards. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Autonomy Evaluation & Metrics Platform
jobs.description: Rivian’s Autonomy Eval Infrastructure team builds the software that helps engineers understand and improve the ML models behind our driving systems and gives release teams evidence they can trust. Within Autonomy’s AI Platform organization, we connect model development with evaluation workflows, metrics, triage and visualization across simulation and real\-world vehicle data. As a senior metrics\-platform engineer, you will design, build and operate a substantial part of the platform that makes autonomy evaluation consistent and reproducible. Working directly with Perception, Planning and Systems engineers, you will connect model experiments to reliable metrics and help turn insights about model behavior, failure modes and generalization into improvements in models and data. This is a hands\-on software engineering role. You will own projects through design, implementation, rollout and operation, make practical system\-design trade\-offs, and mentor teammates. As an early member of a newly formed team, you will help establish the engineering practices and interfaces that make the platform useful across Autonomy. * Own the design and delivery of a metrics\-platform area, such as the metric registry, computation services or comparison and reporting APIs, in partnership with the team’s technical lead. * Design versioned metric definitions and data models for inputs, aggregation, slicing and results. Preserve provenance linking official evaluation runs to code, model, dataset and scenario versions. * Build distributed computation and storage paths with idempotent execution, incremental processing and controlled backfills. Make informed trade\-offs across throughput, latency, cost and reproducibility. * Build comparison tools that expose coverage, sample sizes, uncertainty and changes in evaluation inputs. Help users distinguish model regressions from data, simulator or infrastructure failures. * Partner with model developers to design evaluation experiments, inspect predictions and analyze failure patterns. Use the findings to guide model and data improvements, and build reusable evaluation harnesses that shorten the iteration cycle. * Integrate metrics and regression checks into replay and closed\-loop evaluation workflows and CI. Partner with domain owners on metric semantics and thresholds, and with Systems on evidence for release decisions. * Deliver self\-service APIs and scorecards backed by consistent definitions and results. Migrate existing consumers incrementally while preserving reporting continuity and traceability. * Own reliability and performance for your services through testing, observability, incident investigation and operational documentation; measure improvements in turnaround time, correctness and cost. * Write and review production code, lead design reviews for your projects, mentor engineers, and collaborate across Palo Alto, London and Belgrade to deliver software that users adopt. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience and impact, including ownership of production backend or data\-intensive systems. * Hands\-on experience building software for autonomy or robotics, with direct exposure to evaluation, simulation, perception, planning or validation workflows. * Strong Python programming skills, with the ability to write, test, profile and debug maintainable production software. * Practical SQL skills, with AI coding tools expected to support writing and refining queries; ability to validate query logic, results and performance. * Demonstrated system\-design ability across service APIs, data modeling, distributed processing and storage, including failure recovery, consistency and performance trade\-offs. * Experience taking a project from requirements and design through implementation, rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and communicating trade\-offs clearly. * Practical understanding of model inference and evaluation, including held\-out datasets, generalization, reproducibility and model versioning, and the differences between open\-loop replay, closed\-loop simulation and real\-world measurements. * Ability to reason about sampling, confidence intervals, noisy metrics and valid comparisons, and to work with domain experts when stronger statistical analysis is needed. * Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD and production observability, plus a track record of constructive code review and mentoring. Bonus Points * Experience building metric registries, evaluation services, experiment\-tracking systems or automated regression gates used by multiple engineering teams. * Experience with Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake or comparable distributed data systems, and with AWS, Docker or GitLab CI. * Experience migrating analytical or reporting systems without breaking downstream consumers, or linking metrics to scenario\-level debugging and triage. * Experience with PyTorch or similar ML frameworks, evaluation of end\-to\-end driving models, or connecting offline model metrics to closed\-loop and real\-world driving behavior.

Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work. We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end\-to\-end customer lifecycle. Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers. ### **Obsession: Commit unreasonably.** In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day. ### **Action: Get it done.** Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. environments and move with urgency * Background in distributed systems * Understanding of large scale IT organizations * Programming experience in Python, plus SQL for working with large datasets * Fluent in AI native programming and system design * Familiarity with GTM methodologies (e.g. MEDDIC, SPIN, SPICED) and how users apply them * Excited to work across onboarding, sales engineering, and customer success in a hybrid role * Strong communication skills and comfort presenting to both technical and business stakeholders * Bias toward scaling yourself through process, tooling, and collaboration * Curious and customer\-obsessed: you’re always learning and looking for ways to delight users * Be located in or willing to relocate to New York **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive pay with considerable equity upside * Medical, dental, and vision, including 100% company\-paid plans for you and eligible dependents * Company\-paid life \& AD\&D, plus short\- and long\-term * Wellness stipend: $375/quarter * Learning stipend: up to $2,000/year * Internet \& cell phone stipend: $25/month * Mental health support, virtual care, and care navigation * Fertility \& family\-building support, plus backup care membership * Pre\-tax commuter benefits (transit \& parking) * SF HQ: daily catered breakfast \& lunch, meal allowances, and rideshare support when commuting jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer, Early Career
jobs.description: **Region:** North America, all regions ### **The Role** SDVI’s backend engineers build the systems at the core of SDVI Rally. That starts with the distributed, microservice\-based platform that processes hundreds of thousands of hours of video content every month. It also includes products built on Rally itself to solve use cases many customers share, and a more data\-driven next generation of Rally. This role is for someone early in their career, joining a team that works AI\-first. You’ll help build the agent\-driven tooling and process we use to create reusable Rally supply chains that solve common customer use cases, and push how much of that work AI agents can take on. You’ll work with senior engineers, take well\-defined pieces of work from design to production, and grow toward owning part of that system yourself. ### **What You’ll Work On** * Build and maintain python backend services with guidance from senior engineers * Help build the agent\-driven tooling, pipelines, and checks we use to create reusable Rally supply chains * Work with AI coding agents every day, and help the team find where agents can take on more of the work and where a person still needs to decide * Write and optimize database queries and REST APIs * Establish trust in your work with effective development\-loop tests * Take part in code reviews, and ask questions to learn the codebase and the technologies behind it * Work with customers and customer\-facing teams to understand the use cases behind your work * Take part in design discussions, and apply the feedback you get on your own designs ### **What Success Looks Like** * **First 90 days.** You’ve shipped production changes with guidance, use AI agents as a normal part of how you deliver, can find your way around the code you work in, and take part in code reviews. * **First year.** You own part of the tooling we use to create reusable supply chains, deliver changes from design to production with little guidance, and have helped change how the team uses AI to ship. ### **What You’ll Bring** * Curiosity about new systems and technologies, and the habit of reading the docs and code before asking, then asking good questions * Clear, accurate communication about your work, and honesty about what you don’t know yet * Some experience building backend software in a mainstream server\-side language, from work, internships, or your own projects. We mostly use Python, but value being able to read and understand many languages over fluency in any one. If your strongest language is something else, you should be able to read Python and understand it thoroughly. * A working understanding of REST APIs and relational databases * Experience writing automated tests for your own code * Hands\-on experience building software with AI coding agents, interest in pushing how far they can go, and the habit of checking what they produce ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with FastAPI, Flask, SQLAlchemy, or PostgreSQL * Experience with Docker and containerized deployments * Experience with a mainstream cloud platform, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure * Exposure to distributed systems or data pipelines * Familiarity with professional media formats, such as codecs, container formats, and metadata, and how media supply chains use them If you don’t meet every point above, we’d still like to hear from you. ### **How We Work** * **We’re small and distributed.** Most of our collaboration happens over Slack and Zoom, across time zones. You’ll own what you build, and you’ll work closely with people outside your immediate team. * **Engineers stay close to customers.** You’ll hear directly from the people using what you build. When something goes wrong in production, the team that owns the code helps fix it. * **We dig for root causes.** When something breaks, we find out why instead of patching the symptom and moving on. * **We ship, then refine.** We work in short sprints and improve things over time instead of waiting for a perfect first version. ### **How We Use AI** AI coding agents are part of how we work every day, and we invest in getting good at using them. We’re also careful with them, because customers run their content operations on Rally. We’re tracking industry trends and innovations, but using our day\-to\-day experiences to separate signal from noise. Our engineers are still responsible for the code they ship. We still expect them to explain and defend its architecture and intent, even as more is built with an agent’s help. We judge work by its quality, not its quantity. This role is not a fit for someone who would rather not use AI tools, or who is used to shipping generated changes they couldn’t explain. It probably is a fit for someone who knows where these tools go wrong and how to achieve quality with speed. ### **Logistics** * This is a remote role, open to candidates across the United States * Occasional travel may be required, but is not core to this role * Interview process: introductory call, AI proficiency interview, team technical interview, interview project, interview project presentation, and founders interview ### **Compensation and Benefits** *Salary range $90,000 to $145,000* *Salary range represents the expected range for this position and is based on a number of factors, including location, and* *will* *vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges are US\-applicable only.* ### **You Should Be Interested in SDVI Because:** * You are looking for your next big challenge * You are looking for a company that welcomes your talent virtually * You want teammates you can learn from, and who will learn from you * You want to be part of a team that respects individuals and their work * You consider the big picture and your contribution to it SDVI offers a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salary, medical, vision, dental, 401(k) match, and stock options in a stimulating and rewarding distributed work environment. SDVI is committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusivity in our workforce. We maintain a courteous work environment that recognizes the dignity and worth of each employee. SDVI respects the individual needs of employees and is an equal\-opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Layout Engineer

In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross\-functional launch teams, suppliers, and build crews to ensure spatial accuracy, resolve design interferences, and support seamless facility installations from planning through pilot builds. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain overall 2D plant layouts using AutoCAD in alignment with production flow and facility constraints. * Integrate supplier and contractor drawings—including tooling, tool rails, platforms, and other assembly aids—into master plant layouts. * Create custom AutoCAD blocks (such as carriers, tooling, tool presentations, and aisles), evaluate spatial interferences, and provide design resolutions. * Release weekly layout updates to the core product launch team. * Perform on\-site field checks to identify existing monuments and verify layout accuracy against physical facility conditions. * Provide detailed build and installation drawings to the installation and build teams. * Participate in pilot builds and process validation to verify layout accuracy and resolve design\-related issues on the floor. * Adhere strictly to all customer CAD standards, including file naming conventions, layer structures, and Xrefs. * Upload, organize, and maintain all layout files within Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC). **Qualifications** * At least 5 years of experience in automotive manufacturing with strong proficiency in AutoCAD. * Demonstrated experience creating and maintaining standardized AutoCAD block libraries. * Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify spatial interferences and verify designs via physical field checks. **Preferred Skills** * Knowledge of converting 2D layouts to 3D using AutoCAD Product Design \& Manufacturing Collection (PDMC) tools. * Experience rendering and reviewing 3D facility models in Navisworks.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **THE COMPANY:** STACK INFRASTRUCTURE (STACK) provides digital infrastructure to scale the world’s most innovative companies. We are an award\-winning industry leader in building, owning, and operating highly efficient, cost\-effective wholesale, colocation, and cloud data centers. Each of our national facilities meets or exceeds the highest industry standards in all operational categories of availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience. STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data. Data runs on STACK. **THE POSITION:** STACK is seeking a Controls Engineer to join our Technical Operations team and play a pivotal role in supporting the construction, operation, and maintenance of BMS and EPMS systems at our new data center facilities in New Mexico. The Controls Engineer will work directly with site operations, engineering, construction, commissioning teams, vendors, and internal technical stakeholders to ensure reliable, scalable, and secure controls performance across a large, mission\-critical campus. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Develop a comprehensive understanding of mechanical, electrical, controls, and monitoring architectures, including chilled water plant controls, plant operation, electrical distribution monitoring, and campus\-level system integration. * Support the implementation, commissioning, operation, and optimization of PLC\-based controls systems across mission\-critical mechanical and electrical infrastructure. * Maintain and troubleshoot Ignition front\-end systems, including screens, tags, alarms, historian functions, user interfaces, integrations, and reporting. * Support MQTT\-based data movement and system integration and related edge or enterprise messaging infrastructure. * Work with databases supporting controls, monitoring, alarming, reporting, analytics, and operational data workflows. * Partner with site operations teams to troubleshoot controls\-related events, perform root cause analysis, and support corrective actions for building automation, PLC, SCADA, and EPMS\-related systems. * Support integration and validation of power quality meters, including devices configured for continuous waveform monitoring, event capture, power quality analysis, and electrical system diagnostics. * Collaborate with commissioning agents, contractors, vendors, and internal engineering teams to verify system performance, sequence execution, alarm behavior, trend collection, data integrity, and turnover documentation. * Support site operations by reviewing control logic, plant staging, pumping sequences, valve control, temperature control, differential pressure strategies, and system performance. * Assist with operational readiness, site acceptance testing, integrated systems testing, and turnover of controls and monitoring systems from construction to operations. * Ensure proper metering, trending, and data collection to support operational reporting, energy efficiency, reliability tracking, and long\-term optimization. * Partner with IT, cybersecurity, network, and monitoring teams to support secure and reliable connectivity for OT systems, PLCs, SCADA servers, MQTT brokers, databases, and field devices. * Provide technical support and training to site personnel on controls system functionality, alarm response, data interpretation, and troubleshooting procedures. * Support standards development and continuous improvement efforts for controls architecture, PLC programming practices, Ignition development, data modeling, alarm management, and documentation. **THE DETAILS:** * Location: Santa Teresa, New Mexico; On\-site * Compensation: $160,000 \- $195,000 annually with 10% bonus potential * Benefits: Healthcare, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Paid Leave Programs * Travel: Up to 15% domestically * Must be eligible to work in the United States * Must pass comprehensive background screening **MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Controls, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience with building automation, industrial controls, SCADA, PLCs, EPMS, or mission\-critical facility control systems. * Hands\-on experience with Allen\-Bradley PLCs, including PLC logic review, troubleshooting, field validation, and integration with supervisory systems. * Experience with Ignition SCADA, including tag structures, alarm configuration, graphics, historian functions, scripting, reporting, and system integration. * Strong understanding of mechanical systems, especially chilled water systems, chiller plants, pumping systems, heat rejection, and hydronic loops. * Familiarity with electrical monitoring systems, power quality meters, and EPMS concepts in mission\-critical environments. * Experience with industrial communication protocols and integration methods, including some combination of EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, BACnet, SNMP, MQTT, and OPC UA. * Ability to troubleshoot complex controls issues involving PLCs, SCADA, network connectivity, field devices, sensors, actuators, meters, and databases. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues to engineering, construction, operations, vendors, and non\-technical stakeholders. * Must be comfortable working in a high\-stress, fast\-paced mission\-critical environment with shifting priorities. * Must be willing to support off\-hours troubleshooting, maintenance windows, emergency response, and critical operational events as needed. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Experience supporting hyperscale, semiconductor, industrial, utility, or other large\-scale mission\-critical campuses. * Ignition certification or advanced Ignition development experience. * Experience with enterprise MQTT broker platforms. * Experience with SEL power quality meters and relays. * Working knowledge of SQL databases, preferably PostgreSQL, for data collection, reporting, analytics, and controls system integration. * Understanding of OT cybersecurity concepts, network segmentation, authentication, certificate management, and secure access practices. **Compensation Range:** $133,000\.00 \- $154,000\.00**THIS MIGHT BE RIGHT FOR YOU IF:** * You are a strong communicator, you are persuasive and clear, blending analytics with experience in decision\-making. * You do not get flustered easily. You can juggle multiple priorities while balancing urgent requests with shifting timelines and deliverables. * You are a team builder. You take the time to understand and develop the strengths of your resources while formulating long\-term plans for the growth and success of the team. * You are naturally curious and driven toward continual improvement. While you celebrate your successes, you take time to review and analyze campaigns for future learning. **WHY STACK?** * We offer a competitive compensation package with strong benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401K program, flexible spending accounts – even a cell phone subsidy. * We foster a culture of appreciation, including peer\-to\-peer recognition and rewards programs. * Fun is part of our DNA, with events, game nights, happy hours, and barbecues. * We’re growing – this is a great time to join and make an impact! *STACK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. faster and safer. **Who You Are** --------------- * **A builder who ships.** You love writing software, use coding agents fluently, and take responsibility for the quality of your work. * **A fast learner.** You get oriented in unfamiliar codebases, ask focused questions, and turn direction into working software without needing every step spelled out. * **Focused on outcomes.** You understand jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI models behind our diagnostic platform. You'll work on modern, large\-scale machine learning for health, turning large, messy, real\-world datasets into models that carry real clinical signal. You'll join a team of AI engineers who care about doing this the right way. We're looking for someone who brings current knowledge of the field, whether from graduate research or hands\-on work, and who pushes the team to approach problems from a modern AI perspective. We want someone who understands why methods work, not someone who can only run a tutorial notebook on an off\-the\-shelf model. Together you'll assemble and curate large datasets, train and evaluate models, and show whether they carry real clinical signal. Learning goes both ways here. You'll work alongside experienced AI engineers who review your code and talk through your results, and we expect you to teach them what's new. The work is hands\-on from week one. Over time you'll own larger pieces of the pipeline, from data to deployed model. ### **Responsibilities** * Train and evaluate modern deep learning models on large datasets, including self\-supervised approaches and fine\-tuning of large pretrained models. * Build and maintain the data pipelines that feed them: collecting, cleaning, deduplicating, and versioning large video datasets. * Develop ways to learn from noisy or limited labels, and measure how much real signal the models carry. * Run experiments carefully: track runs, make results reproducible, and write up what you found, including negative results. * Design evaluations that reflect real\-world use, and show clearly where offline metrics and product performance diverge. * Support our existing computer vision work as models move toward production. * Write clean, tested, well\-documented Python that teammates can pick up and reuse. * Take part in code review and technical discussions, and explain your results to both technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Stay on top of current AI research. Reproduce promising methods, propose experiments, and teach the team what you learn. * Pitch in on whatever the team needs. We're small, and everyone does a bit of everything. ### **About Senseye** Senseye is a NeuroTechnology company based in Austin, TX, on the cusp of revolutionizing mental health. We're developing the world's first objective mental health diagnostics platform, measuring cognitive activity through the eye using mobile devices. Our initial diagnostic for PTSD is entering clinical trials, with additional indications for anxiety and depression to follow. We're a team of scientists, engineers, and clinicians building technology that could redefine how mental health is understood and treated. **Requirements** * Master's degree or PhD in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience showing comparable machine learning skills, such as several years of applied ML work or substantial published or open\-source work. * Recent graduates are welcome. Up to about 3 years of hands\-on ML experience, including graduate research, a thesis, internships, and industry work, is a plus. * Solid Python and experience with at least one deep learning framework. * A working grasp of ML fundamentals: training and validation, overfitting, evaluation metrics, and why a good test score isn't the same as a working product. * Hands\-on experience with modern deep learning beyond off\-the\-shelf use. You've trained or substantially adapted models yourself and can explain your design choices and the tradeoffs. * Comfort with Git, the command line, and working on a shared codebase. * Clear writing and communication. You can explain a result or a plot simply and say what you're unsure of. * Curiosity and the habit of digging in when something looks off, in the data or in your own code. ### **Extra Points** None of these are required. * Hands\-on experience with self\-supervised, contrastive, or masked\-modeling methods. * Experience with large\-scale training: multi\-GPU runs or experiment tracking such as Weights \& Biases. * Experience with video, time\-series, or sensor data. * Experience with noisy\-label learning or semi\-supervised methods. * A paper, open\-source contribution, or substantial personal project you can show us. * Exposure to healthcare, medical device software, or other regulated settings. **Benefits** * Flexible schedule and flexible paid time off * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Short\- and long\-term disability and life insurance * 401(k) * Continuing education opportunities * Health and Wellness stipend * Fully stocked kitchen and a flexible hybrid environment * The freedom and trust to shape your role as we design, build, and ship our products

The role provides technical ownership across data engineering initiatives, translating target\-state architecture and platform standards into scalable, secure, governed, and supportable solutions. The Senior Data Engineer leads the technical execution of data modernization efforts, independently solves complex engineering problems, and ensures solutions meet enterprise standards for performance, security, reliability, observability, governance, and cost. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** SmartRent (NYSE: SMRT) is revolutionizing how people live and work with the industry's only end\-to\-end platform designed for the rental housing industry. By uniting purpose\-built software, integrated hardware and full implementation and support in one ecosystem, we help owners and operators simplify operations, cut costs and deliver exceptional resident experiences. Recognized by Deloitte, HousingWire and the PropTech Breakthrough Awards, SmartRent is shaping the future of property technology and redefining what it means to make rental housing smarter. **Job Description** As a Data Engineer at SmartRent, you will build the pipelines that turn SmartRent's device telemetry, operational and enterprise data into trusted, governed assets. You'll build and deploy production\-grade data pipelines in Databricks by partnering closely with Data Science, Product, and functional stakeholders to curate disparate data sources into actionable assets. Reporting to the Director of Data Engineering, part of our new transformational Enterprise Data and AI organization, you will use your hands\-on experience to mature our Databricks Lakehouse to increasingly become the nexus of data\-driven insight across SmartRent. **Responsibilities** * Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for high\-volume device telemetry and operational data. * Design curated data models across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers in Unity Catalog that serve data science, ML, and AI workloads. * Deploy and promote pipelines using Databricks Asset Bundles, in partnership with DevOps. * Contribute to platform standards for governance, cost, and performance with the Director of Data and DevOps. * Build and maintain datasets that support agentic AI workloads, including curating unstructured data, leveraging vector\- and search\-based data stores. * Drive the maturity of our data quality framework, including data sensitivity classification and access controls as part of the end\-to\-end pipeline creation process. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent professional experience. * 5\+ years in data engineering, including production work with core and emerging features in Databricks. * Demonstrated experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow (Declarative Pipelines and Jobs), Lakebase, Asset Bundles. * Experience ingesting and modeling high\-volume IoT, telemetry, or event\-stream data. * Advanced Python and SQL skills * Familiarity with relevant data structures such as CSV, JSON, Parquet and Delta. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to present technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience enabling self\-service data access in Databricks using features such as AI/BI Dashboards and Genie. * Experience in proptech, real estate technology, IoT, or SaaS platform environments. * Databricks Associate or Professional Certifications for data engineering. * Familiarity with Git\-based version control and Terraform. ### **We Put Our Employees First** We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well\-being and future. For our US employees, this includes medical, dental, vision, and life insurance with low deductibles and 75–100% employer contributions. We also provide flexible and generous PTO (because we know how important work\-life balance is), a competitive 401(k) with employer contributions, paid parental leave, discounted insurance plans for pets and legal services and an employee stock purchase plan to help you invest in your future. ### **You'll fit right in if you:** * Do the hard work and go out of your way to deliver excellence * Own outcomes and learn from your mistakes * Are a collaborative and supportive team player—win or lose, you lift others up * Value authenticity, diverse perspectives, and inclusion in the workplace * Have a passion for smart tech and the real estate industry Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** We are seeking a capable and experienced Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our Semiconductor team. This role will work onsite with strategic semiconductor customers, shipping AI and software solutions that run inside their engineering and test workflows. The selected candidate will work shoulder to shoulder with the customer’s design, validation, characterization, test and product teams to turn real engineering pain points into working solutions. The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on software engineer and technical consultant with strong experience building production software using generative AI, complemented by a working understanding of the semiconductor lifecycle. The role requires ownership, technical depth, clarity in communication, and the ability to deploy and debug in complex, secured customer environments. **Position Overview:** The Forward Deployed Engineer – Semiconductor will embed full\-time with a strategic semiconductor customer and own the end\-to\-end solution journey, from discovery and problem framing to architecture, development, field deployment and iteration. The role will coordinate closely with customer engineers and managers across design, post\-silicon validation, characterization, ATE/production test, applications and product engineering. The position will also drive measurable outcomes such as cycle time saved, yield insight gained and manual effort removed through rapid, feedback\-driven iteration. **Key Responsibilities:** * Customer Embedding \- Work onsite with semiconductor engineering teams across design, post\-silicon validation, characterization, ATE/production test, applications and product engineering. * Problem Framing \- Run discovery with engineers and managers and map their workflows. Turn loosely defined pain points into scoped, measurable use cases. * Solution Architecture \- Design solutions that fit the customer’s infrastructure, security rules and tool chain. Make and communicate the key technical trade\-offs. * Production\-Grade Development \- Build data pipelines for test and lab data (STDF, bench logs, wafer/lot data). Develop API and tool integrations, and AI/LLM and agentic workflows. * Field Deployment \& Debugging \- Get solutions running on customer servers, lab machines and clouds. Troubleshoot in live environments with instruments, test systems and EDA/PLM tools. * Rapid Iteration \& Outcome Delivery \- Ship early versions in weeks and gather field feedback. Improve continuously until the outcome is proven — cycle time saved, yield insight gained, manual effort removed. **Qualifications:** * BE/BTech/MS in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience building and shipping production software, including 2\+ years in semiconductor, test \& measurement or hardware\-adjacent engineering. * Strong Python experience. * Hands\-on experience with data pipelines, REST/gRPC APIs, databases, and MLOps or LLM/AI application workflows. * Working understanding of the semiconductor lifecycle — design, bring\-up, validation, characterization, production test — and the data each stage produces. * Comfort deploying and debugging onsite in complex, secured enterprise and lab environments. * Clear communicator who can translate engineering needs into architecture and explain trade\-offs to engineers and managers alike. * Willingness to work full\-time at customer sites and travel as engagements require. **Good to Have Skills:** * Familiarity with semiconductor test data formats (STDF), wafer/lot data and yield analysis. * Exposure to lab instruments, ATE/test systems and EDA/PLM tool chains. * Experience building LLM\-based or agentic applications in production. * Consulting or customer\-facing engineering experience, with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations. * Proactive, outcome\-driven, and comfortable working with ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment. **Benefits:** * We want every Soliton member to grow to their highest potential. Our work environment helps individuals explore their interests and potential and reach out to the resources and people available at Soliton to realize them. Read more about what it’s like to work at Soliton Careers \| Soliton Technologies * Solitons choose their work hours as long as it takes into account the requirements of the job. We take special care to support mothers to excel at work while they handle their responsibilities at home. * At Soliton, we believe that every team member contributes to our success and revenue, directly or indirectly. To recognize this, we share a portion of our profits with all Solitons. Starting from your second year with us, you’ll be eligible to receive a share of the company’s profits. * Health insurance for employees \- your health is a priority! **About Soliton:** Soliton Technologies Pvt. Ltd., a high\-technology software company headquartered in Bangalore, India. Soliton works with global companies, from start\-ups to Fortune 500, across industries including Semiconductors, Medical Devices, Automotive, Industry 4\.0, and Robotics to help them increase their competitiveness and release great products through Software Engineering Services. Since 1997, we have been growing over 25% annually because we especially focus on raising our standards constantly, to deliver an excellent experience to both our customers and our employees. Soliton Technologies is a certified Great Place to Work® in the Mid\-Sized Organizations Category, recognized and issued by the Great Place to Work® Institute. This certification is a testament to our focus on our values of Respect, Integrity, Excellence, and Innovation. With a team of over 400 employees across the world, we forge ahead as engineers working to our heart’s content, moving humanity forward. **Additional Details:** * Work Location (US \- San Jose and Dallas): This role is customer\-embedded and requires working 4–5 days a week at the client site. Also we are looking for candidates with active US work visa/US residents. * Employment Type: Full\-time. * For more information, visit https://www.solitontech.com/ and do read the Impact Report to get a glimpse of the first 25 years of our truly meaningful journey. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Jose, CA 95110
