Located in Memphis, Tennessee, the mission of St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital is to advance cures, and means of prevention, for pediatric catastrophic diseases through research and treatment. Every day, St. Jude generates some of the most valuable data in pediatric medicine, including genomic and multi omics data, medical images, clinical records, and the operational detail of running a hospital and research institute. We are seeking a Director of Data and AI to take that data further and help make trusted, AI ready data part of how St. Jude works. This leader will guide the next phase of our enterprise Databricks platform on Azure and drive adoption across research, administration, operations, and clinical integration. The Director will lead a talented team of data engineers, AI engineers, product leads, platform architects, and solutions engineers, translating platform capability into measurable mission impact. **This position may be eligible for remote work.** However, St. Jude requires all remote employees to: * Travel to our Memphis campus for the interview process and/or orientation, if selected * Travel to Memphis to work on\-site for one week per quarter, or as requested based on business needs, if hired. By applying, you acknowledge and agree to these travel requirements as a condition of employment. This position is remote within approved U.S. locations. Due to state\-specific employment regulations, we are unable to consider applicants currently residing in California for remote work; however, candidates based in California who are willing to relocate to an approved location may be considered. **Your Top Priority: Make Our Data Platform the Way St. Jude Works** ==================================================================== We have built a strong foundation on Databricks. Your central goal is to make it the first place teams turn for trusted data, analytics, and AI. A platform creates value when people use it and when it keeps pace with what they will need next, so you will lead both the overall data platform strategy and the adoption strategy that makes it matter across the institution. * Set the platform strategy and stay a few steps ahead. Keep a clear roadmap of what to enable next, anticipate where research, clinical, and operational needs and AI capabilities are heading, and advise the Vice President, Data \& Analytics on where we need to go. * Set the adoption strategy. Define success and establish targets for active users, teams onboarded, certified data products in use, self service usage, AI solution adoption, and legacy reports and tools retired. * Know your users. Engage scientists, clinicians, finance and HR teams, and operational leaders to understand what they need, what slows them down, and what would make them change how they work. * Make it easy. Remove friction in access, onboarding, and tooling. Provide ready to use data products, templates, and natural language tools that help users get answers without waiting for a custom build. * Build a network of champions. Create a federated model of embedded partners and data champions who teach, support, and advocate within their departments. * Teach and enable. Launch training, office hours, communities of practice, and clear guidance on data tools and responsible AI use for every level of the organization. * Retire the old to make room for the new. Consolidate redundant reports, data marts, and shadow tools so teams have fewer, better, and more trusted sources. * Show the value. Measure and communicate time saved, decisions improved, research accelerated, operational performance improved, and legacy technology retired. **What You Will Lead** ====================== **Build the Platform That Powers the Institution:** * Own the strategy, roadmap, and continued implementation of the enterprise Databricks platform on Azure, including lakehouse architecture, pipelines, workspaces, security, identity, networking, reliability, performance, capacity, and cost management. * Set direction with platform architects on enterprise standards, reusable reference patterns, technical decisions, and operating practices that are secure, scalable, supportable, and designed to last. * Deliver governed, reusable data products across research, administration, and operations. Integrate clinical data in close partnership with the Director of Clinical Data and Analytics. * Assess and introduce capabilities such as AI/BI Genie, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakebase, Mosaic AI, MLflow, model serving, and Vector Search where they solve real institutional problems. * Manage platform vendors, consulting partners, clou contracts, data quality, structured and unstructured data preparation, embeddings, retrieval, and knowledge grounding. * MLOps and LLMOps, including evaluation, monitoring, versioning, guardrails, human oversight, incident response, and lifecycle management. * Experience operating data and analytics as a product practice. * Data governance implementation in a modern platform, including cataloging, ownership, stewardship, classification, access control, lineage, quality, and responsible AI controls. * Knowledge of HIPAA and privacy practices, including de identification and access controls for sensitive clinical and research data. * Strategic thinking and roadmap planning ability, including tracking emerging data, platform, and AI capabilities, translating them into a sequenced roadmap of what to enable next, and advising executive leaders on investment and direction. * Strong executive presence and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear, plain language to senior executives, boards, clinicians, scientists, and external audiences. * Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder engagement, emotional intelligence, sound judgment, and the ability to influence across clinical, scientific, administrative, operational, and technical groups. * Experience speaking at conferences, publishing, or representing an organization in external data and AI collaborations. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Experience with EHR data and healthcare standards such as Epic, Cerner, HL7, FHIR, OMOP, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, and DICOM. * Experience with genomic, multi omics, imaging, high performance computing, or GPU enabled research environments. * Experience supporting open science and secure data sharing with external collaborators, including cloud based research environments and controlled access data. * Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or biomedical vocabularies that improve data interoperability and AI accuracy. * Certification or formal training in product management, agile delivery, or organizational change management. **Why Join St. Jude?** ====================== You will work on data that matters in service of a mission unlike any other. You will have the backing of institutional leaders who see data and AI as essential to St. Jude’s future and the opportunity to build a team and platform that people across the institution rely on to advance cures and save children. **Compensation** In recognition of certain U.S. state and municipal pay transparency laws, St. Jude is including a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This is an estimate offered in good faith and a specific salary offer takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the salary range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is $138,320 \- $262,080 per year for the role of Director, Data and AI. Explore our exceptional benefits! We are committed to a human\-centered hiring experience. Technology may support portions of our process, but recruiting decisions involve human review and engagement. Learn more about our approach to AI. St. Jude is an Equal Opportunity Employer **No Search Firms** St. Jude Children's Research Hospital does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. Please do not call or email. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee or other representative at St. Jude via email, the internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place and approved by HR will result in no fee being paid in the event the candidate is hired by St. Jude.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Mainframe (COBOL/PL1)
jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most. **HYBRID:** Hybrid Work Arrangement: A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. For Enterprise Technology, a hybrid work arrangement will require approximately 40% in\-office time each month, beginning in late 2027\. **HUB LOCATIONS:** Bloomington, IL; Richardson, TX; Tempe, AZ; Dunwoody, GA **SPONSORSHIP: Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H\-1B visa) for this opportunity.** Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: **Software Engineer – Fire Suite****3 Positions Available \| Mainframe Engineering****Bring Your Mainframe Expertise. Help Build What’s Next.** 3 openings. 3 teams. 3 leaders. One Fire Suite. Each position offers the opportunity to bring your skills to a different team within the Fire Suite—all connected by a shared mission to strengthen, modernize, and help shape the future of Fire. This is an opportunity to do more than maintain existing applications. You'll solve complex business and technical problems, develop and enhance critical Fire capabilities, troubleshoot processing across interconnected systems, and help modernize how we build, test, and deliver software through **AI, automation, GitLab, and CI/CD**. If you enjoy digging into challenging problems, understanding how systems work from end to end, and turning business needs into dependable technical solutions, we'd love to have you help us build what's next.**What You'll Do** As a Software Engineer within the Fire Suite, you will:* Develop, maintain, and enhance mainframe applications primarily using **COBOL**, with PL/1 experience as an added advantage. * Translate business requirements into technical solutions, including validation, calculation, transaction\-processing, and business\-rule logic. * Develop and maintain **COBOL programs, JCL jobs, Db2 SQL, file\-processing logic, batch workflows, and system interfaces**. * Work extensively with **IMS and Db2 databases** and manage batch scheduling and processing using tools such as **Control\-M and Auto/Fire flow**. * Create technical and component specifications documenting processing, proposed changes, impacted programs, data, interfaces, business rules, error handling, and testing requirements. * Perform **impact analysis** across programs, copybooks, data elements, records, interfaces, and connected systems to understand upstream and downstream impacts. * Conduct **unit, integration, negative, boundary, and regression testing**, create test transactions, and validate processing results. * Review job output, return codes, spool files, database updates, generated transactions, reports, and downstream results to ensure accuracy. * Monitor and troubleshoot **batch jobs, transaction errors, abends, missing output, and incorrect processing results**. * Investigate production issues, determine root cause, coordinate corrections, and verify successful reprocessing. * Support integrations with upstream and downstream systems and business processes. * Prepare implementation instructions, promote components through test environments, support production deployments, and perform post\-implementation verification. * Apply **Agile and product\-management best practices** to assigned work. * Collaborate with engineers, business partners, and stakeholders to solve complex problems and deliver high\-quality solutions. * Use **AI tools and techniques in development and testing** to improve quality, productivity, and problem solving. * Contribute to continuous improvement of our engineering practices, including **GitLab, Git/IDz, CI/CD pipelines, testing, and automation**. * Create and maintain technical documentation, component designs, processing flows, implementation details, and testing requirements. Qualifications: **What You'll Bring** We're looking for engineers with strong technical fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to navigate complex systems and business processes.**Key skills and experience include:*** Strong **COBOL** development experience. * Experience with **PL/1** is highly beneficial. * Strong **JCL** development and troubleshooting skills. * Deep knowledge of **IMS and Db2**. * Experience with batch scheduling and processing, including **Control\-M and/or Auto/Fire flow**. * Strong knowledge and practical experience using **AI tools and techniqu skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. Additional experience with **REXX scripting, SAS analytics, SPLUNK, IDAA, GitLab, and CI/CD practices** is valuable.**Business knowledge or previous experience with Fire products—legacy, web\-based, or both—is highly beneficial.****What Will Help You Thrive** We're looking for engineers who are technically strong but also **curious, collaborative, and willing to dig deeper**. You'll be successful here if you enjoy understanding the business behind the technology, tracing complex processing from beginning to end, taking ownership of difficult problems, and continuously looking for better ways to develop, test, and deliver solutions. We're interested in your ability to understand the problem, analyze the logic, develop an effective solution, and demonstrate strong engineering fundamentals.**Why Fire Suite?** You'll join a team responsible for **complex, business\-critical technology while helping evolve how that technology is engineered for the future**. It's an opportunity to deepen your mainframe expertise, expand your Fire business knowledge, solve challenging problems, and help advance our use of **AI, automation, modern development tooling, and CI/CD**. We're looking for 3 **Software Engineers** who want to bring their experience, curiosity, and ideas to the team.**Bring your mainframe expertise. Learn the business behind the code. Help us build what's next for Fire Suite.** Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week!* Potential starting salary range: $85,500 \- $145,000 * + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!*** **Get Paid!** On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * **Stay Well!** Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * **Develop and Grow!** Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * **Plan Ahead!** Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * **Take a Little “You” Time!** You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * **Give Back!** We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * **Finish Strong!** Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. **Visit our** **State Farm Careers** **page for more information on our** **benefits****,** **locations****, and the** **hiring process** **of joining the State Farm team!**

jobs.title: IT Software Engineer IV
jobs.description: ### **Information Technology Services \- ITS** #### **State of Idaho Opportunity** **Applications will be accepted through 4:59 PM MST on the posting end date.** **About Information Technology Services** Information Technology Services is a team of dedicated professionals providing core technology and cybersecurity services to agencies across the state of Idaho. Our work enables state employees to deliver essential services to Idaho’s citizens. We invite you to join our team and help strengthen the technology services that support state government. **Summary:** Build software that helps Idaho state agencies serve the people who depend on them. The Office of Information Technology Services (ITS) is seeking an IT Software Engineer IV onsite at our Boise, Idaho Chinden Campus to help strengthen and modernize the applications that support public services across the state. In this hands\-on senior engineering role, you will work alongside developers designing, building, and delivering secure, reliable applications. You will contribute production code, solve challenging integration problems, and help modernize established systems while preserving the essential services they provide. Working with agency partners and technical teams, you will translate business needs into practical solutions that improve services and support the responsible use of state resources. As part of the senior engineering team, you will share technical leadership responsibilities, with assignments and priorities coordinated by the development manager. You will help other developers succeed through collaborative problem\-solving, code reviews, and mentoring. Your experience and judgment will guide architectural decisions and improvements in testing, security, and deployment practices. This position offers the opportunity to stay closely involved in software development while shaping the technical direction of applications with a lasting public service impact. **Please note:** Successful candidates will be required to pass multiple, comprehensive fingerprint\-based background checks specific to the agencies ITS supports. **Example of duties:** * Leads the architecture, development, and modernization of complex enterprise applications, including assessing legacy systems, evaluating alternatives, and planning migrations that preserve essential business functions * Serves on the senior engineering team, providing technical leadership for agency software portfolios and collaborating with development teams to resolve complex design, integration, and maintenance challenges within established enterprise standards * Works directly within development teams to design, write, test, and deliver secure production code, implement reusable components and complex integrations * Designs secure, reliable, and maintainable applications through appropriate architectural patterns, access controls, data protection, and consideration of system dependencies * Establishes and applies engineering standards through architecture reviews, code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration and deployment practices * Mentors junior staff and guides engineering teams through technical decisions, process improvement, troubleshooting, onboarding, and adoption of new development practices * Provides recommendations for investment in new products and technology solutions, supported by appropriate ROI, total cost of ownership, and/or cost benefit analysis **Minimum Qualifications:** Considerable knowledge of: * Data architecture, software architecture, development and testing practices * Multiple programming languages and software development tool suites Experience: * Providing technical leadership on teams developing large software projects * Creating, interpreting and documenting user requirements * Testing and deploying production systems * Managing complex, enterprise/ interdependent systems Supporting organizational transitions to new architectures, new development processes, performing cost/benefit analysis, analyzing buy vs build alternatives and strategic planning * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Seven or more years of hands\-on software engineering experience delivering complex enterprise applications, including legacy modernization and systems integration, with advanced proficiency in one or more technologies such as Microsoft .NET, C\#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, or Angular. * Five or more years applying and improving secure architecture and engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines, using platforms such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Enterprise. * Three or more years providing senior technical leadership within software development teams while contributing production code, guiding architectural decisions, mentoring developers, and evaluating technical alternatives through cost, benefit, and risk analysis. * Experience applying AI\-assisted development tools within engineering teams and evaluating generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability. **Benefits:** This position is eligible for the state benefits package, including: * Excellent low\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance * Generous vacation and sick leave accrual beginning as soon as you start * Eligibility for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSLF) * Paid parental leave * Eleven paid holidays a year * Participation in one of the nation's best state retirement systems: PERSI * Multiple retirement plans * Life insurance * Wellness programs; ongoing training opportunities; and more https://dhr.idaho.gov/StateEmployees/Benefits.html **EEO/ADA/Veteran:** The State of Idaho is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, political affiliation or belief, sex, national origin, genetics, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws. The State of Idaho is committed to access and reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities, auxiliary aids and services are available upon request. If you require an accommodation at any step in our recruitment process, you are encouraged to contact (208\) 334\-2263 (TTY/TTD: 711\), or email ada.coordinator@dhr.idaho.gov. Preference may be given to veterans who qualify under state and federal laws and regulations.

jobs.description: **Job Posting Title** Site Reliability Engineer **Agency** 090 OFFICE OF MANAGEMENT AND ENTERPRISE SERV **Supervisory Organization** IS\-CS **Job Posting End Date** Refer to the date listed at the top of this posting, if available. Continuous if date is blank. Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the day prior to the posting end date above. **Estimated Appointment End Date (Continuous if Blank)** **Full/Part\-Time** Full time **Job Type** Regular **Compensation** Job Details: Full\-time 40\-hour work weeks. Supports the Information Services Division. Salary is up to $110,000 based on education and experience. Position reports onsite in Oklahoma City. Sponsorship: At this time, we cannot offer sponsorship now or in the future. **Job Description** **As a Site Reliability Engineer with OMES you will enjoy:** * Generous leave including 15 days of vacation, 15 days of sick leave and 11 paid holidays annually. * A comprehensive Benefit Package with a generous benefit allowance to offset the cost of insurance premiums for employees and their eligible dependents. **Job Details** * Full\-time 40\-hour work weeks * Supports the Information Services Division * Salary is up to $110,000 based on education and experience * Position reports onsite in Oklahoma City * Sponsorship: At this time, we cannot offer sponsorship now or in the future. **Responsibilities** Incident Escalation \& Remediation (approx. 40%) * Serve as the first technical escalation point for P1/P2 incidents affecting infrastructure, cloud, and application environments. * Lead hands\-on troubleshooting across Windows and Linux servers, virtualization, Azure and hybrid cloud, networking (DNS, load balancing, firewalls), storage, databases, and application middleware. * Act as technical lead within the incident command structure, advising the Incident Commander on impact, options, and risk of remediation actions. * Engage and coordinate subject\-matter experts from network, security, database, application, vendor, and agency teams; drive cross\-domain remediation to closure. * Execute and document emergency changes in accordance with change management and audit requirements. Observability Partnership (approx. 15%) * Collaborate with Observability engineers to define service\-level indicators (SLIs), dashboards, and actionable alerts across Zabbix, Grafana, Azure Monitor, and Datadog. * Identify telemetry gaps surfaced during incidents and drive instrumentation improvements. * Reduce alert noise and false positives; tune thresholds to reflect true user and service impact. Reliability Engineering \& Problem Management (approx. 25%) * Lead blameless post\-incident reviews; produce root cause analyses with corrective and preventive actions tracked to completion. * Define and maintain service\-level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets with service owners and agency stakeholders. * Perform capacity planning, performance analysis, and resilience testing, including disaster recovery and failover validation. * Identify single points of failure and architectural risks; recommend and implement remediation. Automation \& Toil Reduction (approx. 15%) * Develop automated remediation, self\-healing routines, and runbooks using PowerShell, Python, Bash, and infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Terraform, Ansible, ARM/Bicep). * Measure and reduce operational toil; target a sustained ratio of engineering work to reactive work. * Contribute reliability guardrails to CI/CD pipelines in partnership with DevSecOps. Governance, Security \& Compliance (approx. 5%) * Ensure remediation activities comply with NIST SP 800\-53 controls, CJIS Security Policy, IRS Publication 1075, HIPAA, and state security standards as applicable. * Preserve evidence and audit trails for incidents with security, privacy, or regulatory implications; coordinate with the security operations team and Operational Risk \& Controls. * Support internal and external audits by providing incident, change, and availability documentation. **Physical Demands and Work Environment** * This position works in a comfortable office setting with a computer and telephone for a large percentage of the workday. * This position requires long periods, up to eight hours per day, of sitting and working at a desk. The noise level in the work environment is usually mild. * Participation in a rotating on\-call schedule, including occasional after\-hours, weekend, and holiday response for critical incidents. * Work supports essential public services; may be designated essential personnel during declared emergencies or continuity\-of\-operations events. * Occasional travel to state data centers or agency sites. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; equivalent professional experience may substitute year\-for\-year. * 5\+ years in infrastructure, systems, or application operations, including 2\+ years in an SRE, production engineering, or senior escalation role. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex, multi\-layer incidents in enterprise or hybrid cloud environments under time pressure. * Strong working knowledge of Windows Server, Linux, virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V), Microsoft Azure, and core networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, load balancing, firewalls). * Hands\-on experience with at least two observability platforms (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Datadog, Splunk). * Scripting proficiency in PowerShell and/or Python; jobs.title: Transportation Engineer 3
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **About WSDOT** The Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) is a multimodal agency with a global reputation for excellence. Our dedicated workforce plans, designs, builds, and operates an integrated transportation system that safely and efficiently moves people and goods throughout the state. In addition to maintaining over 20,000 lane miles of state highway and 4,100 bridges, WSDOT leads an award\-winning Active Transportation Plan, manages the world's longest floating bridge, and operates the largest ferry system in the nation! **The Opportunity** WSDOT is currently seeking a skilled Transportation Engineer 3 in Union Gap, WA, to support work zone safety operations throughout the South Central Region. In this role, you will serve as the region’s primary resource for temporary traffic control, ensuring work zones meet state and federal safety standards while helping reduce congestion and crashes. You will provide technical guidance on traffic control designs, construction staging, and work zone strategies; coordinate with construction, maintenance, utilities, and local agency partners; and help resolve work zone safety concerns. You will also assist with developing and reviewing traffic control plans, evaluating temporary and permanent signing and pavement markings, conducting field reviews, and maintaining work zone traffic control records. Your expertise will help keep highway projects moving safely and efficiently while protecting workers and the traveling public. **What to Expect** Among the varied range of responsibilities held within this role, the Transportation Engineer 3 will: * Conduct field reviews of construction work zones to evaluate temporary traffic control (TTC) setups, identify safety concerns, and ensure compliance with approved traffic control plans and applicable standards. * Provide independent technical guidance and engineering recommendations to construction offices on complex traffic control challenges, work zone safety strategies, and traffic management. * Review and evaluate traffic control plans, detours, construction staging plans, and proposed revisions, providing technical comments and recommendations to address traffic impacts and improve safety. * Coordinate with construction, maintenance, utilities, local agencies, Washington State Patrol, and WSDOT staff to ensure consistent work zone practices and safe traffic operations. * Inspect work zone traffic control devices, including signs, pavement markings, cones, barriers, message boards, and flagger stations, to verify proper placement, visibility, and compliance with approved plans. * Evaluate real\-world traffic conditions, including congestion, traffic flow, pedestrian and cyclist safety, detour routes, and potential hazards, and recommend adjustments to improve work zone operations. * Maintain and oversee accurate work zone event records in the statewide database, monitor potential conflicts, and provide guidance and training to staff on database use and reporting requirements. * Support the development of emergency temporary traffic control plans and strategies to address unexpected events and changing roadway conditions. * Scope, develop and implement Low Cost Enhancement projects across the region. **Qualifications** To be considered for this opportunity, the following competencies are required: * **Engineering Knowledge:** Demonstrated experience applying engineering principles, methods, and practices to project management in transportation or construction environments. This includes expertise in design development, construction techniques, and/or contract administration. * **Project Analysis \& Delivery:** Ability to evaluate project plans and documentation to ensure compliance with standards and regulations and provide engineering expertise to support successful project design and construction. * **Regulatory \& Policy Interpretation and Application:** Demonstrated ability to interpret and communicate applicable laws, rules, standards, policies, and procedures, including FHWA and MUTCD standards, and agency guidelines, and apply them to project delivery. * **Technical \& Digital Proficiency:** Advanced skills in operating Windows\-based systems and engineering software, including MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, SharePoint, Outlook), MS Teams, computer\-aided engineering applications, cloud\-based platforms, and system databases for project tracking and information management. * **Communication Skills:** Advanced skills in professional communication, specifically in communicating technical information effectively and professionally to a diverse audience, including those with non\-technical backgrounds, virtually, by phone, and in person. * **License and Certification:** Possession of a valid driver's license and ability to operate state\-owned vehicles for travel to and between project sites in support of field duties and essential job functions. Certification as a Traffic design and analysis, temporary traffic control, and roadway safety. * **Work Zone Traffic Control and Safety:** Knowledge and experience interpreting and applying traffic control regulations, standards, and guidelines to evaluate work zone conditions, identify safety concerns, analyze traffic impacts, and recommend effective solutions. **Important Notes** * This recruitment may also be used to fill additional positions per business needs. * This position offers flexible/hybrid remote work options. * In addition to base salary, employees may be entitled to other forms of compensation depending on the type, duties, or location of the position. For union\-represented positions, more information on other forms of compensation can be found in the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreements. Information on other compensation types for non\-represented positions can be found in Chapter 357\-28 of the Washington Administrative Code. * WSDOT does not use the E\-Verify system, therefore we are not eligible to extend STEM Optional Practical Training (OPT). For more information, please visit www.uscis.gov **Why WSDOT** * Work\-Life Balance – We offer flexible work schedules that allow you time for your life outside of this excellent opportunity. * Paid Leave – In addition to 12 paid holidays, full\-time employees mayearn up to 25 paid vacation days per year! * Tuition Assistance – Permanent employees have several options for assistance with education expenses, including tuition reimbursement programs, government discounts at participating colleges throughout the state, and eligibility for federal student loan forgiveness. * Plan For Your Future – WSDOT offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes a variety of healthcare options. Employees also have a choice of state retirement programs, and much more. Go to State Benefits for more information. **How to Apply** Applications for this recruitment will be accepted electronically. Your relevant experience may be evaluated to determine salary. Therefore, it is very important that the “Work Experience” portion of the application be completed in as much detail as possible. In order to be considered for this opportunity, please include the following with your online application: * An attached Resume outlining (in reverse chronological order) your experience to date. * An attached Cover Letter that further explains your qualifications and indicates why you believe you are a viable candidate for this role. * Contact details for a minimum of three (3\) individuals who can attest to your work performance, technical skills, and job\-related competencies. This information can be entered in the “References” section of the online application; does not require an additional attachment. **Please click the "APPLY" button to proceed.** Note that you will be prompted to either sign in or create an account. This step is required in order to submit an application to this opportunity. *WSDOT is an equal opportunity employer. We value the importance of creating an environment in which all employees can feel respected, included, and empowered to bring unique ideas to the agency. Our diversity and inclusion efforts include embracing different cultures, backgrounds and viewpoints while fostering growth and advancement in the workplace. All persons, regardless of race, ethnicity, age, veteran status, sexual orientation, and/ or gender identity, are encouraged to apply. Persons with disabilities needing assistance in the application process, or those needing this job announcement in an alternative format may contact the recruiter listed.* *WSDOT does not use the E\-Verify system, therefore we are not eligible to extend STEM Optional Practical Training (OPT). For more information, please visit* *www.uscis.gov* **Contact Us** For inquiries about this posting, you may contact the assigned Recruiter at amanda.strebeck@wsdot.wa.gov . Please be sure to reference Transportation Engineer 3 \#51353 in the subject line.

jobs.description: The Gear System Analysis \& Calculation Methods Technical Specialist serves as the subject matter expert for analytical methods, simulation processes, and virtual validation techniques used in the design and development of gears, shafts, splines, and transmission systems. The specialist serves as the organization's focal point for system modeling, gear analysis, drivetrain simulation, and virtual validation processes. A deep understanding of gear theory, load distribution, system dynamics, NVH, fatigue, lubrication, efficiency, and manufacturing influences are essential. **Responsibilities:** ===================== * Lead the development and governance of engineering calculation methodologies for gears, shafts, splines, and gearbox systems * Establish analytical best practices and technical standards across global engineering organizations * Evaluate emerging simulation technologies and recommend strategic implementation opportunities * Refine load distribution methodologies and duty\-cycle\-based durability predictions * Refine and validate system models that correlate simulation results to test and field performance * Drive methodology improvements for conventional, hybrid and electric driveline systems * Software \& Methods Development * Product Development Support * Root Cause \& Continuous Improvement Requirements: **Basic Qualifications:** ========================= * Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering or related degree field * 8 years of experience in transmission, driveline, propulsion systems, or related engineering fields * Strong understanding of AGMA, ISO, DIN, and related gear industry standards * Experience validating simulation models using laboratory and vehicle test data * Demonstrated expertise in analytical problem solving and root cause analysis **Preferred Qualifications:** ============================= * Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering * Experience with transmissions and electric drive modules * Experience developing engineering methods, design standards, or corporate specifications * Knowledge of machine learning, automation, or digital engineering applications in mechanical design * Technical publication, patent, or conference presentation experience * Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt Certification

jobs.title: Application Website Developer
jobs.description: **Application \& Website Developer (AI\-Assisted)** **Buda, Texas** (Austin area). Full\-time, on\-site. Flying Eyes Optics makes eyewear built to be worn under helmets and headsets, protected by five patents. We ship worldwide from Buda with a team of about 16\. Pilots, riders and anyone who spends real time under a helmet or headset wear our frames every day. **The role** Several internal web apps are already live here, running creator partnerships, B2B accounts, events and press. Our CEO built them with AI tools. That means nobody here needs convincing that this is real work, the tools are already in place, and the person reviewing your code understands what you are doing. He is also ready to hand it over, and the company would rather he spent his time running it. These apps, plus our websites, would be yours. You would be the person who takes an idea out of a conversation and turns it into something that works. Some weeks that could mean a new page on the site. Some weeks it is a whole application. You would build with AI tools as your leverage, which is how these apps were made and how we expect them to keep being made. **What you would do** * Own, maintain and extend the internal apps already running. * Build and update our websites, from a single landing page to an entirely new site. * Sit with the team, work out what they actually need, and ship it. * Connect the systems that should be talking to each other and are not. * Keep access, data and credentials handled properly as all of it grows. **What we are looking for** * You have built real, working things, and you can show them to us. * You use AI coding tools daily and you know when to trust the output and when not to. * You can read code you did not write and understand why it works before changing it. * You explain technical choices to nontechnical people without talking down to them. * You move fast and you finish. A computer science degree is not required. We care about what you have shipped. **What this is not** This is not a role with a team under you, and we are not hiring one. It is not six months of rewriting systems that already work. And it is not remote: we are on\-site in Buda. **How to apply** Send your resume along with short answers to two questions: * What have you built with AI assistance that you could not have built without it? * Tell us about a time an AI tool confidently handed you something broken. How did you find it, and what did you do? Finalists do a short paid build, about half a day, on a self\-contained project. We pay for your time either way. Pay: $65,900\.00 \- $75,900\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Sunnyvale, California, United States **Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 19205 **Base Salary Range** $193200\-$289800 **Date posted** 11/10/2026 ### **We Are**Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You have spent years building AI systems that have to actually work in production, not just hit benchmarks in a paper. The difference between a model that ships and one that gets shelved is usually in the evaluation framework, the data pipeline, or the post\-training strategy, and you are the kind of engineer who catches those gaps before they become blockers. You read the latest research not to chase trends but to extract what is actually useful, and you know when to build from scratch versus when to extend an open\-source framework. Domain\-specific work excites you because it comes with ground truth. When you fine\-tune a model to generate RTL code, you can compile it, simulate it, and know whether it works. That verifiability changes everything about how you train, evaluate, and iterate. You have built agent systems that do more than call APIs, they plan, execute, self\-correct, and explain their reasoning. You have designed evaluation pipelines that gate releases and catch regressions before they reach users. At Synopsys, you will work on AI systems that power semiconductor design workflows. The problems are hard, the data is structured and verifiable, and what you build will be used by engineering teams building the chips that run the world. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Lead the adaptation of foundation models to specialized engineering domains like hardware description languages, RTL design, and EDA workflows, using supervised fine\-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, and synthetic data pipelines that improve correctness and coverage * Research and implement advanced post\-training methods including preference optimization, iterative alignment, and reasoning enhancement using Monte Carlo Tree Search, process reward models, and trajectory\-based supervision * Architect agentic systems capable of multi\-step planning, tool calling, self\-correction, and analytics over structured data sources like CSV, JSON, Parquet, and SQL, with sandboxed execution and privacy\-preserving designs * Own the evaluation strategy for LLM and agent systems, building automated frameworks with LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, domain\-specific benchmarks, pass@k metrics, and regression suites that gate model releases * Develop production ML monitoring to detect feature drift, data drift, and performance degradation, using statistical tests like Kolmogorov\-Smirnov, Wasserstein distance, and Jensen\-Shannon divergence combined with feature importance * Build scalable pipelines for dataset construction, distributed multi\-GPU training on NVIDIA A100/H100 clusters, checkpoint evaluation, and experiment tracking using PyTorch, Hugging Face, DeepSpeed, and FSDP * Set standards for experimental rigor across the team, including strong baselines, controlled ablations, reproducibility, error analysis, and honest reporting of negative results, and translate outcomes into publications, patents, and production\-ready designs ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Define the technical direction for domain\-specific LLMs that generate verifiable hardware code, improving the productivity of engineering teams designing complex semiconductor systems * Enable reasoning\-enhanced models that solve multi\-step planning and coding tasks with measurably higher correctness, reducing iteration cycles for engineers working in EDA workflows * Deliver enterprise analytics agents that operate autonomously over heterogeneous structured data, automating analysis and reporting tasks that today require manual effort * Build evaluation frameworks that become the standard for how the team measures quality, gates releases, and maintains trust in production AI systems * Detect and remediate production ML drift before it impacts users, ensuring models remain reliable and accurate as data distributions shift over time * Grow the technical capability of the team through mentorship, design reviews, and by setting the example for what rigorous, reproducible AI research looks like in practice * Represent Synopsys AI research externally through publications and invention disclosures that advance the state of the art in domain\-specific AI systems ### **What You'll Need** * PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in applied AI research and production ML systems * 8\+ years of hands\-on experience building and shipping machine learning systems, with at least 3 years focused on LLMs, post\-training, or agentic AI * Deep expertise in PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Datasets, Accelerate), and distributed training frameworks like DeepSpeed or FSDP * Strong foundation in supervised fine\-tuning, parameter\-efficient methods, preference optimization, and reasoning\-enhancement techniques including search\-based inference and reward modeling * Proven ability to design and implement rigorous evaluation frameworks, including automated benchmarks, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, and statistical validation of model improvements * Experience building production ML monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines using statistical methods and data\-quality tools * Track record of translating research into production systems, with evidence through publications, patents, or shipped products that demonstrate both depth and engineering discipline ### **Who You Are** * You do not trust a result until you have measured it three ways, ablated the components, and understood why it works, not just that it works * You can explain a complex tradeoff between model quality, inference cost, and latency to a VP in two sentences without losing the nuance, and you can defend your technical choices in a room full of skeptical engineers * You move between reading a new paper on process reward models in the morning and debugging a multi\-GPU training pipeline in the afternoon without losing context or momentum * You push back when an evaluation is too weak, a baseline is missing, or a launch plan does not account for how the model will actually fail in production * You learn new technical domains quickly, whether that means understanding RTL simulation well enough to integrate it into a training loop or picking up a new statistical test to improve drift detection You set the standard for the team through the quality of your code, the rigor of your experiments, and the clarity of your technical writing, and you grow the people around you by reviewing their work with the same care you* to your own ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus, equity, and other discretionary bonuses. jobs.title: Data Ingestion Sr. Analyst
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY:** Targa is seeking a hands\-on Data Ingestion Sr. Analyst (Enterprise \& OT) to lead how data enters the enterprise data platform. This role owns ingestion across all sources — enterprise applications, third\-party data from customers, suppliers, and data providers, and operational technology (OT) sources — and brings deep expertise in getting field and plant data from SCADA, process historians, measurement, and IoT systems across gathering, processing, and transportation assets into the platform reliably, securely, and at the right speed for how the business uses it. OT data is different from enterprise data: it is high\-volume, time\-series, often near real\-time, and lives behind segmented industrial networks. This Sr. Analyst sets the ingestion architecture and standards for the Data Acquisition pillar, owns the near real\-time (low\-latency) data architecture, and works closely with automation, measurement, and cybersecurity teams. As AI use cases such as predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, optimization, and operator assistants grow, this role is accountable for making operational data timely, complete, contextualized, and secure enough to power them, and for using AI\-assisted tooling to scale the work. **JOB FUNCTIONS AND KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Own the enterprise ingestion architecture and pattern library across enterprise applications (e.g., Oracle Fusion Cloud, UKG, OneStream), third\-party data, APIs, CDC, file transfer, and OT/operational sources. * Set ingestion standards, review designs, and prioritize acquisition work across the pillar in line with Ops and Engineering wave and enterprise demand; provide technical direction to the Enterprise Ingestion Engineer and other ingestion contributors. * Design and build ingestion from process historians, SCADA, measurement systems, and IoT/edge devices into the platform, prioritizing OT data that is gating Ops and Engineering deliverables. * Choose the right latency tier for each use case (minute\-level, hourly, daily) and build the matching patterns, using streaming only where the use case justifies it. * Own the latency\-tier reference architecture, with near real\-time (minute\-level) as the top tier, including standards for low\-latency and event\-based data and the path to consumption (Eventhouse/KQL, operational dashboards, alerts, and AI use cases such as anomaly alerts and operational recommendations). * Define the standard, reusable approach for bringing OT data into the platform from edge to bronze, including patterns for edge processing as some analytics and AI move closer to the asset. * Land high\-volume time\-series data with correct timestamps, units, quality flags, and asset context so signals are clean, continuous, and AI\-ready for machine learning and analytics. * Work with Data Foundation to map OT tags and signals to assets, facilities, and equipment hierarchies; use AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate tag\-to\-asset mapping and naming standardization across sites, validating results before adoption. * Document sources, tag mappings, data flows, and dependencies, and keep runbooks current. * Build OT data flows that respect industrial network segmentation and IT/OT boundaries; partner with OT cybersecurity and the Data Security Lead on approved connectivity, data diodes or brokers, and access controls. * Help define governed, secure access to operational data for AI agents and assistants, working with the Platform / Fabric Administrator and Data Security Lead. * Work with the Platform / Fabric Administrator on retention, tiering, and capacity planning for high\-volume time\-series and low\-latency data. * Participate in site management of change (MOC) so tag renames, new instrumentation, and system changes are known before they break data flows. * Monitor OT and near real\-time data flows for gaps, latency, and data quality issues; apply automated and AI\-based detection of sensor drift, flatlines, and gaps; and work with DataOps on alerting and automated recovery. * Resolve data issues at the source with automation, measurement, and field teams, and support critical OT and near real\-time data flows outside business hours as part of an on\-call or escalation rotation. * Act as the go\-to expert for ingestion and OT data across the team; mentor others on OT, low\-latency, and time\-series data concepts. * Cross\-train a designated backup (Enterprise Ingestion Engineer) on OT sources and low\-latency ingestion patterns so OT data does not depend on one person. * Work with operations, engineering, and measurement stakeholders to understand how OT data is used and what good looks like; guide external partners and vendors on OT data integration work. * Establish and report metrics for sources onboarded through standard patterns, freshness, completeness, and latency against agreed targets, critical\-path delivery for Ops and Engineering milestones, OT data gaps and incidents, and backup readiness. * Travel periodically to plants, field sites, and control centers to work with operations and automation teams. * Other duties as assigned. **MINIMUM ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. * 5\+ years in data engineering, industrial data integration, or automation, including at least 3 years focused on OT or industrial data. * Hands\-on experience with process historians (for example AVEVA PI / OSIsoft PI, AspenTech IP.21, or similar) and SCADA data. * Experience with industrial protocols and integration methods such as OPC UA, MQTT, or historian APIs. * Experience designing and operating low\-latency (minute\-level) and batch pipelines for high\-volume time\-series data in production, plus CDC and API ingestion for enterprise applications, on a cloud data platform. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric Real\-Time Intelligence (Eventstreams, Eventhouse/KQL), Azure Event Hubs, or IoT Hub. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Auto Loader / Structured Streaming, Unity Catalog) for building and operating ingestion pipelines. * Strong SQL and Python; experience working with time\-series data at scale. * Working understanding of IT/OT network segmentation and OT cybersecurity principles. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot) and reviewing and testing generated code. * Ability to lead technical work and work directly with field, automation, and engineering teams. * Strong communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills. * Regular and reliable attendance, with the ability to travel to field sites and support after\-hours escalations. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Experience in midstream, upstream, utilities, chemicals, or other asset\-intensive industries. * Familiarity with gas measurement data and flow computers. * Experience with asset hierarchies and industrial data context (asset frameworks, ISA\-95\), including industrial knowledge graphs or asset context models. * Experience preparing time\-series data for machine learning, anomaly detection, or predictive maintenance use cases. * Exposure to edge computing and industrial DataOps platforms. * Experience governing secure AI or agent access to operational data. * Experience with third\-party data exchange (SFTP, partner APIs, data shares) and enterprise applications such as Oracle Fusion Cloud, UKG, or OneStream. * OT security credentials such as ISA/IEC 62443 or GICSP. * Relevant Microsoft Fabric or Azure data engineering certifications. **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY:** Targa Resources provides equal employment opportunities based on merit, experience, and other work\-related criteria and without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, sex, age, pregnancy, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We also strive to provide reasonable accommodation to employees’ beliefs and practices that do not conflict with Targa’s policies and applicable law. We value the unique contributions that every employee brings to their role with Targa.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Clinical Data Analytics
jobs.description: The Principal Product Manager, Clinical Data Analytics, will play a pivotal role in shaping Tendo’s data\-driven solutions by translating clinical and financial\-focused activities into actionable insights that support patients, providers, and health systems. This individual will help define product strategy and functional requirements for analytics offerings, leveraging deep expertise with healthcare coding systems (ICD\-10, DRG, CPT) and payer/provider data workflows. Specifically, this role will help define data requirements and business logic to: * Measure provider\-level clinical quality from claims data. * Analyze the relationship between quality, price, and market share for health procedures. * Identify missing comorbidities from EHR patient records. This role requires a strong balance of technical acumen, healthcare domain knowledge, and product management experience. This person will work closely with engineering, clinical informatics, and customer\-facing teams to deliver data solutions that improve decision\-making, enhance operational efficiency, and support Tendo’s marketplace growth. Under Tendo’s AI\-First R\&D model, this role operates as a Product Engineer with domain strength, owning features end\-to\-end from discovery through release, with AI as the first author at every stage. **About Tendo** Make an impact—join our team! We’re a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company building a culture that enables teams and individuals to thrive. **Our team\-driven culture and rapid growth have earned us recognition as one of Forbes’ Top Startup Employers for 2024, 2025, and 2026\.** Led by an experienced and proven team, we live by our values and are always on the hunt for motivated people with diverse experiences and backgrounds to help us improve the care journey for patients, clinicians, and caregivers by creating software that provides seamless, intuitive, and user\-friendly experiences. If you like working with innovative technologies and want to be part of a growing team that will help transform the healthcare experience, we encourage you to apply today! **Job Location** San Francisco Bay Area, CA Tendo has hubs in San Francisco, CA; Salt Lake City, UT; Chicago, IL; Nashville, TN; and Philadelphia, PA. Candidates may be located in any one of our hub locations. ### **Responsibilities** * **Product Strategy \& Roadmap:** Help define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for clinical data analytics, aligning with company priorities, customer needs, and market opportunities. * **Healthcare Data Expertise:** Serve as a subject matter expert on EHR, claims, pricing, payment, and healthcare coding data to ensure accurate, compliant, and valuable use of clinical and financial information in products. * **Quality Measurement \& Methodology:** Define and maintain the business logic, measurement specifications, risk adjustment methodologies, scoring algorithms, and forecasting models that power Tendo’s quality analytics products, ensuring alignment with evolving CMS, commercial payer, and industry quality programs. * **Clinical Analytics Leadership:** Partner with quality measurement experts, clinical informatics, data science, and engineering teams to design methodologies that accurately measure provider performance, identify opportunities for quality improvement, and produce transparent and explainable analytics. * **Customer Engagement:** Collaborate with health systems, employers, payers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate use cases, and ensure products deliver measurable value. * **Execution \& Delivery:** Own assigned features end\-to\-end, from opportunity statement through specification, design input, build, documentation, and release, advancing work through the four PLA gate reviews with no handoffs between stages. * **Analytics \& Insights:** Partner with data science and engineering to build tools that surface actionable insights for users, ensuring outputs are accurate, meaningful, accessible, and aligned with defined methodologies. * **Market \& Internal Collaboration:** Monitor industry trends, competitive offerings, and regulatory developments to inform product direction, and work closely with Sales, Customer Engagement, and Operations to support go\-to\-market, adoption, and customer satisfaction. * **AI\-Directed Delivery \& Knowledge Sharing:** Use AI as the first author for specifications, acceptance criteria, documentation, and analysis; critically evaluate and refine AI\-generated output, and contribute prompt patterns, quality examples, and design and decision standards to the shared team library. ### **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 7\+ years of product management experience in healthcare technology, healthcare analytics, data products, or a related field. * Deep expertise in U.S. healthcare quality measurement an ty measurement methodologies into scalable product requirements, analytics, AI\-driven insights, and decision\-support capabilities for healthcare organizations. * Strong working knowledge of healthcare coding systems, including ICD\-10, DRG, and CPT, as well as claims, payment, and payer/provider data workflows. * Experience working with healthcare data standards and interoperability technologies, including HL7, FHIR, EHR data models, provider directories, and clinical terminology standards such as LOINC, SNOMED CT, and RxNorm, strongly preferred. * Experience working with large, complex healthcare datasets and translating data into meaningful products, insights, or analytics. * Working familiarity with SQL, Python, relational data concepts, or similar technical tools and concepts. * Demonstrated ability to define product strategy, requirements, business logic, and roadmaps for complex data\-driven products. * Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical, clinical, and business teams. * Demonstrated ability to own product initiatives from discovery through delivery and post\-release learning. * Demonstrated fluency with AI tools as a first author, with the ability to direct, evaluate, and refine AI\-generated product specifications, documentation, and analysis using strong independent judgment. ### **Nice to Have** * Advanced degree (MBA, MPH, MS in Health Informatics, MS in Data Science, or related field). * Experience with SaaS platforms, digital health solutions, or healthcare marketplaces. * Experience developing products that support provider quality reporting, value\-based care, population health, care management, or healthcare transparency initiatives. * Experience with CMS quality programs, HRRP, HCC, Leapfrog, U.S. News, commercial quality scorecards, or other healthcare performance measurement frameworks. * Experience applying predictive analytics or machine learning to healthcare quality measurement, risk prediction, or forecasting. * Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial claims data structures and reimbursement methodologies. * Familiarity with payer, provider, and employer data integration and reporting needs. * Understanding of value\-based care, reimbursement models, and healthcare economics. * Experience working with EHR systems and clinical informatics teams in a product capacity. **Base Salary Range** $157,250 \- $212,750 This salary range is offered with the understanding that final compensation is based on a number of factors including geography and experience. Tendo also offers an equity package, annual bonuses, and benefits. **Benefits** For full time employees, Tendo also offers full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending and health savings accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short\-term and long\-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k), company paid holidays, flexible time off, and an employee wellness program (“Breathe”). *Tendo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description: **Who We Are** Tenet3® is a digital knowledge management company based in Dayton, Ohio. We have deep roots in cybersecurity, system trustworthiness, and software/hardware assurance. We develop software products involving advanced machine learning and property graph representations to enhance human cognition. Tenet3 is a recognized leader in creating novel solutions for managing knowledge about complex systems. Our capabilities put data in context so that teams can generate meaningful insights. We leverage our knowledge management platform, MeTRA®, and sophisticated AI/ML tooling to rapidly build digital knowledge graphs using open data standards that make them accessible and usable across the lifecycle. Tenet3 is growing by applying our knowledge management platform to systems assurance, cybersecurity, and engineering change analyses. **Why Work Here** At Tenet3, our employee's contributions are highly visible, valued, and rewarded. Be part of a team that supports both your personal and professional growth. If you're looking to work in a place that combines cutting\-edge technology with a strong sense of culture and team spirit, and amazing benefits, then we are the place for you! **The Role** We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer with a strong background in Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and automation to serve as a technical advocate supporting our client's cloud initiatives. This role involves collaborating with development and security teams to build resilient CI/CD pipelines, optimize core cloud network topologies, and maintain proactive observability and alerting tools. You will have the opportunity to leverage your expertise in cloud orchestration, scripting, and access management, working closely with our team to deliver high\-impact, secure, and repeatable cloud deployments. The ideal candidate would be an automation\-driven systems thinker who understands that infrastructure is only as reliable as the code that provisions it. This position will bridge the gap between application development and IT operations, ensuring our client's mission\-critical systems are secure, scalable, and highly available. **Essential Responsibilities** * Develop, maintain, and optimize infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) for repeatable and secure cloud deployments * Build, maintain, and refactor CI/CD pipelines to accelerate feature delivery, minimize risk, and reduce technical debt * Configure and manage observability tools, dashboards, and proactive alerting to detect and resolve issues * Respond to production issues, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to incident postmortems * Collaborate with development teams to align infrastructure design with application requirements * Document technical designs, runbooks, and standard operating procedures to ensure team alignment * Participate in sprint planning and advocate for automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency * Utilize Cloud \& DevOps Skills to: * + Design, provision, and maintain core cloud network topologies and troubleshoot connectivity across multi\-environment setups + Enhance secrets management, access controls, and audit IAM roles/policies for least\-privilege access in collaboration with security engineers + Improve visibility into cloud resource utilization and cost to support budget\-aware engineering decisions **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * **Core Technical Experience:** 3\-5 years of professional engineering experience in DevOps or Cloud Engineering, with a track record of identifying automation gaps, recommending IaC improvements, and troubleshooting multi\-environment or hybrid setups. * **Cloud Infrastructure \& IaC:** Proficiency in modern IaC and orchestration tools (e.g., Terraform, infrastructure requirements, risks, and opportunities, with a proven ability to partner effectively with developers and IT to support secure, reliable delivery pipelines. *Education* Bachelor's degree This is a high\-impact role: we’re not looking for someone who just keeps systems running, but an engineer with a strong operational instinct who detects failure modes before they escalate. You’ll work 100% remotely from LATAM, collaborating with an international team. **What you’ll do** * Own and evolve the observability stack at large scale using Datadog and Elasticsearch * Operate and support graph databases (GraphDB) in production * Identify and automate operational toil to make systems more reliable and efficient * Design, test and validate Disaster Recovery strategies across AWS regions * Work closely with backend engineers to keep microservices scalable and reliable **What we’re looking for** * Senior\-level experience in DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering * Strong hands\-on experience with Datadog and Elasticsearch * Experience with graph databases (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or similar) * Solid AWS experience, including multi\-region setups and Disaster Recovery * Strong automation mindset * Advanced English (B2\+), spoken and written **Nice to have** * Experience with Java (11/17\) microservices * Familiarity with Clean Code practices and unit testing **What we offer** * 100% remote work * Long\-term project with a global technology company * Collaboration with international teams * 15 days of paid vacation per year * Your country’s national holidays off

You’ll work mainly on scalable applications using Node.js, Vue.js micro front\-ends, and AWS, within a service\-oriented and serverless architecture. You’ll work 100% remotely from LATAM and collaborate with a US engineering team. **What you’ll do** * Build and improve scalable backend services with Node.js (TypeScript) * Develop modular Vue.js Micro Front\-Ends using Single\-SPA and the PrimeVue design system * Contribute to serverless and AWS\-based solutions * Write clean, well\-tested code and take part in code reviews * Partner with Architecture, Product and Design to turn requirements into technical solutions * Use AI tools such as Copilot, Cursor, and coding agents to build and validate production\-ready code **What we’re looking for** * 4\+ years of production software development, with a strong focus on Node.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript * Solid hands\-on experience with Vue.js or another modern front\-end framework * Experience with AWS and/or serverless technologies * Experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases * Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Cursor) * Team\-oriented and comfortable working with cross\-functional partners * Advanced English (B2\+), spoken and written **Nice to have** * Experience building AI agents (MCP, RAG, agentic patterns) * Strong experience building client\-facing user interfaces * Exposure to PHP/Laravel * Interest in the nonprofit sector **What we offer** * 100% remote work * Long\-term project with a US technology company * Collaboration with international teams * 15 days of paid vacation per year * Your country’s national holidays off
