jobs.title: Software Engineer, Industrial Edge Software
jobs.description: **What to Expect** We are the team behind the software that runs our fleet of Tesla’s utility\-scale battery energy storage sites. Our application — the Site Controller — runs at the edge on embedded Linux and orchestrates the devices on a site (batteries, power meters, and more), manages configuration and redundancy, integrates with external equipment, and reliably pushes field telemetry up to the Tesla cloud. Our software is primarily written in Golang and Rust, though other strong object\-oriented languages are welcome. We are seeking a talented, motivated, and independent engineer to join the team and contribute to meaningful pieces of that stack, from implementing features through to debugging and supporting deployments. The ideal candidate will be proficient in an object\-oriented language (Go, Rust, or another strong OOP language), have solid software fundamentals, and an eagerness to keep learning in an ever\-evolving environment. **What You'll Do*** Design, build, and own application\-layer software for the Industrial Energy Site Controller on embedded Linux — settings management, telemetry, redundancy/failover, and external communications * Contribute to the edge/on\-device telemetry software — collecting, buffering, and reliably pushing field data up to the Tesla cloud (we build the device side, not the cloud backend) Integrate the Site Controller with external, non\-Tesla systems, building edge proxy/bridge services (e.g. OPC UA* CODESYS) that abstract third\-party equipment behind a consistent interface * Help build redundancy and high\-availability into the site controller — failover, data/telemetry integrity, and resilient comms paths * Partner with engineers across the Cloud/Backend, Validation/Test, Field/Deployment, and Kernel/OS teams to define integration test strategies and ship reliable software to deployed sites * Debug issues across the stack — from application logic down through transport, including live field deployments **What You'll Bring*** Degree in Engineering (Software, Electrical, Computer Systems, or a related field), or equivalent experience * 2\-4\+ years building production software; solid fundamentals in architecture, concurrency, and testing * Proficiency in Go, Rust, or another strong object\-oriented language; experience with (or strong interest in) developing applications on embedded Linux * Experience integrating with industrial/utility protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, DNP3, SCADA, CAN) — or a demonstrated ability to pick up unfamiliar external protocols quickly * Experience building on\-device/edge data collection and ingestion on resource\-constrained systems — reliable buffering and delivery to a backend over unreliable field networks (or strong adjacent experience and a willingness to learn) * Experience with (or strong interest in) designing for redundancy, failover, and fault tolerance in distributed or field\-deployed systems #### **Benefits** Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire: * Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction * Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits * Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution * Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits * Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period) * Employee Assistance Program * Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays * Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources * Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance * Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs * Tesla Babies program * Commuter benefits * Employee discounts and perks program * Earned Wage Access: Real\-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels) #### **Expected Compensation** $140,000 \- $312,000/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. jobs.description: **TITLE** Systems Engineer (part\-time) **JOB SUMMARY** The Systems Engineer (part\-time) is responsible for assisting the Sr Systems Engineer in developing, maintaining, testing, and analyzing university technology and infrastructure services to enable ITS Infrastructure to meet strategic goals. In this role the position will provide work direction to student assistants, manage and administrate university Linux information technology systems, and ensure the successful integration of both administrative and academic systems. As a member of the IT Solutions team, the Systems Engineer (part\-time) is expected to uphold the division’s mission to “empower an agile, digital university and elevate technology as a strategic institutional asset” and contribute positively to a collaborative, human\-centered, innovative, accountable, transparent, and inclusive culture within ITS. **ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS** Reports to: Manager, Platforms \& Cloud Services Supervises: No supervisory responsibilities **ESSENTIAL DUTIES** \- May include, but not limited to the following: Systems Management (65%) * Manages and monitors all installed Linux based systems and infrastructure. * Manages system upgrades, patches, and security updates. * Designs, installs, configures, tests and maintains Linux operating systems, application software and system management tools. * Proactively ensures the highest levels of Linux systems and infrastructure availability. * Monitors and tests system performance for potential bottlenecks, identifies possible solutions, and works with stakeholders to implement those fixes. * Recommend and maintains security, and redundancy strategies. * Writes and maintains custom scripts to increase system efficiency and lower the human intervention time on any tasks. * Creates, manages, and documents hardware and software requirements, objectives, deliverables, and specifications on a project\-by\-project basis. * Evaluate systems specifications and coordinate the design of information and operational support systems. * Provides high\-quality and timely systems support, including responding to incident/problem tickets and troubleshooting errors and issues with systems infrastructure. * Provides support for application deployment and integration issues. * Evaluates, recommends, and implements hardware and software upgrades, updates, and security patches. jobs.description: **Acadian Companies** **JOB DESCRIPTION** **Job Title:** Storage Administrator **Alternate Job Title(s):** NetApp Storage Administrator **Division/Department:** Information Systems **Status:** Salary Exempt **Supervisor Status** Mid\-level individual contributor; no direct reports. Works under general supervision but is expected to execute routine maintenance and troubleshooting independently. Serves as a technical mentor to the Infrastructure Analyst I staff and acts as a secondary escalation point for infrastructure incidents before engaging Senior Administrators. **Performance Appraisal Type**: Support **Location:** Lafayette, LA **Requirement(s)** Current/valid state‑issued driver's license **Access to PHI** Yes **JOB SUMMARY:** We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Storage Administrator to join our IT operations team and specialize in enterprise storage. In this remote role, you will assist in the day\-to\-day administration, provisioning, and monitoring of our enterprise NetApp storage environment. Working closely with and learning from our Senior Storage Architects, you will act as the first line of defense for storage health, ensuring optimal performance and availability for our critical business applications. This role is designed for a rising IT professional with 1 to 2 years of experience who is eager to deepen their expertise in NetApp ONTAP, Storage Area Networks (SAN), and hybrid\-cloud infrastructure within a supportive, modern environment. **PATHWAY:** To ensure your continuous technical growth, this position includes a structured, multi\-step career development pipeline designed to elevate you from an entry\-level administrator to an independent, mid\-level enterprise storage administrator (Storage Administrator II). Through targeted milestones, your progression will cover: **Storage Foundations \& Operations:** Establishing a strong baseline in NetApp infrastructure, completing the ONTAP Associate Learning Path, and earning your NCTA certification. **Enterprise Networking:** Bridging the gap between storage and the broader IT environment by mastering CompTIA Network\+ concepts to ensure reliable array connectivity. **Advanced Administration:** Achieving the industry\-standard NCDA certification and mastering logical storage management, data protection, and high\-availability setups. **Virtualization \& Analytics:** Integrating enterprise storage with VMware data centers (VCTA\-DCV) while learning to actively monitor, collect, and analyze system performance data to eliminate bottlenecks. **Cloud Mobility \& SAN Architecture:** Designing complex block\-storage workflows (NCIE\-SAN), troubleshooting host\-to\-storage mapping (Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NVMe), and preparing for multi\-cloud integrations using NetApp BlueXP. **Infrastructure Automation:** Mastering PowerShell scripting to automate routine provisioning and reporting tasks, culminating in your official promotion to Storage Administrator II. **REPORTS TO:** IT Director **EQUIPMENT:** Basic hand tools, mobile workstation, stationary workstation **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** This job description is not intended, nor should it be construed, to be an all\-inclusive list of responsibilities, duties, skills, or working conditions associated with the job. compression, under the guidance of senior engineers. * Support SAN and NAS environments by assisting with network configuration (iSCSI, NFS, CIFS) and basic connectivity troubleshooting. **Monitoring \& Support** * Actively monitor storage utilization, system health, and performance metrics using tools like NetApp System Manager and Active IQ. * Serve as the primary responder for routine jobs.title: Associate Data Scientist, Personal Lines
jobs.description: **Job Details** --------------- Location: Chicago, IL Category: Data Science and Analytics Employment Type: Full time, Hybrid Job Ref: R2627766\-172 Assoc Data Scientist \- GD08BE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. The Hartford seeks an energetic and passionate Associate Data Scientist to build high\-performing, empathetic analytics teams and deliver smarter product pricing decisions. This role will focus on the Auto line within the Personal Insurance Loss and Demand Modeling team. We support our product and pricing partners through the delivery of rigorously developed and tested solutions including models and implementation support. In this role, you will contribute across the full model lifecycle, from data exploration and feature engineering through model development, validation, implementation, and monitoring. Generalized linear models are a core component of our work, alongside machine learning techniques such as gradient boosted trees and modern MLOps practices. You will also help improve the tools, workflows, and standards that enable the team to support a broad and evolving portfolio of models. **Responsibilities:** * Develop and evaluate predictive modeling solutions that support the personal auto class plan, unconstrained loss models, and customer demand models. * Evaluate new data sources and modeling approaches to boost product performance. Engineer features to uncover additional signal for our models. * Support model implementations with state Departments of Insurance (DOI), serving as a subject matter expert on the models you build and responding to DOI queries. * Maintain a portfolio of repositories and scripts and suggest improvements to workflows. Assist in the modernization of model deployments using our cloud\-based MLOps tools. * Collaborate with team members to plan and deliver projects in an Agile framework. * Develop and maintain analytic packages to facilitate data collection, analysis, and modeling. * Stay up to date on machine learning techniques, apply them to your work, and share them with your team and the broader data science community. * Ensure analytic reproducibility, conduct code reviews, and maintain git hygiene. * Share results with partners and make recommendations based on outcomes. **This role will have a Hybrid work schedule, with the expectation of working in an office (Columbus, OH, Chicago, IL, Hartford, CT or Charlotte, NC) 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday).** **Experiences \& Skills:** * Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Economics, Engineering, Physics, or similar analytical field. * Experience in the insurance industry, particularly in loss cost modeling or personal insurance products, is a plus but not required. Candidates with relevant modeling experience from other industries are encouraged to apply. * Comfort with generalized linear models and related techniques (e.g., ridge and lasso regression, GAMs) and the math behind them. * Hands\-on experience with Python and a track record of delivering clean, literate code in a reproducible environment. * Experience using GitHub for version control, documentation, code collaboration, and technical project management. * Able to independently research solutions, identify when you are stuck, and seek help when needed. * Strong interest in identifying and eliminating workflow inefficiencies. Passionate about tracking down the root cause of problems and identifying tradeoffs. * Demonstrated experience with listening to collaborators and brainstorming outcomes that address their business problems. * Experience building modeling solutions in cloud\-native environments, such as SageMaker, a plus. * Committed to democratizing knowledge, evangelizing good practices, and supporting peers. **Candidate must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship. The company will not support the STEM OPT I\-983 Training Plan endorsement for this position.** **Compensation** The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short\-term or annual bonuses, long\-term incentives, and on\-the\-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is: $81,040 \- $121,560 Equal Opportunity Employer/Sex/Race/Color/Veterans/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity or Expression/Religion/Age

Our platform is compatible with 15\+ unique POS systems, representing over 90% coverage in multi\-unit restaurants. You will be responsible for the development and implementation of innovative on\-premise solutions — including but not limited to self\-service kiosks — that span both **hardware and software**, and you will serve as the trusted bridge between the customer, engineering, and design teams. You will hold responsibility for several of Tillster's key, high\-profile clients across Tillster globally. This is a highly visible role with regular exposure to senior leadership — both internally and with our clients — so polished executive communication and sound judgment are essential. This role requires a deep understanding of on\-premise and cloud restaurant technology — point of sale, payment, kiosk, and other on\-premise systems — combined with the ability to read and work directly from **technical API documentation**, and the communication skills to translate complex technical detail into clear, professional, **client\-facing documentation**. **Responsibilities** * **Client Partnership \& Product Ownership:** Serve as the primary product owner and day\-to\-day point of contact for the customer. Manage the client relationship end to end — setting expectations, aligning priorities, communicating trade\-offs and timelines, and building trust as the go\-to expert for their on\-premise product portfolio. Lead client meetings, demos, and working sessions. * **Requirements Gathering \& Prioritization:** Engage internal teams and both internal and global stakeholders to gather requirements and understand their needs and align with stakeholders on how success will be measured for each requirement. Translate these requirements into actionable product features and enhancements, aligning with leadership on prioritization and roadmap. * **Hardware \& Software Product Development:** Manage the end\-to\-end product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, across both hardware — such as self\-service kiosks, digital menu boards, Kitchen Display Systems, cash payment machines — and software. Work closely with cross\-functional teams including engineers, UI \& UX designers, and customer representatives to define product requirements, create wireframes and workflow diagrams, and ensure timely delivery of on\-premise solutions. * **API \& Technical Documentation Fluency:** Read, interpret, and work directly from technical API documentation to define integration requirements, validate feasibility, scope work with engineering, and answer customer technical questions. Comfortably navigate integration points across POS, payment, kiosk, and other on\-premise systems. * **Client\-Facing Documentation:** Author and maintain high\-quality client\-facing documentation — feature definitions, configuration guides, release notes, RFP responses, and how\-to materials. Communicate the value of features without unnecessary technical jargon and select and articulate the best features to meet each customer's needs. * **User Experience Optimization:** Continuously enhances the user experience of our on\-premise solutions by gathering feedback from stakeholders and collaborating with UI/UX designers and engineers to implement improvements that drive customer satisfaction and maximize user engagement. * **Technical Expertise:** Stay current with the latest advancements in on\-premise hardware and software technologies and leverage your technical knowledge to define requirements that further enhance our product offerings. * **Reporting:** Track and report on key success s** — on\-premise or cloud\-based. * **Defines and consumes APIs (required) —** able to define API specifications and to read and interpret technical API documentation to scope, validate, and communicate integration requirements, including documenting tool/product features and planning migrations between systems or platforms. * **Proven ability to write clear, professional client\-facing documentation — samples/portfolio required.** Shortlisted candidates will be asked to share 1–2 examples of documentation they authored (guides, feature definitions, release notes, or similar). * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * **Senior\-level Technical Product Manager (5\+ years) —** proven experience in a similar role, preferably in restaurant technology, point of sale, payment systems, or on\-premise / self\-service technology. * **Highly analytical and data\-driven —** makes decisions from data, drives continuous improvement, and applies rigorous problem\-solving with deep attention to detail. * **Communicating clearly with all stakeholders —** keeps internal and external stakeholders aligned on project status, priorities, and trade\-offs, and collaborates effectively across cross\-functional teams and customers. * **Familiarity with user experience design principles** and wireframing tools such as Figma. * Ability to travel as business needs demand. **Core skills \& technologies:** Senior Technical Product Manager · Technical Product Owner · on\-premise solutions · self\-service kiosks · self\-service ordering · digital ordering · POS / point of sale (on\-premise and cloud) · payment systems · Kitchen Display Systems (KDS) · digital menu boards · cash payment machines · API specification and system integrations (REST) · agentic / AI solutions · QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) · hospitality and restaurant technology · product roadmap · stakeholder management · cross\-functional leadership · data\-driven product management · bilingual (native Spanish / English) · LATAM · Mexico. **The Interview Process** 1\)Recruiter interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist. 2\)Technical interview with the VP of Product (may include a review of your documentation samples). 3\)Final interview with our VP of Engineering, Kiosk. **Making a Difference in the Tillster Way** Our mission is to empower restaurants and consumers globally, by empowering, supporting, and nurturing the people who are part of the global Tillster team. We want to ensure all employees feel respected, confident, and engaged. Creating an inclusive working environment is of the utmost importance to us. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, family/parental status, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other protected status. **Pay and Benefits (United States)** * Compensation yearly rate is $145,000k \- $170,000k DOE * Meal allowance for each day worked, available through a meal card. * Home/Office allowance reimbursement per calendar month, pro\-rated based on employment start date. * **Health insurance:** Tillster pays the premium for employee private health insurance. At Torus, you will be part of something larger than a single product or technology. Your work will help build energy infrastructure that supports and strengthens our electrical grid, critical systems, industry, and communities for decades to come. We value accountability, collaboration, and clear thinking. We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter. #### **About the Role** At Torus, we're building the world's first mesh energy infrastructure — systems that protect communities, reduce costs, and strengthen the grid for decades to come. Nova Pulse, our Battery Energy Storage System, is at the heart of that mission. As a **Mechanical Engineer**, you'll design, validate, and bring to life the sub\-systems that make resilient energy storage possible. This role sits at a critical handoff, where great engineering becomes great manufacturing. And your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we scale. We *Value Speed and Quality Equally* here; moving fast matters, but so does building it right the first time. You'll need to *Think About Systems and Data Holistically*, understanding how your design decisions ripple across the full product lifecycle, from concept through production. If you're someone who finds energy in solving hard mechanical problems and takes ownership from the first sketch to the final spec, this role was built for you. #### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, document, and test sub\-systems of Torus Pulse (Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Chemical Battery) and/or Torus Spin (Flywheel Energy Storage System Mechanical Battery). * Ensure smooth transition from Design to Manufacturing. * Support DFM/DFA initiatives in collaboration with manufacturing and suppliers. * Support lifecycle development from concept through testing and production. * Solve technical problems to achieve product specifications. * Create, manage, and document critical product specifications. * Work closely with the internal engineering team and external engineering experts. * Ensure compliance with relevant codes, industry standards, and safety requirements. * Other duties as assigned. #### **Required Experience** * Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field * 2\-5 years experience in mechanical engineering * Hands\-on experience with prototyping, testing, and design validation in a regulated industry * Strong background in Solidworks, PDM, and CAD administration * A passion and proven track record of designing mechanical structures * Demonstrates a proactive and action\-oriented approach to problem solving * Strong organizational skills with a disciplined approach to your workflow management #### **Preferred Experience** * Structural design to include steel tube, steel sheet, weldments, machined components, electrical components * Experience includes a focus on energy storage, batteries, or power systems * Familiarity with industry standards such as UL 9540, ISO 26262, or ASME codes ### **Additional Details** **Background Check** All candidates are subject to a background check. **Location \+ Travel** The role is onsite based at our GigaOne warehouse in Salt Lake City (air\-conditioned) with some remote work. May require occasional onsite work at our South Salt Lake HQ Warehouse and/or Springville R\&D Warehouse (air\-conditioned and non air\-conditioned). **Schedule** Full\-Time, Salaried **Compensation** $80,000\-120,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.) **Work Authorization** Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship. **Physical Requirements** * Must have the ability to safely lift and move objects weighing up to 50 lbs. * Must be capable of standing, bending, and executing repetitive tasks for prolonged periods of time. * Ability to read, identify, observe and recognize details, color\-coding and fine print at close range on associated engineering drawings. * Ability to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to, respiratory protective equipment with proper seal, coveralls, ear protection, gloves, eye protection \& safety helmet. * Ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings. * Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. * Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job. * Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required. ### **Our Perks \& Benefits** Benefits eligibility is based on employment status. Financial * Employee Rewards Package including equity * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan * Torus paid life and AD\&D Insurance with options to purchase additional coverage * Voluntary short\- and long\-term disability insurance Health \& Wellness * Health Benefits Package: Choice between traditional PPO or HSA\-eligible medical plans with Torus covering 50% of medical premiums; Dental insurance; and Vision insurance * Plan participants have access to telehealth services, mental health support and coaching, and exclusive discounts on brands, dining, entertainment, and more. Time Off * Unlimited discretionary PTO * 10 paid company holidays * Waiting period\-free 100% paid parental leave Culture \& Community * Regular company\-wide offsites to showcase our progress and learnings. A time to step back, think strategically, and work on the business together. * Team members receive Torus branded gear * Peer Recognition Program * Fully stocked break rooms with free snacks and drinks. Because great work deserves great fuel. Torus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Torus participates in E\-Verify. Once you accept a job offer, we will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from your Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. *\#li\-lw \#li\-onsite*

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer (R&D)
jobs.description: Join the team that's shaping the future of autonomous robotics and material handling. As an R\&D Software Engineer at Toyota Automated Logistics, you'll develop the brains behind intelligent robotic systems, from low\-level hardware control to high\-level autonomy and perception. You'll work on real robots. You'll ship real code. You'll help launch entirely new automation products into warehouses and factories across the world. We don't just build software; we build the future of logistics. **About Us** Toyota Automated Logistics R\&D is the **New Product Development (NPD)** division of the company. Our mission is to develop original products that expand Toyota Automated Logistics' automation capabilities — enabling our commissioning and systems teams to deliver integrated solutions that give our customers a competitive edge. Our \~70\-person team is distributed between our **Boise, Dallas, and Indianapolis** offices, and includes experts in mechanical, electrical, software, and AI disciplines, all with a strong foundation in robotics technology. Beyond our Toyota Automated Logistics offices, we collaborate heavily with our other Toyota partners to innovate and share our technology globally. Software engineers on our team are true full\-stack robotics developers, with opportunities to work across the entire software stack — from high\-level autonomy, AI, and perception to low\-level motor control, hardware interfaces, and everything in\-between. We take products from concept to production\-ready designs, and we execute our software on real robot hardware in live customer environments. Above all else, we know that our strength lies in our people. Through strong mentorship, thoughtful planning, and a supportive team culture, we create space for engineers to grow while maintaining a healthy work\-life balance. **Your Mission** The primary mission of the R\&D Senior Software Engineer is to act as a technical expert and leader who drives the team towards success. You will develop the architectures and designs that enable our software systems to reliably scale to customer deployments. You will put a major focus on refining the processes and SOPs that drive our team to be effective. You will work to mentor and inspire your peers to become stronger engineers. At Toyota Automated Logistics, we value our team culture extremely highly. You will operate as a force multiplier to make the team the strongest they can be! As the R\&D Senior Software Engineer, you are an expert in Linux development using both C\+\+ and Python. You have experience designing production ready software and understand the patterns and architectures used to create reliable and maintainable codebases. You have experience with common robotics software tools and concepts such as ROS, motor control, localization, navigation, and sensor hardware technology such as LiDAR, Cameras, Motors, Encoders, etc. Most importantly, you have experience leading teams, driving processes, inspiring software engineers, and creating strong team cultures with open communication. In this role, you won't just build software. You'll help shape how our systems behave in the real world, and you will build and support a team that values both innovation and thoughtful execution. **Job** **Functions** * Contribute directly to ROS\-based C\+\+ and Python codebases, running on Linux systems. * Create software designs, host design and code reviews, and engage with SDLC processes. * Responsible for owning key development and acting as a key stakeholder in review approvals. * Mentor and guide junior team members – engage in peer programming. * Engage in scoping, planning, and scheduling your work in an Agile workflow. * Engage in, and help create and drive, best practices and SOPs for software development. * Create test plans and engage in hands\-on testing and verification on live Robots \& Hardware. * Uphold our safety standards when interacting with live equipment. * Participate in field trials and customer on\-site Beta deployments as we release new products. * Work with other Toyota Automated Logistics and TICO business units throughout the release process of R\&D products (Manufacturing, Commissioning, Development, etc). **Travel Requirements:** * 5% overnight travel (Travel expenses paid by Toyota Automated Logistics) **Preferred** **Skills \&****Qualifications** * Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar field * Minimum 8\+ years of relevant experience * Experience designing and implementing production software systems. * Experience with Agile development environment and a strong drive for SOPs. * Expert in Linux environment and developing for Linux systems. * Expertise in C/C\+\+ and Python, Experience with other software technologies (Web Development, SQL, etc.). * Experience with CI/CD and testing methodologies and implementation. * Experience with Containerization and Deployment Strategies. * Experience with version control systems, GIT preferred. * Experience with ROS (Robot Operating System). * Must be eligible to work in the USA long term without sponsorship. * Employees must follow all information security policies, protect confidential data, complete required training, and report any suspected security incidents to support our information security controls. **About Toyota Automated Logistics:** Toyota Automated Logistics is your global partner for integrated warehouse automation. Our team combines the talents of Bastian Solutions, Vanderlande's warehousing business and viastore under one brand to deliver scalable systems, intelligent software and life\-cycle services. In addition to exciting work at a growing company, we offer the following benefits: * Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) Retirement Plan with a company match * Vacation / Holiday Pay * Paid Volunteer time off * Tuition Reimbursement * Professional Associations, Conferences and Subscriptions * Company Meetings \& Events *Toyota Automated Logistics does not work with outside recruiting agencies. No solicitation phone calls please.*

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **TransCore (TRN), a subsidiary of ST Engineering, is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our growing Smart Mobility Ecosystems team and help shape the architecture and technical direction of our next generation of mobility solutions.** **Location:** Atlanta **About the Role:** Passionate about the Smart Cities space? Interested in solving problems with how people move? Perhaps this is the role for you! TransCore is seeking an experienced, hands\-on Principal Software Engineer to help build the Smart Mobility Platform, the shared foundation for our Smart Mobility products with the intent to rethink how users move, providing innovative, user\-friendly solutions to their day\-to\-day lives, reaching millions of users across the globe. This "zero to one" role is pivotal in building an entirely new product \& ecosystem from scratch. You’ll serve as the platform subject matter expert for Smart Mobility engineering leadership and work closely with the full engineering group to shape technical direction, developing a high\-quality, data\-informed system to meet customer needs, support user growth \& critical journeys, while unlocking new mobility use cases and verticals. TransCore is uniquely positioned to have a huge impact in advancing smart cities \& mobility and this role is uniquely positioned to achieve this vision. Join TransCore as we shape the future of smart cities and transportation tech. **This is an individual contributor role.** You will not have direct reports. We are looking for a deep technical practitioner who leads through expertise, influence, and good engineering practice, with room to grow into a more senior technical or people\-leadership role over time. **Key Responsibilities:** Be the hands\-on technical authority for the Smart Mobility Platform and its expansion into a multi\-modal mobility ecosystem. Requires deep expertise in cloud\-native architecture, microservices, payment systems, and modern engineering practice. * **Platform Subject Matter Expertise:** Serve as the platform SME for Smart Mobility engineering leadership. Assess current engineering capabilities and architecture, and advise on the technology direction and standards we adopt going forward. * **Hands\-on Design \& Implementation:** Design, prototype, and implement cloud\-native, microservices\-based architectures, focusing on payment integration (PCI DSS), auto integrations, and API\-first design to enable multi\-vertical use cases as well as great end user experiences. Apply user\-first thinking to determine other features or capabilities to build into the UI and ensure the architecture can support. * **Scalability \& Performance:** Ensure high\-performance, scalable systems for high\-volume, real\-time data processing. * **Security \& Compliance:** Maintain system security and compliance with relevant regulations (PCI DSS, GDPR, etc.). * **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Work closely with product, platform, and application engineering teams to align designs, resolve cross\-cutting technical issues, and keep teams on a consistent path. * **Engineering Practices \& Mentorship**: Set and promote good practices (design reviews, code reviews, testing, observability, secure delivery), and mentor engineers across teams. **Key Skills \& Experience:** * Expertise in cloud\-native architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, and event\-driven systems; experience with high\-volume, real\-time data processing. * Proficiency in API design (RESTful/GraphQL) with experience showcasing applications across broad sets of use cases. * Strong working knowledge of modern engineering and DevOps practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability. * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including sustained experience as a technical lead across multiple teams or systems. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field. * Typically requires 14\+ years of combined relevant software engineering experience and advanced education, including sustained experience as a technical lead across multiple teams or systems. * Proven track record of technically leading “zero to one” initiatives, especially in tech\-heavy, regulated industries like transportation or infrastructure. * Strong communication skills and a proven ability to influence and coordinate across teams without formal authority. * Currently working as a hands\-on individual contributor. Candidates whose recent roles have been primarily people management should note this role writes and reviews code and designs. **Preferred qualifications and experience:** * Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science * Application of AI capabilities to improve workflow or deliver organizational efficiencies. * Knowledge of tolling, parking, or transportation technologies is a plus. * Experience working in cross\-functional environments with a focus on platform SDK development. **Physical Demands/Work Environment** While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be seated for extended periods of time. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. * TransCore complies with federal and state disability laws and provides reasonable accommodation for employees with disabilities. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** As a Quality Engineer at Transcendia, you will serve as a key change agent supporting manufacturing operations across our manufacturing campus that incorporates three buildings. This is a highly visible, hands\-on role that requires a self\-motivated professional who can work independently, make sound decisions, and drive quality improvements in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. You will actively partner with Operations, Engineering, and Production teams to identify and solve complex quality and process challenges, reduce operational risk, and ensure the reliability of custom\-engineered materials used in critical applications. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to balance strategic quality initiatives with day\-to\-day manufacturing support. **Key Responsibilities** * Provide routine on\-site support across Hebron manufacturing facilities, requiring frequent movement between locations to support quality and operational needs. * Conduct hands\-on inspections, testing, sample collection, investigations, and audits within production environments. * Act as SQF Practitioner, overseeing food safety programs, HACCP activities, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions, employee training, and SQF certification activities. * Manage the site's MS Access Quality Database, including system maintenance, user access control, specification setup, inspection data management, reporting, troubleshooting, and database enhancements. * Serve as the site validation lead, coordinating cross\-functional IQ/OQ/PQ activities, reviewing validation data, resolving deviations, and ensuring a state of continuous compliance and audit readiness. * Apply data\-driven problem\-solving methodologies to identify root causes, develop effective corrective actions, and prevent recurrence of quality issues. * Independently prioritize workload and manage multiple projects while maintaining a strong sense of ownership and accountability for results. * Work closely with manufacturing and engineering to develop, implement, maintain and improve quality standards and methods to ensure product quality within manufacturing operations. * Collaborate with and mentor cross\-functional team members through the root\-cause analysis process, continuous improvement process, and supporting a culture of quality. * Lead investigations in response to quality nonconformances and manage timely corrective and preventive actions in alignment with quality system requirements. * Analyze quality data and key performance indicators, identify trends, and initiate actions to address emerging product or process risks. * Plan and execute test method validations. * Participate in internal and external audits. **Qualifications** **Education \& Experience** * Experience working in a manufacturing environment requiring regular interaction with production personnel and processes. * Experience utilizing statistical analysis and problem\-solving tools such as Minitab, DOE, SPC, Pareto analysis, capability studies, and root cause methodologies. * Experience with electronic document management systems, SharePoint, or similar collaboration platforms. * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Science, or a related technical field * Minimum 2 years of experience in quality or engineering within a regulated industry

jobs.title: VP Of Technology
jobs.description: ABOUT THIS JOB This position combines executive\-level ownership with substantial hands\-on technical involvement. You will establish priorities, lead and develop engineering teams, and take direct responsibility for architecture, software quality, and delivery. You must also remain an advanced software engineer who can write production code, investigate complex issues, and make informed technical decisions through firsthand experience. We are looking for someone who has successfully led engineering teams, delivered complex software initiatives, and connected technology investments to measurable business results. RESPONSIBILITIES * Own the technology roadmap, aligning engineering priorities with company goals, operational needs, and growth plans. * Partner with executive leadership to evaluate new initiatives, define technical requirements, and make build\-versus\-buy decisions. * Own technology budgets, resource planning, and vendor relationships, balancing investment with business impact. * Establish measurable goals for engineering delivery, system reliability, software quality, and team performance. * Communicate project progress, technical risks, resource needs, and investment recommendations to executive stakeholders. * Set the architectural direction for applications, APIs, integrations, databases, and infrastructure. * Remain actively involved in development through production coding, code reviews, technical design, and troubleshooting. * Take direct ownership of technically complex or business\-critical initiatives, working alongside engineers to deliver solutions. * Evaluate existing systems and lead improvements to scalability, performance, maintainability, and reliability. * Establish engineering standards for coding, testing, documentation, version control, and deployment. * Guide the practical adoption of AI and automation, evaluating their value, reliability, and security. * Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, conduct performance reviews, and address performance gaps. * Own engineering capacity planning, project prioritization, and delivery commitments across competing initiatives. * Establish accountability for project scope, timelines, technical quality, and ongoing system ownership. REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical field. * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial experience building and maintaining production applications. * 5\+ years of direct engineering management experience, including responsibility for hiring, coaching, performance management, and team development. * 3\+ years in a senior engineering leadership role, such as Director of Engineering, Head of Engineering, VP of Engineering, or a comparable position, with ownership beyond a single project. * Experience leading multiple engineering workstreams or teams and managing senior engineers, technical leads, or engineering managers. * Recent, substantial hands\-on coding experience, with advanced proficiency in at least one major backend language and the ability to evaluate code across a broader technology stack. * Deep experience with software architecture, API design, relational databases, third\-party integrations, and distributed systems. * Experience overseeing cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and production operations. * Demonstrated success delivering complex software initiatives from planning and architecture through launch and ongoing maintenance. * Experience owning technology roadmaps, staffing plans, budgets, and vendor evaluations. * Strong understanding of secure development practices, identity and access management, and data protection. * Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs, make decisions with incomplete information, and explain their business implications to executive leadership. Our company offers great benefits: full healthcare package (medical, dental, vision, life), 401k with a company match, catered lunch, coffee, tea and snacks, paid parking, competitive pay, and much more! Anyone who joins our team will have great potential for career and personal growth.

jobs.title: Architect
jobs.description: **Who we are** At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote\-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . **Hiring and how we work** We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote\-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad\-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off\-sites or customer meetings. . **See yourself at Twilio** Join the team as Twilio’s next Architect on our Data Substrate team **About the job** Twilio runs on data, and the platform underneath it is entering a major shift. Open table formats, the convergence of lakes and warehouses, tightening privacy regulation, and AI workloads are all changing what a data platform has to do. We’re hiring an Architect to set our direction through that shift and to make sure the systems we build over the next 3\-5 years are the right ones. You’ll own the technical strategy for our data platform, spanning storage, lake and lakehouse architecture, catalog and governance, and privacy\-by\-design. You’ll work across org boundaries, setting standards that dozens of teams build on and raising the technical bar for the engineers around you. **Responsibilities** In this role, you’ll: * Own the architecture and multi\-year technical strategy for the data platform, including the lake/lakehouse, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and governance, and keep them coherent as one platform rather than separate systems. Define where each engine fits (for example, ClickHouse versus open table formats on object storage) and the migration path between them. * Make and document the major design decisions (ADRs, RFCs) on storage and open table formats, catalog strategy, compute engines, tenancy, data placement, and build\-versus\-adopt tradeoffs, with cost and performance at petabyte scale as explicit design constraints. * Set the reference architectures for how our core storage and query engines (ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and lake engines) are deployed, tuned, scaled and operated as shared platforms, including capacity, cost, tenant isolation, and upgrade strategy. * Define the reliability model for the platform: availability targets, failure domains, disaster recovery, observability, and incident response patterns that teams can adopt. * Build privacy and compliance into the architecture, not onto it. Design deletion and right\-to\-erasure, retention, data residency, and PII classification so they work across the platform’s storage layers, backups, and derived datasets, including data that arrives from upstream streaming systems. * Drive data governance: classification, catalog and metadata, lineage, access control integrated with our authentication and authorization systems, data contracts, quality and integrity standards, and a catalog teams actually use. * Review designs and technical direction across the org, and act as the escalation point on hard distributed\-systems and performance problems. * Mentor principal and senior engineers, and grow architectural judgment across the org, not only within one squad. * Partner with product, security, infrastructure and consuming teams to turn business needs into platform roadmaps, and say no or re\-sequence when the tradeoffs require it. * Track emerging data technologies (such as streaming\-first architectures, federated query, and AI\-ready data layers) and bring forward the ones worth adopting, with evidence from prototypes or benchmarks. **Qualifications** Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! **Required:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 15\+ years of experience in software development or a related field, with at least 8 years in an architecture or senior technical leadership role. * Proven track record of architecting and delivering large\-scale data platforms and setting their technical strategy, on cloud infrastructure such as AWS, deployed with Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm. * Deep expertise in storage and compute for analytical data: columnar and open table formats, lake atalog strategy. * Experience with a platform migration across domains or ownership models, such as moving from central to domain\-owned data. * A track record of measurable cost optimization on large data platforms. * Networking and network security knowledge. **Location** This role will be remote, and based in the United States. **Travel** We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in\-person meetings. **What We Offer** Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location **Compensation** * *Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.* The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: * Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $207,200 \- $233,100\. * Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $219,360 \- $246,780\. * Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $243,680 \- $274,140\. This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. **Application deadline information** Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 1/4/2027 but may change based on business needs. **Twilio thinks big. Do you?** We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. **.** **Stay alert to recruitment fraud** We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text\-based messaging apps. . **Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.** We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Please consult our* *Candidate Privacy Notice**, for information about how we collect, use, and disclose personal information of our candidates.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - .NET
jobs.description: Tyler Technologies’ Maryland Enterprise is seeking candidates for a Senior .NET Software Engineer. The selected candidate will be part of a strong development team and they will be responsible for translating complex business requirements into functional web\-based applications throughout all stages of the SDLC. The Developer will create and support large\-scale/complex applications by gathering requirements, designing, maintaining, developing, testing, and deploying applications with security, efficiency, maintainability, and usability in mind. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Build and ship high\-quality customer\-facing web applications. * Maintain and improve a distributed cloud platform running on AWS. * Develop and containerize .NET applications deployed to AWS. * Provide direct mentorship to junior engineers on the team. * Collaborate with other engineers, engineering management, designers, and project managers to design and architect solutions. **Qualifications:** ------------------- * We would love to talk to you if you… * Care about scalable, robust, well\-tested code. * Consider yourself a full stack engineer, willing to work in any part of the stack required for the task. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Supply
jobs.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper\-targeted segmentation, AI\-powered recommendations, real\-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million\+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first\-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real\-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. **This is a unique moment to join Vibe.** With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance\-driven future for the channel. **Your team** ------------- You will join the Supply team, which owns Vibe's inventory: the publishers we partner with, the deals we run, and the catalog of apps, channels and shows our advertisers care about. Shows are the reason people turn on their TV. Advertisers don't just want impressions: they want to show up next to the right shows, live sports and premium channels. Supply brings that content to Vibe through direct publisher partnerships, curated deals and sponsorships. It makes it easy to find, understand and buy, through real\-time bidding, or any technology the publisher uses. Premium publishers care as much about which ads run on their shows as about who buys them, and great creatives are what earn us access. The team brings together partnerships, operations, and product. You will work closely with the DSP team, which runs the bidding infrastructure, and the Performance team, which decides how to value each opportunity, as well as with publisher partners directly. **Your mission** ---------------- As a Senior Software Engineer on Supply, you will build the systems that let Vibe grow, operate, and trust its inventory. You will turn publisher partnerships into live, healthy supply, and give the business and our partners the tools to manage it at scale. **What you will do** -------------------- **Publisher integrations** * Build and improve publisher integrations end\-to\-end, from onboarding a new partner to supporting new ad formats and sponsorship offers. * Implement measurement requirements with publishers and the DSP team (e.g. UID2, publisher IDs) so the bidder sees richer inventory. * Own integration health: detect broken or degraded supply before it costs us spend. **Deals \& catalog** * Build the services behind deal setup, catalog management, and price configuration, in partnership with DSP on the deal API. * Automate the routine work of the Supply team (new deals, stale\-supply cleanup, troubleshooting) so it scales with the number of partners, and with Vibe. * Enrich the catalog with content data (shows, genres, live events, channels) so advertisers can find what they are looking for, and even enjoy looking for it. **Supply tooling \& publisher platform** * Build real\-time monitoring, alerting, and analytics on supply volume, quality, and spend. * Build publisher\-facing features: reporting, insights, and self\-serve catalog tools. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience as a software engineer building and operating backend systems in production. * Strong programming skills (Go, Python and/or Rust), with real engineering discipline: testing, code review, CI/CD, maintainable design. * Hands\-on with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex or similar) in your day\-to\-day engineering workflow. * Experience integrating with external partners' systems and APIs, and owning those integrations when they break. * Comfortable owning services from code to production: cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Kubernetes, and the observability to know your systems are healthy. * Product sense: you like talking to the people who use what you build, and you turn ambiguous business needs into concrete deliverables. * Excellent communication in English, with internal teams and with partners' technical contacts. * Pragmatism over purity: a bias toward shipping value. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience in AdTech or programmatic: OpenRTB, SSPs, PMP / PG deals, VAST. * Knowledge of the CTV ecosystem (publishers, apps, FAST channels). * Experience with identity solutions (UID2 or similar). * Experience building partner\-facing or B2B dashboards and reporting. **Our Values** -------------- At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high\-performance environment with high\-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. **What We Offer** The base pay range for this role in Paris is €90,000 – €125,000\. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates. The base pay range for this role in New York is $140,000 – $200,000\. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates. At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up: * Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals. * Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week! * Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan. * Meal vouchers — Via Swile. * Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. * Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide. **Our Interview Process** We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting. * Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for. * Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, product background, and approach to the role. * Technical Discussion — 90 minutes. A deeper conversation covering product thinking, measurement methodology, data reasoning, and a use case relevant to the role. * Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions. * Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit. **Equal Opportunity** Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. **Referral Instructions** Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

This role will also be instrumental in establishing data engineering and governance standards, working closely with business stakeholders to standardize and normalize existing data domains, and jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Platform)
jobs.description: **Teaching AI Drug Discovery** ------------------------------ The next great drugs won't be discovered. They'll be designed. But AI can't design biology it has never seen, and the data to teach it barely exists yet. Valen Labs is building the engine that generates it. We are a biological data company. We've orchestrated novel technology and ambitious lab machinery into an autonomous biofactory that designs, builds, and characterizes molecules at a scale and speed the field has never had. Best in class machines, best in class data. We work with frontier AI labs to train their biology models, and we build the benchmarks that measure how well AI can actually do science, from a single binding assay to running an entire lab. Everything we produce is structured, high\-fidelity data, built for machine learning and generated faster than anywhere else. We're backed by top Silicon Valley investors, including funds linked with Peter Thiel, and we're based in San Francisco. **About this Role** ------------------- Every molecule Valen makes and every assay we run has to land somewhere clean, queryable, and ready for a model to learn from. That system is the platform, and you own it. As a Member of Technical Staff on Platform, you build Valen's internal system of record and LIMS from the ground up. You model our samples, assays, and experimental metadata, you build the data pipelines that carry results from the bench to analysis to the model, and you make sure every data point is tracked, trustworthy, and structured for machine learning. You're one of our first engineering hires, so you own the whole stack rather than inherit someone else's. What you'll own: * Build Valen's LIMS and scientific system of record from zero, replacing off\-the\-shelf tooling that doesn't fit our science * Model samples, assays, and experimental metadata so every result is tracked and queryable * Build clean, reliable data pipelines from the bench through analysis and into model training * Migrate our existing lab data and workflows onto the system you build * Work in the lab, five days a week, next to the scientists who use what you ship **Requirements** ---------------- * Strong software and data engineering; you build real systems, not just scripts * One of two paths: you've built a LIMS or sample\-tracking system from scratch at a biotech, or you're an excellent engineer with a biology or wet\-lab background ready to build one for the first time * Comfort owning data modeling, pipelines, and the tracking and analysis layer end to end * A high bar, whether from a rigorous technical program, a strong TechBio or lab\-software startup, or teams like Benchling or Ginkgo Bioworks * Familiarity with protein expression or antibody characterization workflows is a plus * Early\-career and hungry is welcome; a strong track record matters more than years on paper * San Francisco based, fully onsite **Benefits** ------------ * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Meaningful early\-stage equity * Unlimited PTO We work hard, and we're honest about that. The pace is high and the problems are hard. What you get in return is work that genuinely matters, real ownership, and a small team that holds a high bar and ships fast. This is a place to do the best work of your career.

jobs.title: Critical Facilities Engineer (Data Center)
jobs.description: **About Vantage** ================= Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. **This is a evergreen req for active openings available in our Virginia data center locations for immediate hire. These roles will need experience hands\-on talent that will be able to make an immediate impact.** **Site Operations Department** The Site Operations Department is responsible for the overall health of all mechanical and electrical systems, building maintenance, and performance of all data modules in our data centers. The team is staffed 24 x 7 onsite with Critical Facility Engineers (CFEs) on each shift. This team is the face of Vantage to our customers and the first line of defense regarding the uptime of our campus as well as the performance of our customer installations. Using a Critical Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to plan and track work needed, the Site Operations department performs all preventative and corrective maintenance. Our culture expects and rewards team performance that engages directly with the customers and the facility infrastructure. This is a team that does most of the actual work versus calling upon vendors. As a result, we provide superior service that is faster and more cost effective. **Position Overview** **This role is onsite in Ashburn, VA. This is an in\-house position.** **Ideally we will be seeking experienced talent for Levels II or III. One with data center, mission critical field service or mission critical military experience highly desired (US Navy, US Air Force, US Army, US Marines, US Coast Guard). These are in\-house and hands\-on roles using your critical thinking talents to troubleshoot and fix equipment vs subbing out the work.** **Electrical and mechanical expertise in a non\-mission critical field service in cross\-industry may be considered, e.g, chiller technician with larger tonnage but non\-critical environments or field service in OEM equipment outside of data center. (Johnson Controls, York, Trane, Daikin, Vertiv, Eaton, Liebert, Toshiba, Delta, CAT, ABB, Samsung, Mitsubishi, Siemens, Petra etc) . We are also able to consider those that are very trainable.** **Shifts likely to be overnight or 3rd shift. There may be one opening that is 1st shift \- TBD.** We are looking for a Critical Facilities Engineer who knows what best\-in\-class service looks like and can make that a reality. This role is an important member of our facilities team where we manage some of the most efficient and cost\-effective data center facilities in the industry. The successful candidate for this role will work with a team of other electrical and mechanical\-focused engineers performing maintenance and repair for our data center infrastructure. We take our customer requirements for uptime seriously and keep our facilities maintained to a very high standard to insure uninterrupted service for our customers. If you enjoy working on critical data center systems (UPSs, PDUs, Diesel Generators, ATS equipment and Building Controls), as well as industrial electrical equipment and systems that include power distribution components/wiring, electronic components and lighting systems. If you know the importance of getting it right the first time and not disrupting mission critical data centers. If you enjoy delighting customers with superior service and you have the desire and ability to do so, then please read on! **Essential Job Functions** * Work under limited supervision, both independently and within a team environment * Manage multiple one\-time and/or ongoing projects * Respond to safety and emergency situations and maintain a safe and secure work environment * Use discretion and judgment in organizing workflow and adapting as priorities are modified due to a changing environment * Frequent contact with employees at all levels of the organization; frequent external contact with vendors **Duties** * Operate, perform maintenance and service repairs on critical Data Center systems (UPS, PDU, Diesel Generators, ATS equipment and Building Controls, Chillers, CRAH, ETC) * Develop reliability reports to ensure availability and capacity targets are achieved and maintained with 100% uptime * Coordinate, and oversee all maintenance vendors to ensure personnel safety, protect the Facility’s critical equipment, and maintain power to the critical load * Create required MOPs (Method of Procedure), SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and EOPs (Emergency Operating Procedures) to ensure all maintenance activities are performed in accordance to them * Additional duties as assigned by Management **Job Requirements** * Minimum 3 years, 5\+ year operating, maintaining, repairing, inspecting and testing critical electrical distribution systems, HVAC systems and building management/automation equipment * Ability to read commercial building blueprints and understand electrical single lines and schematics * Knowledge of commonly\-used concepts, practices, and procedures related to mechanical \& electrical systems needed to run data centers * Technical Writing skills and experience; as well as creating, coordinating, updating and/or modifying MOPs/SOPs/EOP’s for critical facilities equipment, to include supporting new systems and researching technical requirements * Work experience in the electrical or mechanical field is highly desired. Strong emphasis on technical skills/training, with intent to obtain license within a reasonable time * May be required to complete formal training in an area of specialty, such as UPS maintenance * Candidates must possess reliable transportation for reporting to work for shifts, or emergencies * Travel is expected to be less than 5%, occasionally for training purposes * Potential employees must complete a background check successfully **Physical Demands and Special Requirements** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Ability to stand 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to walk 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to sit 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to climb and balance 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to reach with hands \& arms 1/3 – 2/3 of the time * Ability to smell, talk \& hear * Ability to use hands to type, handle \& feel * Ability to reach with hands and arms * Ability to see at close and distance ranges and the ability to see color * Must be comfortable working in a high stress, fast paced environment with shifting priorities * Must be willing to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, late nights, holidays, and on\-call support * Ability to lift up to 50 pounds 1/3 of the time **Additional Details** * This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD\&D, short and long\-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. * Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown. Posting range is $38\-55 / hour for level Is and IIs. **\#LI\-Onsite** **\#LI\-TS1** We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. Verifying that generated queries stay inside permitted scope is a testable control with legal consequences if missed Acquisition cost validation. Confirm optimised queries touch fewer source tables than baseline and that facility consolidation genuinely works Lead and report Direct two QA engineers; set standards, review coverage, own the defect taxonomy Confirm downstream compatibility across Databricks, SQL Server and Vertica Produce evidence packs suitable for client executive review, and defend methodology, sample sizes and statistical claims under scrutiny. **Educational Qualifications:** \- Engineering Degree BE/ME/BTech/MTech/BSc/MSc.
