jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Agentic Engineering
jobs.description: Position Summary: Vista Equity Partners is seeking a Consultant, Deployment Strategist to help execute agentic engineering transformations at Vista portfolio companies. The role supports Vista’s Agentic Engineering Factory framework, which helps portfolio companies adopt agentic AI across the software development lifecycle, with measurable gains in engineering throughput, quality, and cost. This role sits on the Product \& Technology Value Creation team and owns day\-to\-day engagement execution. The Deployment Strategist works inside portfolio company engineering and product organizations to turn a broad goal, such as shipping faster at lower cost with AI tooling, into a scoped, sequenced, and measured program. They keep that program on track across portfolio company leadership, Vista engagement leads, tool vendors, and delivery partners, and they write what they learn back into Vista’s playbooks, templates, and measurement standards. The Deployment Strategist works as a pair with the team’s Senior Forward Deployed Engineers. The Senior Forward Deployed Engineers own the technical build: repository and environment readiness, agent and harness configuration, and hands\-on work with portfolio company engineers. The Deployment Strategist owns everything around that build: scoping, stakeholder alignment, measurement, program management, and adoption. Together they cover an engagement from the first discovery conversation through measured results. The role requires analytical rigor, technical fluency, and the ability to work credibly with CTOs, CPOs, CFOs, and engineers. It is an operating role, not a pure advisory one: the Deployment Strategist is accountable for whether the work gets delivered, adopted, and measured. This role is for an immediate start. Responsibilities: * Own day\-to\-day execution of agentic engineering engagements at assigned portfolio companies, from discovery and scope definition through build, rollout, measurement, and handoff. * Lead discovery, including data requests, current\-state SDLC and product development interviews, and use case workshops, to identify where engineering work stalls and where AI tooling can have the highest impact. * Translate pain points into scoped use cases with defined success criteria, baselines, owners, and phase\-gate requirements. * Partner with the Senior Forward Deployed Engineers to turn scoped use cases into build requirements, sequence technical work against business priorities, and keep engineers and stakeholders aligned on what is being built and why. * Define and maintain engagement measurement, including metric definitions with explicit calculation logic, baselines, control groups, and efficiency models. Ensure reporting separates adoption from outcomes and holds up under scrutiny from portfolio company finance and engineering leaders. * Run the program cadence: maintain the tracker as the system of record, manage milestones, risks, blockers, and decisions, and produce weekly status updates and steering committee and executive materials. * Work with portfolio company engineers and product leaders to pilot and roll out agentic development tooling. Prototype, script, and analyze data directly where it moves the work forward. * Coordinate across Vista, portfolio company teams, tool vendors, and external delivery partners. Hold partners to agreed scope, acceptance criteria, and handoff plans. * Support change management and enablement, including sequencing of communications, training, and adoption checkpoints, so that the tooling is used in daily work. * Support evaluation of AI engineering platforms and harnesses against each portfolio company’s technical, security, and organizational constraints. * Surface decisions, tradeoffs, and data discrepancies early, and escalate to Vista and portfolio company leadership with a clear recommendation. * Capture lessons from each engagement and contribute to reusable playbooks, phase\-gate templates, data request lists, and diagnostic kits for use across the Vista portfolio. **What Could Be Next:** This role gives you direct exposure to several portfolio companies at different stages of AI adoption, and to the executives who make the decisions. You see what works and what fails across different codebases, team structures, and tool choices. That experience prepares you to lead engagements and a broader portfolio, take on an operating role at a portfolio company, or move into forward deployed, product, strategy, or investing roles focused on software and AI. Qualifications: * 2 to 5 years of experience in consulting, product management, technical program management, implementation, or operating roles, preferably in software or technology. * Demonstrated ownership of a complex, multi\-stakeholder program with ambiguous requirements, where you were accountable for delivery and not only for advice. * Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle, including source control, CI/CD, issue tracking, and engineering productivity metrics such as cycle time and deployment frequency. * Hands\-on use of AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. * Strong quantitative skills, including building and pressure\-testing metrics and models and stating their assumptions and limits clearly. * Ability to communicate clearly with both product management / engineering teams and senior executives, in writing and in person. * Comfort with open\-ended problems, low ego, and a focus on outcomes over credit. * Experience with developer productivity measurement, change management, agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph), system integrators, or private equity operating environments is preferred. * Willingness to travel up to 50%. The annualized base pay range for this role is expected to be between $140,000 \- $165,000\. Actual base pay could vary based on factors including but not limited to experience, subject matter expertise, geographic location where work will be performed and the applicant’s skill set. The base pay is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other components may include an annual cash bonus and a comprehensive benefits package. Company Overview: Vista is a preeminent technology investor, specializing in enterprise AI and software, with over $100 billion in AUM. For over 25 years and across every technology cycle, Vista has been pioneering new approaches to software investing, delivering consistent and compelling results at scale. Today, we're applying that expertise to help harness the transformative potential of AI to redefine how work gets done. Further information is available at vistaequitypartners.com. Follow Vista on LinkedIn, @Vista Equity Partners, and on YouTube.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a proactive, hands\-on **Cloud Security Engineer** to serve as the primary security partner for our Engineering and DevOps teams. In this role, you will be the "North Star" for secure cloud configuration, moving beyond simple alert triaging to building sustainable security foundations. You will bridge the gap between high\-level security architecture and daily engineering execution, ensuring our AWS and Azure environments are resilient, compliant, and automated. ### **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** * **Cloud Governance \& Guardrails:** Lead the deployment and optimization of AWS Control Tower, Security Hub, and AWS WAF to establish a secure multi\-account strategy. * **Cloud Security Platform Ownership:** Own cloud security outcomes across AWS (primary), Azure (secondary), and limited GCP, including secure landing zone standards, guardrails\-as\-code, detection coverage, and remediation automation. * **Secure\-by\-Default Engineering:** Design and implement reusable, secure\-by\-default cloud patterns that allow engineering teams to deploy safely without constant security intervention. Establish hardened Terraform modules, reference architectures, and baseline configurations so the secure path becomes the easiest path for teams building in AWS. * **Container Security:** Collaborate with the AppSec Architect to secure EKS and ECS environments, focusing on runtime protection, image scanning, and least\-privilege orchestration. * **Security Assessment \& Roadmap:** Perform a comprehensive baseline assessment of the current cloud environment to identify gaps and provide actionable, prioritized recommendations. * **Identity \& Access Management:** Lead design and enforcement of least\-privilege IAM architecture across AWS accounts and workloads. * **Operational Excellence:** Develop and maintain secure configuration standards, documentation, and operational procedures that enable engineering teams to consistently deploy and operate cloud services securely. * **Detection \& Telemetry Ownership:** Partner with security operations to ensure security telemetry from AWS environments is complete, centralized, and actionable (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow logs, etc.) * **Cloud Security \& Compliance Alignment:** Ensure cloud configurations and controls align with internal security standards and external compliance requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc.). Partner with Security and GRC teams to implement audit\-ready controls, automate evidence collection where possible, and maintain clear documentation of cloud security control coverage. * **Third\-Party Integration:** Manage secure access and configuration for security vendor tools (vulnerability scanners, assessment platforms, etc.) within the cloud environment. * **Incident Response:** Participate in an on\-call rotation for one week at a time and serve as primary SME for cloud security incidents (IAM compromise, exposed keys, misconfigurations, etc.). * **Vulnerability \& Exposure Management:** Build and run the cloud vulnerability management program for AWS and Azure workloads, container images, and base AMIs. Define severity\-based SLAs, implement scalable scanning and patch workflows (e.g., AWS Inspector, ECR scanning, hardened base images), and partner with Engineering to reduce exploitable exposure. * **Cloud Security Tooling Ownership**: Own onboarding, coverage validation, and tuning of CSPM and MDR integrations across AWS, Azure and GCP. Drive measurable improvement in signal quality, alert fidelity, and remediation workflows through automation and engineering partnerships. * **Secrets, Keys, and Credential Hygiene:** Design and enforce secure secrets management patterns (AWS Secrets Manager/Parameter Store/Vault), automated rotation, and least\-privilege secret access. Own KMS key strategy and governance (key policies, grants, rotation, separation of duties) and ensure no long\-lived credentials in CI/CD. * **CI/CD and Supply Chain Security:** Secure the software delivery pipeline end\-to\-end, including identity federation for CI/CD, policy\-as\-code enforcement for Terraform and Kubernetes, artifact integrity controls (signing/provenance), and secure dependency/source controls. Ensure security guardrails are automated and developer\-friendly. * **Cloud Incident Readiness \& Exercises:** Build cloud\-native incident playbooks (IAM compromise, crypto\-mining, data exposure, suspicious network activity) and run periodic tabletop exercises. Ensure forensics readiness through log retention standards, immutable/auditable logging where appropriate, snapshot/containment procedures, and break\-glass access controls. * **Multi\-Cloud \& Hybrid Baselines:** Establish minimum viable security baselines for Azure and GCP (identity, logging, storage, network, key management) and ensure telemetry parity into centralized detection. jobs.title: Senior AI Governance Engineer
jobs.description: Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar \- delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy. Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact \- both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best. Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs. **Position Summary** This position designs, builds, and owns the technical capabilities that operationalize enterprise AI governance, spanning AI controls and risk assessments, implementation guidance, and working across Security, Architecture, Privacy, Legal, and Data Science teams. Working independently across multiple data domains, this role translates governance policy and regulatory requirements into enforceable technical controls, establishes the engineering patterns other team members follow, and serves as a technical resource to less experienced colleagues. **Essential Responsibilities** * Data Quality Engineering: Design and implement data quality frameworks, rule sets, and scoring methodologies across multiple data domains, including measurement approaches for accuracy, completeness, timeliness, validity, consistency, and uniqueness. Define the remediation workflow and escalation model. * Metadata and Catalog Engineering: Design and implement metadata and lineage capture automation spanning source systems, transformation layers, and consumption assets. Define harvesting strategy, integration approach, and the binding model between business glossary and physical assets. * Data Classification and Protection Engineering: Develop classification and access control patterns, including attribute\-based access control policies, tagging automation, and dynamic masking within the enterprise data platform. Partner with cyber security on control design and evidence. * Solution Design and Technical Standards: Develop reusable governance components, libraries, and APIs, and establish the engineering patterns applied by other members of the team. Solve complex data management problems where existing approaches are insufficient, taking a new perspective on established solutions. Evaluate tooling and recommend platform capability, configuration, and integration approaches. * Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Act as a technical resource and mentor to less experienced engineers. Review work products and provide guidance on standards, design, and troubleshooting. Lead technical workstreams within governance programs, including effort scoping, delivery sequencing, and progress reporting. * Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with data owners, data stewards, platform engineering, enterprise architecture, and cyber security to translate governance policy into enforceable technical controls. Communicate technical design and trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders. **Minimum Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Five or more years of experience in data management, data engineering, or data governance engineering. * Advanced SQL proficiency and demonstrated proficiency in Python. * Demonstrated experience implementing at least one enterprise data management capability end to end, such as data quality, metadata and catalog, master data, or data access control. * Demonstrated ability to design technical solutions independently and defend design decisions to technical and business stakeholders, including experience working across multiple data domains or business functions. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience implementing controls in a SOX, NERC CIP, or privacy\-regulated environment. Gas and/or Electric Utility Industry experience preferred. * Certifications such as IAPP AIGP (AI Governance Professional), CIPP/CIPM, CDMP (data management), or CISA/CRISC. * 5–7 years or more in data governance, AI/ML risk, model risk management, IT compliance or audit. * At least 2 years working directly with AI/ML or generative AI systems, such as model reviews, use\-case intake or risk assessments. * Experience in a regulated industry like utilities, energy. Familiarity with NERC CIP, FERC or state public utility commission oversight is especially valuable. * Hands\-on use of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), ISO/IEC 42001 and 23894, and model risk guidance such as SR 11\-7\. * Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, U.S. state AI laws (for example, Colorado), and privacy rules like CCPA and GDPR. * Understanding of responsible AI principles: fairness, transparency, explainability, accountability, privacy and safety. Our culture is grounded in shared values and employee commitments that guide how we work, support one another, and grow together. **Our Values** Connected, Committed, Trustworthy, Safe **Our Employee Commitments** * Work that makes a difference * A team you can count of * Opportunities to grow * Rewards that help you thrive Xcel Energy provides job applicants reasonable accommodations for disabilities throughout the application process. If you are in need of an accommodation to complete the application process, now or at any time in the future, please complete the Applicant Accommodation Request Form. jobs.description: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced engineer to join the Behavior Evaluation team and play a pivotal role in measuring the safety of Zoox’s autonomous driving technology. The Behavior Evaluation is the team behind the behavioral part of Zoox’s estimate, quantifying how often the autonomy stack causes the vehicle to stop unexpectedly and how that maps to collision risk. You will work closely with a team of talented engineers and researchers in a fast paced, collaborative environment as Zoox expands to more cities and software releases. ### **In this role, you will:** * Build and maintain the Behavior Evaluation data pipelines (PySpark/zspark medallion architecture on Databricks, EMR Serverless and Airflow) that produce weekly per\-geofence estimates. * Turn the statistical method (sampling, triage weights, mileage sharing, projections) into tested, reproducible code with checks that fail loudly when the data is bad. * Build tools that cut the manual work in each weekly run. * Work with cross functional stakeholders so the methodology is applied consistently in code and in clearance reports. * Help adapt to new release methodologies and new geofences. ### **Qualifications:** * 7 \- 9 Years of experience or 5\+ years with a strong data\-platform track record * Expert Python, with production experience in PySpark/Spark and Pandas * Experience designing scalable batch data pipelines: orchestration, Delta/lakehouse tables, idempotent backfills * Solid grounding in applied statistics: sampling, weighting, estimators, confidence intervals * Strong testing and CI habits for data code ### **Bonus Qualifications:** * Experience with autonomous\-vehicle simulation, safety metrics or triage workflows * Experience putting ML models into production in a data pipeline * Experience with Databricks and AWS (EMR Serverless, S3\) There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That’s how we help brands exceed customer expectations. We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry’s most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, improved workplaces, and much more floor space. AutoStore – moving things forward. **The Role:** As a Mechanical Engineer at AutoStore, you will help develop the next generation of automated storage and retrieval systems that power warehouses around the world. You will contribute to the design, analysis, prototyping, testing, and production launch of innovative electromechanical products used in our robots, grids, bins, charging systems, and other emerging technologies. You will apply engineering fundamentals, simulation tools, and hands\-on product development experience to solve challenging technical problems and deliver reliable, manufacturable solutions. Working as part of the New Product Development Innovation Team in Atlanta, you will collaborate with mechanical, electrical, controls, software, manufacturing, and test engineers throughout the product development lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys taking ownership of technical problems, learning from experienced engineers, and contributing directly to products deployed in more than 1,600 AutoStore systems worldwide. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities** * Design mechanical components, assemblies, and mechanisms using 3D CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, or NX. * Perform engineering analyses including hand calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), tolerance analysis, and design trade studies to support product development decisions. * Develop concepts and detailed designs for robotic and electromechanical systems, balancing performance, cost, manufacturability, and reliability. * Build, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative testing and analysis. * Support laboratory testing activities, analyze test results, and incorporate findings into design improvements. * Collaborate with electrical, controls, and software engineers to develop integrated system solutions. * Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical problem\-solving activities across projects. * Support supplier engagement activities including part reviews, manufacturability discussions, and technical issue resolution. * Assist with product validation activities and engineering documentation. * Apply Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/DFA) principles to improve product quality, reliability, and production efficiency. * Create and maintain engineering drawings, specifications, bills of material, and other development documentation. Support new product introduction activities through prototype, pilot, and production phases. * **Key Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. * 3 \+ years of experience developing mechanical or electromechanical products. * Proficiency with 3D CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, NX, or similar platforms. * Experience performing engineering analysis using FEA tools such as Ansys, Simcenter, Abaqus, or equivalent software. * Familiarity with mechanical design fundamentals including materials, stress analysis, tolerance stack\-up analysis, and machine design. * Experience creating engineering drawings and applying GD\&T principles. * Understanding of design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM/DFA). * Experience supporting prototype builds, testing activities, and product validation efforts. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot mechanical systems and identify root causes. * Ability to communicate effectively with cross\-functional teams. Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a team environment. * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience developing robotic systems, automation equipment, industrial machinery, or other electromechanical products. * Familiarity with dynamic analysis, kinematics, multibody simulation, or motion system design. * Hands\-on experience with motors, gearboxes, conveyors, lifting mechanisms, bearings, sensors, or other mechatronic components. * Experience with additive manufacturing, rapid prototyping, or laboratory test equipment. * Exposure to reliability testing, environmental testing, or failure analysis. * Experience using MATLAB, Python, or other engineering tools for data analysis and automation. * Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems such as Teamcenter or Windchill. * Experience working with suppliers and contract manufacturers. Knowledge of warehouse automation, robotics, logistics systems, or material handling equipment. * **We Offer:** AutoStore believes in taking care of employees and is dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. Join us in our mission to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution * Generous Paid Time Off including 12 holidays, paid exercise time, paid volunteer time, and paid parental leave plans for all new parents * Retirement 401(k) plan with employer match and discretionary profit sharing contribution * Educational assistance and professional development programs, including mentorship/coaching programs with external industry leaders Additional benefits include Group Life Insurance, Voluntary Additional Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance programs, and more! * AutoStore is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy\-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. *AutoStore does not accept agency resumes or assistance for this role. Please do not forward resumes to our job's alias or AutoStore employees. AutoStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. This policy should be respected.*

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Operations and Reliability
jobs.description: **About Nscale** ---------------- Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost\-effective, high\-performance infrastructure for AI start\-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI\-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future. **About The Role** ------------------ We're hiring a **Senior Infrastructure Engineer — Operations \& Reliability** to help operate and improve Nscale's OpenStack\-based cloud infrastructure. You should have a passion for cloud infrastructure and open\-source platforms to join our expanding System Engineering function. This role is pivotal in establishing our follow\-the\-sun operational model, providing critical coverage for live services during regional operational windows. You will support live services, resolve incidents across Linux, OpenStack, networking, and virtualization, and work with infrastructure and systems engineering colleagues across time zones. Since then, Pura has grown into a company that sells a fragrance every 3\.7 seconds, partnering with iconic brands like Curio, Anthropologie, and Disney. We’ve been recognized as the Fastest Growing Company in Utah, and we are passionate about making scent a core part of life’s most memorable moments. ### **Your Role at Pura:** As a **Software Engineer (Junior / Mid\-Level)**, you will build and improve the backend services that power Pura’s smart fragrance devices, learning from experienced engineers while shipping production code from your first weeks. You will help us inspire a belief in the power of fragrance to **craft and elevate memorable moments** for our Owners. This is your chance to make an impact in a high\-growth company that’s redefining the way people experience scent. **What You’ll Own:** * Build features: Implement well\-scoped features and bug fixes in our services with guidance from senior engineers * Write quality code: Write clean, tested, and documented code, and take part in code reviews * Learn our stack: Grow your skills in Go, Elixir, TypeScript, and AWS * Support production: Help monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues using logs, metrics, and dashboards * Contribute to infrastructure: Gradually work with Terraform and observability tools like Grafana and OpenTelemetry * Collaborate: Work with teammates and cross\-functional partners to understand requirements and deliver solutions **Essential Functions:** * Participate in team planning, standups, and retrospectives. * Contribute to documentation and runbooks as you learn our systems. * Lead and participate in special projects and assignments as required. **Qualifications:** * 1\-2\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Proficiency in at least one modern programming language. Experience with Go, Elixir, or TypeScript is a plus. * Familiarity with AWS or another cloud platform is a plus. Exposure to Terraform, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry is nice to have. * Solid understanding of software fundamentals such as data structures, APIs, databases, and testing. * Curiosity, a willingness to learn, and openness to feedback. * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. **Pura’s Culture** Our culture is built on a foundation of innovation, collaboration, inclusivity, and being good humans. We believe in fostering an environment where creativity thrives, empowering each team member to contribute their unique perspectives and skills. Our commitment to sustainability and integrity drives our decisions, ensuring that we not only create exceptional products but also contribute positively to our community and the planet. We celebrate diversity and prioritize open communication, cultivating a supportive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and inspired to push boundaries. Together, we’re not just building a brand—we’re creating a movement that redefines the role of fragrance in our lives. ### **Join the Pura Team!** We’re looking for individuals who believe in the power of fragrance and technology to transform lives. jobs.description: **Location: Traveling position. Work at customer job sites nationwide.** **Department**: Operations / Project Delivery Reports To: Mechanical Installation Manager **Role Type**: Technical Leadership / Individual Contributor **Who We Are** -------------- Zone 4 is a nationwide leader in the design and installation of advanced material handling systems, specializing in conveyor, robotic automation, automated storage and retrieval systems (AS/RS), multi\-shuttle, mini\-load, and high\-density racking systems. Headquartered in Orange, CA, Zone 4 serves blue\-chip clients across retail, e\-commerce, logistics, grocery, and other industries. With over 15 years of experience, Zone 4 provides nationwide installation services for projects of varying size and complexity. At Zone 4, we combine advanced planning, transparent alignment, and accountable execution to elevate outcomes and build trust with our customers and partners. **Role Purpose** ---------------- The Conveyor Mechanical Installation Subject Matter Expert (SME) provides expert\-level technical leadership for the planning, installation, alignment, quality control, mechanical completion, and turnover of conveyor and related material handling equipment. This role establishes technical installation standards, supports project launches and ongoing field execution, resolves complex mechanical installation issues, and develops the capabilities of Zone 4’s mechanical field teams. The Conveyor Mechanical Installation SME is a hands\-on technical leader and escalation point who works closely with the Mechanical Installation Manager, project management, engineering, safety, quality, procurement, field leadership, controls, commissioning teams, vendors, and OEM partners. The role supports projects from internal handoff through mechanical completion and may initially serve as a site launch lead on major projects while reviewing and supporting additional sites. **Scope of Responsibility** --------------------------- * Technical installation standards for conveyor, sortation, robotic interfaces, platforms, guarding, and related material handling equipment * Pre\-mobilization review of contract scope, layouts, mechanical drawings, bills of material, installation schedules, and project risks * Project launch planning, site\-readiness verification, field kickoff, benchmarks, control lines, elevations, and installation sequencing * Field troubleshooting, technical escalation, installation oversight, dimensional control, and quality assurance * Mechanical completion, punch\-list resolution, and handoff to controls and commissioning teams * Technical training, mentoring, and development of installers, leads, foremen, and new site leaders * Compliance with approved drawings, manufacturer requirements, customer standards, OSHA requirements, and Zone 4 procedures * Material receiving, staging, inventory control, equipment planning, and protection against loss or damage * Field documentation, launch plans, progress tracking, open\-issue logs, written handoffs, closeout input, and lessons learned **Key Outcomes** ---------------- * Conveyor mechanical installations consistently meet approved drawings, elevations, alignment tolerances, manufacturer requirements, safety expectations, and Zone 4 standards * Projects launch with clear scope, site organization, crew plans, installation sequence, material flow, safety requirements, and sustainable production targets * Gaps, site conflicts, material constraints, and technical risks are identified early and resolved with minimal schedule or cost impact * Site leads and foremen consistently execute effective daily planning, manpower tracking, reporting, quality control, and customer communication * Mechanical completion and handoff to controls and commissioning teams occur with minimal open work or repeat punch\-list items * Standard work, launch checklists, installation methods, and quality checkpoints are implemented across projects * Rework, installation delays, damaged material, and other costs of poor quality are reduced * Lessons learned are captured and integrated into estimating, engineering, project management, training, and future execution plans **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- **Technical Expertise \& Guidance (Primary Focus)** --------------------------------------------------- * Provide expert\-level guidance for the mechanical installation of conveyor, sortation, transfers, merges, diverts, platforms, guarding, robotic interfaces, and related material handling equipment * Interpret contract scope, mechanical layouts, elevations, sections, details, bills of material, OEM documentation, and installation schedules * Serve as the technical escalation point for complex layout, fit\-up, elevation, alignment, support, guarding, equipment\-interface, and installation challenges * Maintain current knowledge of conveyor technologies, installation methods, tooling, equipment, inspection practices, and applicable saf ting, mechanical completion, and turnover activities * Strong working knowledge of conveyor supports, drives, belts, chains, rollers, transfers, sortation equipment, guarding, platforms, and mechanical interfaces * Experience with benchmarks, control lines, elevations, precision measurement tools, laser layout equipment, alignment methods, and dimensional verification * Experience developing execution plans, crew and equipment requirements, SOPs, launch checklists, quality standards, and technical training * Ability to communicate effectively with field personnel, customers, engineers, project managers, vendors, OEMs, controls teams, and commissioning personnel * Ability to travel extensively and support active project sites, including extended assignments during initial onboarding **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with belt, roller, chain, MDR, pallet, overhead, vertical, sortation, merge, divert, and specialty conveyor systems * Experience with robotic cells, AS/RS interfaces, shuttle systems, platforms, catwalks, guarding, chutes, and workstations * Experience supporting mechanical completion, controls checkout, commissioning, customer acceptance, and system startup * OSHA 30, competent\-person, fall\-protection, lift, rigging, forklift, or manufacturer\-specific certifications * Experience acting as a mechanical Site Lead, superintendent, installation manager, quality lead, startup lead, or technical trainer **Travel \& Initial Assignment Expectations** --------------------------------------------- This position is expected to travel approximately 70% to 90%. Initial assignments may include leading the pre\-mobilization and first\-week launch of major conveyor projects, coaching the assigned site lead, and reviewing additional sites from an organization, quality, and execution standpoint. The Travel will require ability to fly and utilize a rental car. **Success Metrics/ KPIs (in order of greatest importance)** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Conveyor installation quality, first\-pass acceptance, and reduction in rework, alignment failures, and punch\-list items * Safety compliance across lift operation, fall protection, rigging, material handling, JHAs, and pre\-task planning * Project\-launch effectiveness, including site readiness, crew setup, material flow, field controls, and achievement of sustainable production targets * Accuracy of layout, elevation, level, straightness, alignment, support installation, guarding, and equipment\-interface verification * Effectiveness and speed of technical issue resolution, escalation management, and recovery planning * Mechanical completion readiness and quality of handoff to electrical, controls, and commissioning teams * Installation productivity and schedule performance without compromising safety or quality * Field leadership capability growth, training completion, and demonstrated improvement in planning, reporting, and customer communication * Adoption and effectiveness of standard work, launch checklists, installation SOPs, quality checks, and lessons learned across projects * Customer, OEM, project management, engineering, controls, commissioning, and field leadership satisfaction with technical support **Role Impact** --------------- This role strengthens Zone 4’s ability to safely and consistently launch and deliver complex conveyor mechanical installations. The Conveyor Mechanical Installation SME provides the technical depth and field leadership needed to improve pre\-mobilization planning, project startup, constructability, installation quality, mechanical completion, and commissioning readiness. By standardizing methods, coaching field leaders, resolving complex issues, and converting lessons learned into repeatable practices, this position directly supports predictable execution, lower cost of poor quality, customer confidence, and the continued growth of Zone 4’s mechanical installation organization.
